Oh yum! This is a great substitute for my favorite coffee ice cream even with my dieter's tweaks. I used fat free half-and-half, Cool Whip Free and sugar free pudding mix. I ran short of instant coffee so I added some instant espresso.  Talk about a quick buzz!  It is _icy_ so I slurped it through a straw less it go to my head! ;-) Thanks for posting your recipe.  I'm sure to use it often this summer.
Terrific.  Not something that can be done on the spur of the moment...........but well worth the time and labor involved!!!!  Really good homemmade wings!

Wow--were these ever good!  I used them in a trifle along with pound cake, vanilla pudding, Grand Marnier and whipped cream--great combo!  Had a few berries left that were wonderful on vanilla ice cream!

Really good recipe.  I rolled the stuffed steak pieces in Wondra flour and then browned them in mix of butter and olive oil.  I used a cornbread stuffing mix as another reviewer suggested.  I replaced the  water with the same amount of beef stock and used the broth to deglaze the pan I had browned the meat in then added it to step 5 .  Thanks so much for posting this.

These were a big hit with DH and I,  we both enjoyed them for supper and then the next day for our lunches!
The only change I made was to NOT saute the spinach--simply piled it onto the hot chicken mixture added more grated fontina and wrapped them and popped in the oven!
Thanks for posting this recipe, I'm sure we'll be having them again and again.

Really great--simple-delicious-fun!I added some fried peppers, onions and mushrooms in place of the black olives(none in the cupboard).  Mine baked in approximately 18 minutes!  We both really loved this and DH took the leftovers for his lunch the next day--he said it warmed up fine in the microwave.  Thanks for posting this!
Really enjoyed the burger. Made exactly as written. We love to try new burgers, and this has turned out to be one one of our favorites. Thanks for the keeper Chef # 363.
Really enjoyed this. Two of my grandsons spent the weekend with us at the lake, and they both loved this dish...a very rare and unusual occurance. Thanks for the keeper, Chili Spice.
Good!

We have been making this chili for a few years now, and it is the very best. It also freezes well ,so sometimes I double the recipe just so I can have extra in the freezer for when I'm to busy to cook.I'm so glad to see it posted just in case I misplace my copy.Thanx
Wow what a fantastic cocktail!!!! I plan on making this alot thanx for the recipe
Very good eggs.I also think the capers make them special. thanx for sharing the recipe
I served these on St. Patrick's Day for my Bunko Party....and they were a hit!!!!! THANX for sharing your recipe!!!

This is good tea. I like the flavor of Thyme. I put a little bit of honey and lemon juice in mine and it was good. I had a stomach ache last night and this really helped it. Thanks for a great recipe. Made for the Feb 2008  Bevy Tag game.

These pancakes were pretty good. They were easy  to make. However, I made me one pancake. When I went to make another one, the batter had discolored. It was weird. I didn't make another one because of it. I don't know what caused the discoloration. I made them a second time, but on another day, but that time  I purt plastic wrap over the top of the bowl and put it in the refrigerator  to let the flavors meld a little bit, and I wanted to see if the batter would discolor again, and it did. Other than that, these pancakes are good. The syrup has a good flavor that enhances the flavor of the pancakes. Good luck with the contest. I will probably make these again and just get used to the batter discoloring. Good luck in the contest.

This is a very good drink. I thought it would be too strong for me but it wasn't. just right proportions of the ingredients.  I will definitely be making this drink often. Thanks for sharing your recipe Julie. Made for the PAC Spring '08 game.

This was good!! The french toast did taste like a snickerdoodle cookie. It was easy and quick to make. Has ingredients I usually have on hand. I will be making this again. Especially for kids. Thanks for sharing your recipe iewe made for PAC Spring '08

These are really good potatoes. They were easy to make.  I used white potatoes. The flavors blended really well together, I usually have gravy on my mashed potatoes, but with these, I don't have to make gravy. I will be making these again, Thanks for sharing your recipe. Made for PAC Spring '08.

This is a good drink. A little strong but good. I used Tequila Rose Strawberry Liqueur. A nice combination of flavors. I think next time I make it, I will add more pineapple juice. Thanks for sharing your recippe Amanda. Made for ZWT 4-Greece and the Cafe ZMAKK Gypsies.

These were good but just a little too much Mayonnaise for me. The horseradish added a little zing to it. I think it needs a little bit more flavor to it. Maybe  add some chopped dill pickles to it. Thanks for sharing your recipe Sarah. Made for ZWT 4-EE

This  made this last night, I didn't have any Amarula like I thought I did when I first decided to make this for the ZWT Dessert Challenge. I used Hot Dam*! Cinnamon Schnapps as a sweetener instead of sugar   For some reason my whipping cream didn't whip up very well. That's okay I used it anyways. It sweetened the oatmeal without being too sweet or overpoering the oatmeal. I used 2 shots of the Hot Damn! which was just about right. Thanks for sharing your recipe Engrossed. Made for the ZWT Dessert Challenge and the Cafe ZMAKK Gyosies.

This were really delicious! I made pancakes instead of waffles. I scaled it down to one serving. For the egg, I  beat one egg in a cup and poured  half of it into the sour cream.  I am not a milk drinker so I didn't have any whole milk,. I mixed a little bit of water with some Half and Half. about 2 to 1 Two parts Half and Half and  one .part water. It worked out quite well.I had Cardamom powder instead of ground.  II had to double the Cardamom to even taste it. It all worked out to be the perfect amount of batter. It made 2 pancakes, which was the perfect amount  I will be making this again.The Directions were easy to follow. Thanks sister gypsy for sharing your recipe. This was made for ZWT 4 Family picks and the Cafe ZMAKK Gypsies

This was a little bit too strong for me. I added 2 1/2 ounces  creamto the drink,. and it was still a little strong. It had a good flavor tho. If I were to make it again, I would use a little less of the liqueurs. Thanks for sharing your recipe Mary. Made for ZWT 4
This is a good drink. The pineapple juice and the strawberry liqueur went well together. I will make this drink again Thanks for sharing your recipe Amanda. Made for ZWT 4 and the Cafe ZMAKK Gypsies.

This was excellent.  Flavor was just what I was looking for.  I used boneless chicken breast halves but other than that made as directed.  We grilled this outside about 4 minutes on each side and it was perfect.  Thanks Lynn

This was absolutely wonderful. Great flavors with a slight crunch from the ramen noodles. I will probably toaste the noodles next time and add them just before serving, but either way is wonderful. Loved the dressing. Thanks Marsha for a keeper.

This was excellent.  Loved the flavor in this.  I was really surprised when the honey mixture didn't melt off the tenderloin but it didn't.  I did not pat dry the tenderloins when I removed them from the marinade just added them to the honey mixture.  Took some time to get the meat coated but well worth it.  My tenderloin was almost 2 pounds so I doubled up on everything and it turned out just great.  Cooked it for about an hour to 160.  I will be making this again.  Thanks LifeIsGood for a real keeper.

These were really nice for lunch today.  They were fairly easy to put together too.  I could not find edam cheese so left it out but other than that made as written.  I'll probably add more pepperoni next time.  Thanks BK for sharing.

What a great combination in the wonderful sandwich.  I loved everything about it.  I only have smoked bacon, so that is what I used and it was just wonderful.  You did a good job on this one.  thanks. :)

Excellent Tuscan Soup.  Very easy to put together and the flavors were great.  I did use more chicken stock and let it reduce some and used 2% milk in place of the evaporated/heavy cream, but I don't think it changed the flavors at all.  Oh, and I could not find cannellini beans, so used great northern, which we love.  Congrats on getting the SI in the Game Forums.

What a great way to get those vegetables into your diet.  The flavors were just wonderful.  I left off the cheese because I didn't want the extra calories, but that would have just added to the recipe which I thought was fine without.  So glad I found this.  thanks Kim
We loved this.  Tried it warm and cold but prefer the warm best.  The lemon caper vinaigrette really adds a nice touch to one of my favorite vegetables.  Thanks Gator.

Really don't know why this is called an American Sirloin Steak, but it was good and tasteful.  I did marinade mine overnight for more flavor.  It was tender and juicy, even though DH over cooked.  I tripled the garlic and used red wine vinegar which I thought would go well with this and I think it did.  Thanks Boomette.

This was great.  I wasn't sure about grapefruit in a salad but it worked so well.  The grapefruit was very sweet and juicy so it was great.  I did add a little more honey to the dressing and dry pan browned the walnuts but other than that made as directed.  Loved it.  thanks Boomette
What a nice flavor this has.  It goes really well together. I only had Malibu Rum, but it went very well with the melon flavor.  Thanks for sharing and you ought to try it.
What a wonderful, fun snack to make. So easy to prepare. So full of flavor. I only made half the recipe but I wish I'd made more. DH ate almost the whole batch. Thanks BK for a wonderful keeper.

DH and I agreed that there was just something missing in this combination of flavors.  Don't have a clue what, but it just didn't come together for us.  A little on the tart size.  I made as written except did not have kaiser rolls so used hamburger buns and provolone cheese instead of the swiss.  Thanks France.  Made for Spring Spectacular

What a great and easy to make breakfast this made.  I followed the directions except added some sliced red onion and a little salt and pepper.  Very filling.  This makes 2 servings for me.  Thanks Lainey.
This was easy to put together but for us we thought the basil dressing drowned out all the other flavors.   Very strong flavor.  And I only used a little over a third of a cup of basil.

This was just excellent.  Loved the dressing.  It was perfect.  I would have liked a little more color for appearance.  I added some red onion and sliced red pepper.  The options are endless.  Thanks Syd.  Made for Camera-less-chef game.

We really enjoyed this.  The marinade is full of flavor and I made as written.  The weather was so bad that I wasn't able to grill it so I turned it into a stir-fry which worked very well.  Thanks Gator.  I'll make this again.

I love everything about this recipe.  I'd give it more stars if I could.  What an unusual sauce.  Just wonderful.  I made as written with the exception of using boneless skinless chicken thighs.  Very moist and tender.  Thanks ZWT 4

Excellent Spinach salad.  I cut this down for the two of us and only omitted the mushrooms, for personal taste.  Used red onion because that was all I had.  Fresh tomatoes from the garden were wonderful on this.  I cheated too and used bacon bits (sorry) Very nice with our Chicken Paprika.  Thanks Hokie.  Made for SSC Pet Parade.

I'll add my 5 stars to this one.  Moist and juicy it was.  So easy to prepare too.  The only thing I did different was to make slits in the roast and insert slices of garlic.  Yummy.  My roast was only about 3 lbs and it was much more done that the photos show, but that was done because this is one slice of meat we like more done than the others.  Don't even know why.  Served this with recipe #266053 as suggested and also some mushroom/onion gravy.  Very good recipe.  Thanks

This was very good.  Loved the individual servings.  I cooked my potates too long and this turned out more like mashed potatoes rather than potato gratins, but the flavor was all there.  I too don't know what tasty cheese is so I used a sharp cheddar and that worked well for us.  Thanks for sharing.  Made for SSC Pet Parade.

What a great ideal for this combination.  Loved everything about it.  I used 2 small jalapenos from my garden and used splenda in place of the sugar, but other than that made as directed.  This complimented recipe #312374 so well.  Thanks so much for sharing.  Made for SSC Pet Parade.

This is so quick and easy to put together.  I had some homemade pizza sauce that I used for this.  I'll add more cheese next time but other than that, a perfect recipe when you want something quick.  Thanks  Made for SSC Pet Parade.

This was really good.  Loved the mayo cheddar topping.  Almost tasted like a BLT.  The only problem I had was that my crust got soggy.  I may take the seeds and membranes out of the tomatoes next time.  I also added some sliced red onion to mine and some salt and pepper.  Thanks  Made for SSC Pet Parade.

This was an excellent taco salad.  I mixed the dressing with the light sour cream, taco seasoning and green chilies and let that chill for about an hour.  The placed the lettuce on top of some Taco Flavored doritoes, topped that with the remaining ingredients, with the addition of black beans and a little cheddar cheese.  Put the dressing on top for a wonderful meal.  I made taco meat for DH because I knew he would want some meat, but I didn't miss it at all.  Thanks.  Made for SSC Pet Parade.

OMG This was just wonderful.  Flavors blended so well together.  I refused to spend almost $3 for a red pepper so I left it out, but other than that, and scaling it down for the 2 of us, made as directed.  I really didn't think the potatoes would heat through in the 20-25 minutes stated time, but I was so wrong.  Perfect.  Thanks.  Made for SSC Pet Parade

Excellent dinner rolls Boomette.  I followed the directions, but used splenda in place of the sugar and doubled the yeast.  I also skipped the glaze and that is probably why my rolls only browned slightly.  The texture and flavor were perfect.  So easy to make too.  The dough is slightly sticky, so I oiled my hands prior to making each roll.  They rose beautifully.  I think next time I'll increased the temperature to 375 or 400 degrees, since it took a little longer for mine to cook, but I was also trying to get them to brown more.  Thanks for sharing.  Made for SSC Pet Parade

This was so good.  Very very moist on the inside at 40 minutes of cooking time.  I also skipped the butter, therefore forgot about the oregano.  But it turned out great anyway.  Nice and crisp on the outside and so juicy on the inside with a cheese surprise.  Thanks  Made for SSC Pet Parade

I made this to take to a cookout tonight, but after my first sample, I know it's going to be a hit.  Love the addition of the kidney beans and the bacon.  Just a really good combination going on in this one.  Thanks.  Made for SSC Pet Parade

We made a batch of these up last night to celebrate getting  a new car and loved them.  Although I looked in several liquor stores I could not find strawberry schnapps so had to use Raspberry, which really turned out great.  Thanks so much for sharing.  Made for SSC Pet Parade

Excellent southern Sweet Tea. I cut the recipe in half also to fit my picture. Followed the directions with the exception of replacing the sugar with splenda, adding a slice of lemon and it was perfect. Mine came out much darker than the photos already posted, but it was not too strong for us. Thanks for sharing. Made for SSC Pet Parade

This was excellent.  The flavors went very well together and the wine gave that little bit extra touch.  I did reduce the wine some, which is probably why I didn't get a nice sauce as described, but it infused into the rest of the ingredients so much that I'll probably do that again next time.  Great flavor.  Thanks so much for sharing.

These are just excellent Egg Rolls.  Very easy to put together.  I did make just a few changes, such as slicing the carrots into thin strips instead of shredding them and chopped up my mushrooms instead of slicing them.  I didn't have dark soy sauce so used 3 tablespoons of low sodium, which worked well for us.  I used egg roll wraps instead of the spring rolls, just easier for me to work with and I also sealed the wraps with an egg wash.  These were just excellent and I know I'll be making them again.  Served this with my recipe #216107

Excellent, but not enough dressing for us. I tripled the dressing because this was a main dish for dinner. I left out the celery and carrots and went with the green onions only. I used chicken tenders and sauteed them in the oil and hot sauce and this worked out really well. Wonderful flavor in the chicken and the blue cheese dressing went great with the heat. Thanks Made for I Recommend.

CB you have a real winner here.  Loved the combination of spinach, chicken and cheese and the black beans and corn just added to it.  I didn't used the frozen spinach.  I took a couple of handfulls of fresh spinach and sauted that in a little olive oil with some chopped garlic.  That added a lot of goodness to this dish I think.  DH requested cheese on top while baking and that turned out well too.  Love the dip.  Just Excellent.  Thanks CB  Made for Adopte a Tag '08

Excellent   Just the right amount of cream cheese and seasoning.  My bacon would not cooperate with me so I removed the fat and layed strips of lean meat on top of each pepper.  Worked out great.  Other than that make as written.  Made for Went to the Market.  Thanks
So easy and great tasting.  Loved the crispiness that this produced.  Served this with sour cream.  I did use kosher salt instead of sea salt since that was what I had.  Thanks.  Made for PRMR

Excellent side dish and very easy to put together.  I only had a 13 oz bag of broccoli but kept everything else the same.  I didn't use all the breadcrumbs because of the samller size and there were still a lot.  I think next time I'll decrease them to maybe one cup.  Flavor was excellent.  Thanks and congrats on the football win.

I made this as directed with only a few alterations.  I adding just a little extra garlic.  I could not get the sauce to thicken so it turned out really runny.  The flavor was good.  I think next time I'll add some crushed red pepper flakes to give it a little zip.  My scallops were very large so cooking time was about 15-20 minutes.  I used Fat Free half and half for the cream to decrease the calorie intake.  Very nice.  Served this with recipe #240223 and some roasted potatoes and red pepper, garlic and onion.  Thanks

This was a very nice chowder.  It didn't have as much heat as I expected.  Very quick and easy to make.  I added a little cooked chopped bacon that I had left over from breakfast which gave it a nice smokey taste.  Used 2% milk in place of the cream.  Thanks for sharing.
These were very nice, even though mine turned out a little on the dry side.  I like the fact that they are not real sweet.  Great flavor and easy to put together.  thanks  Made for Tic-Tac-Toe

Excellent Sandwich.  Loved the lemon pepper seasoning along with the bacon and cheese.  I didn't put tomatoes or lettuce on it but did use some sliced red onion.   Broiled my French  bread for a few minutes which worked well for this.  Thanks appleydapply for a great lunch.  Made for Tic-Tac-Toe

How sinful are these.  Don't care.  They are absolutely wonderful and filling, so you don't eat much.  I made this as directed, with the exception of  increasing the season salt a little and doubled the onion salt.  I used light cream cheese and light butter to decrease the calories a little.  Loved the flavor the seasoning gave to these potatoes.  Thanks Lainey.  Made for Tic-Tac-Toe

What a beautiful side dish to serve.  Flavor was all there too.  I doubled this so I had some left to take to work.  If you like spinach, you will love this.  thanks for sharing.  Made for I Recommend Tag Game.

This is so simple to make and just full of flavor.  The cider vinegar and oil really went well bringing out the full flavor of the vegetables.  I used extra virgin Olive oil.   Just loved it.  And it really presents well with all the color.  Thanks breezermom  Made for Tic-Tac-Toe

Oh this is just excellent. The flavors were perfect. I made half the recipe for next weeks lunches.  I used a can of diced tomatoes with garlic and basil, so left out the fresh basil and that worked well for me.  Other than that, I made as written.     Thanks so much for sharing.

Well I'll be. This turned out so good and pretty too. I thought it was going to be way too sweet, but it wasn't. I'll have to keep this around. I tried the Russian Bubblegum which was just awesome. I'll work my way through the rest of the recipes listed. Thanks so much Annacia and to BK also for sharing this. You just have to try it. As Andi would say "yummers". :)
UPDATE 11/2:  Well I've now tried the Bazooka Frosty.  What a refreshing drink.  All the flavors just blended so well together with a hint of the bubblegum flavor.  I made this on the rock because I was to lazy to get my blender out to crush ice.  Thanks so much for sharing this great drink.

The black beans add real depth to this recipe. Loved it. I smashed 1/2 of the black beans as suggested. Thanks Made for Zaar Stars
UPDATE:  The serving sizes for my family is 2.  I watched my DH and SIL inhale this salsa in a matter of 20 minutes.  Puff-gone..... :)
Excellent.  I would not change a thing about this recipe, except I used a full teaspoon of red pepper flakes.  Simple and bold flavors that are just perfect.  Thanks Jackie.  Made for Tic-Tac-Toe  :)

Excellent.  Loved the addition of the chives.  I've made mashed potatoes with buttermilk before and really like it.  DH usually doesn't eat leftover potatoes but he asked me to save these tonight.  Very fluffy and very good.  Thanks  Made for Tic-Tac-Toe

We loved this.  What a great flavor the marinade gave to the chicken thighs.  It was too windy to grill and I'm still not comfortable with my broiler, so I baked these for about 20-25 minutes at 400 and they turned out perfect.  I didn't used any of the marinade to baste the thighs with when cooked, but did take some of the pan juices and pored that over them just before serving.  We will be making this again for sure.  Thanks Ms. T.

These were excellent, but I just didn't get why they were called Sausage Rolls.  I could not find ground chicken at the store so I made these with "sausage".  We loved them.  Even the seasoning went well with the sausage as did the lemon mayo, which I estimated because of the conversions to US.  Kind of surprised me a little.  They were easy to make.  I cooked the sausage before adding to the rest of the mixture and they were cooked perfect in 35 minutes at 375 F.  The lemon mayo added a nice touch.  Thanks bluemoon.  Made for PRMR

OMG Lainey, you have really produced a winner in this Mac and Cheese.  As you mentioned you do have to ignore conventional wisdom about cooking pasta, but I followed this recipe to the T, with the exception of making half of it.  The end result was a beautiful creamy dish with a wonderful flavor of the three cheeses and the addition of a crunchy top.  Warning, as with all broiling, watch closely that last minute.  I had a couple of places get a little toasted, but no matter, it was good anyway.  I broiled mine on low broil for 7 minutes, should have been 6 for my oven.  Thanks Lainey.  Made for PRMR

This was so easy to make.  I followed the directions to the T but as Lainey stated, I think next time I will cover it before baking.  Mine turned out somewhat dry, even covering it the last 15 minutes of cooking time.  I also saute fresh mushrooms in a little butter and added that instead of the canned.  I also added extra cheddar cheese to the top.  Thanks for sharing.

I'm really only rating the lemon, butter, caper sauce of this recipe since I made my fish using my own recipe.  I've never had any luck cooking fish the way written in this recipe.  We deep fried some fresh bass and used this sauce with it.  It was excellent and I loved it.  Did add some extra lemon juice directly to the fish, but I like a little fish with my lemon.  The caper flavor really added a lot to the overall taste.  Will be making this again for my next fish fry.  Thanks for sharing.  Made for New Kids on the Block.  :)

I made this Monday night to serve to a group of ladies last night and it went over very well.  It served 9 of us.  Although it went over very well with our friends, both my sister and I thought it was very bland.  I'll make this again, but add some additional spices or some peppers.  I did like the fact that it had no can soup in it.  Thanks Lainey.  Made for Zaar Stars Tag Game.

We had a mixed review of the chili sauce tonight.  I loved it and DH said it was okay.  I think I'll decrease the basil next time.  The amount of garlic was perfect.  I baked this in the oven for 30 minutes at 400 degrees.  Thanks.  Made for 1-2-3-4 Hits.

This was a very nice potato soup.  I did add some extra bouillon granules and used sliced carrots because all I had were baby carrots.  Was just a little on the bland side for us, but would be great for kids to enjoy.  Served this topped with recipe #257588 which went very well with this soup.  Thanks.  Made for Holiday Tag Game.

Getting in from work and grocery shopping, these were such a treat.  We fixed our cocktails and stood around the bar and made these as we wanted one.  There a fun finger food and we loved them.  I can't fit a whole cracker or shrimp into my mouth so I cut each shrimp up and added it to the cream cheese and cocktail sauce then sprinkled with the green onion.  We are having these again tomorrow night at cocktail hour.  Thanks so much Hokie for a fabulous appetizer.  Plan to serve these at our big family Christmas dinner next week too.  Made for Holiday Tag Game.

This had a very nice flavor to it, using hot chili powder. However, the sauce had a tendency to burn to the baking pan and I could not get it to stay on the sausage.  I ended up serving this with some hot mustard and crackers for a nice snack.  Thanks Noo.  Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders Tag Game.
Loved it.  I used splenda but other than that made as directed.  Thanks diner.  Made for Zarr Stars
DH and I made these this afternoon and we loved them.  Great combination.  Thanks and congrats on winning Week #16 of the Football Pool.
Excellent.  What's not to love about butter, cheddar cheese, bacon and sour cream.  Loved it.  I made half the recipe for the two of us and that worked great.  Thanks for sharing.
OMG!!!  This is so good and does taste just like a Root Beer Float.  We loved it.  Certain to be made again.  Thanks diner.  Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders
OMG this is so good.  What a great after dinner drink this will be.  I used half & half, but it was still rich and very much enjoyed.  Thanks diner.  Made for I Recommend Tag Game

We really enjoyed the flavor of these fries.  For baked fries they turned out very nice and crispy.  The way we like them.  I was concerned that the parmesan cheese would burn before the potatoes were done, but it turned out perfect.  Thanks for sharing.  Made for I Recommend Tag Game.

These are very good, but would have liked more coffee flavor.  I used the sugar option (actually splenda) and added an additional 1 teaspoon.  Next time I make these I'm going to probably add 3-4 tsp of instant coffee powder, to give me my coffee fix.  Loved the flavor that the oats gave to the drink.  Thanks mersaydees. Made as a bonus tag in the Pot Luck Tag Game.

The caramelized onions are what make this a great burger.  I don't think I've ever tried A-1 so really didn't want to add it to the onions, but I did and loved it.  Added a really nice flavor that went so well with the burger.  I did season my burger with a Weber spice and added a little mustard, but other than that made as directed.  I made recipe #159517 to use for the hamburger bun, which worked very well.  Thanks Lainey for another keeper.  Made for Gimme 5 Tag Game.

Excellent Seafood Cocktail Sauce.  So much better than the bottled stuff.  I let this chill for about 2 hours and we loved it.  Added just a little more horseradish, but other than that made as written.  Thanks Bayhill.  Made for a bonus tag in Pot Luck tag game.

We loved this broccoli salad.  I used recipe #123766 for the Poppy Seed Dressing and it was perfect for this salad.  I left out the walnuts to cut some of the calories and really didn't miss them and only used 1/2 of an apple.  Before it even had time to sit my daughter scooped some up to take home with her.  We will make this one again for sure.  Made for a bonus tag in Pot Luck Tag Game

Excellent Chicken & Dumplings.  It just doesn't get any easier than this.  I doubled the recipe for company and after about 4 hours, I broke the dumplings up and stirred it and let it cook for an additional 2 hours.  Dumplings were great, however the sauce seemed to get really thick, so I'll play around with that the next time I make this.  We really enjoyed this.  Made for Pot Luck tag game.

This was very nice.  The sauce was great, but I only used 1 tsp of the roasted sesame oil from past experience using it.  I did increase the red pepper flakes for personal taste.  Used multi-grain angle hair pasta which worked well for us.  Really like it cold better than warm.  Thanks for sharing.  This has lots of possibilities.

Excellent baked beans.  Loved the way the sauce caramelized.  The texture was perfect.  I halved the recipe and kept the barbecue sauce and brown sugar the same as the whole recipe and that worked well for us.  Thanks so much for sharing.  Again Congratulations on winning the Pot Luck Special Event.

Excellent Chicken Scaloppine. What great flavor even without the wine. I used homemade chicken broth in place of the bouillon and white wine. I think it added an enriched flavor. I also dusted my chicken breast with a little flour before browning. Just before adding the chicken and mushrooms back to the sauce, I added a couple of tablespoons of cappers.  Yummy.  The sauce was just wonderful and the chicken was so moist and tender. Thanks so much for a keeper.

We really enjoyed this.  I didn't use the corn at the request of DH.  I used recipe #244839 for the taco seasoning and it was wonderful.  I doubled the Guacamole because we love it and added some garlic powder and onion powder along with some cayenne pepper to spice it up some.  I filled 2 full 2 tortillas with the whole mixture and added some extra cheese.  Then baked it at 425 degrees for about 14 minutes.  The tortillas were nice and crisp.  Thanks for sharing.

Excellent dish.  I used a California Blend of onion powder which really added a nice flavor.  Loved the addition of the lemon.  One I'll make again for sure when summer veggies are in season.  Thanks for sharing.

I loved this recipe.  I make my steaks using a very similar recipes and the lemon just adds so much flavor.  I forgot to add the Worcestershire sauce, but I didn't miss it at all.  I added a little extra lemon juice when served.  Thanks so much diner for a great dinner.
This is just wonderful.  The flavors blended very well together.  Dressing was perfect.  I forgot to add the sunflower seeds, but other than that made as written.  Thanks Syd.
Excellent.  The spice combination was perfect as was the cooking method.  Thanks so much for sharing.  I would not change a thing about this recipe.

This sauce was absolutely wonderful on some pan fried tilapia.  It had a perfect consistency that adhered to the fish very well.  The lemon flavor was right on.  I would not change a thing about this recipe.  Thanks diner.  Made for Photo Tag

We loved these.  I used the Pearl Red Onions which really worked well for me.  They did fall apart but really added a nice flavor.  Loved the addition of the lemon juice.  I'll admit though I used 2% milk instead of the cream, but I don't think it made one bit of difference to us.  Thanks for sharing.  Made for Pot Luck

This was just excellent.  Loved the fresh whole wheat breadcrumbs.  Came out so crisp and the chicken was nice and moist.  I used Italian seasoning and added about 1/2 tsp each of onion powder and garlic powder.  This would be very good on top of a salad.  After browning in the skillet I cooked in the oven at 350 for 30 minutes.  Perfect.  Served with Ranch Dressing and some honey for me.  Made for I Recommend Tag Game. :)

Dang these were good.  I will admit that I used half-and-half and 2% milk, but they turned out light and fluffy and delicious.  Added a little season salt also.  Liked the used of the yukon potatoes in this recipe.  Thanks so much for sharing.  Made for PAC Spring 2009 :)

This was just excellent.  The combination was perfect.  I also toasted my bread before adding the layers.  Used just a little salt and pepper and left out the cucumber, but other than that made as written.  Thanks for sharing.  Made for Please Review My Recipe tag game.  :)
We loved this.  Not only was it full of flavor, so simple to make.  Thanks for sharing.

Thanks for sharing this awesome Coffee drink.  I used 2% milk, light Cool Whip and I had planned to use sugar free pudding mix, but forgot to add it. I didn't realize that until I sat down to post my review.  Oops....  Tasted just fine to me.  I'll add the pudding next time.  But it was wonderful as is.  Nice coffee flavor.  Thanks.  Made for Zaar Star Tag Game. :)

OMG lazyme.  This is so good.  I made this for my sis and niece last night after dinner.  It was so nice outside, we took these to the patio and shared a wonderful evening.  Thanks.  Made for your cook-a-thon :)

Excellent.  I think this is the best homemade Mac and Cheese I've made thus far.  Very creamy and flavorful.  I made half the recipe and used non-fat half-and-half for the evaporated milk and it worked out great.  thanks so much for sharing your recipe.  :)
Excellent.  I cut this down for the two of us and we enjoyed every bite.  Excellent flavor combination.  I used a little extra cheese for mine and added a good portion of pepper.  Thanks for sharing.

This was very good.  I cut it down for the two of us and it still made a lot.  I think I'll increase the portion of eggplant to potatoes next time to get more eggplant flavor and may play around with the herbs some.  I did add a little Parmesan cheese to the top the last 5 minutes of baking.  A nice way to use eggplant.  Thanks bluemoon :)

Excellent.  So easy to make.  Loved the red pepper and red pepper flakes.  Gave it just the right amount of flavor.  I didn't serve this on pasta, as I also had it as a side dish.  When I do serve it on pasta, I think I'll thicken the sauce some.  Thanks BK for a wonderful recipe.  :)
Excellent burger.  I had to make my on the stove top because of all the rain we are having, but the flavors are perfect.  Loved the bacon cheese topping.  Thanks so much for sharing.  :)

I love this recipe.  The chicken was very moist and tender and the breading was full of flavor.  I didn't find that the bottom got soggy for me.  I forgot to add the butter to the stuffing mix so drizzled it over the top of the breaded chicken and that worked for me.  thanks so much for sharing.  :)

This was very good.  I served with a stir-fry beef dish and since the beef had garlic in it, I left out the garlic in the rice.  Loved the parmesan cheese.  Mine overcooked because I didn't adjust for 1/2 the recipe, my fault and not reflected in my review stars.  Thanks for sharing.  Made for WTTM :)

OMG Ms Andi, these are outstanding corn muffins.  Just the right amount of sweetness.  I really thought they were going to have a very powerful onion flavor, but it was just perfect for us.  Loved the hint of chili powder too.  I used lowfat buttermilk and light sour cream and left out the cilantro for personal preferences.  This will be great with any soups, stews or chili dishes this winter.  Thanks so much for sharing.  Made for LiveStrong :)

This is just excellent.  It really does taste like a banana split.  I doubled this for DH and I using regular ice cream and chocolate syrup, but the sugar free strawberry jam and 2% milk.  Very filling.  Thanks so much for sharing.  Made for Zaar Stars :)

OMG these are just excellent and so easy to make.  I used the grand biscuits, which I don't think worked as well as smaller biscuits would have, but still they were excellent.  I made my own Italian dressing for this.  Didn't really appreciate the sesame seeds, but that might have been because I only made 4 rolls.  You can bet I'll be making these again.  Thanks :)

I made this last night for dinner and we really enjoyed it.  As did another reviewer I added some sliced onion to the mixture and a little extra cheese, but other than that made as directed.  Thanks for sharing.  :)
Loved it.  This went very well on a spinach salad with tomatoes and red onion.  I'll be making this one again.  Thanks for sharing.  Made for WTTM tag game.  :)

The flavor of this steak was fantastic. I could not find the Southern Flavor charbroil seasoning so used Montreal Steak Seasoning, but the flavors were still great. We cooked in the dark so they got a little charred, but still cooked to our liking. Very moist and tender steak. Thanks for sharing. I plan to order the Southern flavor charbroil seasoning for out next cookout.
UPDATE:  I finally got the Southern flavor charbroil seasoning and it was just wonderful.  The steak had an excellent flavor with that addition.  Thanks for sharing.
Very good.  I think next time I'll use fresh broccoli instead of the frozen.  Mine got a little mushy.  Great combination of flavors.  Thanks for sharing.  Made for Zaar Stars.  :)

I'm so sorry but these just didn't work for us. Mashed potatoes are usually creamy as were mine and they were extremely hard to work with as far as the dipping in the egg and bread crumbs. I ended up spreading the egg mixture on with my fingers and then tossing them in the bread crumbs and then using a spatula, turn them over before adding to the oil. Very greasy. Made for PRMR
UPDATE:  I made these again with stiffer mashed potatoes that I chilled first and it worked much better for me.  A lot easier to work with.  Still a little on the greasy side, but we really enjoyed them.  Thanks GailAnn :)

Excellent flavors going on here.  I used a small Flank Steak and it turned out great.  I decreased the grilling time a little and I had a rare steak to serve.  Very tender for Flank Steak.  thanks for sharing.  Made for your win in the Summer Spectacular.  :)

Excellent.  Loved the addition of the sage.  I made mine on the grill and cooked for 15 minutes.  The bottom got a little brown, but tasted great.  thanks for sharing.  Made for you win in Summer Spectacular  :)

Excellent egg salad and the addition of the bacon just brought it to another level for me.  Made this for brunch this morning and really enjoyed it.  I made as written except I used fresh spinach instead of lettuce leaves since that was what I had.  Made for Holiday Tag :)

Loved everything about this recipe.  Although I probably didn't use the correct barbecue sauce, it was still just wonderful. (Part Mustard base, part tomato base and part chinese base by Paula Dean that I had made last month)  I used Pneuma's recipe #374040 for the jerk seasoning and it was perfect.  I left out the crushed pineapple only because I didn't have any and can only imagine that it would even add more flavor to this make again recipe.  Thanks breezermom for sharing.  Made for Holiday tag.   :)

I grilled some yellow squash, zucchini and English zucchini on the grill tonight and this Vinaigrette was just perfect for that combination.  The flavor really complimented the grilled veggies.  DH loved it.  I made as directed and would not change a thing.  Thanks.  Made for a bonus tag in Summer Spectacular 09 :)

EXCELLENT!!!!  I used McCormick's Gourmet Collection Cajun Seasoning which was excellent.  Instead of pan frying the chicken, I flattened them and threw them on the grill until the internal temp was 150 degrees.  Very juicy and tender to lay upon a bed of Spring Mix  greens.  The dressing was a little tart/mustardy so I added an extra tablespoon of olive oil and honey which made it perfect for us.  Thanks for a great dinner tonight.  Made for Holiday Tag.  :)

Excellent tuna sandwich.  I make mine very similar.  I had never tried the muenster cheese and was pleasantly surprised how well it went with this sandwich.  I'll use it again.  This goes together really quick.  I didn't shred my lettuce, just laid a nice piece on top and got to use fresh tomatoes from my garden for the first time this year.  Thanks for sharing.  Made for your win in Summer Spectacular 09 :)

EXCELLENT!  The flavors were just perfect for a delicious juicy burger.  I only had a pound of lean hamburger so I tried to adjust for that amount and probably added a little more barbecue sauce than I should have.  I'm just glad I had the bacon wrapped around it or it would have fallen apart.  The onion and bacon were cooked to perfection in 20 minutes.  Thanks FolkDiva.  Made for your win in the Summer Spectacular 09 :)

I made this last night and really enjoyed the combination of flavors.  I left off the brown sugar rimming but did add the cinnamon sprinkling.  Very nice Alli.  Thanks for sharing.  Made for Summer Spectacular 09 :)

Excellent.  I have nothing to compare this to as it is my first ever Shepherd's Pie.  I absolutely loved it.  With potatoes, beef and corn what is not to love.  My DD will really like this.  The only change I made was to use Rotel for the tomatoes to spice it up a little more for our taste.  Thanks CB for a real keeper.  Made for WTTM Tag Game :)

Excellent.  We really enjoyed the mustard sauce with this.  I grilled my tenderloin on the grill using indirect heat until the temp reached 140-150 (about 40-45 minutes) and let it sit for about 5 minutes.  Very tender and juicy and the outside had a wonderful glaze from the basting.  I'll be making this again.  Thanks.  Made for Summer Spectacular 09 :)

Excellent.  So easy to make too.  I used light butter and white onion (our preference)  and Parsley since I didn't have the dill.  Loved this version of cooking zucchini.  Thanks Acadia Made for Summer Spectacular 09 :)
Oh this is just sinful.  Wonderful combination.  I would not change a thing about this one.  Thanks Shuzbud.  Made for Summer Spectacular 09 :)

Annacia these carrots are so good.  Love the way the honey glazed them and the addition of the chicken broth really added flavor to one of my favorite veggies.  I did leave out the almonds to cut some of the calories and really didn't miss them at all but see where they would add to the recipe.  Thanks so much for sharing.  Cooking time was spot on.  Made for WTTM Tag Game :)

I made this last night for dinner and loved it.  As other reviewers, I used a whole egg and cheddar cheese.  The combination was fantastic with the spinach and mushrooms.  Mine was also done in about 2 1/2 minutes.   It just doesn't get any easier.  Thanks for sharing.  :)

Well DH wanted his usual hamburger with mustard and the fixens.  I made mine as per this recipe and absolutely loved it.  I never eat a whole burger, and DH decided mine was much better and finished it off for me.  Thanks for sharing this fantastic burger.  :)
This was very nice.  Good combination too.  Thanks.  Made for PRMR :)

Excellent.   I spiced it up a little by adding a little additional chili powder.    I used kidney beans since that was what I had on hand and scaled it down for one serving.  I had canned some salsa yesterday and that was what I used for this tonight.  Great stuff.  Thanks for sharing.  Made for WTTM :)

This was a very tasty dressing, but I don't think my avocado must have not been big enought because it didn't have a lot of avocado flavor.  I'll add two of them next time.  However, the salad was enjoyed with fresh tomatoes from the garden.  Thanks for sharing.  :)
Well I would have given these a 5 star review but DH just didn't care for them.  I made as directed and thought the flavor was excellent.  Thanks for sharing weekend cooker :)

This was far from quick and easy for me. Saying that I'm the slowest chopper ever. I had problems with the way the recipe was written and made some mistakes because of it (my fault) The 1 tsp of ground red pepper didn't have divided to warn you and the creole mustard, I think should have read 3 tablespoons, divided. Just would have made the recipe easier to read and follow. I ended up adding 1 tsp of ground red pepper to the Remoulade Sauce (my fault) The flavor was excellent (I used recipe #38148 for the Creole Mustard) Had a little trouble with the cakes separating and the edges crumbling off during the frying process. (May use an extra egg next time). All in all this was a very nice recipe with excellent flavor, even with the 1 tsp of cayenne pepper in the Remoulade Sauce. Thanks for sharing. Made for PRMR :)

DH raved about these.  What a great recipe.  I didn't use as much bacon as called for since my sprouts were so small (I used frozen).  The flavor was excellent.  I served this with the mustard sauce and also some ranch dressing.  I also used metal skewers instead of the tooth picks and placed them over a foiled rimmed pan since I didn't have a wire rack turning them over half way through cooking time.   Worked like a charm  Thanks so much for sharing.  Made for I Recommend

These are delicious.  My chicken turned out very tender and juicy and the veggies were crisp tender.  I doubled the marinade and I'm glad I did.  Used a lot more garlic (about 6 small cloves)  Ran out of the cherry tomatoes for the last 2 skewers, but that was okay.  Turned them about every 3 minutes and brushed with the reserved marinade.   Cooked a total of 15-18 minutes.  Just excellent.  Served this with new potatoes, sliced tomatoes and recipe #333099 :)  Made for PRMR  Thanks diner for sharing.

I thought this was excellent, although I didn't use the low fat cheddar as I don't keep that.  I did cut the Dijon mustard to 1 tsp and thought that was plenty for our taste and left out the salt all together.  Worked well for us and I'll make this again.  Thanks for sharing.  Made for I Recommend Tag game :)

This was very nice.  My only draw back was the sauce just didn't penetrate the meat the way I would have liked and it didn't cook long enough to really get a good caramelization going, which is what I was looking for.  The flavor was there though in this sauce.  I might marinade it next time.  Thanks for sharing.  Made for PRMR tag game :)

These were very good, although a little bland for us.  I grated my squash then squeezed it with paper towels to get the excess water out of it, which I think is a must with this recipe.  We did enjoy it as an alternative way to cook our abundant amount of squash from the garden.  Thanks for sharing.  Made for Holiday Tag :)

Excellent marinade for shrimp.  I had bought the type of shrimp that had been peeled with the tail still on so that is what I used.  Worked beautifully.  I only used one tablespoon of worcestershire sauce instead of the 2 for personal preference.  Thanks for sharing.  I'll make this again.  :)  Made for Holiday Tag
This is only the second time that I've had Captain Morgan and I really like it.  This was enjoyed this hot afternoon.  Made exactly as directed.  Thanks alli.  Made for Zaar Stars
I used my fresh garden tomatoes for this recipes and just loved it.  Made as directed except added some chopped garlic along with the parsley.  Thanks Sharon for sharing.  Made for PRMR :)

We really enjoyed this.  I sauteed the mushrooms in a skillet and had bacon already cooked from the morning, so this went together really fast.  After spreading the garlic butter over the bread, I baked it for about 15 minutes to get a nice golden brown then piled the mushroom and bacon on.  Sprinkled with the Worcestershire and a spritz of lemon.  I agree that the lemon just sends this over the top.  Thanks Pat for sharing.  We'll make this one again.

The 5 stars is for the flavor combination.  I used 4 boneless skinless chicken breast and cooked on low for 6 hours and they were so overcooked that we can barely eat them.  I used a sweet chili sauce so cut the brown sugar down to 1/4 cup and it was plenty sweet.  I want to make this again, but I think I'll bake it in the oven for about 30-40 minutes next time.  Thanks weekend cooker.  Made for zaar stars tag game.  :)

Skipped breakfast today so made this up for my lunch.  The flavors were so good.  And this is so easy to put together.  I didn't have the sugar free stuff so not as guiltless for me.  Thanks CB  Made for Holiday Tag :)
This was so good.  Loved the flavor combination.  :)

I may have just found a new favorite cocktail.  I does taste like tea.  I left out the gin (gives me a headache) and just used a little more of the vodka and rum (I used Captain Morgan because that is the only rum I keep in the house)  Absolutely loved it.  Thanks NWGal.  This is a keeper.  Made for Zaar Stars :)

Very nice.  The chicken breast was so juicy and tender.  Had some problem getting the cracker crumbs to stick with so much handling, but the end result was very good.  May add some herbs to the breading mixture next time.  Thanks for sharing.  Made for PRMR :)

Excellent flavor.  Served this with recipe #116544 and it turned out great.  I made two very large french bread type loaves that rose beautifully.  I got a little confused with the initial instructions.  So I proofed my yeast in my kitchen aide mixing bowl, then added all the wet ingredients, then the salt and flour.  Toward the end, I turned the sticky dough out onto my floured work surface and kneeded in the remaining 1 cup of flour.  Worked perfect.  Thanks for sharing.  Made for Adopt A Tag Fall 2009 :)
My daughter is going to love this.  She always mixes her corn and mashed potatoes together.  The blend is perfect for my family.  Thanks Hokie Made for PAC Fall 09 :)
Another excellent cocktail Boomette.  Flavors were perfect.  Thanks for sharing.  Made for Holiday Tag :)

We loved this.  The dressing is perfect with this combination.  I did leave out the cucumber and kalamata olive for personal preference.  Used veggies from the garden for this.  Thanks so much for sharing.    Made for PRMR :)

I took the advice of Kim and removed the pan from the burner at 4 minutes. Was perfectly cooked at 5 minutes. We really enjoyed this for breakfast this morning. Thanks Nif. Made for Gimme 5 Tag Game :)
I loved this.  Perfect amount of sweetness.  I left out the cinnamon only because of personal preferences.  Thanks Hokie.  These will  be made again.  Made for PAC Fall 2009 :)

This was so good and so easy to put together.  I added more chicken broth and let it simmer for an hour to made the broth very rich and full of flavor.  I'll be making this again for sure.  Thanks.  Made for Think Pink 09 :)
This was very nice.  I also used a fresh mango and 8 oz of pineapple and that worked well for me.  Thanks.  Made for Zaar Stars :)

This was more like a taco salad than nachos but delicious non the less.  I made some dressing that consisted of taco sauce and sour cream and added that to the mix and we really enjoyed it.  Thanks for sharing.  Made for Holiday Tag :)

Loved this.  Other than cutting the cumin to 1/8 tsp (DH only likes a pinch lately)  I made this as directed.  Perfect blend of spices.  Can't wait to have the leftovers for my Spinach Salad at work.  Made for PRMR :)

This was an excellent way to made freezable Twice Baked Potatoes, although I didn't freeze all of them.  I plan to take some for lunches as these will warm up well in the microwave.  I estimated at the ingredients, eyeballing most for what we like and getting the consistency to where we like it.  The flavors blended so well together.  I'll make these again.  But I think I like the thicker potato skins of the baked potatoe.  (I love potato skins)  Thanks for sharing gailanng  Made for Pot Luck Tag :)

Loved it.  I made some sourdough french bread last weekend and froze serving sizes for the two of us.  Thus, I just cut the piece into 2 slices and spread a good portion of this on top and baked at 350 for about 25 minutes to get a good golden brown.  Used dried herbs so cut that to about 1 tsp which worked well.  We loved it.  Thanks Syn.  Made for Zaar Stars. :)

I don't know that I've ever had/made Apple Cider before.  I was home alone this afternoon and fighting a darn cold and decided to make this and get out and sit on the bluff for a while with the dogs.  This was such a great experience.  The flavor of the Cider and the cool breeze in my face made me feel so much better.  Made the whole afternoon better.  The flavor was just perfect.  This is something I'll enjoy again this winter.  Thanks for sharing.  Made for Sweet Traditions  :)

This is just excellent.  I love chicken piccata and this recipe did not dissapoint.  I used the entire 1/3 cup of lemon juice and thought that amount was perfect for us.  Found the parsley while cleaning up.  Never made it to the dish, but no matter, we loved it.  Would not change a thing.  Thanks.  Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders

So good.  I used cheddar cheese for personal preference and cooked mine a little long so they got slightly burned around the edges, but still tasted great.  I used fat-free half & half in place of the cream and it worked well.  Thanks.  Made for Zaar Stars :)
OMG this was good.  Great change of pace for breakfast and something I'll make again.  I didn't think it needed any syrup.  It was great as is.  Thanks SarahBeth for sharing.  Made for WTTM :)

These were very good and so easy to put together.  The flavors went perfect together.  The only change I made was used Splenda in place of the sugar.  Thanks so much for sharing.  Made for Sweet Traditions special :)
Simple is so good.  Great flavors that really added to my plan iceberg lettuse salad.  Thanks Realtor.  I'll make this one again.  Made for NKOTB tag game.  :)

Very nice cornbread but I think I like more cornmeal than flour in mine.  As Dreamer did, I reduced the sugar by half.  I used the 1 egg option that worked well and used low fat buttermilk (personal preference).  Thanks for sharing.  Made for Pot Luck tag game.  :)

I made this the other night when I was so cold and could not seem to get warm.  I really enjoyed the flavors that were very unusual for me.  I made the hot and really enjoyed.  Thanks for sharing.  :)

This was a nice French Baguette that we enjoyed.  I think if you are going to make 3 baguettes out of this recipes they should be termed mini-baguettes.  I made one moderate sized loaf with a whole recipe.  Flavor was very good.  I didn't measure the flour but probably used 2 1/2 cups maybe 3.  I was also concerned about no sugar, but it worked out okay without.  Thanks for sharing.  :)
Very nice.  I did increase the parmesan cheese to about 3-4 tablespoons but other than that made as directed.  Thanks for sharing.  Made for Zaar Stars :)

This was a great tasting soup.  I loved the hint of the lemon and mint.  I didn't have fresh mint so used about 1/2 tsp dried.
