Awesome, awesome, awesome!!! LOVED this! First time making it too! I used arborio rice and had no trouble at all. I did add a pinch more of each of the cheeses, we really enjoy a lot of cheese and strong flavor! (Made half a recipe, and will make another batch SOON!!!) Made for the ZWT4
This was AWESOME!!!! I actually enjoyed it for breakfast!!! What a nice, refreshing treat!!! Absolutely loved it!! Thanks so much!! Made for the ZWT4
These were so fun to make! And my hubby absolutely LOVED them!!!! These would be PERFECT for parties, too! I'll be making these a LOT! Thanks so very much!! :) Made for the ZWT4
Two of my absolute favorites all in one dish!!! What's not to LOVE?!!! We about died over this!! So simple, and yet soooooo good!!! Thank you so very much!! Made for the ZWT4
Loved, loved, LOVED IT!!! I used (Ocean Spray) Cran-Raspberry and Malibu Rum (what I had on hand), and it was soooo good!!! Thanks so much!!! Made for the ZWT4! :)
This will be a nice surprise for my hubby when he comes home! The only thing I didn't have were the capers.  :( But no matter, he'll appreciate them! :) Made for the ZWT4
Heavenly!!! I didn't have coffee cream, so used part heavy cream and part milk, and added a little vanilla. Wonderful!! :) Made for the ZWT4

This was GREAT!!! LOVED it!! So easy to make, and so much better than the over-priced jarred stuff!! With the skyrocketing prices of groceries, recipes like this are SO helpful!! Thanks so much!! Made for the ZWT4

Smoooooth, smooth smoooooooth!!! Made this for company over the holiday weekend, and my guests LOVED it!!!! I did add a bit more ice cream to make it thicker, probably was the ice cream, but it was HEAVENLY!!! Since I was "the bartender", I got to try the dabs left in the blender of each I made, and OMG!! LOVED it!!! Thanks so much!!!! Made for the ZWT4 :)
HEAVENLY is RIGHT!! OMG were these good!!! We absolutely LOVED them!! Thanks so much for a fantastic recipe!! Made for the ZWT4 :)

HEAVEN, pure heaven!!! I roasted mine whole in the oven, and stuffed the cavity with the squeezed lemons cut up! Made for the ZWT4 :)
OMG! Kill me NOW!! This was one AWESOME drink!!! Saving this recipe for company!!! Thanks so much!! Made for the ZWT4 :)

This is a wonderful recipe! We LOVED it! I did only use 2 chicken breasts, but they were HUGE, so everything worked out perfectly! I used dried parsley, thyme, oregano and italian seasoning. And I cut my chicken into "strips" instead of "bites". (Just a personal choice.) I didn't serve it with lemon, I opted to make a dipping sauce instead. I don't fry very often, so this was such a nice treat!!! Loved, loved, LOVED it!! Thanks so much!! :)

My sister and I used to eat our sandwiches like this when we were kids! LOVE them this way!! I used rye, corned beef, swiss; and chive and onion cream cheese on the top, mayo on the bottom. It was pure heaven!! Thanks Melis!! :)

My hubby made this, and I was SO PROUD of him! I was sick and couldn't eat, but he said they were VERY, very good! Oh Boomie! These were tasty lil buggers!!!! VERY rich, I could only eat 4 of them (though I WANTED MORE!! LOL!) I had to use Philly's Vegetable kind, they were out of the onion kind, but they were still fantastic!!! LOVED them!!! Next time I'll try the onion kind when they have it back in stock. Oh, and since my oysters were the tiny petite ones, I put 2 on each, and that worked out perfectly! :)  These would be a GREAT addition to a Super Bowl buffet table!! :) Thanks so much! Really enjoyed them!!! :)
This was HEAVENLY!!!!!! Next time I'll make it a DOUBLE!! :) Thanks so much for sharing such a wonderful treat!!! :) Made for the Bev Tag! :)
This was perfect on a cold, chilly Sunday morning! :) Thanks so much Boomie!! MUCH enjoyed!!! :)

Oh, Boomie!! What have you done?!! LOL!! These are soooo good!!! I used 4 dove chocolates (chopped up) and made just one panini for myself. It was very rich, but heavenly!! Good enough for a Bridal Shower treat, and they stay warm for quite awhile, too! Thanks so much!! :)

The stars just do not go high enough for this recipe!!!!! WOW!!!!! I was absolutely FLOORED!!!!!! They were the BOMB!!!! I scaled it down to make one burger, and I too, used 2 Tbl. cream cheese and 1 rounded Tbl. blue cheese for extra punch! (I love blue cheese!!)
