I made 1/4 of the recipe for my lunch and served it with Golden Taylor Pears and Crisp Rosmary & Sea salt dried Baugette slices, it was sooo good. I will be making this often, thanks so much for sharing another winner Syd.

Thanks for sharing, these  interesting  pancakes Syd. They are dense, flavorful and extremely filling.  I served them to my guest today for lunch and they quickly disappeared. I enjoyed the addition of the lemon juice, cinnamon and powdered sugar on the finished pancake.

This was DELICIOUS...just perfect,  I wouldn't change any ingedients in this tasty drink. It was lovely to be able to taste both the orange and blueberries along with the dairy products. A nice thick, smooth, creamy drink thats good for you. Kudos Syd.

Engrossed I enjoyed this flavorful coffee very much. I made Hawian Kona Coffee, very strong. Then I put the coffee and spices in a pot and simmered for 10 minutes. It was absolutely wonderful, the spices blended perfectly, nothing was overpowering, but I was able to taste each spice. I added a little sugar and didn't even miss the milk. Thanks for sharing, I'll be making this one again.

Wow, What a great beef dish.  I can't believe that it hadn't been tried yet. This dish was awesome. It was quick and easy to throw together. The meat was tender and the sauce was very tasty. All the textures and flavours blended well together, complimenting one another perfectly. I was out of snow peas and celery, so I substituted with sweet red pepper, which worked well in this dish. I can't wait to make this dish again, but with the missing vegetables.  I know that it will be even tastier. Loof thanks so much for sharing this new family favorite.

This rub is so good Lynn. I used it on chicken breasts which I baked in the oven. They were delicious, the skin was wonderful, crisp and oh so flavorful, you could taste all the different spices. What a lovely blend. I'm going to try this on baby back ribs for July 1st. Thanks so much for sharing.

This is a great salad. I loved all the textures and flavors in this tasty salad.  The orange and peanuts work well together. The dressing is a perfect blend, complimenting the salad.  I will be making this again.  Thanks so much for sharing. made for ZWT4.
Thank you so much for sharing your granny's recipe Ravenseyes. I enjoyed these rich, crisp cookies very much. These oatmeal cookies are just wonderful, the texture and flavor is excellant.

These were excellant scones Pat, just wonderful served with a little whipped cream and rhubarb strawberry jam. I enjoyed these tasty little treasures so much, they were light, fluffy and very flavorful. I shaped the biscuits with a butterfly cookie cutter and baked them on a cookie sheet. Thanks so much for sharing this lovely recipe.

Cafe Joy indeed... I enjoyed this tasty treat very much. It has great flavor, is rich, smooth, creamy and sweet. I used the whipped cream and the toasted coconut option and am glad that I did, the perfect finishing touch.  Into my keeper box this goes, thanks for sharing.

These potatoes were enjoyed very much. Served with rare steak they were the bomb. What a great combination of flavors. They complimented the meat beautifully. Quick and easy to make, thick, rich, creamy and a little tangy. We loved them. Thanks so much for sharing this tasty recipe.

These are wonderful pancakes. They were light, fluffy and very flavorful. I loved the addition of the graham wafer. Becareful, watch these babies carefully, my first batch burned quickly. I garnished these very yummy pancakes with butterscotch syrup and icing sugar. Good Luck in the contest Chef.

I really enjoyed these tasty pancakes. They were light, fluffy and tender. Good berry & banana ratio, love the combo. I served these yummy little treasures with syrup, banana slices and whipped cream. Good luck to you in the contest.

I enjoyed this milkshake for lunch today. It was very tasty, refreshing, filling and very satisfying. 
It had a smooth, silky, texture, it was creamy, rich, flavorful and not too sweet. I loved that you could taste the banana, chocolate and strawberries. Good luck in the contest Chef.
I enjoyed this nice, light, thick, creamy, smooth, subtley flavored frappuccino. Good Luck in the contest.
This was a very nice Mocha Frappuccino Shake. We enjoyed it very much. It was light, tasty and refreshing, not too sweet, just perfect. Good Luck in the Contest.

This was an excellant coffee cake Boomette. We really enjoyed this lovely treat. It made a tall, moist, tender, light, cake filled with a perfect cream cheese filling, topped with a tangy home made raspberry jam and cake crumbs. Oh soo good.  Your instructions were very clear, this was easy to put together, certainly worth the extra effort. Thank you so much for sharing.

Delicious..simply..delicious Amanda. What a great recipe, its quick and easy, using simple ingredients. Chewy salty cheese with a lovely crust, lemon and pepper. I served it with toasted sesame bagels, it was perfect. Thanks for sharing, I'll be buying more Halloumi.

This is one tasty chicken dish. Quick and easy with little or no fuss. The flavor is outstanding. I used chicken thighs and legs, didn't have any onion soup mix, so added 1/2 finely chopped sweet onion and used 1 1/2 tsps cayenne pepper. The chicken was sassy and tender while the sauce was sweet, tart, spicy and hot. What a treat served over steam long grain rice. Thanks so much for sharing. Into my keeper box this goes.

I enjoyed this tasty drink very much, it was tart, sweet and tangy. It does indeed taste tropical...just love Guava Nectar.  I really enjoyed the juice combinations in this drink.  Thanks for sharing Boomie.

Excellant pancakes, just excellant. I adore thin pancakes and these are perfect in taste and texture. The syrup is delicious, almost like carmel . I folded the pancakes and filled them with whipped cream and fresh picked raspberries and poured the thick syrup over everything. They were awesome. I will be making these again. Thanks for sharing your tasty recipe.

We enjoyed this tasty rice very much. It was quick and very easy to put together. The flavors & textures all blended well together, creating a very special comfort dish. Nothing over powered, everything was well balanced. I did garnish it with some shredded green onions.  Thanks so much for sharing a dish that will be made often in this home.

These cookies are wonderful. The spice is perfect. The texture of the cookie is crisp, tender and crumbly, the flavor is outstanding. I subed chocolate chips for the nuts as my dh is allergic. The cookies were quick and easy to make, they puffed up nicely. I made 18 large cookies from 1/2 the batch. Thanks for sharing your friends' tasty recipe.

This was really good. It was our first time trying Orzo and we loved it. This dish has lovely depths of flavor and textures. I added a little sweet onion to the mushrooms while sauting and decreased the garlic by half...I have a picky dh. This was a lovely side dish that I will make again.

Wow! Was this good. I'm in heaven. This splash is amazing. Cold, smooth and so full of flavor...and its good for you...yeah!   I enjoyed this very much. The orange blossom honey, just adds that extra little omph...I did use a combination of blueberries and blackberries, because I didn't have enough. This was soo good, I will be making this often. Thank you so very much for sharing this delicious treat CoffeeB.

Very delicious salad loof. This is wonderful, quick, easy and very tasty. I used fresh peaches, they worked beautifully in the salad. I loved the textures and flavors of the crunchy apples, the sharp cheese, the sweet peaches, the pecans and of course the creamy dressing. Thank you for posting a recipe that I will make again often.
We enjoyed this subtley flavored rice. The texture was nice. I used fresh chives and parsley from my garden. It made a lovely bed for the spicy shrimp the nested in it. Thanks so much for sharing.

This was a lovely salad. I served it for lunch and enjoyed it very much. It was very filling and oh so tasty. The textures and flavors were excellant and everything worked well together. Sweet, tart, tangy, creamy and delicious.  I used a medium cheddar, golden & sultan raisins, dried cranberries and pecans. The greek yogurt made the honey and cinnamon sparkle.

This was a wonderful coffee. Rich, strong and robust, with a deep dark flavor. The molasses sweetened the coffee perfectly. I loved it and will make this over and over again. Thanks for sharing this tasty recipe.

This is a wonderful grilled sandwich Syd, I really enjoyed it. I followed your recipe but I used leftover roast turkey and  marble cheese, it was what I had on hand. The sandwich was very tasty, the flavors all compliment one another beautifully and the textures are great together.  I loved the combo of cranberries and horseradish...Thanks for posting...  Kudos
This was so delicious. I really enjoyed the fresh, sweet and tart flavor of this drink. I used frozen raspberries, they worked great. Thanks so much for sharing this recipe Shelby Jo.

Rita, this is a lovely soothing tea. I had a sore throat this morning, but after drinking your tea, I am feeling better. Thank You for posting this recipe.  I used organic honey, fresh ginger, fresh squeezed lemon juice, clove, anise, and cinnamon.  A tasty and spicy combination.

This was another tasty treat by Brandess. The simplicity, quickness and ease of this dish, just ensures that it will be made again and again. We enjoyed this very much, dipped in sour cream Ranch...yummy! 
I only made half the recipe (there was only two of us) so I used one can of roll mix...It made eight large peices...truly great, I see lots of variations in the future...Kudos...Kato

I made this tasty refreshing salad for lunch today. Wow, what a treat. I love the combo of green onions and cucumber. The dressing was absolutely delish. Feta, lemon and olive oil. Yummy!  I will be enjoying this quick and very easy to prepare salad often. Thanks Anna for a new lunch treat...look ma, i'm eating my veggies.

This is a wonderful iced coffee, rich, thick, frothy and ice cold. I did add the Tia Maria...you could just taste it, wow what a great combination of flavor.  I used a vanilla bean & white chocolate ice cream and it worked perfectly, so delicious.  Thanks for another wonderful after dinner treat.

Oh Boy, another winner from Syd, this is sooo good. Wow, its sweet, tart and tangy. I loved it and can't wait to make it again. Made exactly as written with frozen mangos and homemade  pineapple juice and fresh squeezed lime juice. I added the ice to the glass because the mango was frozen, worked great. Thanks for sharing this light and refreshing drink Syd.

Thank you Weekend cooker for sharing this tasty tasty recipe. The batter was perfect, light, thin and flavorful. The apples were perfect, tart and tangy. I used vanilla sugar and cinnamon the perfect topping. It added the necessary bit of sweet to complete this perfect dish. I enjoyed this for lunch but would certainly have it for breakfast or with ice cream for dessert. I loved this and will make again.

Anna you truly are the Coffee Queen. This is so good. I think its even better than chai tea. The spices are wonderful with this cold, dark, strong coffee.  A perfect blending of coffee, spices, milk and sweetness. This ice cold treat will be enjoyed in the winter as well as the summer, can't help myself.  Thanks so much for sharing another winner.

Wonderful potatoes Lynn. I didn't change a thing. These little beauts were crispy, crunchy, tender and flavorful, quick and easy to make too.  My dh was in potatoe heaven.  Thanks for sharing a dish that I will be making often.

This was a wonderful sweet breakfast treat. What a lovely surprise. The apples, pecans, raisins and orange juice blended beautifully with the egg and brown sugar. It was quick and very easy to put together, with common ingredients found in most pantries. Thanks so much for sharing this new alternative weekend cooker.
This is very yummy. A nice strong bozzy drink. You can really taste the different liquers.  It was delicious and warming. Thanks for sharing oh Coffee Queen.
This was a lovely coffee Sharon. I enjoyed this treat very much. The vanilla is a nice addition. The whipped cream did indeed resemble clouds in my coffee. Thanks so much for sharing.

Wow, what a great cake Lynn. This cake was superb. Rich, tall, moist, tender and full of flavor, with a great crumb. It was quick and easy to make. I will be making this one often. Thanks so much for sharing.

What a lovely lovely drink Syd. I used a homemade pineapple juice and gingerale with the candied ginger. I love ginger, so I doubled the amount of ginger based on Elmotoo review. This was a delicious, refreshing, spicy, sweet treat. Thanks so much for sharing. I will be enjoying this often.

My dh & I loved these hot delicious bundels of joy. A nice thick, filling sandwich, that is very very satisfying. You could taste the roasted rosemary chicken, black forest ham, hungarian and german salami. Nothing was overpowering and all flavors were complimentary. The italian dressing started off the tasty treat while the provolone, sweet tomatoe and onion finished it perfectly. Lainey thank you so much for sharing this tasty, quick and easy to make recipe, which we will be enjoying often.

I thought that this was a lovely stew, tasty, quick and easy. It tasted as good as it smelled while cooking. We loved the flavor that all the vegetables created after blending with the cranberries and chicken.  I removed the chicken before serving to debone and then added the chicken back into the crockpot.  Congratulations on this wonderful entry.

The flavor of this crisp was wonderful. Definitely tropical, I enjoyed the addition of the pineapple and coconut in the crisp. I used a mixture of sweet and tart apples for this treat, they worked great. The crisp, was tender, sweet, tart and tangy, with a lovely tropical sauce. I didn't care for the texture of the oatmeal, it almost reminded me of porridge, but my dh loved it. Congratulations on your winning entry.

This lovely recipe was so quick and easy to throw together with fantastic results. We loved these delicious chocolate clusters of raisins. I used a variety of raisins and good quality white and milk chocolate chips.  I made 12 large clusters, they were very yummy. Thanks for sharing this treat.

This was an amazing sandwich. Simply delicious. I used fresh portugese bread, to die for French brie, that was so creamy I had difficulty slicing it...so good, anjou pears, ginger, cinnamon, nutmeg and pecans.  So...so  decadent and wonderful, I can't wait to make this treat again. Thanks so much for sharing.

These are very tasty little appetizers Noo. I have never tried these before.  I enjoyed them very much. I especially liked the taste and texture of the bacon and cherries together. Nice juicy, sweet cherries and salty, crisp, meaty bacon.  Thanks so much for sharing.

A very interesting recipe Boomie. The (biscuits/shortcake/scones) had a beautiful flavor and texture, but like the others I had trouble rolling and shaping the pattycakes, hence no pictures. The cake was light and fluffy with peices of peaches...yummy.  I served with a little icing sugar, cinnamon and whipped cream. Thanks for sharing this treat.

These were lovely pancakes. Sweet and very decadent. The pancakes were full of flavor, fluffy, light and very tender. The banana topping was delicious and melted in your mouth.  I loved the addition of the lime juice, it added an extra pow of flavor.  Thanks for sharing this special treat.

Another wonderful smoothie from Lainey.  Thanks for sharing with us Lainey. This smoothie was spectacular. I love mangos and ginger. I used vanilla yogurt, frozen mangos & no ice. 
Perfect flavor, perfect consistency, all in all a perfect drink.

These quick and easy to make zucchini slices were really nice, they made a great side dish.  The parmesan adds a lovely flavor to this vegetable. The zucchini baked up tender, juicy and flavorful. Thanks for sharing  this winner Anna.

Excellant Garlic bread JB. We loved the addition of the shallots also.  It gives the bread such an edge. I used Portugese bread it was perfect just perfect for this recipe. Light, tender, moist, fluffy, crispy, garlic herbed bread, what more could a girl ask for. Thank you so much for sharing.

This was great Syd. We loved the flavour of this compote. I used frozen blueberries, blackberries, strawberries and raspberries, they were perfect in this .  I topped it with vanilla bean ice cream...Yummy!  Thanks so much for sharing another winner.  I will be making this often, I see lots of possibilities.

Thanks for sharing another winner Lainey. This tasty casserole is amazing. It was quick and easy to make. I agree with twissis that it is indeed a company-worthy dish.  I loved the zing from the cayenne pepper, the intense mushroom flavor and the sharp cheese. I used fresh challah breadcrumbs, they absorbed the butter beautifully for a tasty treat. I will definitely make this again. I served this with fried steak and mashed potatos.  It is a great side.

What a great grilled sandwich. We loved it. I used challah bread, old cheddar, sweet tomato and leftover roasted turkey. It was so good. The textures and flavor made for one delicious sandwich. I can't wait to make this treat again. Thanks so much for sharing.

Oh Yum.  This was so good loof. 
I enjoyed this tasty, refreshing drink very much. The cocktail was perfect, tart, sweet, fizzy and tropical. All the flavors blended perfectly together.  I used regular Sprite and garnished with limes. Thanks for sharing.

This was so good Nasseh, thanks so much for sharing this delicious tea. I loved its spicy, warming sweet flavor.  Made exactly as written but  did simmer for 30 minutes.  I will be enjoying this often come the winter. I loved that you could taste both the cinnamon and the ginger.

Perfect pancakes Syd. Just perfect. These lovely little babies were packed with texture and flavor. I loved them. The pancakes were big, thick, light, fluffy, tender and oh so flavorful. The orange was nice and subtle while the cranberries were sweet, tart and tangy. I used dried cranberries, they worked well in this recipe.  I loved the addition of buttermilk in this dish, it mellowed the flavors beautifully.  I can't wait to share these with my mom... Thanks for sharing Syd.

This is an excellant cake recipe Gerry. We enjoyed this delicious cake very much. I made 1/2 the recipe and used a snowflake shaped cake pan resulting in a tasty hard crusty outside and a beautiful moist and tender inside.  The texture and crumb were perfect.  The cocoa, sugar and cinnamon combo was to die for.  I love what it did with the poppyseeds, a great flavor was achieved and enhanced. I lightly dusted the cake with icing sugar before serving.  Thanks so much for sharing this keeper.

Wow Brew Misstress, a kick indeed, a delicious, dark, heated kick.  I loved it. What a great combo of flavors.  It creates a wonderful spicy mocha treat.  Truly a taste experience. Thanks for sharing. Into my keeper box this goes.

What a great dish, it was very quick and easy to throw together with ingredients I always have on hand. I used a nice large pasta, cherry tomatoes, provolone and parmesan cheeses. They worked well in this dish. I did season the dish with coarse salt and freshly grounded pepper. I did find the garlic to be too very subtle and next time will add the garlic to the dish with the noodles and cheese. Thanks so much for sharing this comforting dish.

Great dip Syd. I really enjoyed this semi tart, tangy strawberries and cream dip. The dip was thin, rich, creamy, smooth and had a nice fresh flavor that I enjoyed. It was wonderful served with fresh strawberries and cubes of angel food cake, and was even better the next day drizzled over Kittencal's recipe #337532. Thanks for sharing another winner.

Wow, fruit salad with attitude. I loved this sweet, tart, tangy fruit salad. I used a good quality fig balsamic vinegar. It was excellant with the fruit. All the fruit were fresh except for the raspberries which were frozen. This really is a lovely treat, guaranteed to wake you up. The berries were fresh and sweet, the orange bright and sharp , with the deep dark balsamic vinegar and the nice mello vanilla yogurt. We enjoyed this very much.  Thanks so much for sharing Sharon.

This is a great chowder Anna. Wow, what flavor and texture in this robust, fresh, tangy tasting soup.  You could pick out all the different flavors, none over powered.   The cheese and the bacon were a wonderful addition.  We enjoyed it so much, that my picky dh even went back for seconds. Kudos for sharing this tasty treat.

What a delicious breakfast treat. We enjoyed this pretty dish very much. The strawberries, cream cheese and chocolate chips make this taste like dessert... whats not to like. It was rich, creamy, sweet and smooth. Thanks for sharing this recipe, which I will make again.
These were delicious. We enjoyed them very much. They were quick and easy to make, with great flavor and texture. I loved the addition of the coconut and cherrys.  Thanks for sharing mon ami.

We really enjoyed these subtle orange spiced cookies. Wow, they pack a punch.  They were the surprise cookie on my Christmas trays this year. They were the first to disappear. Kudos on a cookie, that I will enjoy often.  They were perfect served with a fresh pot of hot tea.  Thanks so much for sharing.

These were incredible Kit. The tasty morsels melted in your mouth. I loved these butter cookies, they were similar to shortbread, but had a wonderful subtle orange flavor that complimented the raspberry jam perfectly. They were quick and easy to make. I used these in my Christmas trays this year and was not disappointed.  Thanks for sharing this winner.

These biscuits were delicious. Quick and easy to make. The biscuits were crisp and crunchy on the outside and tender on the inside, with a nice flavor.  Thanks for sharing this tasty treat.  I really enjoyed them toasted with raspberry jam.  Thanks for sharing.

I made this exactly as written.  I loved this coffee. It was very  warming and spicy. Very,  very comforting.  I used a bold french roast and the vanilla pod option, I did add a little milk and brown sugar.  It was absolutely   wonderful.  Thank you so much for sharing.
This was a lovely refreshing, tart drink Boomie. I added both ounces of orange juice and followed recipe as written. Thanks so much for sharing.

These are some of the best waffles that I have tried on this site. They were light, fluffy, soft, tender, crisp and the flavor was incredible.  I love cardamom and couldn't have enjoyed this recipe more. All the flavors balanced beautifully to create a memorable treat. Thanks so much for sharing Mom2Rose...we loved these.

This was a very tasty sweet bread, CoffeeB, we loved it. The bread was sweet, rich, moist and dense. I used golden raisins as my dh is allergic to nuts. The flavor of this bread is incredible. I served it sliced thin with a little butter. I used finely ground graham cracker crumbs in place of the flour. The result was a very tasty sweet bread, that tasted as good as it smelled while baking. Thanks so much for sharing your grammas recipe.

Yowzer, this is an excellant coffee Lainey.  What great flavor.  A sweet, robust coffee with a lovely mellow taste.  I love the flavors that the maple syrup pulls out of the coffee. Thanks so much for sharing. I will be making this one again.

What a great cake Karen Elizabeth. We really enjoyed this tasty treat. It certainly satisfied my chocolate craving. I loved this deep, dark, delicious, dense, moist cake. It was perfect with a little sprinkling of icing sugar and a small scoop of vanilla ice cream. I shared it with my neighbors, they came back asking for more, so I gave them the recipe. Thanks for sharing a new family favorite.

Delicious Syd, simply delicious.  We really enjoyed this special treat. The cantaloupe and orange juice create a lovely flavor. It was sweet, the texture was perfect, smooth, silky and pulpy. Just the way I love them.
I especially enjoyed the use of the vanilla in this smoothie.  Thanks very much for sharing.

Loved, loved, loved the chicken prepared this way. What a great idea, using a store bought cooked chicken.  It was quick and easy to throw together and definitely company worthy.  We really enjoyed the flavor of the honey glaze, the spices & seasonings were perfect and the chicken was very tender.  I served this with mashed potatoes and steamed carrotes, it doesn't get much better than this.  Thanks so much for sharing your recipe Flying Chef, we will be enjoying this for years to come.

FrenchTart I wish I could give 10*'s for this little treasure. This simple little dish was incredible. It was quick and easy to put together and tasted like grandma made it. Incredible shortbread topping, light, crisp, buttery, sweet and tart fruit, in a delicious sauce. I used a combination of frozen fruit, bing cherries,  blackberries, raspberries, blueberries and wild strawberries.  It was so good. I served it with a scope of French Vanilla Ice Cream. Thank you for sharing a recipe that I will be making again and again. I can't wait for fresh currants.

Another winner from LL.  What a wonderful pork dish. We enjoyed this quick and easy to make dish very much. The pork was tender, juicy and oh so flavorful. I made exactly as written, didn't change a thing. I served this tender, tasty pork with lemon glazed sweet potatoes and brussel sprouts. Thanks so much for sharing Lynn.

Wow, this was delicious, simply delicious. The chicken was perfectly cooked, moist, tender, juicy and the flavor was too die for. You could taste the pepper, garlic and coconut, it was the  perfect blending. I used 3 whole, skinless, boneless breasts and cut them into three strips each.   I found that I was out of apricot jam so I used a Thai hot & sweet, red chili pepper sauce,  it was awesome with this dish.  I can't wait to make this again and try it with the apricot sauce. Thanks so much for sharing another winner.

Wonderful biscuits Syd. We really enjoyed these sweet and subtely spiced biscuits, the combination of cinnamon, nutmeg and yams was excellent. The biscuits were light, tender, fluffy and very flavorful. Watch these babies carefully, they change color quickly. Next time, I will use parchment paper. Thank you so much for sharing this wonderful recipe Syd. I will be making these often.

I loved the carrots prepared this way. They were sweet, buttery and tender. I used the honey option, and decreased the water. The sesame seed garnish adds a nice texture to the carrots. Thanks for sharing your recipe Karen Elizabeth.

This was a really lovely quick and easy to make treat January Bride. The cobbler was perfection served with French Vanilla Ice Cream. I used the frozen blackberries, blueberries and freshly squeezed lemon juice option. What a terrific flavor, tastes like spring. Thanks so much for sharing.

This french toast was quick and easy to make, with splendid results. I used  viennese bread. The brown sugar and cinnamon coated the french toast beautifully. Next time I will omit the maple syrup, the toast was sweet enough on its own. Thanks for sharing your recipe.

This was a very nice appetizer pittgal. I served it with triangels of pita. The cheese dip was rich, thick, creamy, smooth and tasty. I loved the addition of the green onions and bacon to the dip, they added  nice flavor and texture. Thanks so much for sharing.

This was wonderful Boomie. We enjoyed it very much.  The tenderloins were perfectly cooked and the sauce was too die for. What a great flavor.  The mushroom were tender and delicious. I did use oyster mushrooms and the chicken stock option.  Thanks so much for sharing.

This is so good Lazyme, perfect balance of alcohol and coffee. I love Baileys and Frangelico in strong coffee...so this was perfect for me...you could say...it was tailor made.  Rich, creamy and oh so flavorful, simply decadent.  Thanks so much for sharing, I will be making this again soon.

Another wonderful smoothie from JanuaryBride. We enjoyed this tasty treat very much. I did use the banana, strawberry, pineapple and kiwi options, am I ever glad that I did. This smoothie has a nice silky texture and tastes great. All the flavors blend beautifully together to create a memorable sweet, tart, refreshing drink. Thanks so much for sharing. What a great way to get our daily fruit.

My what a wonderful adult cocoa. Absolutely loved it. So good, rich, creamy, smooth and silky, with a kick. I loved the combo of Frangelico, Creme de Cocoa and coffee. I also went overboard with the marshmallows and would do so again in a heart beat. Thanks for sharing another winner Lazyme.

Great Coffee Diner. I enjoyed this lovely treat very much. I am a hugh fan of caramel & chocolate in coffee and this drink did not disappoint. I add some whipped cream and additional caramel for garnish.  Thanks for posting this winner.

Wow, wow, wow Lainey. This soup is excellent. It really does taste like lasagna. Great flavor and textures in this wonderful comfort dish. Thank you so much for posting our favorite soup on Zaar to date. Kudos Kato.

We enjoyed this tasty pasta dish. It was quick and easy to throw together, with ingredients that I always have on hand. Love the combo of pork sausage and cheese. I used a hot italian sausage. Next time, I will add the broccoli florets at the end. (personal preference only)  Thank you so much for sharing.

These were scrumptious scones indeed. We enjoyed this tasty treat very much. I served them with butter and strawberry freezer jam. It doesn't get any better than this....hmm maybe toasted. The scones were big, tall, crisp, tender, flavorful and delicious. They were really quick and easy to make. I will be making these again. Thanks so much for sharing Lalaloula.
This lovely subtley flavored rice was quick and easy to make. Rich and creamy. We enjoyed it very much.  Thank you so much for sharing your recipe.

What a lovely smoothie Shuzbud.  We enjoyed this lovely treat very much. The pineapple, banana and apple blended beautifully with the coconut milk. A nice smooth, creamy, refreshing, pineapple flavor. I will be enjoying this one again.  Thanks so much for sharing.

What a yummy sandwich. We loved it. The meatballs, were tender, flavorful and so tasty. Perfect ratio of meat and tomato sauce. Can't wait to make this hoagie again. I made it exactly as written, very quick and easy to make.  Thanks so much for sharing your recipe Coffee.

This was a great sloppy joe recipe BakinBaby. What flavor, spicy, sweet and tangy.  They were quick and easy to make, with ingredients that I keep in my pantry. I loved that the sloppy joe mix was nice and thick. Thanks for sharing with us...I will be making this one again.

Updated: Man this smoothie gets better and better everytime I make it...sooo yummy....Even my picky dh loved it...Great smoothie Syd. I used fresh pears and pear nectar, they worked well in this recipe. The smoothie was sweet, rich, thick and velvety. I really enjoyed the addition of freshly grated nutmeg. Thanks so much for sharing.

Wow, this dish is awesome.  I loved all the flavors and textures, sooo good.  The orzo is delicious and the shrimp are too die for, simply juicy, tender and spicy.  I love the combination of the orzo with the spicy shrimp.  Boomie thanks so much for sharing this wonderful dish, which I will be enjoying often.

wow, wow, wow.  What a great soup. It was so quick and easy to make. We loved it. The flavors and textures were excellent. What a lovely spicy treat. I did use 3 Thai firecracker peppers instead of jalapenos.  Thank you so much for sharing you recipe. We will be enjoying it again often.  Into my keeper box this goes.

Thank you so much for sharing your wonderful recipe I'm Pat. We really enjoyed this tasty sandwich. The textures and flavor were awesome. Loved the sauce.  I used Collasal shrimp and romain lettuce. We will be enjoying these again really soon.

Another winner from the French Tartlette. Wow, was this good. My new favorite sandwich. I love Halloumi. The combination of ingredients, makes this sandwich really special. I loved the crispy salty halloumi with the tart lemon and sweet onions and tomatoes mmmm. This is so wonderful. I can't wait to have it again today for my lunch. Many thanks dear FT for sharing this treat. Kudos....Kato

These are perfect. I will be making these tasty little morsels for my dil's baby shower at the end of the month. I made 15 little tarts, that were just excellant.  The crust is to die for, it melts in your mouth and the flavor...yummmm. The tarts were very quick and easy to put together.  I used, apricot, raspberry, pineapple and blackcurrent jam and apple jelly.  They were so good, my dh went back looking for more.  Did I mention that they disappeared as if by magic.  Another winner from the very talented Hot Tartlette.

Woo hoo, I made bread.  It turned out great. I can't believe that I made this amazing bread.  FT you are awesome.  Thanks so much for posting this recipe.  I will be sharing with all my bread loving friends. This artisan bread is perfect, beautiful crust, soft, moist, light, fluffy and flavorful. The crumb on the bread was excellent.  I can't wait to impress my son & dil with this great recipe.  Many thanks for making me look good.  Kudos my friend.

These tomatoes are awesome. I used a new sweet variety, (Chocolate tomatoe) that is deep and robust in flavor.  Prepared this way they almost tasted like sun dried tomatoes. They were wonderful. What a wonderful salad flower. I really enjoyed this, the dressing was wonderful with the mint being the most prominent flavor. The sweet tomato, the crisp cucumber and sharp olives were excellent, so refreshing and tasty. Thank you so much for sharing.

This smoothie is sooo good. OMG, I loved it. Magnificent Mango smoothie, truly wonderful flavor, so quick and easy to make and sooo company worthy.  Thank you once again Syd for another great smoothie recipe.  I'll be making this one often.

Lainey this grilled sandwich was delicious.  I love grilled cheese, they are my special weakness. These certainly do not disappoint. I enjoyed this potato dish very much. It was light and fluffy and full of flavor.  The perfect ratio of potato, butter and milk. The potatoes had a nice tang to them, reminicent of sour cream. These were wonderful buttery blueberry muffins Lalaloula.  The muffins were perfect, not overly  sweet. I used fresh blueberries, 1 tsp vanilla, 1 tsp lemon juice and 1/2 tsp freshly ground cinnamon. I did omit the extra sugar on top, I forgot.  Thanks for sharing. this tasty treat.

These were wonderful just wonderful, I made both variations and enjoyed both.  The citrus pancakes were refreshing while the cardomon pancakes were spicy and comforting. I made a one person serving for myself. It was so good. I absolutely loved it, the flavor, the textures. Thanks so much for sharing Weekend Cooker.

Wow, these were great, we really enjoyed them. They were crisy and spicy...just perfect. I did leave them in the oven alot longer than it called for, as I was outside working in the yard.  It didn't hurt them, one little bit. I can't wait to make these again. Thanks for sharing.
What an excellent drink.  I really enjoyed this quick and easy to make cocoa.  It was nice and light, smooth, creamy and silky.  I loved the mocha flavor mingled with the booze.  Thanks for sharing.

Now this is an iced coffee. OMG, if you like flavor try this. I loved the combination of coffee, orange, cinnamon and cayenne. Wow what a treat, cold, deep, dark, spicy and delicious. I did add some additional cayenne. Thanks for sharing another wonderful coffee.

A very tasty and refreshing salad. I used good quality heirloom tomatoes and fresh basil from my garden.  I loved the fresh tart taste that was sweetened by the tomato.  Kudos on a wonderful simple recipe that tastes amazing.

What a lovely mug of coffee. It was a pleasant surprise, as I was a little unsure of how much lavender to put in for my tastebuds. It is a nice subtle coffee enhanced by the vanilla sugar and heavy cream that i used. Thanks for sharing...made for Summer 09 - Comfort Cafe.

Lovely baguette Deantini. I made this recipe into one large baguette.  We enjoyed this quick and easy to make bread very much. The flavor is outstanding, the texture and crumb were wonderful. Thank you for posting this tasty dish.  We enjoyed it very much.  The meat was tender and oh boy the sauce.  It was wonderful, so full of flavor.  My parsnip hating dh, fell in love with the parsnips prepared this way.  I will be making this again.

I love french toast and this beauty did not disappoint. I scaled it down for one and garnished it simply with powdered sugar. Oh sooo good. The orange zest adds wonderful flavor. I can't wait to make this again. Thank you so much for sharing another winner. Made for the Winner of the Recipe of the Day Game. Comfort Cafe /09 :)

Thank youJackieOhNo, for posting this recipe. The pretty fool was wonderful, tasty and refreshing. It was quick and very easy to make. I used a mixture of frozen strawberries and   raspberries, they worked great together. I will make this again and again.

Wonderful waffles, on the deck, in the kitchen, in the yard, it doesn't matter. These waffles are so tasty. I really enjoyed the flavor of these light and fluffy, crisp yet tender waffles.  I can't wait to make these again. I served them garnished with a little powdered sugar, it was perfect. I could have eaten them all.  Thank you so much to you and your sister in law for sharing this tasty recipe.  Made for the Winner of the Recipe of the Day Game. Comfort Cafe /09

Thanks for a lovely drink wicked.  It was just perfect for all the rain we've been having. It was a lovely pick me up. I used 1 ounce of Crown Royal and everything listed.  The lemon, honey and cinnamon added a nice flavor to the cider.  I have added this to my keeper file.

These potatoes are excellent Acadia. We loved them, my dh already asked for them again. These spuds are crisp and crunchy on the outside while staying tender and light on the inside.  The basil and rosemary were a wonderful addition to the potatoes.  Thanks for sharing a recipe that I will make again and again .  Made for the Comfort Cafe's Coffee Diva.../09 :)

This was a very nice treat Wicked.  I enjoyed it very much.  I used all the coffee ice cubes, chocolate and because I didn't have any non fat dry milk I subed with a little hazelnut creamer.  This was a lovely drink.  I can't wait to try it with the dry milk. Thanks so much for posting this quick and easy frozen coffee treat.

What a lovely spiced tea. I scaled it down for one person...it worked great. I used a large bay leaf from my garden, 5 pepper corns, a chunk of ginger, and I added 1/2 a cinnamon stick and 3 cloves.  I didn't use milk but did add the honey.  I will make this again. Thanks for sharing Marra.

Wow Lalaloula! These soft tender waffles are excellent. I will be making these quick and easy to make waffles again. They were oh so flavorful, very light and tender.  They melted in your mouth.  I love the addition of the vanilla sugar.  I enjoyed them very much...thank you so much for sharing.

This was a lovely salad. I enjoyed it yesterday for lunch. It was light and very refreshing. I loved that it had only three vegetables and lots of feta cheese. The dressing was spot on and complimented the fresh garden vegetables perfectly. Thanks for sharing another winner Sharon.

What a lovely ice cream berry soda. I enjoyed this sweet, fruity, chocolately treat very much. I used frozen strawberries and raspberries, that I picked and froze, so added 1 tbsp white sugar to the blend.  Thanks for sharing this refreshing treat. It was perfect for the hot sweltering day we had yesterday.

What a great sandwich.  I don't have a panini press, so I just fried it in my cast iron pan, it worked great. Loved...loved these simple, easy to make brownies.  They were fantastic...chewy and delicious and gone before I could even take a picture. Thanks so much for posting this treasure.

Wow Syd.  I enjoyed this chicken salad very much.  The dressing was wonderful sweet, tart and tangy.  I used freshly roasted chicken breasts, big, crunchy, refreshing seedless green grapes,
salty, roasted macadmian nuts and sweet dried cranberries.

What a great cup of java.  I loved the spices in this coffee. I used all the ingredients except for the half and half.  I used the whipped cream option instead.  It was soo good.  I'll be making this one again tomorrow.  The molasses gives it a nice deep flavor.  Thanks so much for sharing.

Incredible pancakes deb.  So light, tender and fluffy.  I made these pancakes exactly as written.  They were quick and easy to make, with great results.  The pancakes had a nice flavor. I will make these little beauty's again, thank you so much for sharing this recipe.

We really enjoyed this simple soup Weekend Cooker.  It was quick and easy to make and had great flavor.  I also left it on low all day, it turned out perfect, and was hot and spicy. Another winner from Deantini.  I loved this wonderful bruschetta. It was easy to make and was simply devine.  I didn't change a thing, it was perfect as written.  Loved the combo of brie, mushroom and rosemary. Kudos on a great treat, that I will make often.

Sarah Jayne what a great appetizer. WE loved this salty treat. So much flavor and the texture is perfect. What a great idea to add chives...oh yum. The bacon, cheese and chives create a truly wonderful taste experience.

Wow Debbwl Loved this simple to make recipe.  What a great taste treat this was. I served it over fresh blueberries, nectarines and bananas.  It elevates the fruit salad to another level.  I will be using this topping often.  We really enjoyed this sweet and tangy dressing. Thank you so much for sharing your recipe.

Yummy, yummy, yummy.  Best of all, I made them.  They were easy and quick to make.  The results were fantastic.  Big, tall, light, tender chocolate cake, with oozing chocolate sauce. Thank you for sharing this wonderful recipe Paula. Sometimes the best tasting are the simplest to make. This delightful dish, was very quick and easy to make. These are incredible little morsels ratherbeswimmin'.  My dh was in heaven.  He asked me to  make these again. He also asked if we could add them to the menu for our thanksgiving dinner.

This was a lovely refreshing salad CoffeeB, I enjoyed it very much.  We found the dressing a little overpowering, next time I will use less mayonnaise. Thanks for sharing this quick and easy to make fruit salad. :)

What a great fruit salad iewe.  We have never tried this salad with yogurt before,  we make this but usually with sour cream.  Thank you so much for this very tasty alternative. What an amazing treat alligirl. I love scones with coconut, chocolate and macadamia nuts, so I knew that I would love these but the lime just takes it to a new level. What a wonderful rice.  So tasty and flavorful.  It was perfect, just the right amount of spice and apple juice.  It made a wonderful salad with fresh fruit. I loved this deep dark coffee. It was wonderful. The Kahlua, rum and coffee blended beautifully together, I especially liked that the alcohol was not overpowering. I did add some sugar (personal preference only) and lots of whipped cream.  Thank you so much for sharing.  :)

Alligirl, simply incredible recipe, with excellent presentation, it was so pretty. Wow, what strong flavors, the salsa was incredible, sweet, tart, tangy, hot and spicy, mellowed by the cream cheese. We enjoyed this sweet treat very much. We had it for brunch the other day, served with crisp bacon and drizzled in maple syrup. I made the recipe as directed but baked in small individual tart pans. It was excellent, Loved the flavor and ease of the dish. Thanks for sharing your recipe. :)

I loved, loved this quick and easy to make dish. The plantains were incredible served this way. Tender, flavorful and sweet. I served it with some rice and peas and jerk pork tenderloin. This was a lovely soup.  We really enjoyed the flavours and textures. It was sooo good and it was quick and easy to make too. It had both of my dh's favourite soups in one.  I will definitely make this one again.  Great use of contest ingredients, good Luck in the contest.

This dish was wonderful, we loved it.  The meatballs had a really nice flavor and texture.  The thick sauce was easy to thin with a little water.  I served it over rice, garnished with parmesan cheese. Thank you so much for sharing your tasty dish.  Good Luck in the contest.

Littlemafia I really enjoyed this coffee.  The only thing I will do different next time is add less of the coriander, as I found it a little strong.  It still blends very well with the cardamom and coffee.  I made the iced version for the Comfort Cafe - Chalet /10. :)

This was truly incredible Kate.  I enjoyed this delicious coffee treat so much.  I will be making it again, but will have to limit myself to occasionally...sooo good. Um Safia this was awesome. I really enjoyed this delicious exotic coffee.  I loved that you could taste the spices, saffron and the rose water.  What a taste experience it was. Incredible potatoes, littlemafia. We enjoyed this tasty dish very much.  Even my picky dh loved them...I will definitely make these tender, flavorful babies again. Thank you so much for sharing this recipe. :)

What an incredible meal.  We loved this tasty comfort dish.  It was perfectly cooked.  Tasted out of this world.  I used the apple juice option with wine sauerkraut and a polish sausage.  It was quick and easy to make, with lots of flavor.

What a great dish. My dh loved it. Reminded him of a dish his mom made. It was quick and easy to make, very easy to vary. I loved all the flavors from the sauce I used. Wow what a great recipe smellyvegetarian. I knew that we would like them, just didn't know how much.  I have a standing order from neighbors to bring some over whenever I make them. Excellent Hot Chocolate Lauralie.  I enjoyed it so much.  I used 1% milk and dairy milk chips. So yummy, I did garnish mine with whipped cream.  Thanks for sharing Lauralie, I will be making this decadent treat again. :)

Absolutely delicious AZPARZYCH.  We enjoyed the potatoes prepared this way very much.  The were perfect with recipe #373323.  What a great meal we had. Wow, Papa Syd this was so good. I was right, my dh loved this dish, I just didn't realize how much I would enjoy this tasty rice dish also.  It was so good, really quick and easy to throw together. This was so good TLu.  My picky dh was in heaven, as was I.  The flavor is outstanding. The vegetables were tender and crisp, while the kielbasa was perfectly carmelized. These potatoes were spectacular, worth every star.  My dh was in spud heaven.  I let them cook a little longer, they were perfect. Crispy, tender and oh so tasty. Wow another winner from Anna. What a great chicken dish this is. So quick and easy to make with lovely exotic flavor. We loved it. I used chicken thighs and they worked great in this dish. wonderful rice dish Anna. Well worth the extra effort. What flavor, color and texture, it was perfect. We loved all the different layers of flavor. This was the perfect drink this morning after taking the kids to school.  It was so chilly, I couldn't wait to enjoy this caliente.  It was perfect, rich, thick and sweet. This certainly is an imperial coffee.  I loved it.  I enjoyed it hot yesterday morning and then I enjoyed it chilled in the afternoon.  Love a versatile recipe and this one does not disappoint. Very nice breadsticks, I did add additional rosemary, garlic and butter.  Next time, I will add some coarse salt also.  Quick and very easy to make.  Thanks for sharing this tasty treat.  Made for Herb of the Month - Rosemary :)

Now this is a very special lemonade.  Quick and easy to make with incredible results.  This lemonade was sweet, tart, tangy and spicy.  I used soda water instead of sprite, it worked great in this drink.  I agree with UmmBinat that it was very weak with only 1 tsp of the concentrate. Made for Aussie Swap #39. :)

Awesome recipe Sharon, I love Ina Garten her recipes always taste great. Thanks so much for sharing this tasty treat with all of us.  They are so good, its hard not to think of them as a treat.  I agree with the other chefs, I could have easily eaten these crisp, tender, very flavorful potatoes all by myself.  They were quick and easy to make.  I will be making these often.  Made for Aussie Swap #39.  Thanks teammate for another wonderful dish. :)

This was an excellent dish gailanng.  My dh ate most of it in one sitting, said he was going to take the leftovers for lunch... next time I knew, he was eating the leftovers also...said he couldn't help himself...it was just too good. Didn't change any of the seasonings.  It was perfect.  Quick and very easy to throw together.  Thanks for sharing.  Made for Pac  :)

Another wonderful drink from JB.  It was delish.  Truly hit the spot. I used frozen wild blueberries,  since they were so small I also  added additional blueberries and used the full 2 oz of club soda.  What a lovely tart, refreshing drink.  It was perfect.  I'm so glad I saved the best for last.  I can't wait for girl's weekend this summer, to share this cocktail with my mates.  Thank you so much for sharing.  Into my keeper box this goes.  Made for Aussie swap #39 :)

I loved this Anna, this was wonderful. Very easy to make. Thanks to a wonderful friend, I now have butter extract...and was able to use in this tasty coffee. I love the flavor it brings to the coffee. I garnished with whipped cream and a sprinkling of nutmeg.  Thanks for sharing gf. :)

What a great recipe. But I must confess, that I didn't use hershey kisses for the filling...someone ate them all...and left an empty bag...can we say....DH.....so I used marishino cheeries. They worked great in this recipe. The shortbread topping was delicious, while the cherry made for a delightful surprise. Made for Pool Party Tag :)
What a lovely mug of coffee.  It was really tasty.  I love caramel ontop of my whipped cream. This was a quick and easy treat.  Thanks for sharing. :)

Thanks for sharing Elaniemay.  I made a half the recipe, as I usually have problems making bread.  Not this time, it was quick, easy and the results were delicious.  The bread was light and airy.  My dh couldn't believe that I made it.  Thanks for making me look good. :)

What a lovely recipe diner.  We really enjoyed these quick and easy to make potatoes.  I made in a dish big enough for two.  I adjusted the  ingredients and time accordingly.  These turned out perfectly.  Tender and flavorful. The swiss cheese and sweet onions were a lovely addition. I didn't have any green onions left, so I used vidallias...they were nice in this dish. Thanks so much for sharing a dish I will make again. :)

Another winner from my friend Gailanng.  Wow was this good.  Perfect comfort food for the soul.  What more could a person ask for...beef, potatoes, the vegetable trinity, cheddar and spice, spice, spice.  We loved it, a new family favorite.  We will be enjoying this dish often.  Thanks for sharing.  :)

I loved this coffee. It was delish and so quick and easy to make. what a treat. Very comforting and satisfying. I loved using the vanilla bean and butter. It took this coffee somewhere special for me. I garnished this with ground vanilla beans and coarse sugar. Thanks so much for sharing another winner oh Coffee Queen...aka Brew Mistress :)

Thank you so much for sharing this magnificent treat UmmBinat. I loved it. The syrup was thick, sweet and very flavorful. Reminded me of corn syrup. It was definitely worth waiting for it to pour. This treat was really quick and easy to make. I am so in love with this drink that I have made this syrup twice already. I didn't add any coloring to mine...but did use more of the concentrate...as I personally prefer stronger rather than subtle flavor. This was a delicious light, refreshing drink that I will make again and again. Kudos my dear :)

Thank you so much for sharing this incredible treat katew.  We really enjoyed them.  I used a really good quality vanilla bean ice cream.  It was so good in the scones.  I garnished with more vanilla bean ice cream and some strawberry jelly.  What a decadent dessert it made.   I loved how quick and easy these were to make and the texture was perfect.  I'll be making these again on the weekend with my little guests.  They will be so pleased with themselves. :)

I adore french toast and this lovely treat was no exception.  Really easy to make and quick; you just pop it into the oven in the morning for a lovely taste experience.  We really enjoyed the flavor and texture of the french toast.  It was light and puffy, with apples, cinnamon and raisins, what more could you ask for.  Thank you so much for sharing this lovely dish Weekender.  :)

My picky dh & I both loved this recipe.  He hates anything with wine in it...but loved it in this recipe...yes there is hope for other recipes now. :)

Your recipe was incredible, the chicken was so tasty, moist, tender and juicy.  I did add the mushroom option, what a treat this was.  I have put it in my keeperbox.  I will be making this next month when my family comes to visit.  Thanks so much for sharing this treasure.  Wish I could give it more than 5*. :)

This is a lovely spice mix.  I ground all my spices fresh for a lovely taste experience.  Wow, was it good, the cardamom is an  excellent addition, it really adds a nice layer of depth.  I used the spice mixture in recipe #28193 :)  it worked great, they both complimented each other perfectly.  thanks for sharing little. Made for :)

Littlemafia, I enjoyed this subtley flavored coffee, very much.  It was a wonderful blend of coffee, cocoa, mint and vznilla. Thank you so much for sharing this treat. :)

Gerry my friend, I love this recipe.  The rolls are wonderful they are so flavorful, light, crispy and tender.  They taste so good, I can't believe that I made them.  I usually have problems with bread or rolls, but not this time.  Your recipe was perfect, the bread turned out beautifully.  Thank you so much for sharing a recipe that is going into my keeper box.  :)

Annacia, hands down my favorite tea on the site.  I loved it.  I did serve it hot and iced.  I preferred the iced version, it allowed all the flavors to shine thru.  The honey was perfect in this drink.  Made exactly as written, wouldn't change a thing my friend. Thank you so much for sharing this lovely recipe.  I have another batch sitting in the fridge waiting for tomorrow.  Cheers :)

Thanks for sharing another winner Littlemafia.  Often the simplest ingredients are the best. I loved the soft subtle flavor of the mint, with the nice, crisp fresh peas, it was perfect just perfect. I also used mint from the garden. I will be making this recipe again. :)

What a great recipe Jubes.  We really enjoyed these crispy, crunchy, flavorful spuds.  They were so easy to make.  I used Mixed italian herbs and jamacian jerk spice, rice flour and olive oil.  These were so awesome, I can't wait to try them again, with different herbs and spices.  Thanks for sharing. :)

What a delicious recipe swissms. My dh & I enjoyed this tasty dish very much.  It was quick and easy to throw together, threw it into the fridge and left it till dinner time.  What flavor, texture and oh the flavor.  Perfection, sheer perfection served with new boiled potatoes and fresh green peas. We will be enjoying our chicken grilled this way again in the future.  Thank you so much for sharing.

Lavender, these are some of the best scones that I have ever tried.  Your Grandma's recipe is perfection.  These scones were everything that you want one to be, light, fluffy,tender and oh so flavorful.  I love the flavor that the sour cream brings to the scones, incredible. Thank you so much for sharing your recipe my friend. It rocks. Into my keeperbox this goes.  Can't wait to have this treat again.

Wow Debbwl, we loved this simple dish.  It was so flavorful.  The pork was perfect, moist, tender and juicy. The sauce was incredible, it had so many layers of flavor.  Thank you so much for sharing and thank you so much for being my swap partner this month. :)
Thanks for sharing another great recipe Debbwl.  I really enjoyed these sweet and spicy carrots. I used nice organic carrots,they worked great with this recipe.

What a terrific recipe.  I loved the blending of the brown sugar, eve apple, butter, white balsamic vinegar and pepper.  It was awesome.  A lovely surprise.  It was the perfect accompaniment to our st. louis bbq sauced pork chops. Thank you for sharing. :)

This lovely recipe was a winner for us Debbwl.  Loved it.  Used sweet onions, long grain rice, 2 eggs and a mixture of meats, (prime rib, sirloin roast and shrimp), I garnished with green onions. It was awesome, very quick and easy to make.  I will be making this again and again.  Thanks so much for sharing. :)

What a great soup Pat.  It's lovely, great flavor and excellent texture.  It was rich, creamy and smooth and very flavorful.  I did add addition red curry, as we like a more intense flavor(personal preference only).  Perfect treat to share with family and friends.

I enjoyed this crispy french toast.  It was a nice change to the usual.  It was quick and easy to make.  The maple syrup is the perfect topping.  Thank you for sharing this lovely treat, which I will try again.
Love chocolate, raspberries and ginger.  I'm in heaven.  What a lovely creamy, rich, decadent treat.  Thank you so much for sharing.  I will be making this often this winter.

What an incredible treat.  So quick and easy to make.  It smelled devine while baking.  It had great texture and tasted amazing. The butterscotch and tart apple make it so memorable.  Thanks so much for sharing Annacia.

Great potato dish Sharon. It was quick and easy to make. The pototoes were perfectly spiced, tender, yet crisp. I wouldn't change a thing, we enjoyed them very much.  Into my keeper box this goes.  Thanks for sharing.

Wow Anna, what a tasty treat this is. I was so surprised by the big bold flavor, I knew that it would be good, but I didn't realize just how good this simple salad really is.  Loved it, fresh, raw and oh so tasty.  The combination of lemon, cinnamon and mint creates something truly special.  I did use sugar instead of splenda. Kudos my friend for another wonderful salad.  You truly are helping to convert me into a salad eating lady. :)

WIGal, this is one excellent grilled sandwich.  We enjoyed this very much.  The apples, spices, sugar and cheese blend perfectly together, creating a very special treat. This soup was lovely, it was so flavorful and tasty.  I also didn't mash the potatoes completely, resulting in a great texture.  Thank you so much for sharing this great recipe that was quick and easy to make.

We really enjoyed this burger recipe Crafty Lady.  The flavor was outstanding.  The burgers were soft, tender and very juicy.  We served ours with sweet onion, tomato, mustard and ketchup.  Thank you so much for sharing this wonderful treat, which I will make again.

My dh & I both enjoyed this delicious stew.   It was chocked full of flavor, was quick and easy to make and is good for you.  I used fresh herbs and a good quality parmesan cheese.  What a taste exerience.  Thank you for sharing your recipe morgainegeiser.

Wonderful, wonderful, wonderful.  What a fantastic scone.  The flavor was excellent, the texture was perfect, crisp and crumbly on the outside and tender on the inside. I used golden raisins, good quality pure vanilla extract and freshly grated lemon peel. I can't wait to make these again.  The scones were incredible served warm from the oven with a little butter.  Thank you so much for sharing this recipe Lalaloula, that is going into my keeper box.

Thank you so much for sharing this wonderful recipe loof.  We enjoyed this treat very much.  The flavor of the muffins is outstanding and the texture is incredible, crunchy and soft and tender on the inside. What a lovely soup Debbwl.  We enjoyed the soup it was very tasty, full of flavors that we enjoy, unfortunately we found the wine a little overpowering. Next time I make this, and I will, I will decrease the amount of wine I add. Thank you for sharing this bright, bold, savory soup.

Gailanng you are my hero, kudos on simply the best mashed potatoe recipe ever.  Since first making this taste treat, I have made them four times, seriously four times. Thank you so much for sharing this recipe with us.  It is my favorite mashed potatoes recipe and I will be making this often.

My dh & I enjoyed this potato casserole recipe.  It was quick and easy to make, using ingredients always on hand. We thought it was a perfect side for recipe #274202, which we served it with. My dh & I both loved this bbq sauce.  It was awesome, just packed full of heat and flavor.  The only difference was that I used smoked chipotle chiles in adobe. Delcious, delicious, delicious.  My favorite dish of 2010.  Wow! what a stunner this was.  The perfect comfort food fit for family or king. Thanks for being such a great swap partner Peggy.

I loved lox, cream cheese and bagels, I felt that this recipe was tailor made for me. Wow, what flavor and the textures were all so complimentary.  I really enjoyed this lox recipe, the addition of the capers, horseradish and fennel is brilliant. Thank you so much for sharing Sharon.

This is the perfect meatloaf recipe Crafty Lady. We really enjoyed these special little treats.  The flavorful was amazing, the mini loafs were moist, tender, juicy and oh so flavorful.  I really loved the ease of this dish, it was on the table in no time at all.  A great comfort food.  Served them with homemade oven chips and vegetables for dinner, and I enjoyed the one that was leftover the next day in a sandwich.  Thank you so much for sharing another winner.  Into my keeper box this goes.

I really enjoyed this tasty treat Loof. I used a nice dark roast. I made this exactly as written and wouldn't change a thing.  Loved the addition of the vanilla extract in this. Thank you so much for sharing this lovely drink, which I will make always, being the coffee drinker that I am. Kudos my friend.
Loved this sweet and creamy iced coffee.  It was quick and easy to make with excellent results. I used a nice bold coffee for a wonderful latte flavor.  Thanks for sharing your treat Katew.

Awesome recipe, quick and easy to make with fabulous results.  I made exactly as written using a variety of mini gem potatoes.  So good, perfect amount of seasonings and cooking time. The potatoes were tender and oh so flavorful. Into my keeper box this goes, thank you so much for sharing this tasty recipe.

A big loud good morning to you.  What a great jolt in the morning, bold, deep and robust.  I loved the combo of spices in this espresso, the ratio was perfect.  I did add 1 tsp sugar and whipped cream garnished with coarse sugar and vanilla bean.  Thank you so much momaphet for sharing this recipe.

I so loved this tea.  It was quick and easy to make with ingredients that I always have in the pantry.  So delicious, sweet, tart, tangy and spicy.  I used a nice green tea, raw honey and meyer lemons. Into my favorites cookbook for 2011 this goes. Thanks so much for sharing with us Coasty.

These pancakes were delish.  They were quick and very easy to make.  Make sure to  watch carefully as they browned quickly.  I yeilded 6 small pancakes and I must confess, I ate them all myself. What a winner Breezermom.  This recipe is terrific.  I used a bold, thick soya sauce and extra sesame oil because I was out of sesame seeds, otherwise made as written.  It was quick and easy to make with excellent flavors.  Garnished with green onions it was a perfect afternoon snack. Thank you so much for sharing your recipe, into my keeper box this goes.

Awesome wings, we really enjoyed these sweet, salty sticky treats.  They were quick and easy to make.  I upped the red pepper flakes and brown sugar (personal preference only) and used a dark soya sauce.  Made in a cookie sheet it worked great with this recipe.  Thanks for sharing a recipe that I will make again.

This egg dish was really lovely.  We enjoyed it for breakfast with toasted rosemary foccia, cherry tomatoes and bacon.  The eggs were runny, just the way we like them. I loved the quickness and ease of the dish.  Best of all its made from common ingredients found in most kitchens. Thank you for sharing this recipe.

My dh & I really enjoyed this dish.  It was the first time that we tried eggplant and we loved it.  It was quick and easy to make, tender and crisp with a slightly sweet, yet savory flavor. I used white balsamic vinegar and green onions instead of chives, I also added a small sweet potato. Thank you starrynews for sharing a recipe that we will enjoy again and again.

We enjoyed these marinated tomatoes very much.  It was a quick and easy recipe to make, had good texture, a nice tart flavor and was well balanced. I scaled the recipe down for two people, it worked great. Used all ingredients listed and made as directed.  Can't wait to try these this summer with fresh tomatoes and orengano from the garden.  Thanks for sharing your recipe Debbwl.  Made for Favorites 2011

What a nice lunch this made with fresh homemade bread.  Yummy.  The salad was perfect, it tasted as good as it looked. The organic baby Spring Mixed Greens were a nice base for the pears and feta. Thanks for sharing this tasty treat Katzen. Made for Favorites of 2010.

I loved this simple, quick and easy to make recipe Elmotoo.  It was awesome.  I used frozen berries from my own bushes that I froze last summer, what a great way to use them up.  Added lemon slices, vanilla bean, allspice and cinnamon to the pot for a fantastic treat.  My dil and I enjoyed this very much, thank you for sharing this lovely treat.

januarybride I love your drink recipes, they never disappoint.  What a treat this kiwi juice turned out to be.  Tart, tangy sweet and absolutely delicious.  Smooth and silky with a great after taste. This will be going into my Favorites for 2011 I can't wait to make this for girl's weekend this summer, I will be adding some Grey Goose to the mixture. . Kudos on a quick and easy to make recipe that is sure to thrill.

Wow, was this good MomLuvs6.  Truly an outstanding cake. I absolutely adored the flavor and texture of this cake. Easily the best cake I have made on this site so far. I split the cake added fresh stewed strawberries and vanilla whipped cream and garnished with a little powdered sugar. This beautiful treat will be going into my Best of 2011 cookbook.  Thank you to momaphet for recommending it and also a big thank you to MomLuvs6 for sharing her recipe with all of us.  Made for best of 2010.

What a tasty sauce Katzen.  We loved the tart,tangy, raw flavors with a hint of heat.  It was wonderful served over fusilli noodles and garnished with shredded parmesan cheese and recipe #186620 (Mom's Meatballs).  What a great meal it made.  The sauce was quick and easy to make with ingredients always found in the pantry.  My dh is looking forward to the leftovers today for lunch, stated that it is a wonderful comfort food.  Thank you so much for sharing, made for Best of 2010.

Excellent, simply Excellent.  Lynn's Favorite Jerk Chicken, is now my favorite jerk chicken.  This is so good, so much flavor and I love the way the heat hits you after you have taken a bite and swallowed.  So wonderful, you can actually taste the different flavors in this dish.  I made exactly as written, marinated over night and broiled in the oven.  Thank you so much Lynn for sharing this wonderful recipe, which has gone into my keeper box.  This treat will be going into my Favorites for 2011.  So happy I choose this recipe to make for Pac 2011.

Congratulations to your son, you have a little chef in the making.  I enjoyed this for my lunch today. This recipe was quick and easy to make, was tender and very easy to eat.  Thanks for sharing.

Another awesome recipe from gailanng.  These were excellent.  They reminded us a little of sheppard's pie. Made exactly as written, but garnished differently, added the butter and sour cream then add sliced green onions. These tender potatoes were full of flavor. Can't wait to make these again.  Thanks for sharing my friend. Made for Pac 2011.

What a great pot of tea this recipe makes. I loved all the flavors in this delicious cuppa, I used organic green tea, homemade chinese 5-spice powder and wildflower honey along with 1% milk. Thanks for sharing your recipe Syd, it was delicious. I really enjoyed this tart and tangy treat.  I marinated it over night and enjoyed it the next day for lunch.  I made exactly as written seasoning it with fresh ground sea salt and black pepper just before serving.

Wow, what an awesome recipe weekend cooker, resulting in pork that tasted incredible and was quick and easy to make.  The porkloin was moist, tender, cooked perfectly while the rub was too die for. I will be adding this recipe to my cookbook of favorites for 2011.

Boomie, I loved these pancakes.  They were the best.  Light, fluffy, tender and full of flavor. I garnished them simply with a pat of butter and some icing sugar.  Thank you so much for sharing a recipe that I plan on enjoying often. I will be adding this recipe to my favorites cookbook for 2011.

Another winner for the Coffee Queen.  I adored this simple treat. It was quick and easy to make and tasted incredible.  I must confess I had two servings that morning. Thanks for sharing your recipe Syd.  It was cool and refreshing.  I enjoyed the combination of cranberry, lime and grenadine. This tart treat will be perfect this summer by the pool.

My dh & I loved, loved, this dish.  It was awesome, so many textures and so much flavor. We really enjoyed the tart, tangy, sweet, vegetables and sausage. Thanks so much for sharing a recipe that I will make often BakinBaby.

Thank you for sharing your recipe Theresa.  We really enjoyed the chicken prepared this way.  I used chicken legs and wings from a large chicken and was very happy with the results.  I did marinade overnight.  The chicken had a subtle spicy flavor and was moist and tender.

What a lovely coffee diner.  I really enjoyed this treat.  It had a lovely spicy mocha flavor with a kick. It was so quick and easy to make, that it could be dangerous. I can forsee myself enjoying these often, way too often.  Thanks so much for sharing another winner.

This was a lovely recipe Noo.  All the ingredients blended together perfectly to create a tasty dish. I couldn't find salsify so omitted it from the recipe. Made the recipe exactly as written and marinaded the chicken for 4 hours. Thanks for sharing your recipe.

We enjoyed this tasty comfort food very much Ingrid.  The pasta was perfectly cooked, bathed in sauce and wrapped in warm melted cheese. Thank you so much for sharing.

Yummy.  What a wonderful cup of coffee Debbwl.  I really enjoyed this spicy coffee, it blended beautifully with the rum flavoring. It was so quick and easy to make.  I must confess I drank the whole pot. The spices were right on.  Thank you for sharing this beautifully balanced coffee, which I served with sugar and whipped cream, garnished with my favorite vanilla bean and coarse sugar mixture.

My dh & I enjoyed this simple thai dish very much.  It was quick and easy to make, with spectacular results.  The flavor was outstanding and the chicken was tender. Thanks for sharing another winner Deantini.

Loved, loved this sandwich.  It was awesome. Thank you for sharing this awesome spice blend Chocolatl.  We enjoyed it very much. Great flavors.  I used it on skinless, boneless chicken fillets.  What a treat this was.
