Oh wow......the simplicity of this recipe, alongside the fact that it tastes just wonderful makes this an absolute surefire winner!!<br/>I actually have this book, but admit that this recipe didn't grab me, and shake me around until I read the reviews here....and boy am I glad that THAT happened!!<br/>I didn't grill mine, as it was tipping with rain ( typical-first time in about three months!), so took my cue from another review, and used a wok.....fabulous...just can't say enough good stuff about it!!<br/>Seeing stars diner...and lots of them.....you should be!!!<br/>Made for PRMR.

This really is PERFECT!!!!  We've made this twice now, both times with equally fantastic results.<br/>DH is over the moon with happiness now that his bacon can be cooked just the way he likes it, and I am too, as I'm going to get bacon sandwiches cooked for me every weekend now!!!<br/>Winners all round.....big thanks Elmotoo.<br/>Made for AUS/NZ RECIPE SWAP #76.

I used half minced beef, and half Italian sausage for this recipe ( I prefer a mixture).<br/>I also added a dash of bicarbonate of soda to the mix to take some sting out of the tomatoes. I also added some salt and a sprinkle of oregano to the ricotta mixture to lift it a little.<br/>A good, tasty lasagne recipe, that we thoroughly enjoyed!!<br/>Made for PRMR.

What an absolutely fabulous and effective idea-I love it!!<br/>I used plenty of cheese, peppers, ham and onion with a few chilli flakes thrown in for good measure.<br/>A real lip smacker of a lunch,  thanks Rosie.<br/>Going to teach DH how to make these, as he loves omelets, and can't make them!<br/>Made for PRMR.

Made with homemade chilli...this was my children's first encounter of a chilli dog....they absolutely loved it, and have had me make it several more times....especially when they have friends over.<br/>A massive hit...thank you pammyowl xx<br/>Made for PRMR.

OH WOW...DH and I absolutely loved these!!!<br/>I made them as directed...I highly recommend the bag technique.... and like other reviewers didn't need to cook mine for the length of time specified.<br/>They were crisp, moist and very very tasty!!<br/>We ate some of them plain, and tossed some in Louisiana Wing Sauce...both versions were delicious!!<br/>This is definitely a make again...and again recipe for us....!!<br/>Thank you very much for sharing.<br/>Made for PRMR
This made really big fat stuffed burgers...that made really big fat stuffed tummies in our house...with equally big grins to go with them!!<br/>Yummy...thank you!!<br/>Made for PRMR.

My lot are not great pork chop lovers...and I am always trying to find ways of getting them to eat them, as I love them!<br/>So I'm pleased to report that this worked out really nicely for me....the chops were deliciously moist and tender, and apart from the 8 year old moaning about the lemon ( but he did consume the whole chop!!) , all comments were very complimentary.<br/>We did use a little barbecue sauce, but it's not strictly necessary.<br/>A fantastically quick and easy dish, that I thank you for!<br/>Made for PRMR.

Totally delicious......loved the shallot and especially the garlic....yummy!<br/>Mine broke up when I tried to turn them, but I ended up with even more scrummy crispy bits...which was even better!!<br/>The entire family loved and devoured this...so this is a real keeper!<br/>Made with pleasure for Rookie Tag.

What a fabulous recipe!!! <br/>This proved to be a real hit in our household....especially with the children, who don't really like creamy based sauces!!<br/>I  used a mixture of chicken mince and chopped chicken, which worked really well...and  only used red peppers, and skipped the celery.<br/>I recommend that the peas are totally defrosted, as mine weren't quite there, and therefore the end result was a little runny, but we didn't care, and it tasted absolutely wonderful.<br/>Served with salad and crisp garlic bread....totally delicious!!<br/>The children ( aged 6 and 8!!) even told me that I could definitely make it again...now that's an endorsement!!<br/>Made for PRMR.

Like Diner and others, I opted for a whole steak rather than kabobs...<br/>unfortunately, I has to cook mine indoors, as the weather turned on me ....but I'm looking forward to cooking these on the grill....as I think it will take them from great to really great!!<br/>Made for PRMR.
YES...this was a great chicken cheese steak....<br/>Had to use breast instead of thigh to keep DH happy...but happy he certainly was, after wolfing down one of these!!<br/>Made for PRMR.

These were great tasting burgers...so easy to make that 6 year old DD gave me a hand ( which she loved !!!).<br/>Simple and effective burger recipe that we all enjoyed and will definitely use again.<br/>Thanks so much!<br/>Made for PRMR.
SUPER....YES!!<br/>EASY...YES!!<br/>Loved by the entire family and devoured with glee....YES...and....YES!!!<br/>Made for PRMR.

Great meatloaf.....we covered half with bbq  sauce and half with ketchup...totally delicious.... and the leftovers were every bit as good too...!!<br/>Another winner from your stable of recipes....thank you.<br/>Made for PRMR.

YES.....this may well be low fat....but probably not so much, when you actually want to eat the entire dish yourself because it tastes so darn good!!!<br/>Just try and take the dish away from me, and make me share it.......I think NOT..!!!!!<br/>Made for PRMR.
I never would have thought to fry pasta like this...but I'm very glad that someone did!!<br/>This was cheesy deliciousness, that I just couldn't get enough of.<br/>Made for Zaar Stars.

Five stars for this recipe is somewhat mean...these wings deserve a solid TEN!!!<br/>These got devoured in double quick time.<br/>The wings were crispy on the outside, succulent on the inside, and the sauce was just amazing...sweet, mustardy with a touch of heat...all perfectly balanced and finger licking good!!<br/>A sure fire winner in our book....many thanks Teresa.<br/>Made for PRMR.<br/>Made for PRMR,

Simple store cupboard items come together to make a most delicious rub.<br/>I rubbed mine liberally all over some beautiful fat pork loin chops, left them for fifteen minutes, and then threw them onto the grill.<br/>The chops were sweet and  smoky, with a nice herbiness about them, which we thoroughly enjoyed.<br/>Looking forward to trying it again on other meats this summer!<br/>Thanks Rosie.<br/>Made for PRMR.

Quick, simple and quite delicious.......so much so, that after my 7 year old DD tried some, she abandoned her own meal, and hijacked my bowl of it!<br/>I love this simplicity of this, and the versatility too, as I know that some cooked shredded chicken, and some sweetcorn ( even creamed corn) would just be fantastic in this.<br/>Thanks Rosie, for a wonderful recipe.<br/>Made for PRMR.

Super scrummy pizza topping.....just needed a few chilli flakes to pep it up a little for our tastes.<br/>I used our favourite homemade pizza sauce, and went with the pineapple option ( which DH wasn't impressed with at first, but thoroughly enjoyed!).<br/>Cheers Peter....great recipe.....I salute you!<br/>Made for AUS/NZ SWAP#84

Yummy yummy  yummy .........this dish was a big hit, even with seven and nine year old peskies, who are particular about their pasta!<br/>I took tips from previous reviews and saved on cleaning up, by mixing the sauces, cheese and pasta together with meat in the pan....a good move!<br/>Leftovers are just as tasty.....and I still have some stashed in the freezer, for when I need a good meal on the table fast.<br/>Thanks for a top notch recipe Rosie.<br/>Made for PRMR.

Yum, yum YUM!!!!<br/>We absolutely LOVED this one.......it's quick and easy enough to treat yourself to a great breakfast before dashing out of the door to begin another busy day.<br/>We also loved it without the salsa, but smothered in Cholula Hot sauce, or Tabasco Chipotle Pepper Sauce.<br/>Deliciously fantastic way to start the day....big thumbs up from us!!!<br/>Made for PRMR.
The flavor of this soup was excellent, however, it was not very thick like I would expect a cream soup to be. I will make it again and play with it to make it more to our liking as far as thickness.
While we didn't try the pancakes because of my wheat allergy, I did make the Blood Orange Honey Sauce.  It was pretty good - a nice change from maple syrup.

Made for Zaar Tag 08A.  I made this for a monthly healthy carry-in that we have at work.  I haven't taken it to work yet, but I did save a little bit out for me to eat and it was absolutely wonderful. So much lower in calories and fat than using sour cream and it tastes good too!  Thanks Kate for a great recipe!
Very Good.  Made for 2008 All New Zaar Cookbooks Tag.  These would make a great breakfast for company. Thanks WiGal for a great recipe.

Was looking for something different to have with chicken instead of regular old mashed potatoes.  I liked them, but the rest of my family didn't care for them.  They didn't like the broccoli with the potatoes.  I will try them again without the broccoli. Thanks Utahmomtotwo.
Made for 2008 All New Zaar Cookbooks Tag.  Very yummy and very easy to make.  Will be making these quite often.  Thanks for a great recipe.

Made for Newest Zaar Tag 2008.  Made these over the weekend.  All I can say is "yummy"   These were so easy and the chicken just fell off the bones!  Will definitely make this again.  Thanks Boomette for posting this!

Made for Recipe Swap #16 Aus/NZ.  Very good & easy breakfast.  I only made half of the recipe because I was the only one around at the time.  Will definitely make this again and it's also very easy to transport and warm up for breakfast at work.  Thanks Chef1Mom for this recipe that I will use over and over!

Made for Healthy Choices 2008 ABC (May).  These weren't as sweet as I expected them to be, but they were good none the less.  I was able to make these GF by substituing Bob's Red Mill AP GF Flour and GF Oats.  Thanks for posting this recipe Redsie!

Made for Newest Zaar Tag 2008 (April).  Very yummy dressing.  I made this with fat free Greek yogurt and skim milk.  I eat a lot of salad and am always looking for new salad dressing recipes and this one was great - reminded me of tzatziki sauce.  Thanks for posting this Boomette!

Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders Tag Game.  We really enjoyed the flavor of this glaze.  I think that next time I made this I will double the sauce and marinate the chicken in it before grilling so the flavor imparts into the chicken.  Thanks for posting this, loof!

Made for "I Reccomend Recipe Tag"  These were great!  Mine were a little soggy, but that's because I didn't do a very good job of planning dinner tonight.  Other than that, the flavor was fantastic and they browned up really nice.  I'll be making these again.  Thanks for posting this, Susie!

Made for "I Recommend Recipe" Tag.  Really easy oatmeal recipe.  It's great that you can put it in the oven and walk away - no standing at the stove watching it cook.  The other great thing is that it reheats really well.  Thanks Boomette for posting this recipe.
Made for Aus/NZ - Make My Recipe Edition 5.  This was incredibly easy and very good.  I love anything teriyaki!  Served this with rice and pea pods!  Thanks for posting this January Bride!
Made for "I Recommend" Recipe Tag.  We really enjoy rooibos tea and have it quite often so I thought this would be a nice change.  This was okay, but I would prefer plain rooibos tea.

Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders 2008 Tag.  Another successful transition to a GF cooking using GF oats!  They sure didn't last long, but considering they have all the elements of breakfast food - a couple of cookies and a cup of yogurt and you've got breakfast!  Thanks for posting this Boomette!

Very yummy shake.  My oldest DS and I thought it was fantastic, but my DD wasn't quite so sure, but that's probably because she's not really that fond of chocolate covered cherries.  At any rate, I will definitely make this over and over again.  It was wonderful. Thanks for creating this naturally gluten free desert!!!!

Made for Aus/NZ - Make My Recipe Edition 5.  This was a very good salad recipe - due to dietary restrictions I had to leave the sesame seeds and oil out, but otherwise it was good (I'm sure it would have been better with these two ingredients).  Very easy to do and all you need with it is a grilled chicken breast and you're good to go.  Thanks for posting this JanuaryBride!

Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders 2008 Tag. Excellent marinade. I used this on boneless baby back ribs and they were so juicy and tender! Thanks for posting this LavendarLynn!  Update 10/6/08 - Leftovers of this (if you happen to have some - I made extra) are great in flatbreads as gyros!  Yummy!

Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders 2008 Tag.  I've always been skeptical of fish tacos.  It just didn't seem right, but I decided to take the plunge and try them.  Am I ever glad that I did.  These are awesome and there wasn't a drop left over. The only thing I would do different next time was to make a double batch of the slaw.  Thanks for posting this Heidi!

This smelled awesome when it was cooking. I did have a little trouble getting my rice done, but that could have been because I used a rice blend instead of the wild rice mix that doesn't work because of food allergies. The flavor of this was excellent and I would most definitely make this again because its a great fall dish and very comforting. However, the six servings are not very large.

This was absolutely awesome.  Everyone LOVED it and I will most definitely make this again.  It's a true "Dining on a $" recipe because any veggies will do and it's a great way to use them up.  For those of you that must eat gluten-free, this works great using GF spaghetti broken up in 2-inch pieces.  Good Luck!!

Made for Recipe Swap #22 Aus/NZ.  This was yummy, yummy, yummy! :yummy:  I made this using FF vanilla ice cream instead of frozen yogurt to save on calories and WW points and it was fabulous.  Thanks for posting this twissis!
Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders 2008 Tag.  Very, very easy and soooo good.  Will definitely make this again.  Thanks for posting this BakinBaby!

Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders.  This was great. DH & I really enjoyed it.  I liked the fact that it is low in carbs.  I'm not doing a low carb diet, but I am watching my intake.  I did add a can of tomato sauce as it looked a little dry to me.  I will make this again as it was quick and easy.  Thanks for posting this Hokies!

Made for I Recommend Tag.  This is yummy.  I love oatmeal and I love peanut butter & jelly.  This was a nice change from the regular oatmeal that I eat every morning.  Thanks for posting this Melissa!

Made for Aus/NZ Recipe Swap #25.  We loved the gravy for this, but the steaks tasted just like hamburgers.  I will make this again, but next time I would add some sauted onions, oatmeal and eggs to the ground beef to make them moister and to give them a better flavor.  Other than that this recipe is a keeper.  Thanks for posting this CraftyLady!

Made for New Kid on the Block Tag.  This was absolutely wonderful.  We love sauerkraut and the only way I usually make it is with spareribs and then I put it in the crock pot.  This was a very nice change from our normal dish and I will definitely make this again.  The pork chops were just as tender as could be.  I served this with mashed potatoes.  Thanks for posting this gailanng and it definitely deserves more than 5 stars.

Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders.  This was great!  We really enjoyed it and I will make it again.  I did make a couple of changes based on our personal preferences ~ added garlic when cooking the ground beef and also added cumin along with the chili powder.  I also used black beans and V-8 juice because that what I had on hand.  Thanks for posting this Kate!

Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders.  Made this for a fellow co-worker's birthday.  It was a hit.  Four people asked for the recipe and I was glad to share it.  This is a very moist flavorful cake.  The only thing that I had an issue with was the frosting.  When I was mixing the frosting, it appeared to be a little too thin so I added an additional 1/2 cup of powdered sugar - big mistake - I should have left well enough alone - it was very difficult to spread what I had over the cake - so I rescued it with another layer of frosting (not made according to these directions) and it was just fine.  Also, I was able to successfully make this gluten free by substituting 2/3 cup brown rice flour, 2/3 cup cornstarch, and 2/3 cup tapioca starch and adding 1 tsp xanthan gum.  Thanks for posting this wonderful recipe, breezermom!

Made for Potluck Tag.  These were great waffles ~ I loved the cornmeal in them.  I also added the vanilla and 1/2 cup of ground flax seed.  These are so healthy for you and I will be making them again.  Thanks for posting this recipe kittycatmom!

Made for Every Day is a Holiday Tag!  What a yummy, yummy dessert!  The only thing that I did different was to use brown sugar Splenda instead of regular Splenda.  This tasted just like apple pie without all the fattening ingredients in apple pie.  We always have apples on hand, so I will make this yummy treat quite often.  Thanks for posting this Brooke the Cook!
Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders.  This was really good.  I didn't chill the mug but that wasn't important to me.  Thanks for posting this Nif!

Made for I Recommend Tag.  What a wonderful dish.  It was super easy and tasted fantastic.  The only thing that I would do different next time was to double the sauce recipe as we like a lot of sauce with these kinds of dishes to soak up in to the rice.  Thanks for posting this Queen Dana!

Made for Zaar Stars.  Oatmeal is one of my favorite breakfast foods mainly because it fills me up and keeps me satisfied for a long time.  I'm always willing to try oatmeal a new way and will always look for oatmeal recipes for tag games.  This one was wonderful.  I loved the toasted almonds along with the sweetness of the apple and the maple syrup.  Thanks for posting this Sharon!

Made for Went to Market Tag.  Excellent mashed potatoes.  The garlic and sage go together very well ~ a different combination that I was a little leary of, but had no reason to be.  Thanks for posting this Nif.

Made for Aus/NZ Recipe Swap #26.  These were good, the only thing is that there was a little too much sauce.  Liked the sweetness ~ I think next time I make them I would cut the chicken broth in half.

Made for Aus/NZ Make My Recipe ~ Edition #7.  This was great.  The garlic is not overpowering at all. I was a little skeptical about eating one of the garlic cloves ~ I didn't but maybe next time I will.  The chicken was very tender and flavorful.  I used boneless skinless thighs.  Thanks for posting this Chef FloWer!

Made for Newest Zaar Tag!  I can't say enough good things about these blondies ~ they are awesome!  I love the subtle taste of peanut butter in the bar and the addition of the peanut butter chips.  I much prefer to make bar cookies over regular cookies because they are much quicker to bake.  These will be added to my regular rotation of baking.  Thanks for posting this recipe.

Made for PAC Spring 2009.  Other than the fact that I wasn't sure how to use this (I used about 1 cup of water and an 8 oz can of tomato sauce), this was awesome.  Even DH commented on how good it was ~ he usually doesn't comment much unless he really likes something.  I do have my own enchilada sauce recipe posted, but it is time consuming.  Will definitely make then when I'm time crunched.  Would be a great recipe to make up in advance so you have it on hand.  Thanks for posting this Flower!

Made for Everyday is a Holiday Tag.  Excellent cookies!  I loved the mini chocolate chips and the peanut butter flavor.  Very easy to convert to gluten free ~ just used my favorite gluten free flour mix and gluten free oats.  Yummy!  Thanks for posting this!

Made for Every Day is a Holiday Tag. Peanut butter is one of my favorite things (after chocolate, of course).  I really enjoyed this.  I did add some brown sugar and 1 T of ground flax seed after it was cooked (always add ground flax seed to my oatmeal).  Thanks for posting this Brooke!

Made for Aus/NZ Make My Recipe Edition 7.  We didn't really care for these.  They were nice and tender, but we thought the amount of basil was overpowering.  I might make these again, but would definitely cut back on the amount of basil.

Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders.  Excellent stir fry sauce.  I did, however, leave out the sesame oil because of an allergy, but it was wonderful anyway.  I can imagine how good it would be with the sesame oil.  DH loved it the way it was. Will definitely make this again.  Thanks for posting this Kitten!

Made for Went to Market Tag.  We enjoyed these even though I was only able to marinate these for about 30 minutes because it was getting late and I had to change my dinner plans at the last minute because my other meat didn't thaw out in the refrigerator (don't like using my microwave to thaw meat).  Served with recipe #330132 and pasta for a quick weeknight meal.  Thanks for posting this Nif!
Made for Went to Market Tag.  These were excellent muffins.  Loved the orange flavor in combination with the blueberries.  Thanks for posting this Boomette!

These were excellent.  I served them with rice and grilled adobo chicken thighs.  The only thing that I would do different would be to add more spice as they weren't quite as spicy as we like.  I used two 15 oz cans of black beans in place of the dry beans.  Thanks for posting this Lazyme!

Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders.  There aren't enough stars to give this recipe.  Our local grocery store had blackberries on sale for $1 a carton (they're usually over $3) and this recipe was perfect for the fresh berries.  Took them to work today and they were gone in no time.  Will be trying these later with fresh raspberries.  This is an excellent spring/summer dessert.  Thanks for posting this!

Made for Everyday is a Holiday.  I only made half of the recipe as no one else here even wants to think about eating home-made salad dressing ~ who know why???  Anyway, I rather enjoyed this and will make it again.  Thanks for posting this.

Made for New Kid on the Block Tag.  This is a wonderful salad dressing and it has two of my favorites ~ honey mustard and poppy seed.  It was very easy and I will make this often.  The only thing that I changed was to substitute plain fat free yogurt for half of the mayo to cut down on the fat in this recipe.  Other than that I followed it exactly.  Thanks for posting this Amy!

Made for Newest Zaar Tag.  These burgers really were juicy, but the real star of this recipe is the rub ~ it was awesome.  I was so tickled to find a rub that didn't include black pepper.  I'm allergic to black and white pepper and always leave it out of recipes that include it but this time I didn't have to.  Can't wait to try this rub on other meats.  Thanks, Sharon!!!

Made for Went to Market Tag.  This was a nice change from the usual broccoli with butter on it that I normally serve.  The only thing that I would do different (just personal preference) would be to use fresh broccoli (don't like all the stem pieces on frozen broccoli).  Thanks for posting this Nimz!

Made for Everyday is a Holiday Tag.  If I could give a recipe more than five stars this would be one of them.  We all loved it - this is pure comfort food.  The cornbread topping is so good and the filling is nice and creamy.  I did leave out the mushrooms due to an allergy and increased the corn to 1 cup.  Will definitely make this again as I always have these ingredients on hand.  Thanks BabyKato for a great recipe!

Made for Aus/NZ Recipe Swap #28.  These were good and I was glad to find a tortilla that worked out well  I've had many disasters with making tortillas and it didn't happen this time.  The only thing that I did different was to omit the xanthan gum (I'm allergic to it) and replace it with 1 T ground flax seed.  Thanks Az!

Made for 1-2-3 Hits.  Wonderful potatoes - the top crust came out nice and brown just like the photo that diner posted.  Followed the recipe as written except that I only made half of the recipe. Served with meatloaf and green beans for our Father's Day Dinner.  Thanks breezermom!

Made for Zaar Stars.  These are great muffins.  I like the fact that this recipe only makes 6 muffins (no work to figuring out half). Loved the combination of almond, coconut and chocolate chips!  Thanks for posting this Hokies!
Made for Potluck Tag.  This goes together super fast.  I love peanut butter on apples and this is even better.  Like the sweetness that the honey adds.  Thanks for posting this Hokies!!

Made for Potluck Tag.  This a great rice recipe.  I couldn't believe that it was done in 11 minutes and was perfectly tender and for once my rice didn't boil over.  Will definitely make this again.  Thanks Grumpy!

Made for I Recommend Tag.  Since discovering some additional food allergies, I've been on a quest to find good salad dressings and this one is great.  Love the sweet and tangy flavor.  I only used two tablespoons of oil instead of three and it still tasted great.  The only thing that I might do different next time is to use honey instead of sugar.  Thanks for posting this Jackie!

Made for Everyday is a Holiday.  Very easy and tasty fish and it's quick to fix.  Love the lime flavor with the herbs.  I used tilapia for this and will be making this often.  Thanks Realtor for posting this.

Made for Every Day is a Holiday.  This is a nice little pound cake.  While it's nice to have leftovers, there are times when I don't want a lot of extra dessert hanging around.  Thanks for posting this Realtor!

Made for 1~2~3 Hits.  These were good, but we thought they could have used a little more lemon flavor.  So next time, I will do like one of the other reviewers and add some lemon juice.  Thanks for posting this breezermom.
Made for Gimme 5.  We were split on this ~ DD loved it, DH was indifferent and I thought it was missing something.  It was however, very easy and great for a quick weeknight meal.  Thanks diner!

Made for Potluck Tag.  The main reason that I chose this recipe was for the salad dressing as I'm always looking for different dressing recipes to try.  The dressing was so easy and tasted fantastic.  I had it on salad that was similar, but excluded eggs and included cooked diced chicken and craisins (a salad isn't a salad without craisins).  Thanks for posting this Starry!

Made for I Recommend Tag.  This was an excellent dish and a great use for leftover chicken.  Because of some allergies that I have, I needed to make a couple of substitutions for the enchilada sauce I used #306854 and for the cornbread mix, I used 1/2 cup + 2 T of gluten free flour, 1/2 cup cornmeal, 2 T sugar, 1/2 t baking powder and 1/4 t baking soda.  I did have to bake the base layer a little longer than the recipe notes, but that wasn't an issue.  Thanks for posting this seesko!

Made for Gimme 5 Tag.  I don't generally care for sweet with warm vegetables, but the sweetness of the honey combined with the saltiness of the butter was a perfect match.  Thanks for posting this Lavendar Lynn!

Made for Comfort Cafe ~ Summer 2009.  These were excellent and we loved the orange flavor.  Would like to have grilled them but we were short on time (use charcoal and you know how long that takes! LOL!).  Used boneless pork loin chops and thickened the sauce with a little bit of cornstarch.  Thanks for a yummy recipe Gatorbek!

We really enjoyed this ~ the flavor was just right and none of the ingredients were overpowering!  Used the outdoor grill instead of the broiler.  Served with recipe #250042.  Thanks for posting this alli!  Made for Went to Market Tag

Yummy, yummy, yummy......Did I say this was yummy???  I eat oatmeal just about every morning for breakfast and it's nice to have something different.  I've never put applesauce in my oatmeal so I wasn't quite sure what to expect.  I was pleasantly surprised with the flavor the applesauce added.  Thanks for posting this.  Made for Zaar Cookbooks Tag.

Made for Newest Zaar Tag.  Excellent dressing.  Loved the flavor combination.  I didn't have any fresh garlic cloves so I used 1/2 tsp garlic powder, but will definitely use fresh garlic next time.  DD usually turns her nose up at some of the dressings that I make, but she couldn't leave this one alone!  Thanks for posting this Nif!
Made for I Recommend Tag.  This was okay, but I much prefer actual brownies.  I had a problem with the texture - wasn't quite what I expected.  It was good, though for a quick chocolate fix.

Made for Zaar Stars.  Excellent marinade for steak.  You could taste all of the flavors in this and not one overwhelmed the other.  I used flank steak because that is what I had.  Will definitely make this again.  Thanks for posting this Diner!

Made for 123 Hits.  This is a great recipe and we really enjoyed it.  Nice for those times when you want to have steak that is marinated but don't have time or forget (which I often do).  Thanks for posting this bmcnichol!

Made for Farmer's Market Tag.  What a great way to use zucchini and a nice change from regular coleslaw.  I need to make this again because I used rice wine vinegar and really think I should have used either white or apple cider vinegar as it wasn't really very sweet using rice wine vinegar.  Thanks for posting this Rita!

Made for Everyday is a Holiday Tag.  What a great way to use leftover cooked chicken.  I'm always looking for different ways to use cooked chicken (get tired of casseroles).  Loved the flavor of the sauce along with the guac and sour cream.  These make a great week night dinner as they are quick and easy!  Thanks for posting this Debb!

Made for Gimme 5.  We really enjoyed this and I will most definitely make this again.  We are big fans of cranberries and love the tart taste of them.  The almond extract adds a nice touch.  Thanks for posting this Hokies! :D

Made for New Kid on the Block Tag.  This is excellent and very flavorful.  I like the fact that this doesn't have added oil.  The only thing that I did different was to add some plain fat free Greek yogurt to make it a little bit thicker which is just a personal preference.  Thanks for posting this Realtor!

We enjoyed this cornbread and it was so easy.  I made this in a 8" square pan and it did need to bake a little longer than 20 minutes.  I did leave the corn out of it but next time I will try it with the corn.  The only change that I would make the to recipe is to add about a 1/2 teaspoon of salt as I thought it a little bit bland, but that doesn't affect my rating.  Also, I was able to make this gluten free by using my favorite GF flour blend.  Made for Fall PAC 2009.  Thanks for posting this Loula!

I just love being able to find pizza crust recipes that are easily convertible to gluten free and that don't contain yeast.  This was very good and I will definitely make this again.  I only used the cheeses and not the vegetables, but will be trying it with the vegetables next time.  Thanks for posting this Loula!  Made for Fall 2009 PAC.

Oatmeal is one of my favorite breakfast foods.  But, I was a little bit skeptical when I saw this recipe ~ thought there was way too much salt and sugar, but I made it that way anyway.  Am I ever glad that I did.  The salt and sugar balanced each other out and the butter added great flavor for a very creamy oatmeal. Will definitely make this again.  Thanks for posting this recipe. We love zucchini! Our garden won't produce for a month or so (if the weather EVER gets warm), so I had to buy it. I also had one small yellow squash in the frige, so I added it...it looked pretty together! I sauteed the shallots on medium high heat to caramelize them, then added the squash.
