This is a wonderful soup for a cold day....or just when you feel the need for a comforting bowl of soup.  I chose to add the mushrooms, using the full 8 oz package.  I really enjoyed this, and will make it again.  Made for TYM tag.  Thanks for sharing!

Very quick and easy, and great tasting!  They came out looking like they were breaded lightly and nicely browned.  I think that next time I will rub the filets with some lemon and season them lightly for the initial broiling time.  I'd like to give 4 1/2 stars, but Zaar won't let me:(.

I really didn't know if I should rate this 4 or 5 stars.  I knew I would need more seasoning....I'd have to have some salt and pepper!  So when baking, I topped with Cavendar's Greek Seasoning.  I don't know how this would taste without it, but with it....it is fabulous!  I do have a question about the serving size...3 thighs for one person?  I had a package of 4 thighs, so I increased the marinade a bit and added 5 more small new potatoes....this was perfect for us.  Served 2, with absolutely no leftovers, and everyone sucking their fingers for more!  So its a 5 with the added seasonings!  Thanks for posting.  Made for Zaar Stars.
I halved the recipe, and they turned out great.  I did cheat a little and I added  some diced up "sugared jalapenos" to a few of the eggs.  Loved the recipe!  Made for Think Pink!

I've never had the Ruby Tuesday's version, so I'm not sure if it tasted like their version.  This is a good basic recipe, but it wasn't quite what we were looking for...I think it may have been the cheese dip.  I'd like to give 3 1/2 stars, but Zaar doesn't permit.  Made for Zaar Stars tag.

This was very good!  I made it exactly as posted, and it was very good like that.  I had some steamed asparagus leftover from last night, so I chopped and heated it and threw it in as well.  I did seem to have a high ratio of sauce to pasta, so I think you could possibly stretch this dish to serve more. Thanks for posting!  Made for TYM tag.

Deceptively simple!  You would never know how easy this recipe is by reading the ingredients.  Very yummy.  I'd increase the sauce by a bit, but I like a lot of sauce.  I truly enjoyed this chicken!  Thanks for posting a great recipe.  Made for 123 Hit Wonders tag!

This was a very nice marinade. I marinated my NY Strip for about 2 hours, then grilled it.  I think next time I will let it marinade overnight to let my meat absorb more of the flavors.  4 stars for my short marinating time, but 5 stars for the possibilities!  Made for Zaar Stars!  Thanks for posting.

Very hearty breakfast, or it could be dinner!  I shredded Monterrey Jack cheese, and used part of a ham steak, so my ham was pretty thick.  I cooked my egg for 3 minutes, and the yolk was hot but runny.  Thanks for posting.  Made for Newest Tag!

I may be a purist, because I didn't really like these carrots.  My DS did like them though....although he refused to eat the raisins! So 4 stars for getting DS to eat cooked carrots....he only eats raw!  I think there was too much cinnamon... would reduce it if I make these again.  Thanks for posting a nice vegetable recipe!  Made for Zaar Stars.
This was good, but I think I would cut the potatoes into smaller wedges to let more of the potato be exposed to the mustard mix.  Made for TYM Tag.

Who would have thought that fresh lemon juice and olive oil would make such a good dressing?  I have quite a fondness for kalamata olives and feta cheese, so I knew I would love this!  This salad did not disappoint.  Thanks for posting!

This is a really different tasting deviled egg.  I love mango chutney, and this added quite a twist to a traditional treat.  Loved the curry powder as well.  I enjoyed these deviled eggs very much, but other guests weren't quite as fond of them....preferring a more traditional style of deviled egg.

I marinated chicken thighs and drumsticks for 5 to 6 hours....started marinating when I went home for lunch, and started cooking after I got off work!  They turned out very moist and the marinade was perfect.  Thanks for posting!
I loved this!  Didn't even realize it needed to be chilled when I picked it....I just had some asparagus I needed to use!  The taste is fabulous...thanks for another great recipe Teresa!

I didn't have thighs, and used boneless skinless chicken breasts.  I'm sure this detracted from the taste somewhat, but this was really good with chicken breasts.  2 large chicken breasts would definitely serve 4!  This recipe has a lot of flavor and spice, so if you don't like that, I wouldn't try it.  But if you do, this is the recipe for you.  I think Andi's idea of adding the rice to the skillet would work out great...my sauce was runny, and the rice would definitely soak that up!  Thanks for posting!
This is great!  I love brussel sprouts, and the adjusted amount of brussel sprouts matches the other ingredients well!  Thanks for posting!
Good burger.  I used white american cheese, and had to cook them inside because the weather wasn't cooperating today.  The teriyaki gave them a slightly sweet taste!  Made for Zaar Stars!

I really love brussel sprouts, so I knew I'd like this recipe.  Easy to make and easy to enjoy!  Loved the butter, parsley and chives with the brussel sprouts, but found the walnut oil detracted a bit from the taste of the sprouts.  Thanks so much for posting your yummy recipe!
These are so surprisingly light tasting!  I thought I'd taste the cream cheese and green onions more, but the flavors are very subtle.  This is a definite repeat recipe!  Thanks for sharing!

5+ Stars!!! Lots of butter, which I'll probably reduce next time...but this tastes fabulous!  I cut this down to 2 very slim fillets, and just eyeballed the rest of the ingredients.  Then I increased the black olives (used calamata olives), which I think made the dish.  I diced the garlic finely, so I didn't puree it.  This is going in my keepers book....thank you so much for sharing this wonderful recipe!  Made for Gimme 5 Tag!
Surprisingly easy and good!  I wouldn't change a thing...I can't imagine a more perfect recipe.  Healthy, quick, easy, and delicious!  Made for Holiday Tag.

I loved this!  I also sprayed my ramekins, and they turned out wonderful.  I halved this recipe with no trouble.  I almost left out the breadcrumbs, because I'm really not a fan, but I did add a little.  Used spring onions, and probably more garlic than I should have!  Made for Holiday tag...thanks for posting!

I can't say more than the other reviews...this is a wonderful marinade and the chicken is wonderful!  I loved that the marinade wasn't just liquids...so the topping on the finished chicken was chunky!  Because it was so dark, I was afraid it was burnt, but it tasted wonderful. Thanks for sharing.  Made for Holiday tag.

I used canned tomatoes, drained.  I did not add any water, but I did add garlic after the onion had cooked until tender.  My okra wasn't runny at all.  It turned out the perfect consistency for a side dish...if it had been runny, I'd just serve over rice!  I have to admit, after cooking a while, I took half out without the chili powder, then added chili powder to the rest.  Just wasn't sure about the chili powder with the okra.  Surprisingly, it was good.  I like it both ways!  Thanks for posting.  Made for Holiday tag.

This was easy to make, but didn't turn out the way I thought it would taste. I'd cook the onions while the meat is browning, so that they are nice and tender in the gravy. My onions must have been very "thick", because they weren't tender after 1 1/2 hours of cooking. I was expecting a taste more like country fried steak, but as SB6 pointed out in her zmail in response to my review, that is not what she intended with this recipe. A side of sauteed mushrooms really compliments this dish.

I marinaded for 2 hours, and this turned out wonderful!  I used boneless, skinless chicken thighs because that is what I had on hand, and grilled them outside.  Fabulous flavor!  I'll definitely make this again.  Made for PRMR tag.

Loved the tomato sauce!  It was delicious!  My roast wasn't tender after 1 1/2 hours, but I'll blame that on the roast and the fact that I had previously frozen it!.  Leaving the roast over the heat to try and get it to tenderize.  The flavors in the sauce are delicious...thanks for posting a yummy recipe!

I have to add to the other 5 star reviews!  This was amazingly easy, quick, and delicious.  I threw in some frozen vegetables when I added the chicken broth (used instead of water), and I had a one dish meal after a busy day at work.  Thanks for sharing your recipe.
This was just wonderful!  Easy and yummy.  Thanks for posting your wonderful recipe.

I made a version of this for my kids when they were young.  I'd grill or fry the hot dogs, then slice them in half....sometime I'd just cut little discs.  Then I'd melt a little butter in a skillet and spread it on one half of two slices of bread.  Put a slice of cheese and the hotdogs between the slices of bread, and make a grilled hotdog & cheese sandwich.  Then I'd mix whatever each kid liked on their hot dog...ketchup and mayo, mayo and mustard, etc in a little ramekin and they would dunk the sandwich into the sauce.  Really easy kid friendly lunch!

This was really hot!  But I didn't have 1 1/2 lbs beef round steak, just 1.3 pounds.  But no problem!  I did add the pinto beans in the last 10 minutes of cooking to heat them up.  And to cut the heat I sprinked some shredded mexican blend cheese on top.  Next time I would increase the garlic to 3 or 4 cloves instead of 2. Delicious!

These were surprisingly delicious!  With so little seasoning, I wondered....but they turned out beautifully browned....crispy on the outside and warm and tender on the inside.  I followed the earlier review and cut my potatoes in half, and this worked perfectly for me.  Thanks for sharing.

Delicious Recipe!  Quick, easy and wonderful!  I'll definitely make this again.  I used pine nuts instead of almonds since they were listed first....I'd like to try it with almonds too.  Thanks for sharing!

Super easy and quick, just what I wanted after a long Monday at work!  I made it exactly as posted this time.  Next time I think I'll substitute broccoli for the peas.  Very cheesey, and the bacon is delicious in this!  I'll have to make this for DS when he is home from college....he'll love this.  Eat it up fast....this cools off really quick! Thanks for sharing this simple and delicious pasta meal.

Delicious!  Easy to make, and really tastey.  This is an economical, yummy dish!  It used everything I normally have in my fridge, pantry, or freezer...no trip to the store for me :) !  Thanks for sharing a great drumstick recipe...loved slashing the meat to let the marinade in!
More than 5 stars!! Delicious recipe!  Thanks for sharing SarahBeth.

I scaled the recipe back too, but I don't think I scaled it back enough!  But this was guiltily delicious!  I had way too much butter for the bread I had, but just couldn't waste it :) !  So mine was extra tastey!  I did increase the garlic, but kept the other ingredients the same.  Thanks so much for sharing!

It was sooo cold here....at least for where I live! I had to have something hot, and this reminded me of what my Mom made for me on winter mornings before I moved away....delicious!! I did add some raisins. Thanks for reminding me of the simple pleasures!

I'm not sure if I was just exhausted from not sleeping the previous 2 nights, or if this actually works.  But it worked last night!  I didn't add the brandy, but this was yummy and I did sleep well last night...so 5 stars from me.

I haven't had toast and jam or chocolate milk since my kids were little!  What a treat this morning.  I did use Apricot preserves because I didn't have the strawberry.  This brought back lots of fond memories. Thanks for sharing.
Loved the mint and vanilla.  I also used the regular ratio of water to coffee.  I didn't add the whipped cream though.  Thanks for sharing.

This was very good.  I love all the ingredients, so I knew I'd like it.  I also added a little bit of chopped kale.  Mine didn't look as tomatoey as shuzbuds, so next time I'll add some more tomato.  Thanks for sharing!

Very different boiled egg recipe from what I am used to.  Once I got over them not tasting like "deviled" eggs and accepted they were meant to be a different taste, I realized that they are phenomonal.  So smooth and creamy.  I used garlic and chive cheese.  Thanks for sharing your recipe!
I really loved this!  I used baby portabellos instead of the full sized ones.  I also added a little bit of toasted pecans to the mix.  I'll do this one again.  Its very hearty and delicious!

I made the paste first, and let it sit for 2 hours.  These had a very nice taste, althought I did need to add some salt.  Served these with chicken thighs with a mango chutney sauce, and they worked really well together.  Thanks for sharing your recipe!
I'm not familiar with "Raising Cane", but this is a very good dipping sauce...sort of like Thousand Island dressing!  Thanks for sharing!
This is so good I wished I had saved this to make for after my DS came home for Christmas break.  I'll have to repeat it then!  Thanks for sharing!

Love kahlua, love rum, love coffee...what else is there to say?
Left off the whipped cream because in the frenzied holiday tag game, I'd already had a hot cocoa with whipped cream and thought I'd save myself a few calories!! Loved it.  Next time, I'll have whipped cream!

I make a similar recipe every year, but simmer it slowly over a low heat for a couple of hours...then add Captain Morgan's Spiced Rum and sit before the fire, totally relaxed, enjoying the wonderful smell that permeates the entire house!  Love spiced apple cider.  Thanks for sharing!
Yum!  I've never had butter on my tuna salad sandwiches before!  But I usually add boiled egg, so I felt I could justify the added fat & calories.  Thanks for the great recipe.  Loved it.
Tastes just like the buttered ritz crackers I use on lots of my casseroles.  I can make this more economically and easier, so I'll definitely use this again.  Thanks so much for sharing your recipe!

These were very good, but I think I still prefer plain old mashed potatoes.  The cream cheese made these very rich.  For a special dinner these would be very nice.  I didn't save these and bake them later :) because of the madness of holiday tag this week, and they were lovely served immediately after cooking!  Thanks for sharing.

I made this with the coffe liquer, and loved it.  It is quick to put together and delicious as well.  I topped with whipped cream instead of froth, just personal preference!  Thanks Pat for sharing another yummy recipe.
Yummy!  I don't think we let it cool off enough before putting it on the ice cream, so it made it a little thin, but oh sooo delicious!  Thanks for sharing!

There's nothing better than chicken fingers when you are in the mood for them!  This mayo sauce was very good....served half the chicken with it and half with Recipe #391028 391028.  Made for Holiday Tag!

I made these last night, and ooooh!  They are so good.  I love toffee, and usually its on top of chocolate, so this was a pleasant surprise for me.  I let DS eat 2 pieces, I ate one, and took the rest to work the next morning.  By 10 am, there were none left....everyone was asking me if I had more at home that I could bring in the next day!  Thanks you so much for sharing a delicious recipe!
So easy and so good!  I added a dash of salt to the butter mix, and this was just delicious.  Made for Zaar Stars Tag!
I made these yesterday to go with some Prime Rib that I made for Christmas Eve dinner.  Fabulous!  DD said it was the best part of the meal.  Thanks for sharing!

I really enjoyed these potatoes!  They almost tasted like sweet potato pie.  I made these to go with a ham at Christmas, and they paired very well.  The only change I'll make is to reduce the cinnamon next time.  Made for TYM tag.
Absolutely the best!  It was our favorite thing we had this Christmas!  Beautiful too!  Thanks Alli!

I was a little skeptical about the mayo coated sweet potatoes, but they turned out yummy!  I cut my potatoes thin, so didn't need to cook as long as called for in the recipe....I just watched for them to start to brown.  The mayo/bbq sauce turned out very smooth and was delicious with the sweet potato fries.  I do think I will reduce the amount of mayo that I coat my fries with next time, as mine turned out a little greasy, but otherwise, perfection!  Thanks for sharing!

What's not to like about this luscious drink?  I also didn't use sugar, and I didn't use a sugar substitute.  I felt the whipped cream and amaretto added enough sweetness.  Thanks for sharing this delight!!
I used fresh snow peas, and followed the recipe exactly.  It turned out really nice.  The glaze was perfect, and it was so nice to see a recipe for 2!  Made for Zaar CB Tag.

I halved the recipe, and this was really easy to throw together. I cut my potatoes 1/8" thick, so they were done right on time. The comment around the table was that they were a little "bland", so maybe I'd throw in some additional seasoning next time.  Made for Gimme 5 Tag.
Yummy, yummy!  I used 2 % milk, and it worked wonderfully.  DS thanks you very much for posting your recipe!
I love brats in beer, and these were great.  I used Johnsonville Brats, and the topping of sauteed onions and peppers was perfect. Thanks Vicki for sharing.

So easy to make and so crispy! I don't usually get that nice crunch with baked chicken fingers, but I used panko instead of crackers and they worked great.  The plum sauce is yummy too.  Thanks for sharing.

Absolutely fabulous stew!  The mix of flavors is great.  I was scared I had too many onions in my meatballs, but they were perfect.  I loved the cayenne in them to counterbalance the sweetness of the cinnamon and raisins.  I did bake the meatballs for a little while to get the fat out of them before adding to the stew.  The health benefits of the spices in this is great...cinnamon helps balance blood sugar levels, and turmeric fights cancer and improves skin quality....I could eat this every week!  Thanks for sharing!

I have to agree with all the other reviewers!  This is a delicious soup!  I halved the recipe, and used half vegetable stock and half chicken broth (both homemade).  I did add the oatmeal, just because I was curious.  I let mine simmer another 10 minutes afterwords to let the oatmeal get mushy.  This recipe is going in my keeper file!  Thanks for sharing.

Great!  I made exactly as posted, except I cut it down to 2 sausages.  We really enjoyed these.  The apple onion mix was very nice, and I loved the mustard blend.  Thanks for the great sausage recipe!

I made this during the Stocking tag game in Holiday, and thought I'd posted a review....my photo is here, just not the review.  This is a great way to use leftover bread and save some money!  Thanks for sharing!
I love mushrooms!  But I felt the 'breadcrumb' taste overwhelmed the other flavors.  I'd decrease the amount of breadcrumbs.  Thanks for sharing the recipe!

This is a very easy and tastey chicken recipe.  I couldn't get my chicken pounded thin enough...next time I will ask the butcher!  I think this would actually be easier with the tenderloins!  Thanks for sharing.

The smell coming from the oven while this was cooking had me salivating.  My expectations were high for this dish!  But I found it a little bland....maybe my curry powder wasn't hot enough, although I used the hot curry powder.  Next time I may use red curry paste, or add some additional seasonings.  But this is a very beautiful dish, and smells wonderful while it is cooking.

I loved this!  I love onions, and I love buttermilk....so no doubt, I loved this.  I particularly liked the touch of the green onions to break up the monotomy of the whiteness of the potatoes.  Thanks for sharing your lovely recipe.
Over the top macaroni salad!  I made this for 2009 Favorites Cookbook Tag (posted by cookiedog), and the flavors are great!  This will be a repeated recipe.  Thanks for sharing!
This is simple to make and easy to include on the grill whenever you are grilling!  I'll do this again.  Made for Best of 2009 Cookbooks Tag.

Five stars for the butter!  I seasoned my steaks the way I normally do.  The butter is wonderful!  For presentation, I'd freeze the butter, but to serve on the steak, room temp is better....it doesn't cool the steak off and melts wonderfully into the meat.  Made for Best of 2009 Cookbook tag.  Thanks for sharing!
Great grilled cheese...didn't make it on a panini grill...I don't have one.  But it's great just grilled in the skillet.  Made for Favorites of 2009 Cookbook Tag.

These are really great with the balsamic sauce.  I let my sauce simmer a little so that it developed a syrupy type density. That way it stuck to my asparagus that much better!  Thanks for sharing.  Made for Best of 2009 Tag game.

Loved the idea of this and enjoyed the taste of it.  However, when I cooked my oil and garlic/caper mixture according to the time in the recipe, I ended up with caper and garlic "crisps"...not spreadable on the bread. That makes it a 4 star. So next time, I'll either reduce the cooking time of the cooking temp.  Otherwise, this is a 5 star recipe!  I highly recommend that others try this recipe, just reduce the cooking time or temperature.  Giving a 5 star to encourage others to enjoy this wonderful treat.  Thanks for sharing a great recipe.

I halved the recipe, but used a really big garlic clove....love garlic!  I absolutely loved these!  I had to use frozen peas, and can only imagine how good this would be with fresh ones.  Thanks for posting this delicious recipe.

This is the way my ex-husband liked his french toast, but he also liked maple syrup with it, not just the powdered sugar.  This was a reminder of an old favorite from years past.  Made for Holiday Tag.

I absolutely loved the chicken.  I used leg quarters instead of drumsticks, and they turned out wonderful!  I thought the salsa had a little bit too much lime juice, but that's just personal preference.  Made for Best of 2009 Tag game.
This works great!  I tried it on cilantro and parsley, and it worked on both!  Made for Favorites of 2009 Tag game...thanks to Marramamba for putting it in your cookbook!
This is delicious!  I overcooked it a bit, but otherwise, this turned out really great.  I made this for Favorites of 2009 Game tag.  Thanks to Sweet PQ for putting it in your cookbook!

OMG!  This was fabulous!  I had to make this with a "store-bought" tomato, and it was delicious.  I can only imagine the mindblowing taste when made with a fresh-picked tomato from my backyard.  Thank you Marramamba for putting this fabulous choice in your Favorites of 2009 cookbook!

My mom used to make a version of these with leftover stewed squash.  Today, I made these exactly as posted, and I have to say I could have eaten it all by myself.  They are that good!!  Thanks to Marramamba for putting these in your Favorites of 2009 Cookbook!  Great recipe.

Really great and easy to put together!  Loved it.  I'll reduce the pasta to sauce ratio next time, because I love lots of sauce. Made for Favorites of 2009 Tag game.  Thanks to Nif for putting this in  your cookbook!

The smell while this was cooking was just what I was looking for when I tagged this recipe.  The taste is spectacular as well.  I halved the recipe for 2 and this decreased the cooking time a bit.  I marinated for 4 hours, and thoroughly enjoyed the other half of the bottle of wine while enjoying my Boeuf Bourguignon! Made for 123 Hit Wonders.

This is the best green bean stir fry I have every had!  I made it exactly as posted, except I halved it for just me.  This is great.  My stove cooks a little hot, so I did have to reduce the temps, especially when it came time to mash the garlic.  Loved this wonderful recipe!  Made for Favorites of 2009 Tag game.  Congrats on being a favorite!

This is really great!  I haven't had the chai tea from starbuck's, but DS has developed a liking for it.  So I tasted it, and I'm sending him half of the mix to have at college.  Thanks for sharing your lovely mix!

5 Stars for the taste!  Plus I have a serving for lunch tomorrow!  Unlike mikekey, I do not have "labor intensive" issues...I looked at the time allotted and knew I'd be busy a while.  However, the cooking times seemed to exceed what was specified.  So be prepared to spend at least 2 to 3 hours on this dish, not 1 1/2.  I couldn't get my sauce to brown in the time allotted, and exceeded that timeframe.  The flavor of this dish is wonderful!  But I think you should be prepared for a longer time in preparation and cooking!  Thanks for sharing this delicious recipe.

5+ Stars!  I absolutely loved this.  I used fresh tilapia, but I think this would be even more fabulous with fresh red snapper or grouper.  Thank you so much for sharing this wonderful recipe.  Made for PRMR tag.

I cooked the meatballs in the skillet, and I couldn't help myself, I had to taste one before covering them with gravy.  Very tastey!  I wish you had shared the gravy that your family uses with these meatballs, but I tried to follow your instructions and make a milk-based gravy.  I made my gravy with the drippings left in the skillet, mixed with flour.  Then I stirred in a mix of beef stock and milk, and waited until it thickened.  I was lucky enough to have a cup of leftover Recipe #374647, and I stirred that in.  Then I added in some sour cream, black pepper, and parsley.  Delicious!  Served over some leftover angel hair pasta, although I really wanted to serve over mashed potatoes!!  This was delicious.  Thanks for sharing!
What's not to like about this recipe?  I made exactly as posted, and it was fabulous alongside a great fish dinner.  Thanks for sharing!
Beautiful Salad!  I followed the recipe exactly and used applewood smoked bacon.  I also used no fat Greek yogurt, and it all went together deliciously!  Made for Potluck Tag.
This is a beautiful dish with a very unique taste.  I love bok choy, and next time I'll probably try to grab a bigger bunch!  I loved it over the jasmine rice.  Thanks for sharing!

I have to say I altered the recipe, in that I used bone-in chicken breast, and then baked it instead of frying it....the bone-in chicken was what I had, and baking it fit in with the other things I had to do.  This recipe adapted perfectly to this!  I used shredded romano cheese, which I really had to press onto the chicken to get it to stick, but it worked wonderfully!  I noticed it getting a little brown while cooking, so I made a loose tent with foil so that it wouldn't burn, but would still stay crisp.  I ended up with wonderful tasting, crispy chicken!  Made for Best of 2009 tag!  Thanks for sharing your recipe.

This is definitely quick and easy!  Like a previous reviewer, I increased the beef broth to increase the gravy.  This is very filling and satisfying.  I think it serves more than 4, as it makes a lot.  Made for Zaar Chef Alphabet Soup tag.
Very good!  Loaded with blueberries, and the cinnamon topping is really nice!  These aren't overly sweet, either, which is nice for breakfast!
I love bacon of any kind, and really enjoyed the peppery taste of this.  I used thick-sliced apple-wood smoked bacon.

I loved this!  DS, on the other hand, tried to pick the celery out of it.  Instead of crushed cornflakes, I used crushed ritz crackers, just a personal preference.  I much prefer this green bean casserole to the one with the french fried onions.  Made for 123 Hits!

I love rutabagas, so I was happy to try this recipe out!  I did scoop some of the rutabagas out cubed to eat that way, as that is how I usually enjoy them.....full of the juice and with some fried cornbread patties to dunk in the liquid!  Gotta have pepper sauce too with that!  Then I proceeded to try these out your way.  I used Smart Balance 50/50 Sticks, but decreased the amount of butter to 1 tbsp.  That was definitely enough for me.  But I may have found my new way to eat rutabagas.  These smashed up, with butter and seasoning, is delicious!  Thanks so much for sharing.  So glad I picked this recipe to take to the potluck!

These are decadently good.  I made exactly as posted, but next time I'll try and reduce the fat content (And there will be a next time!)  I found that the potatoes that were "taller" browned really quickly, so try and make sure they are all of equal heights so you don't burn some of them.  Made for Holiday tag.  Delicious!

I just love mushrooms, and this recipe wasn't a disappointment!  Very simple to make, and a wonderful side dish.  I used this for a side to chicken, but it would be delicious with beef as well.  I saved a little bit to put on a chicken sandwich for tomorrow's lunch.  Very versatile recipe with the sherry....it goes well with anything.  Thanks for sharing a wonderful recipe!
I haven't used this as a dry rub, but I really enjoyed it as a salad dressing mix.  Easy to put together, and delicious.  Thanks for sharing!
I loved these! I halved the recipe, but otherwise made it exactly as posted.  Mine needed a little salt and pepper, but otherwise they were totally excellent!  Thanks for sharing.

Great ribs!  They weren't permeated with the wonderful smokey flavor from cooking all day on the grill, but these are a great "quick fix".  I soaked hickory chips for 24 hours before starting my fire, so that they would have a little bit of authentic smokey taste.  I made half with mustard based sauce, and half with regular red barbecue sauce.  I think I preferred the mustard sauce, but only because the red sauce seemed to burn a bit on the grill.  I will definitely make these again, because they are so quick and easy to do.  And sometimes you only have a few hours to do your ribs!  Thanks for sharing a recipe that I'll make again and again! Made for Potluck tag.

I really enjoyed this recipe.  I love grilled veggies, and wanted to try these with couscous.  I tried it first without the feta, then sprinkled a little fat free feta on a serving.  I really liked it much more with the feta.  So the feta will be a must for me from now on with the repeats of this yummy recipe!  Thanks for sharing a yummy, healthy recipe!
Fabulous!  Loved how crispy they still were!  Looked great and had a wonderful texture and taste.  I'll make these often!  Thanks for sharing.  Made for Zaar 123 Hits tag!

I used chicken thighs for this, bone in, and pulled the skin off at the poster's suggestion.  At first, I thought that not enough breading stuck onto my chicken, but it turned out fabulous!  The breading had a nice flavor and just a little bit of spice to it.  First response at dinner, was chicken again?....later ...can I have more?  This was a hit at my house.  Thanks for sharing!!  Made for PRMR tag.

Like other reviewers, I was amazed at how much I enjoyed this potato salad!  So easy to make, and so few ingredients!  Even so, this is delicious!  I added no salt or pepper...and it didn't need any!  I cooked my bacon, and crumbled it up...used applewood smoked bacon, and it was great.  Other than that, I followed the recipe exactly.  Thanks so much for sharing a delicious recipe for potato salad!

Very tropical and tastey!  I loved the fact that with fresca, you don't feel so bad having a drink.  I did find it a little sweet, so I squeezed a little extra lime juice into it.  Thanks for sharing your easy to make drink!

I am torn between 4 and 5 stars.  I liked the taste of the potatoes, but other diners didn't.  I loved that the olives added the salt and I didn't really need to add any.  I should have broiled them at the end to get them nice and toasty, but I didn't.  Mine turned out nice and "white", thats why I didn't post my photos.
Wow!  Couldn't believe how thick and un-butterlike this sauce turned out!  I served this over tilapia filets, and it was wonderful!  Thanks for sharing!  Made for Zaar stars tag.
Quick, easy, and delicious!  I made it exactly as posted.  I think I'll half the recipe next time, as I felt it was too much for one serving.  But definitely delicious!
Loved this recipe!  The steak was perfect, cooked on the charcoal grill.  The sauce was delicious, and took very little time.  Loved it!  Made for PAC Spring 2010.
I cooked this recipe exactly as written, except I halved it and then added additional red wine! Very yummy comfort food!  Thanks for a great everyday meal!  Made for PAC Spring 2010.

Ohhh, so yummy! I cut this down to 2 eggs, and this is delicious!  I used only fresh ingredients, and didn't find that the omelet was two moist at all.  I love baking the omelet..I can prep, and then throw it in the oven while I finish getting ready for work!  Gives me 20 minutes to dry my hair and put on my "face"!  Love it!!  Made for Potluck 2010.

Very nice rice...I made it as  side, and kind of wished I'd just made the rice and thrown in some leftover chicken.  The italian seasoning seemed to overpower the other dishes.  But I think this would be fabulous as a one dish meal....adding some chicken and throwing in some steamed fresh broccoli.

I totally loved this!  I made it exactly as posted, but I have to say.....a ground beef patty would be absolutely delicious with this mushroom sauce!  This is a wonderful recipe, and I thank you for sharing it with us.  Made for 123 Hits tag.

Really great tasting fish!  It cooked up looking beautiful, and was moist inside.  I felt the fish needed more seasoning....absolutely no salt in the recipe at all.  I made as specified the first time for first time rating, but next time I'll add some seasonings other than the lemon pepper.  Loved the panko!  Made for PAC Spring 2010.

WOW! Great recipe, quick and easy to make too. The sauce is a must....don't skip this easy step, and don't omit the chutney...the sauce is what makes this recipe different from all the other chicken/pineapple sandwiches. Absolutely loved this one...thanks for sharing the recipe!

I made one potato outside on my charcoal grill.  I loved the taste, and used garlic salt.  I did make the mistake of cutting the slices a little thin on some of them, so be careful!  Really enjoyed these, since I could cook them on the grill along with the rest of the meal.  Made for potluck tag.

I can't say anything that hasn't already been said.  I've never had the greatest luck with homemade bread, so I tucked this recipe away in my "Want to Try" cookbook.  I've finally gotten up enough nerve to do it, and I'm so glad I did.  I was afraid that I'd done something wrong, because my dough didn't double in size, even after 3 hours.  But I put it in the refrigerator and pulled it out the next day.  Grabbed a melon sized ball and made a baguette.  No glaze or seasoning, just the plain bread.  And it was fabulous with a little butter.  I can't say I'll make a loaf everyday....with only 2 here we would be huge!! But I'll definitely be able to dispose of this within the two week period.  Hopefully I'll get brave enough to roll it out and make cinnamon bread or throw some other seasonings into it.  Right now, I'm just proud to make it plain!  Thanks for sharing.

Wow!  I've seen this recipe over and over again, but never thought to make it.  I'm so glad that I did.  I had some beautiful strawberries, and made this dip for them....fabulous!  Can't wait to try this with other types of fruit.  Thanks, Deb for sharing!

I really liked this as posted!  The things that I feel would take it over the top is to add some fresh cilantro and some diced jalapeno.  I will reduce the sauce I put on each tortilla next time because it was just a little runny, but I used smaller tortillas and thought I'd rationed everything out right.  Great quick and easy lunch or weeknight recipe.  Thanks for sharing!

Super easy and quick.  I planned to make these outside on the charcoal grill, but time got away from me and it was time for American Idol!!  So I broiled them inside so that I could listen and watch while they cooked.  Delicious!  I could see serving them up as appetizers or a main dish.  I do think the smokey flavor from the charcoal would compliment the flavors, so I'll make them outside next time.  But this is a wonderfully easy, low fat recipe that can be made anytime!  Loved it!  Thanks!  (Photos to come!)

Oh Wow!  I was amazed at how absolutely wonderful this taste combination was. I made this with fresh bread from Recipe #340621 by French Tart.  So delicious!!!  I made this for I Recommend Tag, and I think I'll hang out there more often, as this is one of the best recipes I've made this year, and so simple too! Thanks Starrynews for the recommendation!

I halved the recipe for just me, so I'd have leftovers for lunch!  Delicious soup, one that I will make often, since I am a "soupaholic"!  The only thing I changed was too add just a bit of garlic after sauteing the veggies and chicken...didn't want it to burn.  Otherwise, I stayed true to the recipe.  Yummy soup!  Thanks for sharing!

I really wanted to love these, but the flavor was just on the surface....I think it is wonderful that it is WW's accepted, but I recommend covering the grill during the last minutes of cooking so that the "true" smoke flavor seeps into the meat.  I'm not a WW member, so I don't know what you can add without messing up the points.  I'd mix some seasoning into the meat, other than the onions and jalapenos.  The taste on the surface is delicous....love the "glaze".  Thanks for sharing!
This is delicious!!  I'll definitely make this again, and probably use the same veggies.  Quick and easy to make which is always a plus.  Thanks for sharing!
This is really yummy, but my corn wasn't tender after 30 minutes on the grill.  Otherwise, this was delicious!!  Thanks for sharing!

Loved this!  I have to admit, I topped it with red wine vinegar, instead of adding any oil!  I did sprinkle the red pepper flakes, salt and pepper over the salad.  I just left out the oil!  Thanks for sharing.

I really loved this!  I wanted something "basic" tonight, but instead I got something spectacular!  What a wonderful surprise for a 30 minute meal!  I just wish pine nuts were cheaper here!!!  I'll definitely keep this recipe...loved the raisins.  The portions are generous....I served with a salad and cut the recipe in half, and I think half would generously serve 3.  But there is nothing wrong with generous portions....if DS was home, there would be nothing left!  Made for PRMR....thanks for sharing!

I loved the taste of this, but mine turned out to be quite messy!  I didn't add the tomato because I knew it would add alot of drippy juice, and I hoped I'd be able to eat this in the car on the way to work. I hollowed out a little in the middle of my english muffin to encourage the egg to stay on it, but it still spread out over the sides of the muffin.  Regardless, it tasted delicious and I enjoyed it for breakfast today!

This is a very easy sandwich to put together, but to me, it just cried out for a piece of bacon!  However, I resisted the urge and ate it exactly as posted.  I did use a generous amount of black pepper, and served it on some of French Tart's Homemade bread!  Thanks for sharing, Starry!

I made this exactly as written, except I halved the recipe.  I thought I might need to reduce the microwave time for the potatoes, but after testing at 10 minutes, I didn't need to.  I didn't add the bacon to try and reduce the fat content (even though I had a cooked piece in the fridge!).  I really enjoyed the potato, corn and cheese mix!  This is so easy to make and so tastey!  Thanks for sharing, Hokies!

I love dill, and was really wondering about this recipe!  I'm a tried and true fried egg eater, usually with toast to soak up the yolk.  This was a very different taste for us!  Enjoyed for breakfast today.

Super easy, and super good!  I think I might switch it up a bit and used ranch potato chips instead of barbecue.  This time I used the barbecue chips, and dipped in ranch....next time I'll use ranch potato chips, and dip in barbecue sauce!  There will definitely be a next time....they are so quick to make, and moist and juicy!  Thanks for sharing, Andi.  Made for I Recommend Tag.

Where are the extra stars!  These are amazingly delicious!  They weren't as moist as some deviled eggs, but the taste was great.  I halved the amount of bacon, and that didn't seem to impact the taste, at least not to us!  Thanks so much for sharing a deiliciously different deviled egg recipe!

This was very thick and creamy, but I'm afraid that maybe I'm just not fond of lemon in soup.  But it did look very nice and I did keep the heat low, so my eggs didn't scramble.  I was a little worried that the egg really didn't have a chance to cook....I've had some unpleasant experiences with raw eggs, and didn't want to experience the unpleasantness again!  But I resisted the urge to overheat, and my soup remained "unscrambled" and very smooth in texture.

5 Stars for the Dressing!  Loved it!  This was a very different spinach salad for me, with the avocado and bell peppers....I'm used to mushrooms, onions, and bacon!  I used red bell pepper instead of yellow, because the yellow bell peppers just didn't look good at my grocery store.  Otherwise, I followed the recipe.  Delicious!  Again....the dressing is fabulous!
The spice mix is perfect in the breading.  I did use panko instead of regular breadcrumbs due to personal preference.  This makes for a very nice light fish meal.  Thanks for sharing!

Delicious Greek Salad!  I've tried to upload pics, but Zaar seems out of sorts right now!

Thanks for posting!

This was so easy and quick to do!  I was making steak on the grill, and didn't want to overcook my meat, so I started these in the oven, moving them to the grill when I started my steaks.  Delicious and easy!
Great taste with the coconut rum!  Made it a little sweet.  Sorry my photo fogged up....its really humid in Florida right now!
DS loved it!  I made 4 slices and he ended up taking mine that I had taken a couple of bites off of :).  This does make alot, and I halved the recipe.  Made for Zaar Chef Alphabet Soup tag!

Very good pizza.....plain but pleasing for more sensitive palates.  I'd like to use a mix of ground beef and italian sausage next time.  This is a great pizza for kids...nothing to upset their tummies!  Thanks for sharing.

Great twice baked potatoes.  The only thing I might do differently is change the cut of the potato to the traditional way....much easier to eat that way!  Loved all the ingredients and seasonings.  Thanks for sharing!

I've never made a pizza sauce with bacon grease in it, but this added a wonderful smokey flavor to the sauce.....I used applewood smoked bacon.  Since I used bacon in the pizza sauce, I also added the bacon to the pizza.  Great combination!  Thanks for sharing your great recipe.

I was so pleasantly surprised by how great this tasted with the lemon juice squeezed over it!  And it was so quick to make that I know I'll be making it again.  Followed the recipe exactly and wouldn't change a thing! Thanks for sharing.
Absolutely wonderful mac and cheese!  Loved the mix of cheeses.  This recipe got 5 stars from everyone.  Thanks for sharing.
So simple and so delicious!  I had this over angel food cake, and it was perfect!  I did let it sit for several hours before serving.  Thanks for sharing!

Loved this!  Loved the mix of sweet and sour.  I might add a bit more chicken next time to make it a more "main dish" soup, but otherwise, I'd leave this recipe exactly as posted!!  Thanks for sharing.  Made for ZWT6.

DS could not quit raving about these potatoes!  He just loved these.  I added a little extra garlic, and since I only had 1% milk, I mixed the milk with half and half.  This turned out yummy.  Made for ZWT6.  Thanks for sharing!

I had this drink this morning as my "It's the weekend and you can relax" coffee.  It was a wonderful choice!  I halved the recipe, but otherwise followed the instructions, right down to the whipped cream!  Thanks for sharing a yummy coffee.
Delicious!  I made this to serve over waffles, and it was perfect.  Thanks so much for sharing this yummy recipe.  I was lucky strawberries were in season!
I halved the recipe, but otherwise I made it exactly as posted.  Delicious chops!  I used Recipe #92803 92803 for my hoisin and it worked out perfectly.  Thanks for sharing!
Easy to make and delicious!  I used the extra red pepper flakes and it was perfect for me, but too hot for the rest of the family!  Thanks for sharing!

This broccoli was delicious!  I didn't cut my broccoli into small enough pieces, so I had to cook it longer.  The taste was wonderful.  I took a photo, but it was awfully out of focus, so I didn't post....so sorry!

Really good fried rice.  I cut the amount of soy sauce in half, and served the chili garlic sauce on the side to be stirred in because I had 4 year old mouths to feed tonight.  I also added some carrots to the mix.  I sliced the green onions, and then forgot about them!  So we enjoyed this without the garnishment!  Thanks for sharing!

I put your recipe to an extreme test!  I made triple the batch and let my daughter and her fiance take it all (minus a taste for me!) on a tubing trip down the Coldwater River today.  She and 10 of her best friends from high school, along with their various boyfriends/girlfriends got to test it out! I chose the crockpot method, as I cooked this while we were out getting dinner the night before her trip.  The results:  5 Stars for the taste, the only concern was that some of the drummettes were "falling apart"....maybe because of the crockpot, or maybe because they were riding in a cooler on a river!!! I did use 2 of those really large crockpots, so all the drummettes got saturated in the marinade.  I stuck a couple of drumsticks in for good measure, and those turned out well too!  Thanks for sharing.

I only had green cardamom, and regular cumin seeds, but otherwise I made this as posted.  Heating it all in the skillet instead of just grinding the spices up really made the kitchen smell wonderful!  I used this in my Recipe #163665.  Thanks so much for sharing!
I started that this morning before work....went to work with red fingers!  But these were wonderful once I got home and had the opportunity to taste them.  Thanks for sharing!

I've never had this mix on a sandwich before, and I was so pleasantly surprised by how delicious it is!  The apples are delicious on their own....but even more so with the ooey-gooey melted havarti.  Thanks for sharing!

I made this a while back and forgot to review it!  So sorry!  This was very chocolatey.  I made it for DS, and he really enjoyed it.  He much prefers homemade pudding to store bought!  And this was just the right amount.  Made for I recommend.

OMG Fabulous!  I followed the advice of the poster, and grilled my steaks....it was a wonderful summer night on the Gulf Coast, so why not?  The seasoning was wonderful, and the feta and olive topping was icing on the cake!  Diner....thanks so much for sharing this lovely steak recipe!

I made exactly as posted, and as in another reviewers notes, I will reduce the lemon juice next time....it started cooking my chicken before I was ready to grill.  (After 45 minutes)  Otherwise, this is delicious as posted!  Love grilled chicken! Thanks for sharing.
This was lovely.  A different twist from the usual garlic seasoned green beans.  We really enjoyed them.  Thanks for sharing!
5 Stars from the Unrulies for all the Sexy Men in Greece!  Totally enjoyed this lucscious drink....thanks for sharing.

Lovely way to spice up plain rice, and it is beautiful to look at too!  I had this with a chicken and apricot tangine tonight, and it went together wonderfully.  Thanks for sharing your jasmine rice recipe!  Made by a fellow Unruly.
Wow!  The combination of spices was perfect!  And even DS loved the sauce, and he hates yogurt!  Thanks so much for sharing.

Wonderful!  DS just loved this...I had to leave out the green pepper, and only added mushroom to half because of DS, but it was wonderful just as I made it!  I did use fresh minced garlic instead of garlic powder.  We really loved this!  DS is taking the recipe back to college with him to try and impress his roommates!  Thanks for sharing.

Delicious!  I ended up making 5 burgers instead of 4.  I am a grill-a-holic, so just couldn't subject burgers to the broiler....sorry!  All I can tell you is that these are fabulous grilled!  I made exactly as posted, except on 1 burger I used gouda, on 2 I used provolone, and on 2 I used monterrey jack pepper cheese.  DS wouldn't eat the ones with pepper jack.  He ate his 3, and I had one....delicious.  So this serving for 4 served 2....although one person ate the bulk of it!!  Loved the avocado on this.  Thanks for sharing!
The best carrots ever!  I just used regular carrots and cut them up.  They were fabulous....thanks for sharing this wonderful recipe!

I used this marinade with fish, and then put it on the grill alongside some burgers I was making for my son.  The fish turned out partially grilled, partially smoked....whatever, they were delicious!  Marinated for about 25 minutes.  Wonderful.  Thanks for sharing.
Easy to make, pleasing to all, and delicious!  What else do you want?  DS added more butter, but that is just his preference.  Thanks for sharing!
Loved it!  I love tarragon, and this was a real winner for me.  Served over angel hair pasta.  The kids didn't care for it, but all the grown-ups loved it!  Thanks for sharing a delicious recipe.

I thought this might be a little too much onion, so I decreased it....but the onions around here are large!  Otherwise, I made as posted.  They were oniony enough, so I didn't decrease the onion too much.  A really good appetizer.  I'll add jalapenos next time...I felt it needed some heat.  Thanks for sharing!
Easy to make, and a recipe everyone will eat!  That's a wonderful recipe!  This recipe will go with practically anything, so it is very versatile.  Thanks for sharing this easy recipe!

Loved these!  I had 6 boneless, skinless thighs, but kept the marinade the same.  Delicious!  Recipe states it is for 4, but I had one thigh, and DS had the rest.....so mine served two but with only 6 thighs and a teenage boy thrown in!  Great recipe!

I seasoned my pork and diced veggies with Cavendar's Greek Seasoning, added some garlic, and lots of black pepper.  I cut the recipe down for 2, and had lots of yummy stuffing for my veggies.  I used portabello mushrooms, but diced up a couple of button mushrooms to add to the mix.  We loved the mushrooms and zucchini, and I think I'd like to use red bell pepper instead of tomato next time to coordinate the colors.  I used sliced mozzarella instead of shredded, and waited until after 20 minutes of cooking time to add the cheese so it didn't get too brown.  Fabulous meal in one!  We enjoyed this for a tasty lunch.  Made by an Unruly Under the Influence for Zingo!

Yummy recipe!  I loved the mustard taste.  I grilled mine, and the smokey taste is wonderful with the mustard marinade.  Loved butterflying the tenderloin....made it so quick and easy to cook.  Thanks Deantini!
Great surprise of a sandwich!  I used whole wheat sandwich thins, and really enjoyed this.  Thanks for sharing with an Unruly!

Very nice butter sauce.  I broiled some fish fillets tonight and used this butter to baste it with.  Also used it as a dipping sauce for the fish.  Thanks for sharing....made for ZWT by an Unruly Under the Influence.

I know it is supposed to be open-faced, but this was really messy to try and eat.  However, the taste is very nice.  I added some fresh basil leaves to the top, and I really liked that addition.  Made for ZWT6 Zingo by an Unruly Under the Influence.  Thanks for sharing.

I loved these!  I cooked the cup of sauce down to a glaze in the skillet, and cooked the rest down to a nice thick sauce in a saucepan.....made for a heavenly sauce!!! Loved these...without the extra glaze, they were a little bland, but with the extra, they are perfect!  Thanks for sharing.  Made for ZWT6 Zingo by an Unruly Under the Influence.

I don't think my little "chicken balls" turned out as pretty as kellychris's, but they sure were delicious!  I'm sure these are supposed to be Asian, but we dipped into tzatziki (sp?) sauce and loved it! Kids dunked in ketchup of course lol!  Made for Zingo in ZWT6 by an Unruly Under the Influence.  Thanks for sharing!

I guess if I was a vegan, I might rate this a 5.....but I am definitely a carnivore, so I missed the texture and taste of meat!  That being said, they have a very nice taste.  I had some whole nutmeg that I ground up, and used fresh parsley.  Thanks for sharing your recipe!  Made for ZWT6 Zingo by and Unruly Under the Influence.

Yummy and easy....what could be better!  Loved the heat from the curry paste.  My biggest challenge was finding a can of pumpkin soup!  Thanks for sharing.  Made for ZWT6 Zingo by an Unruly Under the Influence.

I loved the cool way to split the banana!! I made this for breakfast, and could only eat 1 slice, so I'd up the servings to 2.  I also just eyeballed the peanut butter...probably used more than a tablespoon. Delicious! I've had banana sandwiches before, and had peanut butter and honey sandwiches, but never hot and never with cinnamon. Wonderful combination and a nutritious, fast breakfast. Thanks for the wonderful recipe. Made for Holiday tag.

Fabulous! Fabulous!  It was pouring rain outside, and I had to take photos inside, so they do not do the recipe justice.  Spicy and delicious.....just what I like!  Thanks so much. Made for Holiday tag.

Very tasty and easy stir fry!  I used sirloin, and marinated it in the teriyaki for about 40 minutes.  I increased everything just a tad, because I had a pound and a half of sirloin and added 2 cloves of minced garlic.  Otherwise, I followed the directions, although I was tempted to add some mushrooms!  Everyone loved it.  Made for Zaar 123 Tag!  Thanks for sharing.

Wow!  So easy and delicious!  Loved the almonds in the topping.  I cut this down to serve 2, and used individual gratin bowls to cook it in.  It still turned out wonderfully well, I just decreased the cooking time a bit.  Thanks for sharing this lovely recipe.  Made for Potluck tag.
Very good meatloaf.  A very different taste for us!  Served it with fettucine alfredo instead of mashed potatoes to continue the italian theme.  DS really liked it.  Thanks for sharing!
Beautiful and deliciously refreshing drink for a hot summer day!  A little sweet, but still great.  Made for Zaar Stars.  Thanks for sharing!

Very good mushrooms.  My mushrooms didn't absorb all the marinade, but I went ahead and skewered them anyway.  Popped a couple into my mouth just to try, and loved the flavor.  I sliced them up and topped a yummy grilled burger with them.  Thanks for sharing.
Delicious and easy!  I used a Vidalia onion, and it turned out wonderful.  Made for newest tag game.  Thanks for another great recipe, diner!
Absolutely amazing!  I didn't change a thing.  DS thought he'd gone to heaven with these burgers!! Made for 123 Hits!

The vote around the table was that I should have put some melted butter over the chicken before baking, or sprayed with cooking spray.  It was a little dry.  The coating was very nice.  We ended up serving it with a honey mustard sauce that we whipped up on the spot.  I think this will be nice tomorrow sliced up and served on top of a salad with a nice dressing.  Thanks for sharing!  Made for Potluck tag.
Great twist on carrots!  I've never had carrots like this, and it was a fun experience.  DS still prefers his carrots raw, but everyone else enjoyed them!  Thanks for sharing.

My neighbor gave me some fresh blueberries, so I made these!  So glad I did.  DS ate all but 2 (out of 12),  so I think he liked them.  I liked that they weren't as sweet as other muffins I have made.  I didn't have splenda, so I used sugar (gasp!).  Also, I used butter instead of margarine.  I added a bit of almond flavoring as well.  These will be a definite make again recipe.  Made for Holiday tag.

Loved the taste of these....my only warning is to be careful letting them drain on paper towels!  The sugar makes the paper towel stick to the bacon.  I had to peel the paper towels off.  But these are absolutely delicious....slap my face and go ahead and eat all that fat yummy!

Great chicken thigh recipe!!  I marinated for the full 6 hours (maybe a little more).  I baked mine in the oven, although I wanted to grill them....with a heat index of 115, I just couldn't do it tonight.  They turned out perfectly in the oven.  DS declined the glaze on his, and kept eating and eating them.  Everyone else used the glaze and loved it.  The consensus is these are delicious with and without the glaze!  Thanks for sharing this wonderful recipe!
I really enjoyed this potato salad.  It wasn't overly spicy, and the flavors blended nicely.  Easy to make too.  Thanks for sharing!

Loved, loved, loved this!  So easy and simple!  I decreased the onion due to DS's preferences, and instead of the salt and pepper I used Southern Seasoning.  This was wonderful!  I'll make these again.

I used boneless skinless chicken thighs, and they turned out very good.  This was quick and easy, using things I normally have around the house....a keeper for me.  I did use 6 thighs and increased the sauce a bit.  DS ate 5 of them himself, and came looking for more!!
Very good!  I did splash a little vodka into it, and that seemed to make everyone enjoy the punch and go back for more!!!  Thanks for sharing.

I love a grilled cheese sandwich, there is just something comforting about them!  I loved the added bite from the horseradish!  I only had white onion, so I used that.  Also, I used a mix of sharp and mild cheddar.  Great sandwich. Thanks for sharing.  Made for I Recommend tag.

Very easy to put together and very kid friendly.  I increased everything just a bit because I knew that it would be eaten up quickly by a group of teenage boys.  Everyone loved it.  Made for Zaar stars.  Thanks for sharing!

I loved the allspice in this.  I had to use dried dill, as that is all I had.  Otherwise, I followed the recipe exactly.  I was scared it was going to be too thin, but after simmering uncovered it thickened up nicely.  Again, I really loved the allspice in this....made this tomato soup a bit different from others I've had.  Thanks for sharing!

Overall, this is a very nice chicken recipe.  It is really easy to make and comes together very quickly! I have to agree with Vicki...the honey was a bit overpowering.  I'd decrease the honey and increase the dijon mustard.  Didn't use the nuts....not on my current diet, but I bet they would have offset the sweetness.
This works really well. I've never used it in dressings, but I have used it to cook with.  I remember my Mom doing this too.  Thanks for posting!

I cut this down to just serve two, and it turned out great.  Normally I'm not a fan of low fat mayo, but with this recipe I didn't even notice it.  Loved the colors too.  Made for 123 Hits tag....thanks for sharing!
Surprisingly sensational!! Loved it!  Thanks, WiGal.

I loved that I had everything I needed on hand to make these noodles....always a plus!!  I was looking for a low fat noodle dish, and with no butter or cream this worked.  I halved the amount of olive oil, but left the garlic and red pepper flakes the same.  I did use a bit of the starch water.  I also added a little kosher salt to these.  Thanks for sharing!

Wow!  5  Stars!! Loved, loved, loved this!  I did add a little no salt Greek Seasoning instead of the salt and pepper, because I'm trying to cut my salt intake.  The tomato basil salsa was fabulous! I halved the olive oil in it, and it was still fabulous. I am on a diet right now, and I didn't feel deprived at all eating this wonderful dish!  Thanks for sharing this wonderful recipe!  Made for Photo Tag!
So easy to make and it looks beautiful with the combo of colors!  Enjoyed the sprinkling of basil that stuck to each piece.  Thanks for sharing!  Made for Photo Tag.
This is a great salad!  Loved the dressing....very different!  The mix of textures and colors makes this a beautiful dish.  I halved the recipe, and it still made quite a lot :) Made for PRMR tag.

Just started a diet....not weight watchers, but decided to try this. I'm not really allowed to have some of these ingredients, but it was wonderful to taste some heat!   The sodium content was way over what I'm allowed to have, but otherwise I could put the ingredients into a category or two!! LOL :).  Regardless of the diet issues, I really enjoyed this soup!  Very enjoyable.

2nd Time Reviewing...hope this one takes!  Yummy salad...I didn't use the baby greens, as I felt the balance between chicken and veggies was already weighted heavier towards the veggies. This is great for taking to lunch for work....tastes great after sitting overnight in the fridge!  The cabbage stays nice and crisp....I just chopped cabbage, shredded carrot instead of using cole slaw mix so it would be fresher.  Nice and crispy!

Amazing taste for so little effort!  The flavor in this recipe was incredible.  Chicken was very moist and delicious.  I did bake mine a little because my chicken breasts were huge, then turned on the broiler.  Turned out perfectly!  Thanks so much for this delicious recipe!

So easy to make and delightful!  I used half regular mayo and half light, and they turned out wonderfully.  I took mine out of the oven a bit early, so they sort of sunk in....but were delicious regardless.  I'll make these again!!

I was really wanting a nice hot soup, and this turned out wonderful.  I made it exactly as posted, and really enjoyed it.  The barley really fills you up.  I'll take Deantini's tip and use broth instead of stock next time to reduce the calories even more.  Thanks for sharing!  Made for Holiday tag.

I cooked mine outside over a charcoal grill instead of an indoor grill.  I don't usually put lemon on steak, but this turned out very good.  Enjoyed the basil....very nice.  Thanks for sharing! Made for Potluck tag.

I've made carrot and raisin salad before, but never with orange juice....not sure how I feel about the addition...sometimes I liked it, and other times I missed the traditional taste I am used to. I did enjoy the yogurt with the light mayo....normally I just use regular mayo.  Made for Potluck tag....thanks for sharing.

Loved these!  I didn't use garlic infused olive oil, because I read somewhere that you should never cook with infused oils....that they make things taste a bit bitter.  So I minced up some garlic and threw it into the roasting dish!  Toasted up my sesame seeds, and this came together in no time at all.  I'll definitely make this again.  Thanks so much for your wonderful recipe.

I'm on a diet, and looking for recipes I can make and still fit into my diet.....so I used ground sirloin instead of ground beef to cut fat and calorie count.  I was so pleasantly surprised by this recipe....It was delicious!  I was able to eat a bowl full of this and still stay within my boundaries!!!! Thanks so much for a delicious, filling recipe.  Made for Holiday Tag.
Love sauteed spinach...the lemon juice was a new addition for me.  Enjoyed this dish very much.  Thanks for sharing....made for your win in Football Tag Week 3 2010.

What a totally unique tasting burger!  I grilled mine outside on the grill....don't have a grill pan!  Served it without bread because I have elimated bread right now due to a diet, and used ground sirloin to cut the fat content.  These are full of flavor! I didn't add the water because with the sirloin the mix was already a little watery.  These are very salty with the olives and pesto, so you don't need to add any more.  This was a really great tasting burger...just not the traditional one!  I can totally picture this served up in a pita with some wonderful tzatziki sauce and shredded lettuce. Thanks for sharing your wonderful recipe.
Very good!  A little sweet for me, but other guests just loved it!  Plus it is such a beautiful color!!  Thanks for sharing.
Beautiful recipe, Lalaloula!!  Amazingly delicious, and soooo little effort!  Definitely a do again recipe.  Loved it....thanks for sharing this.
The taste of this is great!  Very easy to make too.  My glaze was a little thin, most of it ran off the fish.  Don't know how to prevent this, but I'd love to figure it out!  Thanks for sharing!

Can the fat and calorie count on this be right?!!  I sure hope so, because I'm on a diet and loved having bacon and cheese and milk......things I really shouldn't be having!  This is delicious.  I halved the recipe, and my serving size was 1/4 of that, but have no fear, I'll take care of the leftovers!!!  Thanks for sharing!
Really enjoyed this!  I used frozen peas and fresh snow peas.  Followed the recipe exactly.  I added the chives, due to personal preference.  Made for Holiday Tag.

Perfect blackened chicken.  A really hot skillet is a must for this....I used an old cast iron skillet that belonged to my grandmother.  The chicken was so moist and flavorful, with a nice crispy, spicy coating on the outside.  I loved this, and I'll definitely make this again.  Thanks for sharing!

These pork chops turned out wonderfully moist.  I hesitated to marinate too long because lemon tends to cook meat with it's acidity.  So I marinated for 3 hours.  Not really sure if I like the lemon with the pork. It's probably just a personal preference....maybe I'm just too used to smoked pork chops or pork chops with gravy!  If you are a lemon lover, I think you'd love this...made for Holiday Tag.

Okay.....I have a problem with this recipe....I'm only allowed one bowl on my diet, and I absolutely had to have two!  This is delicious.  I made as posted except I used 3 garlic cloves instead of 2.  I used my immersion blender to blend, and heated everything up before serving.  I used no fat greek yogurt for my garnish, and sprinkled a tiny bit of fleur de sel at serving.  Thanks for sharing!  Made for Photo Tag.

I used butternut squash, as all the pumpkins are huge here.  Also used fat free half and half instead of regular half and half.  Loved how healthy this recipe was!  I'll reduce the amount of curry powder and turmeric next time....I felt it over powered the veggies a bit.  Thanks for sharing!  Made for 123 Hits tag game.

Absolutely wonderful!  I sliced my potatoes very thin....about 1/8 inch thick.  Also sliced my onions that thin.  The potatoes were wonderful, although my onions did char and turn black at the 45 minute cooking time.  This is a definite make again recipe.....delicious!
Very nice oatmeal!  I loved the cinnamon, brown sugar, and blueberries.  I mixed milk and water to cook the oats in, so I didn't add any milk at the end.
Great!  My only regret was not mixing up some extra honey dijon sauce!  Very easy to make on a weeknight, and it tastes spectacular.  Thanks BakinBaby!  So glad to have you back in the games!

I was very happy to come home from work and find part of my meal done.  The pork chops turned out very tender!  I had a lot of sauce, so I may reduce that next time.  This is a very good tasting and easy recipe.  Thanks for sharing!  Made for Market tag game.

This is very good. I particularly liked browning the vegetables, it seemed to draw more flavor out of the vegetables.  Next time I'll start the veggies with just the cauliflower and then add the broccoli after a couple of minutes because I thought my broccoli was overdone.  Thanks for sharing!  Made for PRMR tag.

These carrots are great!  I had everything I needed and they were really quick and easy to put together.....the only thing, I forgot to add the almonds (left the butter out on purpose to cut fat).  But they were great cooked the way I did!  Thanks for sharing!

This is by far one of the best Chicken Salad's I've ever had!  I had to substitute green bell pepper for the red, but otherwise I made it exactly as posted.  It is a very unique tasting chicken salad that I'll make again.  Thanks for sharing!

These are great!  I halved the recipe and it cooked up quick and easy.  I liked the nutmeg in this, but could definitely taste it.....so if you aren't a nutmeg fan I'd reduce the amount.  But I'll keep it the same.  Thanks for sharing!  Made for Holiday Tag.

I've never poached eggs (GASP!), but ate them when my mom made them.  So this was a first for me.  It worked....don't know how much better than other techniques, but since I don't have an egg poacher like my mom, this skillet method was wonderful!  Loved my yummy breakfast! The pics are dark, but it is pretty dark right now when I get up to go to work and I wanted natural light with the eggs. :)

Fabulous!  I always use balsamic and a little olive oil to marinade, never equal amounts and never for this long a marinating time.  But I took a leap of faith and did it.  Added the shallots and rosemary, and let it sit while I worked.  (Took it with me to work so I could flip it!)  The only change I made was to use Southern Charbroil Seasonings instead of salt and pepper.  These steaks were cooked perfectly and tasted absolutely divine!  You have outdone yourself swissms!  Defintely a keeper recipe!

Loved these!  I'm a spice-a-holic, and I doubled the spices!  Of course lots stuck to my fingers and never made it on the potatoes.  I chose to do the rounds, since there were no photos of the potatoes prepared that way.  I cooked for the full 25 minutes.  I didn't need any salt with the other spices, another plus!  Thanks for sharing!  Made for Photo Tag!
Delicious scrambled eggs.  Mine took quite a bit longer to cook though.  I used low fat sour cream instead of creme fraiche.  Thanks for sharing!
Quick, easy, and yummy!  What more is there to say?!  Thanks for sharing.

This was really easy to make, and I enjoyed it over your Recipe #291328.  I made it with regular chicken bouillon cubes, and can't stress enough how important it is to use the low sodium.....mine was very salty! My fault since I didn't use the correct bouillon cubes.  This thickens up really quickly and looks great.  Thanks for sharing!

Can't believe this is low fat!  My only problem is that I think my stove just cooks too hot....my breading got a little dark, so I will reduce the heat next time.  Served with your Recipe #291170.  Thanks for sharing!

I loved the pepper jack cheese in this.  This makes a lot of filling for 2 eggs, but the filling is what makes it good!  I'm on a diet right now, so used turkey bacon and low fat cheese.  I also only ate half, because this makes a big omelet.  Thanks for the great breakfast!
Enjoyed this with breakfast this morning.  Very nice change from orange juice!  I used pink grapefruit juice, and it made this extra sweet.  Thanks for sharing!

Wow!  These are delicious!  I made a half batch, and wish I'd made the whole one!  I used 0 fat greek yogurt, and these turned out moist and delicious!  I added the butter-egg mix before adding the yogurt....there was no mention in the recipe of when to add that. These are delish!  Thanks for sharing this make-again recipe!!

Very similar to my Recipe #382998, except mine uses cumin instead of chili powder. :)  I cooked mine in a rack on top of a broiler pan so the bacon wouldn't soak up all that fat.  Otherwise, I made it as posted.  I twisted some and left some flat.  The twisted ones took a bit longer to cook.  This was delicious!  Thanks for sharing.

Absolutely fabulous!  I grilled a chicken breast last night to dice up and put on this pizza today.  Wonderful decision.  The smokey flavor of the chicken complimented this pizza beautifully.  I made it exactly as posted today, and it was great.  Next time I'll add some feta cheese....I think that would just put this over the top!  Thanks for sharing.

I made some adjustments to this recipe because of my diet, and I really wish I hadn't.  I used low fat turkey italian sausage, and the "whiteness" of the turkey sausage just didn't do this recipe any visual favors...however, it tastes great.  I'd definitely add the cornstarch, because my sauce was really thin.  I served over spaghetti (whole wheat), and the meal was great.  I think this would be best with the original ingredients or with smoked sausage instead of the turkey sausage, but this worked for me on my diet.  Thanks for sharing...made for Photo Tag.

I made these in the crock pot as posted, and loved the way they held together cooked that way.  The presentation is beautiful.  But the flavors didn't really get into the potato because of the skin, and I think it might enhance the taste of the potatoes to dice them up before pouring the butter on them. Next time I'll try that.  Served these with fish and they were thoroughly enjoyed.  Thanks for sharing!
Great!  Love Vinegar and Cucumbers!  First time without onions added for me.  Thanks for sharing!

I love asparagus, and this version is delicious....I reduced the cooking time because I noticed my asparagus getting too done...my stove cooks really fast.  I loved the combination of asparagus and grape tomatoes.  I'll add a little garlic next time, because I tend to add it to everything.  Thanks for sharing!

I will eat brussels sprouts any time....but these are really delicious.  I did cut the olive oil a bit, and added some extra balsamic vinegar.  Loved the dijon mustard in this...thanks for sharing a great recipe!

As posted, this is a little bland.  But dice up some jalapenos, add some green onions, or throw in some mushrooms, and this is great!  I used low fat tortillas and low fat cheese, and this was a wonderful breakfast.  I made as posted, and ended up using some salsa to add in some spice....next time I'll add jalapenos and green onions so I can eat this on the road.  I loved the crispness of the fried tortilla.....something nice and unique in a wrap. Thanks for sharing!

This soup is full of wonderful tastes!  I used the larger portion of spices, and added more broth to mine, because as posted this is more of a stew.....very little liquid left.  I also had to cook mine longer to get the potatoes and carrots tender, so I'll either cut those smaller or cook longer from now on.  This is a very satisfying soup, and I'll make it often in the winter months.  Love the curry in this....I think I'll enjoy even an extra portion of curry in mine next time! Thanks for sharing a wonderful one-dish meal!

More than 5 Stars!  I broke the rules and made this with boneless skinless thighs, since I'm on a diet and really can't have the fat from the skin.  Drained the fat after the first 35 minutes of baking, and then topped with the remaining marinade.  I didn't really get a glaze, but that may because I didn't have the fat from the skin.  The taste is wonderful.  A keeper of a recipe.  So glad I tried this!  Thanks for sharing!

Really great.  I grilled it, and it was hard to do because winds were blowing at 20 mph and it was turning cool!  But delicious!  I added in some yellow squash and used red bell pepper instead of green because I had some.  Really enjoyed this "dinner on the grill".

I love brussels sprouts!  I couldn't find a chili pepper, so used a jalapeno instead.  I also used sesame oil because I couldn't find sunflower oil.  This was a really nice side with my chicken tonight.  Thanks for sharing!

I doubled the dijon mustard and mushrooms, and added some minced garlic. This is quick and easy to make, and great served over rice (or pasta). This hit the spot on a cold day when I just didn't want to grill outside!  Made for I Recommend tag.

This is quick and easy, and made with something I always have in my freezer!  What's not to like?  I agree with other reviewers....not sure the onion, sugar and broth add much to this recipe.  I made it as posted, and now wonder why I didn't make it the way Annacia did.  Loved the pine nuts with this, next time I'll increase them a bit.  Thanks for sharing your recipe!

I followed diner's advice and left my steak whole.  I used a New York Strip.  I added some mushrooms to my onions, and the combination was great.  Next time I'll throw my veggies on before my steak....they weren't quite done when the steak had reached my desired doneness.  Loved this combination of exquisite flavors!  Love to cook on the grill!  Thanks for sharing your recipe. Made for 123 Hits Tag.

This bread was a bit tart, but delicious!  It is very moist.  Can't wait to try it toasted tomorrow morning, as Annacia suggested.  Thanks for sharing!  **Have to add this, after sitting overnight, this bread is magnificent!  Didn't even need toasting! Try it!**

I've made this salad with pecans, sunflower seeds, and now toasted almonds.  Always delicious!  I used no fat mayo and real bacon instead of bacon bits....just don't like those.  Wonderful salad!  Thanks for sharing.

Nice spicy fish....I'll add a little fire to this next time with some cayenne to liven it up.  This recipe is really visually appealing, so it would be nice for a dinner party.  But it's quick enough for a week night.  Thanks for sharing!

I used blueberries because I couldn't find locally grown strawberries here right now.  This was wonderful!  I used 0 Fat Greek yogurt and there is no way you would think this is low fat.  Delicious!  I didn't eat this as a desert, but as breakfast :)!  Thanks for sharing!

Made this exactly as posted, except I used Recipe #268149 for the spaghetti sauce instead of pre-made, and I added a bit of no fat shredded mozzarella.  The panko made this very crisp, while the chicken inside was very moist. Made for your win in Football Tag, Week 10 2010.

I really liked this!  I did this on the grill, and it was great.  I used shallots this time, but think I might try green onions next time....although I like the mellow flavor of the shallots.  Thanks for sharing this yummy recipe!

So creamy and delicious!  I halved the amount of butter, and also used fat-free half-and-half to cut the fat content in this recipe.  Even after my changes, this turned out totally delicious.  I did cook my stock for 3 hours uncovered instead of 1 hour covered to make it a bit richer.  Thanks for sharing your recipe!

I know I made this a while back and uploaded the photo.....thought I'd reviewed it too, but looks like it didn't stick.  I loved this.  My neighbor was keeping me in a large supply of blueberries, and this salad was a wonderful way to use them up.  Loved the combination of feta and blueberries.

Amazing!  The leeks, portobello, and garlic takes this recipe over the top.  I used fat free half and half and stock left from Thanksgiving turkey.  I think it would be creamier with the whipping cream, but I loved it the way I made it.  I halved the recipe, but actually used more spinach (I mashed it down in the measuring cup so I'd get more....I know how it disappears when you cook it!).  A definite make again dish.  Just sorry I didn't make this when the sun was out so the photo could do this beautiful dish justice.  Thanks for sharing!

Like other reviewers, I doubled the asparagus.  I also used chicken stock instead of vegetable broth, because that is what I had on hand.  This was really delicious, but I had to add additional liquids to get my rice tender.  I added the asparagus stems as indicated, but waited 5 minutes to add the tips so they didn't fall apart.  Loved the tarragon in this!  Enjoyed this as a side to some fish tonight.  Thanks for sharing a delicious recipe!
