I cooked it on low for 7 hours and the meatballs were nice and tender and broke up, which I liked so you didn't just have a big mouthful of the meatball...you got some with each spoonful.  Undoubtedly it would have been fine at 5 hours, but I was out and about and didn't get home in time!  About halfway through my bowl I tossed some shredded cheddar cheese on top. It was a nice addition and went weill with the soup. Who knew that something so simple could be so tasty! Thanks for posting!

This was a great supper.  I made as directed except I used boneless skinless chicken breasts.  I also forgot to marinade it...but it still turned out great!  I added a lot of hot sauce, but I couldn't even taste it in the end.  Next time I'll add a LOT of hot sauce.  Thanks for posting!
This was pretty good, but I would cut back on the sweet and sour mix just a tish.  It was a pretty pinky light rosy color and looked lovely in the glass.  Thanks for posting!

Yummy!  I used instant mashed potatoes because I didn't have any homemade ones already and didn't want to make them just for this recipe.  This was fantastic.  So easy and delicious.  I'm usually not a huge mashed potato fan, but I would definitely eat these any day.  This is going into my keeper file!  Thanks for posting.
mmmm..yum.  This made a wonderful breakfast on a cold morning.  Like another reviewer, I used milk instead of water too.  I really enjoyed this and look forward to making it throughout the winter :)

Oct. 2nd, 2008; Yum, yum, yum, yum, yum :) This is such a simple and tasty snack mix. I didn't even think that I should have bought halloween M&M's. That would have made it look more seasonal. I'll have to do that next time. I'm looking forward to bagging some up and taking to work to snack on :) Thanks so much lazyme! Made for Photo Tag.

Updated October 25th, 2008...I made some of this and took it to my parents when we went to visit this weekend...my dad LOVED it.  He couldn't stop eating it.  He's always been a peanut guy, (but what man isn't), but he just couldn't get enough of this.  Thanks again lazyme for the simple treat.

Yummy!  What a different way to do pizza.  I really liked the crescent roll crust.  I really liked the mozzarella cheese with it but I'm sure any kind would still be great.  This is a nice easy weeknight meal that will be going into my "keeper" file!  Thanks for posting!

What a winner, French Tart!  I made these with my husband in mind, but I really loved it too.  For the sausages I used jalepeno and cheese smoked sausages.  It was such a simple recipe that took little time to prepare.  It was fun to try something other than a plain old bun.  My husband is a mustard guy so he especially loved the onions.  Great recipe!  Thanks for sharing!

This was so great.  I used a 12 oz. frozen pound cake...and I forgot to thaw it before I wanted to make it, so I microwaved it to soften it up.  And it didn't occur to me that I should let it cool before adding the fillings...whoops!  It still turned out fine, but some fo the chocolate had melted out and was on the sides...  I didn't use all of the filling becuase it looked like a lot, but I wish i did...next time I'll really load it on.  I used the toffee bits too, but I would like this just fine without them too.  This was a great dessert that was so simple to make.  I'll be making this again!  Thanks for posting!

Fantastic!  I made exaclty as directed except used boneless skinless chicken breasts cut into tenders.  (about 4 large breasts cut up).  The seasoning was great...my garlic loving husband and I really enjoyed this recipe.  It was a lot crunchier than I thought it would be...the  coating was the prefect crispiness. We used some bbq sauce and ranch on the side to dip, I preferred the ranch with it.  Thanks so much for posting this great recipe!

What a great idea!  I will agree that it was a little more than just 1 serving...I probably should have shared it! lol.  I added pecans instead of walnuts for personal preference.  I really enjoyed this, and it definitely fulfills the chocolate requirement when I'm in a hurry and don't want a whole cake.  I ate it right out of the mug and topped it with some ice cream and caramel syrup.  yum. Thanks so much for posting...I'm sure I'll be making this alot. :)

What a great snack!  I had some homemade pepper jelly...(not by me, but I buy it often from a roadside stand that is in between where I live now and my parents house)  I didn't have whole wheat crackers so I used ritz...the were a little crumbly though and broke sometimes when i tried to spread  the cream cheese on, but it tasted marvelous.  Next time I'll definitely do the wheat crackers since they would be more durable and hold up better.  This is such a great recipe (and easy too!) Thanks for sharing!
These had a great flavor, but were more dry than I would have preferred.  Still very tasty though. The 8 minutes was the perfect cook time.  It halved nicely too.  Thanks so much for sharing :)

This was great!  I did the stove top method and it was easy as could be.  I didn't have any bourbon so I used Jack Daniels, like another reivewer did.  It was very tasty and the Jack wasn't too strong.  I served along with mashed potatoes.  Great supper.  Thanks so much for sharing!

These were so cute! lol.  Small and definitely bite sized.  They seemed to be missing a little something though...not sure what.  I used american cheese on some and swiss on the rest.  I did scale back on the onion some though because it sounded like a lot.  I liked the toasted bread as a bun.  Thanks so much for posting!

Yummy!  I made exactly as directed except that I used bottled lime juice but didn't use as much as it said that 1 lime would be equal to.  When it comes to limes my husband and I usually agree that less is more.  This came together very quickly and was a nice beverage to sip on while we watched a movie tonight.  (Elf...gotta love it! lol)  Thanks so much for posting Syd!

Yummers.  What a great idea to jazz up grilled cheese a little.  My husband loved it too.  I served it with some tomato basil soup and it was the perfect dipper.  I used a different method to cook it though...I used Chef V's method Recipe #192896 ...the only way I do grilled cheese anymore.  This is definitely a keeper!  Thanks for posting this!

Yummy gravy!  I made this for breakfast this morning using a zesty hot sausage.  I was worried it would be boring with so few ingredients, but it just goes to show how just some good old salt and pepper can really add to a recipe.  I used some refrigerated pillsbury buttermilk biscuits.  Thanks so much for posting :)

This was a tasty pizza.  I used red wine to "sautee" my mushrooms in but I would have preferred the flavor of a broth I think.  I would definitely do it differently next time.  Over all though it's a great pizza!  Thanks for posting!

This is the perfect way to "sautee" mushrooms.  I used red wine, but think I would prefer a broth next time.  The red wine flavor just was off for me.  I will use the method though often for many recipes.  Thanks :)

Yummy, yummy, yummy!  I made this as our supper tonight and it was great.  I made the recipe as directed and then also served a veggie on the side.  We still had a few leftover that I will try freezing.  (I know the directions say to freeze before baking, but I figured I'd give it a whirl!)  I makes a nice light meal, or I'm sure would be great for an appetizer at a party.  Thanks so much for sharing this keeper!

This was a great lunch for a lazy day.  They were so quick to through together and I have everything on hand.  I did use provolone instead of swiss, but otherwise made as directed.  Thanks so much for posting this tasty quick lunch.
What a great potato recipe!  It couldn't have been any easier either.  The old bay seasoning is perfect for this.  I wouldn't change a thing.  Thanks so much for posting!
Tasty :)  This would be a kid pleaser for sure.  I did leave out the black olives though just because of personal preference.  I really liked the biscuit "crust" topping.  Thanks for posting!

These were great.  I baked them but would love to try them done in a skillet.  They made for a super easy meal.  I served it with Recipe #117297 to dip in.  They went great together.  Thanks so much for posting Boomette!

These are great cookies.  The flavors all work perfectly together.  I used fresh squeezed orange juice and frozen cranberries.  They look so pretty -- perfect for holiday goodie trays.  Thanks for posting!

Yummy!  Such a simple ad tasty treat.  I did use ice cream instead of frozen yogurt just because I already had the ice cream in the freezer.  I used sprite zero too.  This is perfect for the whole family...a real kid pleaser I'm sure.  I will keep this in mind for a summertime "cool-down".  (If summer ever gets here!)  Thanks for posting.  Made for Football Pool 2008.  Congrats on the win!

What a great "mocktail".  I did cut back on the lime just a tiny bit just for personal preference.  The lime was still there but not too overpowering.  I also used sprite instead of seltzer.  Thanks for posting!
This was a pretty good potato dish.  I liked the crunchy french fried onions on top.  I cut the recipe in half and it worked great.  Thanks so much for posting!

This made for a great meal.  It reminded me somewhat of a mexican type of hamburger helper.  I used a couple orange mini sweet peppers instead of the green pepper but otherwise made as directed.  I really enjoyed this and it was super easy to make.  Thanks for posting!

Very simple and tasty dip.  I thought it was a litle bit too mild though so after trying it I did add some more salsa.  I liked the subtle avocado flavor.  I sat down with a big bowl of this and a bag of tortilla chips for a lazy day lunch since I was home alone. :)  Thanks for posting!

This was excellent.  I cut the recipe in half and it worked wonderfully.  It was a mix of a chili and a stew.  The flavor seemed very stewlike even though there were beans and spices.  The stew meat was tender and wonderful.  Thanks so much for posting!  Made for Went to Market Tag.

These were pretty good.  I thought it was a bit too much cream cheese, and I didn't care for the taste of the green onions with everything else.  I would just leave them out next time.  I think the 1 regular onion is enough.  I thought the seasoning salt would be out of place but it worked!  Thanks for posting!

These are so good!  I've tried quite a few different sloppy joe recipes and this one is right up at the top.  It used all stuff I have on hand which is always a plus too.  I did leave out the onion because I was out.  Thanks so much for the great new sloppy joe recipe.  ~ Made for I Recommend Tag

Wow!  This was fantastic!  All of the flavors work so great together, and it's healthy!  It couldn't have been any easier to prepare either.  This is definitely going into my keeper file.  Thanks so much for sharing this great recipe!  Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders Tag.

This was pretty tasty for being pretty healthy!  I used more mushrooms than called for but other than that followed the recipe.  It made for a nice supper last night for my husband and I.  Thanks for posting!
Yum-O!  So tasty.  It was the perfect side to my ravioli (premade, I was feeling lazy!)  I made exactly as posted and will be making again.  Thanks for sharing!

This was such an easy supper!  Thank heavens for the crockpot!  The sauce was very good but the chicken was a little dry.  I would cut the cooking time back...(I did 6 hours on low)  Thanks for posting!

Excellent!  I really liked this.  The honey was a bit strong for my tastes, because I'm not a huge honey person, but it is in the name of the drink...I should have expected it!  Next time I'll cut back just a tish on it.  It was super easy to put together too.  Thanks so much for posting!

yummy yummy!  Pure comfort in a crockpot! lol.  Love ranch anything so I knew I would love this.  The potatoes were nice and tender and the "sauce" was perfectly flavored.  Thanks so much for posting!

This was such an easy way to do fish!  I used sole because I'd never had it before and was feeling adventerous.  We really enjoyed this.  Eating healthy doesn't have to be boring!  Thanks so much for posting another great recipe!

Oh my goodness this was phenomenal!  It was easy to prepare too!  I cooked the chicken indoors under the broiler but would love to grill them outdoors in nicer weather.  I was a little nervous about the dipping sauce but it was great!!  I used a habenero instead of serrano chile though.  Still had LOTS of heat!!  This is a great recipe and I'm looking forward to chopping up the leftover chicken to put on a lettuce salad tomorrow for lunch!  Thanks so much for posting!  Made for Photo Tag.
This was a nice breakfast side.  I really liked the vanilla on it.  The sweetness of the honey/vanilla was nice with the sour/tart of the grapefruit.  Thanks so much for posting!

This was a nice variation to a regular tuna sandwich.  I liked the addition of the jalapeno -- I almost doubled the amount called for.  I thought the mustard was just a tish too strong for my tastes though.  I really  liked the cream cheese, but my husband says he would have prefered plain old mayo.  (I think he's crazy :) )  Thanks for posting!  Made for Photo Tag.

So great!  I had to make these indoors due to the weather, but can't wait to try them on the grill.  I love Montreal steak seasoning so i knew this would be a keeper.  Perfect flavors.  Thanks for posting!

What an amazingly easy recipe!  I always have canned mushrooms and cream of mushroom soup on hand, and of course the worcestershire sauce on hand as well, so all I needed to do was pick up a beef roast.  I cooked it for about 7 hours on low and it was perfect.  Even reheated later it was still good.  Would be great along side a heaping mound of mashed potatoes.  Thanks so much for sharing this simple recipe!  Made for Photo Tag.

I made these exactly as directed except used regular hamburger buns instead of ciabatta rolls.  My husband and I both really enjoyed these.  Cumin is my favorite spice so I really enjoyed that in the seasoning mix.  For the cheese we put provolone on some and swiss on others.  The flavors are so nice -- it was a great alternative to a regular old hamburger.  Thanks so much for posting!! Made for Please Review My Recipe Tag.

Very good quick meal!  I had never had pierogies before so I was excited to try them.  They were so good!  Thanks for introducing them to me!  I made the recipe exactly as directed except I accidently dumped my pierogies without defrosting them first.  So, after adding them, I poured everything into a baking dish and baked it at 350 for about 15 minutes.  It worked great.   Thanks for posting!  Made for Photo Tag.
Perfect technique for hard boiled eggs.  I loved how easy it was and they peeled nicely too!  This is the way I'll be doing my hard boiled eggs from now on.  Thanks!!

So yummy!  It's hard to go wrong with any kind of fried chicken so I knew this would be good.  I used boneless skinless chicken breasts just because that's what we prefer.  The chicken itself was prety moist and juicy.  This is definitely a make again recipe.  Thanks for posting!! Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders Tag.
This makes a very good sauce.  I'd never had piri-piri sauce so i wasn't exactly sure what to expect.  I used this for Recipe #369919 and it worked wonderfully.  Thanks for posting!

Yummy yummy.  If your going to have potato chips with a burger, might as well throw them on the burger!  I did use plain ruffles chips, but it would be fun to try flavored ones...maybe dill pickle flavored?  or some of the spicy kinds?  I like the crunch for a different texture.  What a simple and tasty burger.  Thanks for sharing!  Made for PRMR tag.

Very yummy!  The flavor was great -- the breadcrumbs & parmesan cheese was a tasty combo.  I had trouble keeping the batter on, but I think I just didn't have my oil hot enough because I turned the heat up a little and the last few rings I did were better than the first ones.  I dipped them in ranch and thoroughly enjoyed.  I will make these again!  Made for Please Review My Recipe Tag.

Tasty!  My husband and I really enjoyed these.  I might have used a little more onion and green pepper than called for...I just eyeballed everything and didn't measure.  I cut into mine too soon -- didn't wait the full 10 minutes because i'm impatient and they looked so good! They oozed and were messier to eat than they would have been if I left it alone for the full 10 minutes...oh well!  Thanks for posting this yummy recipe.  Made for Zaar Stars Tag Game.

I fell in love with Chambord a few years ago when I had my first French Martini.  Since then I've been looking for other recipes that use it and i'm SO glad I found this one.  It is so tasty...I'm a fruity drink person...this was right up my alley.  I also love that it's fairly simple and can order it at most any bar, unlike lots of other tasty recipes that have a billion ingredients.  A perfect drink.  Thanks for sharing this keeper.  Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders Tag.
Yummy yummy!  It is very tart, but I like it like that.  I used Triple Sec instead of Cointreau but it still tasted fabulous.  Thanks for posting!

Very tasty.  I loved that it was simple and had so few ingredients.  I left out the pine nuts just for personal preference but otherwise made as directed.  I halved the recipe for just the two of us and it worked nicely.  Thanks so much for sharing this recipe!  Made for Photo Tag.

These were very good muffins.  I didn't add the sugar on top but wish I would have...it would have been a nice touch.  I made exactly as posted and they were pretty easy to make.  They weren't overly sweet but it was nice.  Thanks for posting!! Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders Tag.

I dont' think I had ever used my oven at 500 degrees before, lol.  I was a little worried it would be too hot and they would just burn to a crisp, but they turned out beautifully.  Crisp on the outside, tender and soft on the inside.  The mustard mix was nice, not too overpowering.  Thanks so much for posting!  Made for phase 2 of Theirs, Yours & Mine Photo Tag.

This was really good.  My husband doesn't dole out 5 star ratings very easily, and you got a full 5 from him!  That's impressive in itself!  The marinade was so good -- tasted nice and bright and fresh.  A perfect summertime grilling recipe.  I only let the chicken marinate for about 2 hours, but can't wait to try it when it can sit a full 4 hours.  GREAT recipe.  Thanks SO much for sharing!  Made for Phase II of Theirs, Yours, & Mine Photo Tag in the Cookbooks Forum.  (Recommendation offered by TeresaS)

Honestly, I've never had onion soup before...but this was good.  I used a slice of swiss cheese instead of the shredded but otherwise made as directed.  I liked the mushrooms in it...gave it a little bit more interest besides just the onion flavor.  Thanks so much for posting!  Made for Phase 2 of Theirs, Yours, & Mine Photo Tag. :)

These were really good.  I love pizza, I love quesadillas, so it was a great mix of the two.  I used regular pepperoni since I don't need it to be gluten free, but otherwise made as directed.  This would be great kid food, but is great for adults too ;)  Made this for a light lunch.  Thanks for sharing!

This was very tasty.  Perfect breakfast for a chilly fall morning.  I made as directed except added pumpkin pie spice in place of the cinnamon.  I didn't measure the milk I added...I just poured in a splash.  Thanks so much for postin!  Made for Theirs, Yours, & Mine Photo Tag.

This was a very tasty meal.  I liked the creaminess the cream cheese added, but it did seem like there was just a little something missing...some spice or herb or something.  We did really enjoy it though.  I did have a little bit of trouble with the crescent roll dough, but nothing major.  They do make crescent roll dough that comes as one big sheet with no seams, that would be the way to go on this recipe I think.  Thanks so much for posting!  Made for Theirs, Yours, & Mine Photo Tag from Nif's recommendation.

Great drink!  I didn't like it quite as much as my husband did...I'd give it 4 stars, he says 5.  The tequila isn't too strong, and the flavors really work together.  Thanks so much for posting!  Made for your Football Pool Win, Week 4.

These were very good!  I doubled the recipe but other wise made as directed.  Oh, and my burrito shells didn't look big enough to be burrito shells...? So we ended up using a couple more than the recipe called for.  The filling was so yummy - the seasonings were perfect.  We loved this recipe.  Thanks for posting!  Made for Theirs, Yours, & Mine Photo Tag.

Loved these simple and tasty appetizers.  I made these to eat as a snack as we watched some football on Sunday.  I microwaved them for just a bit and they were great.  It used ingredients I usually have on hand, so that's a plus too.  Thanks so much for posting!  Made for your football pool win :)

This was nice for a quick chocolate fix.  Loved the portion control especially since my husband doesn't like cake and sweets.  Now I can have chocolate and not be stuck with a bunch of it leftover!  It had nice flavor but the texture was a little bit off -- almost rubbery/chewy.  It was still yummy though!  Thanks for posting.

What a tasty, easy, different way to do a hot dog! I made as directed, and added some mustard. It's perfect for the last few hot dogs in the pack that you ran out of hot dog buns for! Thanks for posting! Made for Theirs, Yours, & Mine Photo Tag.

This was very tasty!! I really liked it, nice and orangy peachy :)  I love sweet and fruity drinks, and this is one that I could get in trouble with I think!  It's also very simple...I like drinks with few ingredients.  I will be keeping this recipe for future use ;)

Delish! These little nuggets of goodness were so quick and easy to make. I did 1/2 teaspoon of the hot sauce, but still couldn't really tell it was in there...I think I'd put quite a bit more in next time. We love heat. The barbecue flavor was really nice too. We tried some Sweet Baby Rays BBQ sauce and also ranch dressing for dipping, and both my husband and I liked both but preferred the ranch. I've done something similar to this before using crushed doritos on whole chicken breasts -- I really liked these little bitty bits because you got a lot more crunch and coating with each bite than you do when it's a whole chicken breast. This was so easy even a caveman could do it ;) lol. Thanks for a keeper of a recipe!  Made for Theirs, Yours, & Mine Photo Tag.

Great fries!  They turned out great for us, but the only reason I'm rating this a 4 instead of a 5 is because we upped the temp a lot.  We ended up doing them at 450 for the first 30 minutes and then 475 for about 10 more.  They were really good that way though.  We just seasoned them with plain old salt.  Great fries.  Thanks for posting :)

This is a delicious refreshing summer salad.  I really enjoyed it.  I liked this salad more than ones with mayonnaise or sour cream because it really allows the cucumber flavor to shine and not be covered up.  So simple and great!  Thanks for posting.
We really liked this overall, but didn't really care for the basil flavor in the mayo mixture.  Next time I think I'll just use plain 'ol mayo.  Very good recipe though.  Thanks for posting :)
Absolutely delicious. We normally do just the plain old butter and garlic salt.  This really took it up a notch . This is going in the keeper file. Thanks for posting!

Wow, Realtor, you have a real winner with these brownies!  So delicious and moist.  The frosting is pretty sweet, but so perfect with a glass of milk :) I like that it makes a small pan since my husband doesn't care for sweets much. Now I won't feel quite as bad when I eat the whole pan myself lol.  I'm definitely making these again, thanks so much for posting!  Made for PRMR Tag.

Yummy Yummy oatmeal.  I just loved this.  I think I could scale back a little on the cinnamon though...otherwise loved it the way it is.  Skipped out on the salt -- might try it next time to see how it changes the flavor.  Will be making this often.  Thanks so much for posting!  Made for PRMR Tag.
I was impressed with how quickly this came together.  Super quick and easy!  It was very tasty too.    I used italian seasoned breadcrumbs but otherwise made as directed.  Thanks for posting!

I love dips.  A lot.  I really enjoyed this one. I made as directed but went with just a little horseradish -- I'm not a huge fan of it,.  I'm sure my husband would have loved for me to put in the max amount.  I tried it with pretzels, some random crackers we had partial boxes of laying around lol, and some potato chips.  Went well with all but did like the pretzels the best.  thanks for posting!  Made for your football pool win week 1.

What a yummy chili recipe.  I made as directed except used a little less of the chipotle peppers in adobo...I know how hot those babies are and was nervous about doing as much as called for lol.  This had great flavor and really hit the spot on a chilly fall night :)  Thanks so much for posting!

wow.   Can you get any easier or yummier??!! These were fantastic and took no time at all to make.  I had a hard time finding a cookie cutter the right size -- they all were way too big or a little too small.  After some searching I decided on a cake decorating tip -- I have a big one that was the perfect size on the big end.   I really loved these and my husband was impressed too.  Thanks so much for posting! Made for PRMR tag!
My husband and I both loved this.  It was very easy and healthy!  We didn't find it bland at all.  This is definitely a keeper!  Thanks for posting.

mmm this was yummy!  I loved the pecans with the snap peas, very nice combo!  Mine ended up really buttery, but I forgot that I didn't have as much of the peas as the recipe called for, so I should have cut back on the butter too.  Totally my fault.  This was so quick and easy, and will surely be repeated in our house.  Thanks so much for posting!

Does it get any easier than this!?  Wow, what a great easy meal.  I was worried that these would be too hot to eat much of, but it was just the perfect amount of heat.  My the end I could feel the burn, but was so good!  I made exactly as directed and loved them as is.  My husband didn't care much for the oregano in the marinade though.  We still both really enjoyed these.  They were perfect for our superbowl supper.  Thanks for sharing.  Made for PRMR tag!

What a tasty little snack!  I realized I only had pecan pieces, not pecan halves, but it still worked out great, just the same.  You can definitely taste some heat but it wasn't overpowering, which was nice.  They are delicious on their own, but am looking forward to topping off my salad for lunch tomorrow with them.  Thanks for posting!  Made for photo tag.

This made a nice combination of flavors. I used homemade bread dough.

Another time I think I'd add the cheese on top of the meat layer as I assemble the roll and let the oven melt it because it made an awful mess in the skillet. Worth it though.

I loved the generous portions that made this a REAL meal. A doubled recipe fed 2 adults, 2 teens, and a toddler. The use of both regular and sundried tomatoes made it nice and rich too. But it didn't quite live up to its potential because the flavor was rather one-dimensional. IMO, it needs garlic and another herb, perhaps oregano, to add depth and complexity. Additionally, DH complained that the cayenne on top was like finding landmines -- it might have been better added along with the basil so that the flavors would meld. It would have been a 4-star though except that the author messed up the fresh-to-dried basil conversion. Even using the regular conversion of 1 tsp dried basil for each tbs fresh the flavor was overpowering. If I'd used 6 tablespoons of dried basil in the doubled batch it would have been like eating pesto out of the jar with a spoon. In a regular review I'd just have noted the error and given it the 4 stars but since its a contest entry I can't rate it as highly as I'd rate a recipe that written correctly. Sorry. :-(

Absolutely delicious! I used some chardonnay that was too dry for our tastes so it ended up sweet enough without being candy-sticky. Very fruity and refreshing. A little powerful though so watch out if you're like me and get silly on one glass of wine. ;-) :-D LOL

The family is split on this one. Everyone agrees that the chicken was delicious (DS#1 would have increased the intensity of the flavors if he could). Two of us liked the potatoes. Three thought they were sort of bland and somehow missing something.
I made 9 chicken leg quarters in a quadruple batch of marinade (soaked about 4 hours), and potatoes. The only thing I could think that might have improved the dish would be to add onions as it baked. Note -- It doesn't say whether to cook covered or uncovered so I cooked it covered for half an hour then uncovered it for another half hour to brown.
Very very good! I am not a sour cream fan, but the flavor was not overpowering. Really enjoyed the mushroom-fish combo.
Very tasty (I love caraway seeds). We served it with lots of honey. Mine was shaped funny, though, not like in the picture shown. I don't know enough about making bread to know what I did wrong.

Yummy! I don't know if the brown sugar is authentic, but even if it is, I probably won't use it next time. We forgot the yogurt, and we ate it with fish rather than chicken, and it was still delicious! We at this and our fish on top of basmati rice.

This was a really nice soup.  I loved the flavors and that it's so healthy.  I didn't uses fennel seed because we didn't have any, and I blended only half of the soup because DH prefers it a little chunky.  Thanks Boomette.  Made for New Zaar Tag.

These cucumber boats were delicious and so pretty!  Our family had some guests over today and the boats were a hit!  Even my younest and picky DD loved eating her "boat."  She wants me to make them again soon because they're fun to eat! :D  I was adventurous and used Recipe #118182 in place of the feta, but it really tasted fantastic.  My family will be making this again!  Thanks!  Made for ZWT 4.
This a wonderful simple, healthy, fresh, and delicious tasting salad.  Thanks!  Made for ZWT 4.

Delicious dressing!  I really LOVED this.  I didn't use it on a chicken salad, but a regular Greek style salad.  I didn't add the honey, but made exactly otherwise.  I'll be making this for my family again, because they all enjoyed it.  Thanks!  Made for ZWT4.  Go Jefes!

Delicious and sweet salad!  This salad was a big hit with my DD's, DH, and Filipino friend!  They loved the sweet, fresh taste and I'm sure we'll be making this one again!  Made for ZWT4.  Go Jefes! ;)
I loved this salad, but then I love tart salads!  I added garlic salt and and italian seasoning.  I'm going to try making this with calamansi juice next time.  Made for ZWT4.  Thanks!

My DD's want you to know this is worth more than 5 stars! They absolutely loved it!  DH and I enjoyed it too. ;)  We enjoyed this combo for breakfast along with some oatmeal.  Thanks!  Made for ZWT4 - Go Jefes!

These carrots were delicious and quite easy to make!  Even my Filipino friend that usually doesn't like any cooked carrots said she liked them!  This is a big plus, because she eats with our family every day for lunch and we like to have cooked carrots sometimes.  Thanks little wing!  Made for ZWT4 - Go Jefes!

This was a really good rice!  It tasted like spanish rice without the spicy kick.  My whole family really enjoyed it and I think I'll use this recipe again the next time I want spanish rice and add some spice to it.  Thanks!  Made for ZWT4 - Los Jefes de la Cocina.

Wonderful dressing! We only used 1/4 cup olive oil, because we wanted a stronger basalmic vinegar taste and enjoyed it with a green salad. We also added a touch of the lemon juice.  If we had this with a pasta salad we would have definitely used the entire amount of olive oil. Thanks! Made for ZWT4 - Los Jefes de la Cocina.
This was a very nice carrot salad.  We ended up adding some more orange and only a dash of sugar.  DD's loved the sweet and cinnamon taste to thier carrots.  Made for ZWT4 - Los Jefes de la Cocina.
Yummy!  We loved this oatmeal!  We liked the added cinnamon.  My family enjoyed it with some vanila soy milk.  Thanks Boomette!  Made for ZWT4 - Jefes de la Cocina.
This turned out really nice. We are big zucchini fans in my house, so it was fun to try this new way of cooking zucchini. Thanks. Made for ZWT4 - Jefes de la Cocina.

Delicious and easy! I already knew this would taste great because of all the rave reviews and I wasn't disappointed.  However, I was sceptical about it being as simple as everyone stated and was happily surprised to see just how easy it was to throw together and then let it freeze on it's own!  I used the food processor method.  I will make this again as it's always hot here in the Philippines and we're always wanting icy treats to cool us down!  I didn't use optional ingredients; the orange-flavored liqueur or Grand Marnier and it was still fabulous!  Made for ZWT4 - Los Jefes de la Cocina!
This was really good garlicy tasting rice.  Reminds me of the garlic rice that is popular here in the Philippines.  Thanks!  Made for ZWT4 - Los Jefes de la Cocina!

This was so delicious!  I love anything with balsamic vinegar in it.  I used a mix of both red and green bell peppers.  I also added some fresh cilantro leaves to garnish.  Thanks!  Made for ZWT - Jefes de la Cocina.

This was so yummy!  Makes a lot of soup, so I think we will be having it again tomorrow which is fine by me. I used 1 Tbsp canola oil in place of the butter and vegetarian chicken stock (McKays chicken seasoning mixed with water)  to cut out a lot of saturated fat and remove the cholesterol.  I also only used the equivelent of 1 can of each of the beans, because I wanted it to be more soupy.  This turned out so delicious and very healthy!  Thanks Marlitt!  Made for ZWT4 Zingo - Los Jefes de la Cocina!

These were really yummy noodles and so quick and easy. I already had some homemade pesto sauce prepared, so it took me no time to have this ready for my family today when I felt too busy to cook! I had a little trouble trying to decide how to adjust this to make enough for my family.  I think the serving sizes are a little large, but maybe it's just me.  Thanks Brooke! Made for Zaar Tag.

This dip/salad is delicious!  I ate it plain like a salad without chips as a healthy evening snack, though I know it would've tasted great with chips or with some bread either!  Thanks Syd for the delicious recipe!  Made for Zaar tag.

Yum!  Quesadillas are one of my all time favorite snacks, and I loved this new way of eating them.  I used half pepper jack cheese and half cheddar cheese and a tad less mayo (maybe 1/3 cup) because that's what I had.  They were really terrific!  Thanks Boomette!  Made for 1-2-3 Zaar Tag.

I should've read the other reviews before making this.  I read through the ingredients knowing it had all the things I love in it without paying close attention to the amounts listed.  I was trying to quickly put this salad together so it would have the time to marinate before dinner and didn't realize until I was dumping the 2nd Tbsp of garlic salt in that it was going to be way too much salt!  I'm hoping the recipe meant to say 2-3 tsp instead of 2-3 tablespoons.  Unfortunately none of my family could stomach this salty salad and ended up having to dump it.  That being said, I'm sure this recipe would turn out really nice without so much garlic salt listed. UPDATE: I saw the salt amount was changed and tried this again.  It was really nice and tasted great spread over some bread!
FANTASTIC!  This salad was beautiful, simple, and tasty!  Can't ask for more.  Made for Vegetarian Swap.

Delicious cake!  Tastes so much like banana bread, which is one of our family's favorites.  I altered it slightly to make it vegan, because I had some vegan friends coming for lunch.  I used coconut milk instead of buttermilk, 3 egg replacers, and soy margarine for the butter.  It tasted wonderful and I believe we'll make this again sometime!  Thanks Loof!  Made for Zaar Tag.
These are yummy potatoes that my whole family enjoyed!  I added an extra potato and forgot to increase everything else, but they still turned out fantastic.  Thanks!  Made for Zaar Tag.

Fantastic stir fry!  I loved this vegetable meal and so did my family.  It's so healthy for you and tastes great!  We ate this with rice.  I left out the arugula and sesame seeds (though I really want to try this again with both) and used bok choy instead of celery.  Thanks so much Boomette for this recipe!  Made for 1-2-3 Zaar Tag.

This was delicious! I don't remember ever eating barley before, but had heard how healthy it was and wanted to give it a try. My family loves rice and bean recipes, and this recipe reminded us all of rice and beans except I think we liked the barley even better! I followed Dreamer's suggestion to use diced tomatoes and only used a 15 ounce can. That amount turned out perfect for us. I also used some cut up bok choi instead of celery, because I hadn't realized my celery had gone bad and I wanted to replace it with something. Turned out great and I know I'll cook it again as I'm always needing great crock pot recipes! Thanks! Made for 1-2-3 Zaar Tag.
This was a really nice stir-fry.  I loved the variety of fresh vegetables!  I added a good helping of braggs liquid aminos (like soy sauce) and ate it with rice.  Thanks!  Made for new Zaar tag.

This was so easy and wonderful!  I loved the flavor combination of the potatoes and my whole family loved them.  I also added a carrot grated to the mix just because I always love carrots with sweet potatoes and I'm always trying to find ways to add more vegetables.  Thanks for a fantastic recipe loof!  Made for 1-2-3 Zaar tag.

This is a great substitute to help lower your sodium intake!  I must admit I like soy sauce taste better, but this is a great replacement that I can use instead so I don't consume so much sodium.  We eat rice with soy sauce added almost every day here in Asia, so this is great for us!  Thanks KateL!  Made for 1-2-3 Zaar Tag.

This was a wonderful blend of veggies!  Went over well with the whole family - even DD that hates mushrooms liked it as long as the mushrooms were hidden in a big bite with the other veggies.  It was nice to have cooked veggies that tasted more American style than Asia style for a change. lol  My cilantro went bad and couldn't find any at the market, so I had to do without, but I felt it had such a nice buttery taste to it that the cilantro wasn't missed.  Thanks!  Made for Adopt a Tag II - Sept 2008.

My family loved this pineapple smoothie!  It was so easy to make and was so refreshing on a hot day.  I didn't add any sugar, I did use the ice, and I cut up fresh pineapple.  My DD's thank you for the special treat and I thank you that it was healthy for them! ;)  Made for veg*n swap II.
This was a really yummy stir-fry!  Wonderful flavors!  I'll be making this again!  Thanks!!  Made for Fall 2008 PAC.

Yummy, creamy smoothie!  I regularly make smoothies with banana, pineapple, and mango, though I usually use soy milk or coconut milk.  The whipped cream made it taste like an extra special treat and my DD's loved it!  Thanks for another great recipe!  Made for PAC Fall 2008.
This was a yummy, peachy oatmeal!  I used canned peaches...and a BIG can so there would be plenty of peach pieces in each bite!  Thanks!!  Made for PAC Fall 2008.

YUMMY!  Tastes similar to cooked pechay (bok choy) in the Philippines!  I think it's because of the ginger flavor.  So, of course we all loved it! :)  I followed the recipe exactly as stated.  Thanks!!  Made for PAC Fall 2008.
Yum, yum, yum!  This was simple and wonderful!  My family enjoyed this with rice and chapatis for a fantastic lunch.  Thanks!  This is a keeper.  Made for Tempted by Turmeric Tag.
This tasted great!  An easy and healthy pasta that my family will enjoy having again sometime.  Thanks mliss!  Made for My 3 Chefs Nov 2008.
Wonderful!  My whole family enjoyed this.  Had it with some corn bread to make a perfect meal.  We will repeat this.  Thanks!  Made for 1-2-3 Zaar Tag.

Wonderful!  I wondered what it would be like with the cucumber and I really enjoyed it this way.  My family really liked it also.  I halved the recipe, used fresh basil, and used more yogurt instead of adding mayo.  Turned out great!  Thanks!  Made for 123Tag.

My family absolutely LOVED this recipe!  This is the recipe, along with my slight adjustments, that we will use from now on to make Eggplant Parmesan! :)  I used about 4 Japanese eggplant because that's the only eggplant we find in the Philippines. ;)  I also added a mix of grated parmesan and romano cheese, and some regular spegetti sauce for the marinara.  Turned out fantastic.  Made this for Kittencal's tag a thon.

Wow, these were some great tasting green beans!  A perfect dish for Thanksgiving or Christmas dinner - which I plan to make them again for! :)  Thanks Syd, my whole family loved this.  Made for Dec veg*n swap.

I thought these were really good!  My girls think they taste similar to German potatoes.  I used the stovetop, though I'm sure they would've been really nice on the grill as well.  I used lemon juice instead of lemon peel and regular balsamic vinegar instead of white.  Very tasty and we all love them.  Thanks!

Wonderful muffins!  I used fresh coconut and chocolate sprinkles instead of chocolate chips (we ran out but my DD's were already set on making these today, haha).  We loved these and served them to some friends who came over for dinner and enjoyed them as well.  This is a wonderful treat that I'm sure we'll repeat.  Thanks!

Oh, these were so YUMMY!!!  Some of the best stuffed peppers we've had. :)  I halved the recipe, used brown rice, and used fresh romano instead of parmesan because that's what I had.  Thanks Boomette!
I loved this fresh tasting pasta salad!  I omitted the onions for DH and used colored pasta shells.  It was absolutely delicious!  Thanks!

I made these tomatoes awhile ago and just forgot to review them!  These were fantastic and as soon as tomatoes come back into season I plan to make it again!  Thanks for such a fresh and flavorful recipe!

Yummy rice. The peppers turned out so tasty.  I will make this again just modify the cooking process slightly.  It took longer than 25 minutes for the rice to cook.  It was about perfect at almost 40 minutes.  Then I made the mistake of taking it off the burner and keeping it covered for 20 minutes while I prepared other food.  The 20 minutes covered caused the rice to become mushy.  So, I would either cook for the 25 minutes and then let it set for 20 instead of serving immediately or cook for about 40 and serve immediately next time.  Looking forward to trying this recipe again.  Thanks!  Made for vegetarian swap.

Yum!!!!  This turned out so great!  I used fresh apricots and soy milk, and I doubled the recipe (so glad) to make two loaves.  My family enjoyed one loaf tonight and we're sharing the other with friends tomorrow.  Thanks so much!  Made for vegetarian swap.
This was so good!  I halved the recipe and used vegenaise (I LOVE vegenaise) which still kept the fat content down.  This was so good that I know my family will be enjoying it again.  Thanks!
This turned out really nice.  I love cucumber dishes with my Asian food.  I made exactly as listed but had it sit to marinate overnight.  Thanks!  Made for Asian tag.

This was so great!  I used fresh basil instead of dried oregano, because that's what I had and it needed to be eaten.  I also added about 1/3 cup tomato sauce for my DD's.  Thanks!  Made for veg*n swap.

Yum, yum, yum!  These were tasty and FUN!  I used only 1 1/2 bulbs of garlic and about 1/2 of the wonton wrappers in the package.  This made 28 wontons for us and we served them with Recipe #224053.  Thanks Jammy! ;)  LOONEY SPOON PHOODIES ZWT6!
My DD's give this 10 stars!!!  This really was delicious and a fun treat for the whole family!  Thanks Sharon!  Made for ZWT6 LOONEY SPOON PHOODIES.

Great flavor!  I used half the amount of oil by cooking the bok choy is a little water instead of oil.  This is similar to something we enjoyed eating in the Philippines with mung beans.  Thanks!  Made for ZWT6 LOONEY SPOON PHOODIES.
Great basic brown rice recipe.  I added a little BRAGGs liquid Aminos  for flavor.  Thanks!  Made for ZWT6 - Looney Spoon Phoodies!

So, so good!  These are an excellent treat for summer!  I used vanilla yogurt, brown sugar, and guava, passion fruit, orange concentrate.  I'm going to come back to this recipe once it's mid-summer.  Thanks Sharon!  Made for ZWT6 LOONEY SPOON PHOODIES! :D

This made a delicious and healthy lunch!  I added a Tbsp oil when cooking the tofu and bell pepper.  Right before taking the tofu and veggies off the stove I also added a Tbsp of Asian red sweet chili sauce to give it a little extra flavor.  Thanks for another great recipe!  Made for ZWT6 LOONEY SPOON PHOODIES.

OH WOW!  This turned out even better than I thought it would!  Before letting the tzatziki sit in the fridge I tasted it to see what I thought...it tasted okay, but when I added it to the sandwich 3 hours later all the flavors together were so perfect!  I will definitely be making this sandwich again, especially since my DD's were surprisingly as crazy about them as I was!  Made for ZWT6 LOONEY SPOON PHOODIES!
This was a fun change from the normal hummus recipe that turned out tasting really good!  I halved the amount and used it as a veggie dip.  Thanks!  Made for ZWT6 - LOONEY SPOON PHOODIES!

The 2 things about this Greek style salad that put it over the top are the addition of garlic (yum!) and how pretty its presentation is.  I'm going to make this salad the next time I have to throw a salad together for guests - its so easy, but tastes fantastic and looks beautiful!  Made for ZWT6 - LOONEY SPOON PHOODIES!
This was fantastic!  My family loved it.  I followed the recipe exact and used an orange and green bell pepper.  Thanks Starry! Made for ZWT6 - LOONEY SPOON PHOODIES!

This was great!  My whole family loves thai peanut flavors and this dish was no exception.  It was gobbled up quickly and my DD's were asking for more.  The only change I'd make is to make more next time. ;)  I served this with fried tofu and brown rice for a healthy and delicious lunch!  Made for 1 2 3 Tag.

This is going to be my new Mexican Rice recipe!  Even my picky DD loved it!  DH called it incredible. :)  The only thing I changed was to add a little garlic salt at the end.  My family ate this with homemade beans, corn, avocado, and some corn tortillas.  Thanks Sharon!

This salad was a hit with my friends and family!  Very flavorful!  I used less about half the oil that it called for and it was still delicious.  I poured leftovers on top of some leafy greens the next day to make a different salad and it also tasted great!  Made for 123 Hits!

Love, love, loved this!  My kids loved it too, so I'll be making it again.  The only thing I did different was I used splenda instead of brown sugar because I had run out of brown sugar and it was still wonderful!  Thanks for a keeper!
Loved it, loved it, loved it.  Loved the smell of curry while it was cooking, loved the taste as I ate almost the whole thing for my dinner!  Made for ZWT4 Curry Challenge.

If you're a tomato soup fan, this is your soup!  I converted this recipe for preparation in a crockpot, and did not saute any of the vegetables.  I simply put every ingredient (except for the olive oil) in the crockpot.  In hindsight, I do wish I had chopped the tomatoes finer.  I felt a little unsure of the minimal seasoning, so I added a teaspoon of Spike Seasoning.  I then covered it and cooked on low for 6 hours.  I was afraid I should have reduced the amount of liquid, but it was fine!  I will be doing this again come colder weather.  Made for the Daffy Daffodills of ZWT4 for Canadian Crockpot Cooking Challenge.

Warning - for chocolate lovers only, as this is insanely rich!  Very easy to prepare.  I served it on the warm side with some Haagen Das vanilla ice cream, and made sure I added the walnuts.  Thanks for posting this!

I made this exactly as directed (although I did not puree any of it), and it was a departure from the typical black bean soup.  It is very well-spiced, but I think I need to play with the seasonings a bit more.  I felt the ground cloves overwhelmed some of the other spices, so I would want to make some adjustments next time.  But there definitely will be a next time!

I'll be jumping on the bandwagon too!  Super easy and super tasty.  However, I could not grill it as we were having inclement weather so I broiled it instead.  I would definitely like to try this on the grill, though.

The directions for this were perfect!  I must admit, I was a little fearful of so much bacon, so I cut it back to 6 slices.  Also, before I put the skillet in the oven, I sprinkled about 1 cup of shredded cheddar over the top.  The frittata was super fluffy, super easy, and super delicious.  Thanks for another keeper, Lori Mama!

This blew me away!  I never thought I would find a Scampi recipe that I liked as much as my own, but I may have to reevaluate my opinion.  I made this exactly as written, including the breadcrumbs.  I think my personal recipe will go into retirement for awhile!  And, by the way, it is super easy.

This is a simple, flavorful soup.  I had leftover rotisserie chicken, which worked perfectly in this recipe.  I followed everything exactly as written, and will definitely be making this soup agian.  Thanks, Kim.

I haven't made bread in a long time, but this recipe tempted me to do so again.  And I'm so glad I did.  The directions were perfect, and the results were also.  Thanks, Shelby Jo, for a winning recipe.  Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders Tag Game.

This was a nice change of pace and very flavorful.  The hardest thing for me to find was the white wine worcestershire sauce.  After going to 4 different stores, I had to settle on Lea & Perrin's White Wine Chicken Marinade instead.  I do not have a mini slow cooker, so I combined the ingredients in a small casserole and baked at 350 for about 20 minutes.  It was browned, bubbling, creamy and delicious.  Made for I Recommend Tag Game.

This was easy to make and very tasty.  However, the butter mixture did not really penetrate the bread that well, so I think that, next time, I will bake it for a while before running it under the broiler.  But I will be making it again!  Made for All New Zaar Cookbooks Tag.

This was exactly what I had been craving ever since I saw a Food Network show featuring Moules Frites (I made the frites as well).  It was simple and easy to prepare, but the flavor was anything but ordinary.  An excellent meal!  Thanks for posting, FT.  Made for Newest Zaar Tag Game.
Wow, this was yummy and rich!  You would hardly realize that there is alcohol in it (which can be a dangerous thing)!  Made for Went to the Market Tag Game.
I have never been a limoncello fan, so this was a pleasant surprise.  I finally found a way that I can enjoy it!  Thanks for posting, diner!  Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders Tag Game.
Sooooooooo refreshing, and love the lemon!  Will be enjoying this too much, I'm afraid!  Made for October Beverage Tag.

This was really very enjoyable.  I love dill, and this definitely highlighted it.  The only thing I did differently was to mix the dressing ingredients in the bottom of a large bowl first, then added all the other ingredients and folded it together.  It definitely needs time to chill in the fridge to meld all those wonderful flavors.  This one is a keeper.  Made for My 3 Chefs.
This was delicious, and very quick.  I used cheese tortellini, and then made the recipe exactly as written.  I will be enjoying this again!  Made for Potluck Tag Game.
Well, I love butterscotch schnapps, so this was right up my alley!  I will be enjoying this regularly!

Fantastic!!  My grandfather always had roasted chickpeas as a snack, and this brought back many childhood memories.  The previous reviews were very helpful too.  I would say it took about 1 hour, and I did add some olive oil.  Thanks for posting this one.  Made for Football Tag Week #12.

I was a little uncertain about this because of the orange juice and orange zest, but it was fabulous!!!  I used 9 small red potatoes (because they were on the smallish side), and only chopped the red onion, rather than julienned.  Everything else is exactly as written.  This is very unique and elegant, and even provided me with a delicious lunch to pack.  Thanks so much for posting this one!! Made for Newest Zaar Tag Game.
All I can do is agree with the previous reviews.  These were so unique, so easy, and so tasty!  I also will be making them again!  Made for Potluck Tag Game.

This was delightful, and very easy to make.  It was nice to serve something other than the standard hot dips we have all become accustomed to.  I will definitely be making this again!  Made for Potluck Tag Game.

This were really tasty and easy to put together.  Unfortunately, I had to cook them in the broiler, as my outdoor grill was sitting under a mound of snow, but I can't wait to try these on the grill once warmer weather is upon us.  Thanks for posting.  Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders Tag Game.
Wow!  Incredible!  I did not know I was in for such a treat.  Thanks so much for posting this one - it will be enjoyed frequently.  Made for Newest Zaar Tag Game.

These were delicious with a nice, fluffy texture.  I also appreciated the hints on how to reduce the servings, because I made it for 7 servings, and it made a LOT of batter.  I will definitely make these again!  Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders Tag Game.

I really enjoyed these scones, and they were very easy to make.  I also really liked the fact that they were cooked whole in a pan and then cut after cooling, as opposed to rolling and patting triangles.  The cakey texture was wonderful and was not as dry as your typical scone.  I will be making this again!  Thanks for posting.
Simple and delicious, and tastes like you took a lot more time than you did!  Rather than two small dishes, I made this in one large dish for a nice presentation.  I will be making this again!

I made this exactly as posted, except I used 1 lb. of chicken tenders.  This was quick and easy and made for a flavorful meal without the guilt.  I served it with steamed zucchini and brown rice for a lovely satisfying meal.  Thanks for posting!  Made for PRMR Tag Game.

First of all, let me say that I do not really like rum, but I was intrigued to try this, and I'm glad I did.  It was delicious, and I have finally found a way to enjoy rum!  Made for Please Review My Recipe Tag Game.

This was light and lovely.  I used butter instead of margarine.  Unfortunately, I could not find cream of broccoli soup mix anywhere, so I used a can of Cream of Broccoli soup.  The texture was great and the flavor was rich.  I will be making this one again!  Made for PRMR Tag Game.

These were so moist, even after baking them for 27 minutes.  There is just the right amount of peanut butter, which really goes great with the chocolate.  I will definitely be making these again.  Made for Potluck Tag Game.
Very tasty and simple!  I made eggs over easy also, and it was a lovely combination.  Made for Potluck Tag Game.

Delightful!  I made this exactly as posted, except I got a late start, and ended up cooking it on High for 4 hours, added the carrots and cooked for another hour.  I was a little light on the salt, and next time I will add a more generous amount, because it really enhanced the flavor.  I served this with brown & wild rice and sauteed Swiss chard.  Thanks for posting!  Made for Please Review My Recipe Tag Game.

I didn't know what to expect from reading the previous reviews, so I did prepare them in a skillet.  I thought there was enough flavor, as well.  I seem to enjoy garlic with my shrimp, though, and was missing that flavor.  Will probably add some next time.  Made for Potluck Tag Game.

This was fabulous, and so easy, too!  I made it exactly as posted, except I did not add the pine nuts.  Wonderful, creamy texture.  With so many strong-flavored ingredients, I didn't know what to expect, but it blended together deliciously!  Made for Zaar Chef Alphabet Soup Game.
Fantastic appetizer!  It is different from the usual fare, and is simple yet delicious!  I will be serving these again.  They are so easy to put together!  Made for Potluck Tag Game.

This was really tasty!  I used olive oil instead of the canola, and I bought a 16-oz. container of fresh, chopped clams, which I used instead of the canned.  I also used 16 oz. of ziti, and there was plenty of sauce for it.  Great dinner!  Made for Potluck Tag Game.

This is a great salad dressing, and the ingredient for the salad are simple but perfect to bring out the flavors of the dressing.  As previously stated, the 8 hours marinating is the key!  You will not be disappointed.  Made for Please Review My Recipe Tag Game.

Really very nice, and the texture was great too (nice and velvety).  I made this the night before serving, and I think that helps in letting the flavors develop.  I will certainly make this again!  Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders Tag Game.
This couldn't be easier and was a nice change of pace from the typical pasta salad.  The baby spinach is a nice addition.  Super quick, too!

Another winner, Baby Kato!  I served the hot version of this recipe, but did not add the strawberry preserves.  It was wonderful without it!  I am looking forward to tasting it after it has been refrigerated for a "cold" version.  This is one of the best rice pudding recipes I have tried.  Thanks for posting!
Fantastic cake.  I made it exactly as posting, using vegetable oil.  I will be making this again!  Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders Tag Game.

I concur wholeheartedly with the previous 5-star reviews!  I love leeks (which go great with potatoes) but I really was indifferent to butternut squash.  Well, not anymore!  These three ingredients marry so well!  I will be serving this on my Easter dinner table this year.  It is a great holiday presentation and is truly delicious!  Made for Please Review My Recipe Tag Game.
Another winner, Baby Kato!  I made this exactly as written, and it was divine.  Perfect with a cup of coffee (or tea).  It was quite easy, too!  I will be enjoying this again.

I made this exactly as posted, except I only had plain protein powder, so I added some vanilla extract for sweetness.  I used fresh blueberries, as well.  I am not a big breakfast person during the week, but I know how important it is, so I felt like I was really doing something good for myself.  It is also nice and quick, and pretty tasty.

I was in smoker oyster heaven (one of my favorite treats)!  I couldn't find onion cream cheese, so had to use chive cream cheese instead.  Also, I prefer water crackers, so used them.  Overall, everything went beautifully with the oysters, and I will be making this often!  Thanks so much for this great, yet simple, idea.

This was really easy and tasty and came out nice and moist.  While the top was nice and crispy, I found the bottoms to be a little soggy, and I wish perhaps I had turned them over to avoid this.  I used nice, thick breasts, which took the full 40 minutes to bake.  I also think some nice gravy would add the right touch, and will definitely make some to go along with this next time.  Thanks, Lainey.

This is really tasty, with plenty of sauce for your noodles, which is always nice.  I did not use top sirloin, but used 1 lb. of sirloin tips, which I cut into cubes rather than sliced thinly.  They came out very tender and flavorful.  I truly enjoyed this and will be making this again.  Thanks for posting, Ingrid!  Made for Please Review My Recipe Tag Game.

This was delicious, just the right balance of tart and sweet.  The batter mixed up beautifully, but I started to panic when it seemed it would overflow the 9x5x3-inch pan! It did puff up a lot while baking, and some did spill over.  It ended up taking 70 minutes to bake, and I ended up with a GIANT loaf.  I was not complaining after tasting it, though, and I will be making this again.  Thanks for posting this lovely delight, Mel!  Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders Tag Game.
Simple, easy, and delicious!  What more can you ask for?  I will be making this again.  Made for Please Review My Recipe Tag Game.

This was really very nice, and easy to put together.  I could not find chorizo, however, and had to substitute linguica.  Also, I had extra leeks in the house, so I used them in place of the onion.  The sherry really is a nice touch.  I will be making this recipe again.  Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders.

These were really tasty, and so simple to make.  The aroma is delightful too!  I also used Montreal seasoning, and made everything as directed.  The combination of the sweet and savory brought these over the top, and I will be making this again.  Thanks for posting this recipe.  Made for Please Review My Recipe Tag Game.

I LOVE broccoli rabe and this was a wonderful, quick recipe that had a perfect balance of flavors.  I could have eaten the whole things myself!!!  The lemon juice was a really nice touch.  Made for Please Review My Recipe Tag Game.

This was delightful and very easy.  I could not find the crab/shrimp combo, so I had to use a can each of the crab and shrimp.  I also sauteed the onion in some canola oil first (rather than use the spray - I guess I should be more calorie-conscious).  I did not find this chowder too thin, but I could easily use a spoon!  I will be making this again.  Made for Please Review My Recipe Tag Game.

The garlic butter is definitely a nice accompaniment to the sirloin steak.  I made exactly as posted and thought it was pretty tasty.  However, the garlic butter did not really penetrate the steak as I would have liked.  I almost wonder how this would turn out if you brushed the garlic butter on the meat before grilling.  Thanks for posting.  Made for Please Review My Recipe Tag Game.
Delicious is the key word here!  Everyone who tasted this soup loved it, and it was so easy to make.  I will be making this again, I am sure, by popular request.  Made for ZWT 5.
Fantastic (and it does go great with eggs)!  I used red-skin potatoes, but steamed them in the microwave first to soften.  I will be making this often.  Thanks for posting.  Made for ZWT5.
As Mia #3 suggested, I also added garlic.  I marinated chicken wings in this sauce for a little while, then grilled them.  Delicious!  I will be enjoying this again!  Made for ZWT5.
Delicious!  I love olives, and I had never thought of this combination before, but I will be thinking of it often.  Thanks for posting this winner.  Made for ZWT5.
OMG - I loved this!  I made it exactly as written, except I could not find the sun-dried tomato paste, so just used regular.  I will be making this again!  Made for Please Review My Recipe Tag Game.
This is a fantastic salmon recipe.  It is simple and quick, and comes out tasting restaurant-quality.  I will be making this again.  Made for ZWT5.

Wow.  First of all, I love Manchego cheese.  I had never had serrano ham before, and all the ingredients went so well together.  I will be making this again and again and again (when I can afford it)!  Made for ZWT5.

This was absolutely delightful!  I have been only cooking corn in the oven now, and this steps it up a notch, with the flavorful butter coating the corn.  Will be making this again and again and again!  Made for ZWT5.
This was simple and delicious.  I will definitely be making this again in the near future.  Thanks for posting.  Made for ZWT5.

This was a nice, moist roast chicken.  However, with the amount of cayenne, I thought it would have a little zip, but I didn't notice any.  The skin was crisp and tasty, but the seasoned butter did not really penetrate the skin.  I would like to try this again, but use the butter mixture directly on meat, underneath the skin.  Thanks for posting this.  Made for ZWT5 by a Groovy GastroGnome.

This was a simple, tasty meal.  I used 4 large skinless chicken breasts (which were about 1.75 lbs).  When I went to stir it halfway through, I noticed things seemed to be a bit dry, so I added the white wine at this time (without cornstarch).  I checked it after 3 hours and it was well cooked.  I did not need to add the cornstarch, as the sauce was thick enough.  It smelled absolutely wonderful, and I really liked the combination of tarragon and thyme.  Thanks for posting this.  Made for the Groovy GastroGnomes for ZWT5.
This was simple and fast, yet really flavorful!  I sliced my zucchini in quarters, which were absolutely delicious.  I will be making this again.  Made for the Groovy GastroGnomes for ZWT5.

Magnifique!  I diced the potatoes, so I did not precook them at all, and they came out wonderful!  I served them alongside Recipe #373168 for a lovely Sunday dinner.  Thanks for posting this.  I will be making this again.  Made for ZWT5 by a Groovy GastroGnome.

I made this exactly as posted, but I have to say the sauce seemed to me to be a little thin.  The cognac and Dijon mustard seemed to cancel each other out, but it still was a very nice cream sauce that I will play with some more.  Thanks for posting this.  Made for the Groovy GastroGnomes for ZWT5.
You can't beat this for simple!  Everyone enjoyed this tremendously, and it really hits the spot.  The chocolate wafer crust is a nice change of pace.  Made for ZWT5 by a Groovy GastroGnome.
Another great grilled corn recipe with a great kick!  I made it exactly as written, and was thrilled.  Made for ZWT5 by a Groovy GastroGnome.

This was super easy and super tasty - and a great way to use up my leftover roast chicken.  I never thought to use French onion dip in a recipe before, and it really gives it a nice lift.  I will be making this again.  Made for ZWT5 by a Groovy GastroGnome.

This was pretty easy and fast to put together, given the long list of ingredients.  However, I found that is was not quite as flavorful as I would have liked.  Maybe it is just a simple matter of adding salt and pepper to taste.  I will definitely try this again, though.  Made for ZWT5 by a Groovy GastroGnome.

Wow!!  I'm so glad I decided to participate in this Salsa challenge, or I never would have tasted this.  After reading the previous reviews, I left out the sugar (to lessen the sweetness) and gave the slightest pinch of the optional spices, which I think I will forgo next time.  Wonderful, wonderful flavor and spice.  I will be making this again (and it's easy too).  Made for Salsa Challenge Part 2 by a Groovy GastroGnome for ZWT5.

Another recipe that is simple, easy and delicious!  I have a feeling I will be enjoying this all summer (my grilling season).  I made as directed using half oil and half butter and also the garlic powder.  Made for ZWT5 Zingo Picks by a Groovy GastroGnome.

This deserves 5 stars just for ease, but it happens to be delicious too!  While it is spicy, it is something that everyone seems to enjoy (hot or cold).  I will be making this often.  Made for ZWT5 Zingo Picks by a Groovy GastroGnome.

Super easy and delicious!  I used real crabmeat and also subbed Old Bay Seasoning for the seasoning salt.  Otherwise, I made as directed, serving with cracked black pepper water crackers.  Divine!  I will be making this again.  Made for ZWT5 Potluck Zingo by a Groovy GastroGnome.

Five stars for the butter (because that is what this recipe is all about)!  I made double the amount of butter, and am glad I did, because it is safely in my freezer waiting for the next steak, or hamburger, or baked potato, or corn on the cob, or whatever suits my fancy.  Mind you, I am NOT a blue cheese fan, but loved it in this recipe.  I agree that that steak itself could use some seasoning, but the butter is divine!  Thanks for posting this delightful recipe.  Made for ZWT5 by a Groovy GastroGnome.

Delish!!  I made exactly as posted, using flat-iron steaks.  I am disappointed that my flambe did not seem to flame as long as everybody else's, but the end result was superb.  This made a LOT of mustard sauce, which was great the next day eaten cold with leftover steak.  Thanks for posting this winner!  Made for ZWT5 by a Groovy GastroGnome from one Jackie to another!

This was a nice, new way to make potatoes.  I made them on the grill, and they did take about 15 minutes to cook.  They complemented our steak nicely and the onions really make the difference.  Thanks for posting this.  Made for Potluck Tag Game.
I halved the recipe, and found this really delicious.  We had some for breakfast and then later on in the evening I reheated it with leftover meat loaf.  I will be making this again!

I had some lovely Black Mission figs and couldn't wait to try this!  I have never used agave nectar before and didn't realize quite how sweet it is.  I made the recipe exactly as posted and would have to see that it was a tad too sweet for me.  It is a lovely combination, though, so next time I will just use less agave nectar.  Thanks for posting this!  Made for Please Review My Recipe Tag game.

Absolutely delicious (and easy, to boot!)  I made everything exactly as written, except I substituted tilapia for the catfish, which is also a mild-flavored fish.  I will be dining on this many times.  Even the non-fish lovers enjoyed this!  thanks for posting.  Made for Please Review My Recipe Tag Game.

Wow - this definitely was incredible!  It was so easy to put together, too.  I used no-bake lasagna noodles, which really sped things up.  I actually used only half the amount of chicken and diced it (because I just can't get the hang of shredding it) and only used a total of about 2 cups of cheddar cheese.  However, it was definitely phenomenal, and I know I will have many requests to make this again.  Thanks for posting this winner!  Made for Please Review My Recipe Tag Game.

I can't say how much I love this!  It was so tasty and easy to put together.  The naan really makes a thin, crispy crust and all the other ingredients combine so beautifully.  Best of all, I felt positively virtuous eating this, with no guilt at all!  I will be enjoying this often.  Thanks for posting this.  Made of Everyday's a Holiday  Tag Game.

Really very tasty wings, and definitely a departure from the usual.  I did manage to find a mustard-based barbecue sauce (Whole Food's 365 Texas Barbecue Sauce), which was something I have never had before.  The sauce is very sweet, which balances the spiciness of the wings.  I actually had 24 wings, which I put in a bowl after grilling and poured the sauce over.  There was plenty of sauce to go around.  Thanks for posting this.  Made for Please Review My Recipe Tag Game.

This couldn't be faster or tastier - a combination that I am a big fan of.  I also decreased the olive oil and added an extra tomato.  Thanks so much for posting this keeper!  Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders Tag Game.

Yummy!  I made this exactly as written except I used fresh strawberries instead of frozen and I added some plain iced green jasmine tea to thin it a little.  I ended up with a delicious, creamy breakfast drink.  Thanks for posting this one!  Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders Tag Game.

Really very tasty.  Believe it or not, I have never made chicken in the crockpot before, and was delighted with how moist and tender it came out.  The tenders just fell apart while cooking and distributed evenly throughout the dish when the cheddar and pasta were added.  I used mini farfalle (bow tie) and it was perfect.  Perhaps next time, though, I might want to add some mushrooms (they are a favorite).  Thanks for posting this one!

Delicious!  I used 1 lb. of 16/20-count shrimp and made exactly as posted.  The only change I made was to add a pinch of cayenne.  This really took seconds to make and ended up being the "turf" part of our "Surf and Turf" dinner.  I loved the sherry flavor, which was more pronounced than the garlic (for a change).  I will be making this again.  Thanks for posting.  Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders Tag Game.

These sandwiches were scrumptious!  The "special sauce" was really enhanced by the sour cream, and balanced the sauerkraut nicely.  I made this exactly as posted (with no variations) and will be making them this way again.  Thanks for posting this keeper, my fellow Gnome!
This was delicious and so easy.  I made exactly as written, except this made one giant smoothie for  my boyfriend's breakfast-on-the-go.  Thanks for posting this.  Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders.

Nice, tasty dish that is very versatile.  Rather than use it as a salsa, I mixed some with some mini-bowtie pasta and packed it for my lunch.  It was a nice, change of pace and very healthy.  Thanks for posting this.  Made for Please Review My Recipe Tag Game.

I had been dying to try this, and I was not disappointed!  I made this exactly as written, except I used grape tomatoes, halved, instead of cherry tomatoes, quartered.  This made an incredible, satisfying lunch.  The bacon and avocado go great together.  I used mini-farfalle, which is what I had on hand, and it worked out just fine.  I will be enjoying this recipe frequently.  Thanks for posting this winner!  Made for Everyday's a Holiday Tag Game.

I have never seen this at a Mexican restaurant, so I can't testify as to how close it is to the real deal.  My end result also was a bit on the thin side.  However, the taste is wonderful so, whatever you care to do with it is up to you, but you will love it.  Made for Everyday's A Holiday Tag Game.

No - this is not just another steak sandwich (thank goodness)!  It is delightful!  I used baby portobello  mushrooms and followed the rest of the recipe exactly (although I didn't have Sweet Russian mustard).  I did use the creamed horseradish, though.  The mushrooms and onions were so tasty!  I will be making this again.  Thanks for posting this.  Made for Newest Zaar Tag Game.

This was divine!  It was easy to throw together in the blender.  The first time I served it, I made it early in the day for a late dinner.  It was lovely.  However, I did have leftover dressing the next night, and it was even better.  I served this over a grilled romaine salad, and it complemented it perfectly.  I will be making this often.  Thanks for posting this.  Made for Everyday's a Holiday Tag Game.

Delightful!  I also skipped the overnight step (simply because I forgot to do it the night before), but did let the pan sit in the refrigerator for about 1 hour, then waited 30 minutes before baking.  I did not use any sugar on top, because we don't like things too sweet, and it was perfect for us.  It took exactly 30 minutes to bake, my blueberries did not sink and, overall, it was a great success.  I will try it again, though, using the overnight method.  Thanks for posting this.

I couldn't resist trying this because the fresh blueberries really intrigued me.  What a winning combination, and who ever would have thought to do this before?  They are really delicious and can actually trick you into thinking you are eating something good for you!  Made for Everyday's a Holiday Tag Game.

What a fantastic combination of flavors.  This really was a tropical delight.  I also did not use the water, but I did substitute iced green tea instead.  I will be making this often.  Made for Everyday's a Holiday Tag Game.

Fabulous!  The flavors all came together wonderfully, with great results.  My guests absolutely raved over this, and I will be making this recipe again.  Thanks for sharing this.  Made for Adopt a Tag 2009.

I couldn't believe that you could get a breakfast sandwich together so quickly!  I happen to like my eggs cooked well, so I needed to microwave the second time for 40 seconds.  I wished the muffin had been toasted, though, so next time I might try doing that first.  If you need breakfast in a hurry, though, this is the go-to recipe.  Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders Tag Game.
All I can say is ... yummy!  This was really delicious and easy to make.  Thanks so much for posting this, because we will be having this a LOT!  Made for Newest Zaar Tag Game.

I was a little confused by the directions, so I sort of winged it.  After the sausages had browned for about 10 minutes, I added the onion, garlic and 1 tablespoon of oil.  I let them cook for a few minutes while I cut the peppers in strips, then added them, and cooked everything together for about another 20 minutes or so.  At the last minute, I added about 1 cup of marinara sauce and warmed that through.  It was really tasty and made wonderful sandwiches on rolls.  I will make this again.  Thanks for posting!  Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders Tag Game.

This was absolutely delicious, yet so simple!  The seasoning was just perfect (although I added some black pepper), and the crust came out lovely.  We have enjoyed this warm for dinner, and brought cold slices for lunch, which was also excellent.  I can see why this would be a family favorite, because it is now one of our favorites.  Thanks for posting this.  Made for Please Review My Recipe Tag Game.

This was fantastic, much to my delight, because I was a little bit unsure.  I used chicken breast sliced for stir-fry, I ended up getting some wonderful Thai basil from a local Thai market, and I had chilies from a plant my son just gave me that he bought at a Thai restaurant.  I did miscalculate on the chilies, and ended up with about only 1 heaping tablespoon finely chopped but it was more than spicy - it did clear my sinuses!  I had never used fish sauce before (and hated the smell of it), but it worked in just fine.  There was indeed a lot of sauce, so make a lot of rice (I used basmati).  I can't say enough how delicious this was, and I will be making this again.  Even though I have had Thai Basil Chicken in restaurants many times before, the coconut milk really added a unique aspect that I will want again.  Thanks for posting this.  Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders Tag Game.

I, too, used sliced Swiss cheese (just because I couldn't find shredded).  I was hesitant about the celery seed, as well, since I don't really ever use it, but it was a delicious dressing.  Very simple to make too, and makes a very nice lunch that is not run-of-the-mill.  Made for Everyday's A Holiday Tag Game.

This was a great technique.  I used both the salt and the vinegar.  I only had to cover the skillet for about 30 seconds.  Then I cooked the eggs for about 3-1/2 minutes (because I like the yoke well-done).  It was still a tiny bit wet, but that's okay.  Thanks for posting this easy-to-follow technique.  Made for Everyday is a Holiday Tag Game.

This is great, and really very versatile.  I made the recipe exactly as written, using whole wheat tortellini.  Then, I added about 1 cup of diced grilled chicken to make this a main dish.  It was creamy and delicious.  But it is even great served cold, believe it or not!  I took some to work for my lunch, and didn't reheat it.  It was great.  So, this can be a side dish, a dinner, or a lunch!  Thanks for sharing this recipe!  Made for Everyday is a Holiday Tag Game.
