Great snack food to keep around! Thanks for sharing!
Great! I used cooking spray to make it more calorie friendly, and sprinkled lime juice/coarse sea salt over them before baking to make them like Chipotle's chips. I served with Recipe #193688

DH LOVED this one! Thank you! :) I used whole wheat pasta, lean ground beef, and 1 1/2 cups of low fat mozzarella cheese. I left out the mushrooms but otherwise followed exactly! It's a keeper - thanks so much for sharing!

WOW this is good! Let me start by saying I HATE plain milk, always have. I can't stomach it. I always have to have chocolate or strawberry flavor in it to even manage it, and the occassion I do that is rare. I am, however, pregnant and trying to get lots of calcium for my little one so decided to try this. This makes it bearable and honestly is less sugar than chocolate milk as well as made with more natural ingredients - I love it! Thanks for sharing.
Yummy breakfast! I used smart balance butter and reduced fat peanut butter. Nice and different!
Perfect! I used whole wheat penne pasta and followed the rest exactly. Tasted absolutely fabulous and this recipe is a keeper!

YUM! This is absolutely terrific! I didn't have any bananas, so I used banana cream pie yogurt in place of the plain yogurt. I also scaled this down to 1 and for me it was the PERFECT size, filled my smoothie glass right up to the top leaving none left in the blender. I loved the light accent of the orange juice - a change on my normal yogurt & milk smoothie! Thanks so much for sharing this - I will make it a lot this summer! :)

Oh wow, this is good! :) I used the Oscar Meyer Real Bacon Pieces package... and only about a 2/3 of that package (so about 3 ounces of bacon). I used a little less scallions too. I served it on those thin bagel crisps... this would be great for company! Going in my Zaar Stars book -- thanks for sharing!
Great burger! We just bought a new grill and tried out these burgers first on it. Perfecto - very yummy! :) Thanks for sharing.
Very yummy! I used low fat cheese and omitted the onion/cilantro. It was fantastic and SO filling! Thanks for sharing!
Absolutely fabulous! :) made as listed except used lowfat cheese and mrs dash for the seasoning. So yummy and great for a quick protein boost! Thx for sharing.
Yummy lunch! I used cayenne pepper instead of chiles and didn't use bacon. Still great stuff and will make again!

LOVE this idea! I used reduced fat cheese and light miracle whip to make a little bit healthier. I agree with some of the other reviewers -- it needs some spice, next time might try some onion powder or green onions for a little more zip. I am putting these in the freezer for an after school snack for this hungry teacher! ;) Thanks for sharing -- will be fun to create my own variations of this recipe, too!
Super easy, and super yummy! I used low-fat ingredients and it worked great! Thanks for sharing!

This was yummy! I followed exactly, using light alfredo sauce and low-fat cheese. It had such great flavor - different too! I think next time I will use less sauce... it got a little messy! BUT GOOD! Thanks for sharing!

My {almost} 2 year old giggled and shouted "ELMO!!" when I put these in front of him. :) He also loved the taste.... he really loved  Elmo's "eyes" - (the olives) -- so much more I had to give Elmo a few extra eyes. ;) Thanks so much for sharing such a cute idea!!!

Easy, yummy, healthy -- my kind of dish! I made it even easier by prepping everything the night before and tossing it in a freezer bag. Threw it in the crockpot this morning and dinner was ready when I walked in from work! DH, DS, and I all loved it. I also used already frozen peppers to make it even easier. ;) We served it with Recipe #167975 and Recipe #121031 for a full on mexican fiesta! Thanks so much for sharing -- it's a keeper!
Pretty yummy stuff! My husband LOVED it, and my son & I thought it was pretty good. :) Can't go wrong with Pioneer Woman. I used Recipe #392356  to cook the bacon.
Easy, perfect recipe! Thanks for sharing. :)

These are absolutely the best sandwiches ever! I had them at a church potluck and couldn't wait to make them for our family. Only changes I made were to not mix the mustard with the butter; but to put a dot inside each sandwich. I also omitted the poppy seeds/dried onion and we didn't miss it. Next time, I think I will cut the amount of butter in half as we won't miss the extra. Thanks for sharing the recipe!

These were pretty darn good!  I changed a few things.  1/2 whole wheat flour, fat free yogurt, EVOO rather than vegetable oil and a little extra orange zest.  Amazingly enough, we all said that we'd double the orange zest.  I used frozen organic blueberries that just so happened to be HUGE, so the flavor in these just popped out!  Nice!!!

Thanks so much for a great recipe that will be a repeat here for sure!  I'm looking forward to warming one up for a snack tomorrow!

Great chicken!!!  I used boneless skinless chicken breasts and it probably sat in the marinade for about 6 hours.  There was an excess of marinade, so next time, I'm going to use 1/2 of the marinade on the chicken and put some veggies in 1/2 of it.

Thanks, Redsie, for yet another great recipe!

What a terrfic dinner!  I have made this a couple of times and forgot to rate it before sorry.  To feel that a recipe is healthy, it has to have the majority, if not all, of it's calories and fat from food that is beneficial.  So many cabbage recipes have too much added sugar, white rice, etc, so I am a big fan of this one!  I do use the sugar in it, since it's such a small amount and it really does make the difference in whether it tastes "tinny".

I use 1 lb Laura's 4% fat ground beef and I serve brown rice to the less calorie restricted as well as putting some shredded cheddar that they can add if they choose.

Thanks for the recipe...it will be used frequently!

I made the pudding with skim milk and left off the mini choc. chips because I didn't have any.  My son was licking his bowl clean and he's been thumbing his nose at a lot of desserts lately.  Thanks for a sweet treat to wow my little monster!

Amazing, amazing, amazing!  Oh, this was the best!  This is now going to replace my much more complicated tried and true pleaser!  Oh, I bow to you, Caroline...

I used some mega large potatoes, but hey, go for it!  Less onion for my son, no sour cream for my family, Hormel bacon pieces and mixed 1/2 of them right into the creamy soup.  I mashed most at the end, leaving about 5 chunks per bowl.  We used to devour soup at Bennigan's and this is the closest and MUCH healthier!  Could add more white veggies in but I don't think I'll tamper w/ it.  Unusual for me.  

My son said, "Mommy, you should be a chef in a 10 star resturant" and it spurred a very enjoyable conversation about what "our resturant" would serve, who would work in which jobs, and much much more with animated facial expressions and hands.  :D  

Thank you from the bottom of our filled up tummies!

A refreshing salad which could be a dessert also.  The flavors blend well and are not too sweet.  This recipe would go well with any menu.  We enjoyed it and will have it again.  Prepared while a participant in the Aus/NZ Swap #14, March 2008.
Excellent flavor to relax with!  Good recipe for a Pina Colada!  Prepared for 2008 Aus/NZ Swap #21 Event.
EXCELLENT flavor for an iced coffee.  Make a large amount because you'll want more!  Prepared for the Jan 2009 Comfort Cafe Event.

Excellent flavor!  We enjoyed these carrots with fried pork chops and broccoli.  "Just right" seasonings for these carrots and they help to make a colorful food plate!  Prepared as a participant in the Aus/NZ Swap #25 February 2009 Event.
EXCELLENT!  It makes a lot of "gravy" for the rice.  I cooked it in my crock pot with much success.  I only put a very small amount of onion. Buggsy thanks for sharing this recipe!

Wonderful flavored eggs!  I enjoyed having the orange zest in the eggs.  Next time I think I'll add more zest and maybe some herbs.  Thanks for this recipe, Tisme!  Prepared as a participant in the April 2009 Aus/NZ Swap #27 Event.

My favorite way of making potato salad!  The bit of onion really gives it  great flavor.  I added 1 teaspoon of mustard for sharpness.  Great recipe and will be preparing again!  Prepared as a participant in the May 2009 Aus/NZ Swap #28 event.

Wonderful flavor and a great side dish with any entree!  DH and I both love carrots.  I substituted butter for the olive oil.  Easy preparation!  Prepared as a participant in the Aus/NZ Swap #29 Event June 2009.

WONDERFULLY FLAVORED!  A bread which goes well with any entree.  Easy preparation.  I used an Artisan French Baquette and sliced into large pieces which was DH's preferences.  The garlic and parmesan flavor was very much enjoyed! The smell of it being toasted was great!

VERY GOOD!  This is a nice breakfast item....you get your egg, fruit and bread!  I am a big lover of raisin toast and this one was great!  Prepared as a participant in the 8th Edition of Make My Recipe Event.

A wonderful recipe for breakfast or snack.  I added a small scoop of ice cream and a sprinkle of cinnamon.  Easy preparation and a delight to eat!  Prepared as a participant in the Aug 2009 Ramadan Tag Game Event.

EXCELLENT Flavor!  I often crave iced coffee and this one hits the spot!  Great beverage to enjoy and relax with after a long day.  Quick and easy preparation!  Prepared as a participant in the Sept 2009 New Kids on the Block Tag Game.

YUM!  A great beverage to relax with on a lazy afternoon!  Strawberries and bananas always go well together and this drink was full of flavor.  I added a small amount of Splenda (1 teaspoon) to add sweetness.  A thick and delicious smoothie!  Try it!  Prepared as a participant in the September 2009 1-2-3 Star Hits Tag Event.

DELICIOUS! and easy preparation.  I decide to make my apples for a dessert snack.  I added white raisins and topped the apples with a small bit of ice cream.  Boy! was this good!  I did use Splenda brown sugar to cut down on calories (personal preference). This is a great recipe and I want to thank you HokiesLady.  Prepared as a participant in the September 2009 Gimme5 Tag Game Event.
EXCELLENT flavor!  We enjoyed these cucumbers with our dinner tonight.  A great side dish which will go with any entree.  Prepared as a participant in the Aus/NZ Swap #33, October, 2009

A very delightful drink!  I used the microwave which speeded up the preparation.  A good glob of cool whip out of a squirt can just made the topping right!  Made as a participant in the 2009 Aus/NZ Xmas Make My Recipe Event.

This is a good one meal dish to have for dinner.  i added a can of petite tomatoes and an extra can of beans.  My family has always been fond of chili and this disappeared quickly.  Prepared as a participant in the December 2009 Partying the Diabetic Way Event.

This recipe had all the ingredients that I dearly love!  Very tasty indeed!  I used brown sugar Splenda and left the peel on the apple.  Prepared as a participant in the February 2010 Heart Healthy Tag in the Diabetic Forum.

We in the South gotta have our iced tea!  Happynana this was just delicious!  This makes the right fit anytime of the day!  Prepared as a participant in the Feb 2010 Afternoon Tea & Light Suppers Event and also in the Aus/NZ Swap #37.

Absolutely delicious!  I added a sprinkle of cinnamon, but the real ingredient which sent it to the top is the orange zest.  A nice combination of fruits that is very tasty!  Will have again and again.  Prepared as a participant in the Make My Recipe 10th Edition February 2010.
Good Bread!  I added a bit of mozzeralla cheese and parsley to the top.  Had with spaghetti dinner.  Prepared as a participant in the 2010 Zaar Cookbook Tag March 2010.

YUM!  A good combo...peanut butter and chocolate!  A great beverage to relax with and to satisfy the craving of chocolate!  I vote for this one!  Prepared as a participant in the Aus/NZ Swap #39 April 2010.
Yummy!  A good bread to have with any meal!  Full of flavor and enjoyable!  Prepared as a participant in the Aus/NZ Swap #40 Event in May 2010.

Family inhaled this meal before I could photo it.  I'm guessing I should cook when no one is home so that I can.

VERY flavorful! No guilt at all, served with a mixture of steamed veggies. YUMMMMM!  The marinade not only gave it a wonderful taste but made the chicken tender.  Was able to cut it with a fork!!! Excellent recipe.  Made for PAC 09.

I made this last night after using a recipe in a book I found.  I was going to post it here but glad to find it was alrerady posted.

The book didn't state that the chipotle's should not be in the Abodo Sauce in the cans so mine came out super spicy.  (First time using the abodo sauce) I'm very tolerant to spicy but this was even too much for me.  I had to put the meat in a strainer press out the sauce and run some water over it to take the edge off.

Other than that minor detail missing in the book, this was perfect.  I now know from the recipe here to find one without the Abodo sauce or to just use fresh.  I made everything eactly as written and I was not disapointed.  This is a keeper.  Thanks for posting here. :-)

This is raspberry tea heaven! I did have to change it a little to suit my tastes though.  I used 3 quarts of water, 1 cup sugar (not big on the sweet in my tea....next time I'm thinking half a cup would do, half of a 12 ounce bag of frozen raspberries when brewing,12 raspberry zinger tea bags by Celestial Seasonings as I didn't have any earl grey or regular tea, plus it was decaf so I could enjoy it at night, and 5 packets of True Lemon (crystalized lemons.......I fresh produce like lemons don't do well in my fridge as I tend to forget I have them.)  I like my tea to have a strong flavor and this was nailed right on the head with my slight modifications.  When the tea was made I used the rest of the frozen berries as "garnish" and to help make it cold with the ice.  It would have been very pretty looking for guests.  This is a keeper, awesome post!

I want to give this more stars but I had issues with the recipe.  I followed the directions to a "T" used the same amount of ingredients listed EXCEPT for the cheese as we didn't have any.  I was concerned with the lack of liquid in this dish as it didn't seem like there would be enough.  As it cooked the juices from the chicken gave it a little more in the begining.  Then towards the end I guess the rice soaked up the majority of it. When I lifted the lid from my crockpot what I saw was a big mushy mess.  I had crossed my fingers and hoped that the rice would be ok, but it was grainy and hard (uncooked) in some places and in others just flat out mush almost like a stuffing but in rice form.  The chicken was very mosit and tender, it fell apart easily with a fork.  The taste of the chicken was wonderful, after reading the reviews I was worried about the saltyness of it as I don't care for salty foods but this was fine.  I will try this again and nix the rice in the crockpot perhaps make it in the rice cooker instead.  Also will add maybe a can more of the mushroom soup along with extra milk and add some fresh mushrooms as that would have been a nice touch.  Can always pour the soup part it over the rice after everything has cooked.  Good starting point, thanks for the recipe.

Being that I didn't have very many veggies to choose from in our house (our fault not yours), it was lacking in the veggie department, BUT with the spices it was quite AMAZING!  We had this served over some brown rice.  I will have to make this again with some broccoli, califlower, mushrooms, carrots, and celery I'm thinking......and perhaps a bit more curry with perhaps some pepper.  I will be making this again, that's for sure!!!!!!!!

Absolutly grand!

yummo, really smooth after dinner drink, loved it!

I'd never heard of putting peanut butter in porridge before so this combo intrigued me. It was a little strange upon first mouthful but I soon got used to the taste and quite liked it. I mixed my jam into the porridge, I think without that sweetness mixed in I wouldn't have liked it as much. Thanks for posting!

I cheated a bit with this & used some canned potatoes tossed in the mixture. I ten baked them in the oven with some butter & oil tossing to coat & then throughout cooking a few times. the flavours in this are very subtle but really nice. A great side to go with our steak dinner. Thanks for posting!

My 4 "girls" always ensure I have fresh free range eggs so am always looking for different ways to use them, this was like no recipe I'd seen before so decided to give it a try. I scaled it down to serve just one for my brekky on toast. This was nice & easy to prepare and tasted great, perfect for a cold morning in Autumn. Thanks for posting!
This was really nice, the lime juice really cuts the sweetness of the drink. Very tropical, this was lovely over ice.

This was really tasty but I found this simply too sweet for my tastes and I'm usually a real sweet tooth. I ended up adding some soda water to dilute it a little. If I make again I will omit the sugar & increase the lemon. Thanks for posting!
This is really tasty, I must admit I did cut the syrups down to half which was plenty sweet for me. I used cinnamon-walnut syrup & caramel topping for a tasty & decadent coffee treat.

These were really nice, the flavour was really subtle but good. Once cooked I sprinkled with a bit of sea salt & extra parmesan, these went well with our steak sandwich dinner. Thanks for posting! Made for ZWT 4

These were fabulous. I usually use balsamic in my caramelized onions but the red wine vinegar works nicely too. I served with mayo, tomato chutney and some baby spinach leaves with a side of fries. Super tasty, we loved it.

I liked these but the flavour wasn't as intense as I was expecting. I used tomato paste but the flavour of it didn't shine through in the finished product.  The parsley was a nice touch. If I make these again, I might try the catsup instead.

I wanted a salad for lunch & had all of these ingredients on hand so put it together. I didn't serve it in pita, just by itself and also added some capsicum & red onion but left out the olives, used just a dollop of olive oil to moisten. This was a lovely flavourful lunch. I ate mine straight away as I was starving but I think this would be even better if the flavours were left to meld together for a smidge. Lovely salad, made for ZWT 4. Thanks Pneuma!
This was okay for my tastes. I can't really say I've ever had ginger beer before but purchased some for mixers. This was nice but quite dry I prefer a sweeter drink but thanks for posting!

Had all the ingredients on hand so made this breakfast except used dried basil, it's winter here & too cold for fresh basil. I used 2 eggs instead of substitute. This is a lovely light brekky, great when you don't want something too heavy. Made for ZWT 4.
So simple & so tasty, I only had vanilla vodka so used that but it worked well. Made for ZWT 4.
I needed some cream of mushroom soup for a recipe I wanted to do but got to the pantry  to find I had none, thank goodness for this recipe, thanks for posting!
What a delightfully different breakfast. I used some infused olive oil spray instead of garlic on the rolls & used a mix of parmesan & mozzarella, very tasty & enjoyable. Made for ZWT 4.
I really enjoyed this as a side to our main pizza, I scaled it down & spread on just plain bread, cut into sticks, the flavours go together really well. Made for ZWT 4.
Lovely easy & yummy brekky on a Sunday morning. I scaled it down to serve one & topped with sliced bananas and maple syrup, made for ZWT 4.

This is a regular brekky for me, this morning I served with vanilla yoghurt & boysenberries, no sweetener. This is a simple & delicious brekky full of grains so keeps you going until lunch, yum!
Made for ZWT 4.

I did this in my rice cooker so just threw everything in and used vegie stock. This was nice but the flavour is really mild & I would have liked it a bit more intense, I would probably add a little more garlic and use chicken stock for more flavour if I was to make this again. Made for ZWT 4.

I took the idea of this & ran with it to make a non alcoholic coffe treat. I used irish cream & chocolate flavoured coffee syrups and added some coconut milk powder for the hint of coconut. All combined to make a delicous coffee this afternoon. Made for ZWT 4.

Made this for toddler DD with what I had on hand so used some orange juice, a bit of coconut powder & also added some vanilla yoghurt. Little Miss DD enjoyed very much, I thought it was good too. Made for ZWT 4.

I cheated a bit with this & used some canned carrots and poured the dressing on them after cooking. I also added a little butter to the honey-lemon which I think was a nice touch. A lovely simple way to jazz up carrots! Made for ZWT 4.

I scaled this down to serve 2 and used allspice in lieu of cinnamon for the African spice it up challenge. I used slivered almonds and just a tiny splash of orange blossom water. Very interesting flavours. I wasn't sure whether I liked it after the first mouthful but as my tastebuds adjusted I ate the whole serving myself for lunch, lovely to try something different. made for ZWT 4.
Oh yeah, warming & comforting on a cold winter's day, great smooth tasting flavours in this one. made for ZWT 4.

I really enjoyed my cauli & broccoli this way, I used dijonnaise & sour cream and as suggested by some other reviewers doubled the sauce, really simple to do and full of flavour, I'm sure to make this often. made for ZWT 4.
I really enoyed this one, it was sweet but not too sweet and quite tropical tasting. The pineapple cranberry combo mellow out the potency of the vodka nicely. Made for ZWT 4.
Yummy dessert shake, how can you go wrong with Amarula & ice-cream? Both DH & I enjoyed this. Made for ZWT 4.

I did these for dinner so made large meatballs using a home-made ranch mix as we don't have dry ranch here. These were really nice, the sauce was sweet & savoury at the same time and hubby enjoyed these as well. I especially love the idea of roasting the meatballs first so they don't break when simmered in the sauce. made for ZWT 4 - Zingo.
How can you go wrong with these ingredients, lovely fresh flavours & a healthy snack too, just loved it. Made for ZWT 4 - Zingo.
A lovely different way to make lemonade, I have a generous lemon tree through winter so used lemons and some leftover condensed milk I had for a lovely treat. made for ZWT 4.

Yummo, this is simple but so very tasty, the Italian herbs along with the parmesan really give the eggs a nice punchy flavour. I used some shredded ham I had leftover instead of bacon served on toast for a most enjoyable breakfast. Thanks for posting!
I need my caffeine so I used regular coffee and about 1/2 tblsp cadbury cocoa instead of Swiss Miss. The flavours here are very subtle but lovely, not overpoweringly sweet just smooth & tasty!
I love how simple this is and so tasty with only a few ingredients, also great as it can be prepared ahead of time & put in the oven later. Great recipe I'm sure we'll make again. Thanks Iewe!
A lolely tasty lunch, I served on oregano bread rather than muffins and used bacon, I love the tang of the mayo with the bacon. Thanks Lainey!

Yummo, toddler DD downed this record time, I had to sneak a taste in before I gave it to her knowing that she wouldn't share this once she'd tried it. I didn't have chocolate yoghurt on hand so used vanilla with a small scoop of chocolate ice-cream left in the bottom of the tub, I also snuck in some baby spinach leaves merely for extra nutrition. Thanks Lainey!

A lovely simple side dish, I cheated & did this in the rice cooker with grated carrot & zucchini and even toddler DD ate some so great way to sneak a serve of vegies into the kids. Thanks for posting!

A lovely simple salad with the mild flavour of sumac, I made this hoping that I might get toddler DD to eat her salad with the red "sprinkles", sadly it didn't work but all the more for mummy! Thanks for posting!
Yummo, I made this for a light dinner & DH's comment was he could eat it every night so 5 stars from me. Left out the avocodo & used ranch dressing. Made for ANZ Swap August 2008

I love lemonade & I love pineapple so this is a match made in heaven. I used tap water rather than seltzer water as I wanted to keep it for a few days and didn't want it to go flat in the fridge. I made a half serve but found that it needed a lot more water than was called for, from a half serve of juices & syrups I ended up getting about 1.5 litres of lemonade so I think I ended up adding about 4 cups water for a half serve which was still lovely & sweet but not syrupy sweet. Great recipe & one I'm sure I will make again. Thanks Annacia!
I just made the salad & sprinkled with feta, lovely & simple to make and a great healthy weekday lunch, thanks!
A lovely simple way to do spuds, mine took a little longer than 15 mins, approx 18 mins but great flavour & great result, thanks!
Yummo, devoured by toddler DD in a matter of seconds, lucky I snuck a taste first, a keeper, thanks!
A lovely simple brekky to put together, both toddler DD & I enjoyed this. Thanks!
A lovely one to sip on on a Friday afternoon after a hectic week. This is sweet & smooth & sure to please, yummo!
What a lovely simple drink, great for if you have a little red leftover after cooking, I added a smidge more orange juice & relaxed in the tub with this , thanks Boomie!
Sweet & tropical, I knew I'd love this, this one I will definitely make again, thanks Mama!

I made this for toddler DD & I and it was a lovely change from plain porridge, nutty & chocolatey, great combo. I left out the protein powder though & used a little Splenda for a bit of sweetness..Thanks JB!

I made this using canned corn so I didn't have to wait for it to thaw. This is a lovely salad that went great with our BBQ dinner, the leftovers I had the next day over salad greens, I tasted it before I put the dressing on & I think I preferred it naked though!! Thanks JB!

I love how simple this is, dinner was ready in no time. I did add some finely shredded vegies to the couscous which I fried off a little before adding to it just for extra vegie content. The 2 ingredient sauce is fab, thanks for posting!

I enjoyed this but I too found the ginger flavour really subtle & when I got to the bottom of my cup realised why, the minced ginger was sitting on the bottom of the cup even though I made as directed & really stirred it in, it didn't melt into the drink as I would have liked, still tasty stuff though, thanks BK!
Yummo, fabulous flavour in this drink, I loved it, perfect for a hot day when you don't want alcohol, thanks Syd!

I really loved this easy to make salad & thought the dressing was divine..I didn't have any sprouts so left them out but otherwise made as directed. I think some spring onions or green onions would also be a nice addition to this. Thanks for posting!

When I todle hubby this was for dinner he was rapt,  alovely simple to put together dinner on a rushed weeknight, I used rye bread & also added a smidge tomato chutney on each, great sandwich, thanks!
Very mild & lovely refreshing drink, the alcohol is only a small amount so not too overpowering & the lime & cranberry go well together. Thanks for posting!

This was lovely on top of hamburgers & I think a lot depends on the type of beer you use, the onions really absorb it well. I would have liked it a little sweeter but it was still a lovely side, thanks Noo!

I went to make this & then realised at the last minute, almost all my butterscotch chips were gone so used about 1/3 cup butterscotch & the rest cinnamon chips that were given to me in a swap, this tastes absolutely wonderful and also keeps very well, was still good to eat up to a week after baking as long as kept in a cool place & in an airtight container. Thanks Syd!
To cut the fat I made this with just milk rather than cream. Still really tasty & great to unwind on a Friday afternoon. I know it would have been divine with the cream!
This was a really nice moist meatloaf, I loved the smokiness the BBQ sauce & salsa gave it. I served with mashed potatoes & tomato chutney. Thanks Syd!

What a lovely simple dish to make. I did this to sewrve 2 but still used a whole can tomatoes. I only realised I only had a half packet onion soup mix left so that's all I used & I didn't add the sugar. The flavour was very subtle so I'd like to try again with the full pkt soup but the chicken was lovely & moist & there was plenty of sauce!

Fabulous, I always have a tonne of lemons during Spring/Summer and this is a lovely way to use some up and get a good kick of antioxidants from the kiwi at the same time. I used Splenda in place of sugar & also added a bit more water as it was still quite sweet for me. Lovely drink, thanks JB!

These were great, hubby & I both enjoyed them. I used some leftover mountain bread as tortillas & used sour cream in the sauce as I had it to use up, served with mexican beand and a big salad, this was a delicious dinner. Thanks for posting!
A lovely way to enjoy my morning coffee, the mint makes it lovely & warming. Thanks Boomette!
A lovely simple brekky that tied me over until lunch no problem. LOve the idea of using marmalade to sweeten rather than sugar. Thanks Brooke!

After seeing Tastetester's photo, I just had to make this. I made for my toddler's playgroup & the kids loved dipping their fruit in it. We don't have cool whip here so I used a Danish powdered whipped cream mix with the marshmallow spread and cream cheese, was just lovely!
Rather than frying I just broiled mine & used vintage cheese and dijonnaise for the condiment and also added some baby spinach leaves, so tasty, a fab sandwich!
What a lovely simple side to do..the broccoli still had a nice crispness & the balsamic on it was wonderful. Thanks!

Yummo, I made this for my dinner, but no mushies, yuck, I used red onion, snipped chives & also topped with some crumbled cottage cheese that I had to use up along with some pesto croutons. This was fabulous, I'm still lickimg my lips!

This was a great way to use up the little bit of peanut butter in the jar. I used the jar and just added everything else & gave it a good shake. We used this to top some honey pancakes with banana for brekky. A hit with toddler DD & me. Thanks!

I loved this salad, the crunch from the nuts and the creaminess from the cheese go so well together with the cumin dressing. I don't really like mint but added it anyway & found that mixed with the other spices it's hardly detectable. Great recipe, thanks Boomie!
This was a lovely change from the usual potato based tuna patties, I left the butter out & didn't miss it at all. Even toddler DD ate hers all up even the sauce. Thanks for a great kid-friendly meal!
A lovely refreshing drink on a warm day, very much enjoyed, thanks!
I did a half batch for toddler DD but it made enough for both me & her. This was a lovely combo & toddler DD downed it in no time. Great for those who can't have dairy too! Thanks Syd!
This was lovely for something a bit different, just like a noodle coleslaw, the heat from the chilli & the crunch from the nuts is a lovely combo. Thanks for posting!
I did a serving for 2 but left out the oats. Little Miss DD downed this in no time, thanks for posting!
Loved it. I scaled it down to serve one & used some french onion cream cheese I had in the fridge, topped with fresh chives & served on wheat toast for a most enjoyable brekky. Thanks!
Thsi was a lovely filling brekky that I most enjoyed. I halved the amount of maple and served to toddlerr DD too, she wasn't too keen so all the more for mum..:lol:
A nice combo, smooth tasting & quite strong, I enjoyed it. Thanks Mama!
Yummo, I did a half serve & used about 1 tblsp pudding mix. Toddler DD downed it with hardly a breath. Thanks Lainey!

I did this as s moothie for toddler DD. I tasted it & quite liked the nutty flavour but not so for miss DD. I had to add some juice to dampen the nutty flavour for her but then she drank it happily. This is an interesting way to enjoy Tahini, thanks Syd!
A really nice way to jazz up some humble canned tuna, great flavours here, this was much enjoyed, thankyou!
This is a great fun recipe for kids. I made these for toddler DD, she wasn't too keen on them by themselves but spread with some cheese, she gobbled them up no problem. Thanks for posting!
Really lovely flavours, caramel & hazelnut complement each other really well. Thanks for sharing!

These were really nice. I did the micture the night before to let the oats soften a little. The mixture was a bit thick & heavy the next morning so I added some more milk to thin it out a bit. My "girls" have been a little slack so I had to use egg substitute but it worked well. Little Miss DD & I enjoyed these with jam for a lovely filling brekky. Thanks!

I'm not really a whiskey drinker but I have it in the bar so decided to give this a go, this is a really nice drink and the "additives" really mellow out the whiskey taste, was most enjoyed, thankyou!

I kept forgetting to buy tortillas so did this on bread instead. Both toddler DD & I enjoyed this for a special lunch. The coconut wasn't all that detectable though so I would probably add more for my tastes next time. Thanks for posting this yummy high protein & potassium treat.
I've always loved cabbage with bacon & with the cream added really makes this something special. A terridfic side that was most enjoyed, thankyou!

These are really tasty burgers and a great way to use up excess zucchini. Rather than top with tzatiki, I topped with honey mustard mayo and salad for a delicious Friday night dinner. Thanks Bluemoon!

I love my coffee & my dark chocolate so this was a lovely treat. I used Lindt dark chocolate & left out the almond. I did find that this wasn't quite sweet enough for me as I like a sweet coffee so I added a touch of Splenda to round out the flavours...thanks Sharon!
What a great healthy brekky, instead of flaxsseed oil I added some ground flaxseed to the mix and this was enjoyed by both toddler DD & myself!
I made this one for toddler DD but she couldn't get past the "grainy" texture & wouldn't drink it so it ended up all mine....very tasty & filling snack, thanks for posting!

This was a lovely simple dish to put together. I did it for brekky & served with vanilla yoghurt & granola. I'm sure I will make this often.
Thanks for posting!
Made this for toddler DD & she downed it in about 30 secs. I used vanilla yoghurt & only a smidge honey, lovely smoothie, thanks Syd!
A lovely filling brekky with that lovely hinto of vanilla, I topped with parline pecans & vanilla yoghurt, thanks CD!

Toddler DD loved this "special brekky". I cheated a little & used nutella & peanut butter together & topped with strawberry syrup instead of the jam mixture. A lovely treat on a special occasion. Thanks Boomie!
I loved these sweet & tasty carrots, the sauce is delish! I made these as a way of trying to get toddler DD to eat her carrots, pleased to say it worked..Thanks for posting!

I've made this twice now. I only had a self saucing pudding mix so used a bit from each sachet, the first time we had it plain & the second with mashed banana added too. Toddler DD enjoyed it both ways, thanks Boomie!
I'm not a big tequila lover but the other ingredients help to disguise the flavour a little. Nice one for a Friday night, thanks Mami!

I did a small batch of this for brekky using some hot cross buns I had leftover in the freezer from Easter. Smell gorgeous in the oven and was a lovely breakfast treat served with vanilla yoghurt. Thanks for posting!

I loved this one, I've never had malibu & coke so I loved the flavour of the coconut with coke zero. I must admit I really couldn't detect the other flavours much, the malibu was most dominant but I loved this nonetheless & will make again. Thanks Boomie!
Fabulous, this is dreamy, so smooth & a great one to wind down with on a chilly autumn evening, thanks for posting!

Loved this simple to do side. I don't usually eat mushrooms but ate all mine up in this. I used Sake in place of rice wine and kecap manis as I was out of soy, mine was probably a little sweeter due to the ingredient substitutions but worked well with this dish served alongside some chicken skewers & rice. Thanks Pneuma!

I had all the ingredients for this so made is as a simple Saturday night dinner. I only did 1 egg which was plenty for me and I also added some chopped green onions I had leftover to the rice. This was a great use of leftovers and made for a tasty dinner which was put together in no time. Thanks for posting!
I love winding down with a "spiked" coffee on a Friday afternoon and this made for a lovely treat. I also added a little milk and topped with whipped cream to serve, was delicious!

This made for a fairly guilt free brekky, other than the fact that I topped with golden syrup...:lol: This was easy to make and I loved the corn-flake crunch coating, alovely spin on Fench toast. Thanks Syd!
This was an interesting way to serve eggs, very spicy but I liked it alongside my sourdough rye, always nice to try something new, thanks Noo!

I made these for a playgroup morning tea & they were a hit. I used chocolate honey & the honey flavouyr is just nice, nice too overpowering. I used all white self-raising flour (I'd run out of wholemeal) and left out the baking powder, served with just a little butter, these were a hit with both mums & toddlers, thanks for posting!

This made for a lovely simple brekky served alongside some vanilla yoghurt. I used some hazelmeal I had on hand with the oats and used the microwave for most of the heating which made it simple to make! Thanks Pat!

5 stars for simplicity even if I did change it up a bit. I did mine more stir-fry style & added some mushrooms and capsicum with the onion & carrots. I also added some chopped chicken I had to use and hokkien noodles in lieu spaghetti. Beacuse of all the extra ingredients I doubled the sauce but added some extra water to thin it out a bit. This is a great simple dish to put together and easily adaptable to what you have on hand. Thanks for posting!
This was a nice change from oats and a new way of serving bulgur for me. Much enjoyed, thankyou!
This was a nice hearty soup but I did find that I missed the meat. I think that with some bacon added this would be perfect. Thanks Deb!

What a lovely simple side, I used about 3 tblsp pesto (the rest of my jar) and I found it plenty, even toddler DD ate this, served alongside some bacon feta stuffed chicken breasts for a lovely dinner. Thanks for posting!

A lovely simple side, I love tomatoes when they are soft but still hold their shape, made for a nice accompaniment to our steak dinner.
Thanks!
Yummo, this so reminds me of the drinks my husband & I sipped on in Vanuatu on our honeymoon, much enjoyed, thanks for posting!
Simple & delicious, my kind of dinner, this is great as it used minimal ingredients but packs a great flavour punch, would be great to serve company too. Thanks for posting!

5 stars because it finally got toddler DD to eat rice, a lovely simple side to do, went well with our chicken casserole. I used flavoured cream cheese instead of boursin and left out the mint. Thanks Boomie!

What a great combo, this is really tasty. For me this was sweet enough so I didn't add any sweetener but I did sprinkle with some cinnamon to serve. Thanks WRC, this will be going on regular brekky rotation!
I loved this, the bread choice & yoghurt combine to make a nice sweet bread without having to add extra sugar or use any spreads. Made a lovely brekky, thankyou!

A nice change from hot chocolate. I made one for 4 yr old DD using 1 tsp of each sugar & extract which was plenty sweet enough for her & one for me using a bit more of each. This is a lovely before bed drink that was much enjoyed by both myself & DD. Thanks for posting!
What a lovely simple way to jazz up some fish fillets, this went over well with both hubby & I. Thanks for posting!

We don't have jiffy mix here but I received some from a swap partner so used it for this. I loved the meat base of the pie but found that the jiffy mix was really hard to spread evenly on top and when it should have been cooked there were a few places where the jiffy mix was still a little gooey. This is a great idea but I think I would have preferred a pastry top..loved the meat mix though. Thanks for posting!
Yum, I used a very ripe banana & ovaltine for the chocolate but not quite the full amount. Toddler DD & I both devoured it! Thanks Pat!

Loved these..I scaled it back for 2 dogs but still used a whole egg so my mixture was a little runny..if I had more hot dogs and did a half mix I'm sure it would have been fine.. I even cooked up the leftover batter into fritters and it was good!!!
I loved this simple to do coffee, the cream mellows out the molasses making a smooth tasting but robust blend. Thanks!
This was a lovely simple meal to put together and tasted great, I would have liked more sauce though so would double that if I make again. Thanks Boomie!

Yum, I loved these. I had quite a few of the ingredients needed in the frisge to use up but did a make a few subs. I used dried cherries in place of cranberries, yoghurt in place of sour cream &  Splenda in place of sugar. My substitutions did not seem to affect the outcome of these delicious little treats. Thanks for posting!

What a lovely simple dish! Tasty too. Just wasn't sure about the texture of the chicken once cooked..I think I may have preferred a meatier chicken cut like a thigh as the breast was a bit too "shreddy" for my liking. Thanks for posting!
A great sugar mix to have in the cupboard..I used it for porridge and also sprinkled on some muffins I made the other day, gives a nice hint of something special.
Yum! I made this for 4 yr old DD who gulped it down with no hesitation, a lovely combo, perfect for an afternoon snack!
This was a nice variation on fruit salad..I also added grapes and an orange to mine and served with vanilla yoghurt & granola for brekky. Thanks for posting!
I loved the sound of this but I found them a little bland too, always good to try something new though so thanks for posting!

Loved these, the banana flavour is really evident which is nice... I used whole wheat SR flour and Splenda in lieu of sugar...served with cream cheese...4 yr old DD and I both enjoyed them. Thanks Syd!
Yum! I cheated a little & used some Berenberg Caramelised Onion in a jar with a lovely vintage cheese and fresh chives from the garden..so simple but oh so delicious!!

I made a 1/3 recipe using some honeycomb ice-cream I had that was a bit crystallised and no good for eating on it's own. This is lovely & simple..and easily made from fridge & pantry staples...my kind of recipe..Thanks for posting!
This was easy to make and I loved the corn-flake crunch coating, a lovely spin on French toast. Topped with golden syrup..mmmm! Thanks for posting!

Yum, this is very tasty but very sweet..I used less than the sugar called for but still found it too sweet for me so stretched it out and added more milk...similar to abuelita but with a hint of orange. Thanks for posting!

What a lovely simple dinner side, just throw everything in the pot and let it go to work. I used brown rice so had to use a bit more water and cook for longer but this is definitely much nicer than plain old rice. Thanks for posting!
I'm a bit of a coconut freak so knew I'd love this..the coffee creamer adds a creamy dimension to this smooth tasting coffee drink. Thanks for posting!

I made this for miss 4 year old DD using 1 tsp alpen blend hot chocolate mix and leaving out the sugar. I also added 1tsp of LSA (ground linseed, sunflower seeds and almonds) to add extra nutrition and cooked in milk rather than water for a creamier consistency. Miss DD gobbled it up and asked for another bowl so a 5 star winner for me. Thanks for posting!

I always make my porridge with milk for a creamier consistency..on this occasion  I made apple cinnamon flavour with pink lady apples that are in season here at the moment and Splenda in place of sugar. The perfect breakfast for a cold winter morning here in the hills. Thanks Sharon!
This was a lovely drink, for me I would have liked it a little sweeter..for my tastes a dash of lemonade added & this would be perfect..but still very much enjoyed. Thanks for posting!

This made for a nice filling brekky, I also added the berries during cooking...I would have liked this a little sweeter so would add a smidge Splenda if I made it again..served with yoghurt..it was much enjoyed. Thanks!
Yum, the pumpkin in this spice mix was delicious..I would have liked if the pumpkin had a bit more crispness to it..mine was quite mushy when cooked, but nevertheless this was tasty!

I scaled this down to serve one and added about 1/8 tsp cayenne...I loved the zing from the pepper..this would be hard to even detect if you didn't know it was there...a lovely decadent coffee drink. Thanks for posting!

What a lovely simple brekky, alsmost sweet tasting from the tomatoes. I used just a smidge of butter in a non-stick pan, basil as the herb and served with wholemeal toast for a satisfying breakfast. Thanks for posting!

Oh yeah, this is my kind of drink, sweet and coconutty. This combo is delicious...I used the last of the lime juice in my bottle which was about 1 tblsp (1/2 oz) and it was just perfect for me. Thanks for posting!

I cut this by 1/3 but found that 1 egg wasn't quite enough to cover my 2 pieces bread so my second piece was less eggy and more crispy from the syrup mixture on the bottom of the pan...I have to say I actually liked the 2nd piece better...it had a sweet crunchy coating that was divine..to up the orange flavour based on other reviewers I also added some orange extract. Very much enjoyed this decadent brekky. Thanks for posting!

I was surprised by these, the batter I thought was quite thick so was expecting a dense pancake but they were lovely & light. I used a flavoured yoghurt and so no toppings were needed, were good as is. Thanks for posting!
This was nice but a bit too sweet for my tastes, something different for sure!
This was really yummy..the texture is almost cake-like..very much enjoyed this lovely treat, thanks for posting!

Made for a lovely brekky with some wholegrain toast..I used an Australian mustard and the last of my ranch dressing mixed with a little cream to make up the full amount. These were very tasty and much enjoyed. thanks for posting!

I thought this was okay, the consistency was more pudding like as the texture is very spongey..my 4 year old was amazed by this and we shared it with some cream on top..I don't know that I'd make it again but it was good to try. Thanks for posting!

I'm sorry Jubes but like one other reviewer I also found these a bit bland tasting..made as directed but I would have like the flavour to pop a bit more..maybe a stronger tasting cheese or garlic would be a nice addition. Always nice to try something new though so thanks for posting!
This made for a tasty brekky, served with some vanilla yoghurt, very nice, was much enjoyed, thanks!
Delicious, lovely rich & creamy flavour, was even a hit with little miss 5 yr old DD, a keeper, thanks for posting!
Really nice spuds and creamy without all the fat, the whole family enjoyed them, thanks for posting!
Yum, easily made with pantry staples and tastes delicious. Was a hit with the whole family, thanks for posting!
Thanks for a lovely simple side dish, tasted great and I think even a splash of wine would be great in this too, thanks for posting!
Very simple & decadent, 5 year old DD was in heaven for her brekky this morning. Thanks for posting!
This was awesome...a hit with the whole family, really tasty, one to make again for sure. Thanks for posting!

This is probably 1 of 3 or 4 hot cocoas I've made, & IT IS DEFINITELY ONE OF THE BEST! I'm a big fan of dark chocolate, so this recipe was a great find! With only one exception, I pretty much followed the recipe on this ~ I did, however, make only half a recipe & included just 1 teaspoon of the chili sauce! Although these were made several weeks ago, I totally forgot to post the review! Fortunately I keep notes while making recipes so I can refresh my memory about it! [Tagged, made & reviewed in Please Review My Recipe]

[Tagged, made & reviewed in Zaar Chef Alphabet Soup Game]

Made just as indicated (using the canned beans & corn) & had A WONDERFUL SALAS that will be made again & again over the summer! Thanks for sharing a great, easy-to-make recipe! [Tagged made & reviewed in Please Review My Recipe]

VERY, VERY NICE! Yet another quick way to prepare a great vegetable ~ We really enjoyed the garlic & basil combo here! Thanks for sharing a nice keeper recipe! [Tagged, made & reviewed for one of my groupmates in the Aus/NZ Recipe Swap #27]

Followed the recipe pretty closely but did use lemon pepper instead of the usual S&P, & also used a Vadalia onion, all for a VERY, VERY TASTY SALMON DINNER! ABSOLUTELY WONDERFUL TASTE TO THESE COOKIES! I was going to send some off to work with my other half, but they are so addictive that by the time Monday morning came around most of them were gone! I actually doubled this recipe, since I was making these as finger food & using the caramel sauce as a dip ~ OUTSTANDING! I couldn'd find Pink Ladies so used Honeycrisp apples! This is a very nice twist to the usual grilled cheese! I used rye bread & followed the recipe for A GREAT SANDWICH TREAT! Would also like to try this with a hearty wheat bread! {Tagged, made & reviewed in Everyday Is a Holiday!]

AN ABSOLUTELY GREAT SPREAD! We really enjoyed the use of molasses in this keeper of a recipe, & I now have it in my gifts for the holidays cookbook! Many thanks! [Taggd, made & reviewed in 1-2-3 Hit Wonders]

VERY, VERY NICE BREAKFAST, & definitely a tasty change of pace for early morning! I did use a homemade applesauce that was slightly sweetened but then cut back by half on the honey! Thanks, much, for sharing the recipe! [Tagged, made & reviewed for one of my Vegetarian partners in the Vegetarian/Vegan Recipe Swap 7]

Tripling the recipe, I made these the other day for a monthly group I host, & they were all happily pleased! Definitely a fun recipe to make, for adults as well as kids! Thanks for sharing! [Tagged made & reviewed for one of my Raw Food partners in the Vegetarian/Vegan Recipe Swap 10]

Here's another recipe in which I cut back on the use of chilies, this time using just one, but otherwise following the recipe! A recipe definitely worth keeping, & I plan to make these for one of the monthly groups I host (in another 10 days)! [Tagged, made & reviewed while in Spain with the ZWT5]

Although I followed the recipe, I made sure that the lemon I used was LARGE ~ Love those lemons! Loved these magdalenas, too, & will be keeping this recipe around for awhile! Thanks, much, for posting it! [Tagged, made & reviewed while touring Spain with ZWT5]

I chose this recipe are a match to the book, With Love From Spain, Melanie Martin, when ~ one the Zaar World Tour 5 ~ I accepted the Spain Challenge #3, A Storybook Meal! Very, very nice chicken! Really enjoyed the use of the saffron & rosemary, & I'll certainly be keeping this recipe around! [Tagged, made & reviewed while in Sprin during the ZWT5]

Would never have made these for myself, but when we had several latino friends over, that was another matter! We managed to cut it down by half, & I still had enough to serve to one of the monthly groups I host ~ & for some unknown reason, EVERYONE RAVED ABOUT THESE! [Tagged, made & reviewed while visiting Mexico during the ZWT5]

Made this for breakfast for 4 of us the other day & made a couple of minor (I thought) changes ~ I used 1/4 lb of the chorizo sausage AND 1/4 lb of a spicy Italian sausage, & then, added some of the smoked paprika that a friend of mine encouraged me to use! We all loved the combo of meats AS WELL AS the veggies in this dish, & all agree you deserve 5 stars for ONE GREAT DISH! [Tagged, made & reviewed while touring Spain with ZWT5]

We had company over the long weekend here & I had a ball playing around with a 'Mexico' theme in the kitchen! Thanks for sharing the recipe! [Tagged, made & reviewed while in Mexico with the ZWT5]

I'm a big yam fan & always enjoy trying new recipes with it as an ingredient ~ Particularly appreciated the combo of yam/orange/pineapple here! The only thing I changed here was in NOT peeling the yams (LOVE THOSE PEELS!) ~ It might not be as NICE looking when finished, but it yams are tasty that way! Thanks for posting a really great recipe! [Tagged, made & reviewed in 1-2-3 Hit Wonders]

I have great fun making breads, & this one was PURE JOY ~ Very simple (almost rustic), & especially nice with a homemade strawberry jam I had on hand! Thanks for a great, simple, keeper of a recipe! [Tagged, made & reviewed while in the Caribbean with ZWT5]

Made this with just a few small changes ~ I made this with 4 pounds of boneless, skinless chicken breasts (cut into bite-size pieces) & used almost 3/4 cup of fresh orange juice along with all the zest (minced) from 1 large orange (I LOVE the taste)! That all made for A VERY NICE TASTING chicken dish! [Tagged, made & reviewed for the All Aboard! French Challenge during ZWT5]

I followed your lead with the herbs & included the optional ones, resulting in an ABSOLUTELY GREAT OMELET BREAKFAST! Would definitely make this one again! Thanks for sharing it! [Tagged, made & reviewed while touring France with ZWT5]

Lainey, this is A REALLY, REALLY GREAT SMOOTHIE, even if I did leave out the crushed ice ~ The frozen bananas gave the drink enough of a chill, & the combo of pudding & banana was wonderful! A DEFINITE KEEPER! [Tagged, made & reviewed in Zaar Stars Tag]

Although I think the chicken broth would be very nice in this recipe, I switched to a homemade veggie one instead since I was making this for a couple of vegetarians at the dinner table! VERY, VERY TASTY with the barley & the recipe is a great keeper! Thanks! [Tagged, made & reviewed in Every Day Is a Holiday!]

Made this for my morning meal & it was nice ~ Nothing fancy, but very satisfying for breakfast, especially when dressed a little with a nice salsa! Being not-much-of-a-drinker, I decided to make this without the rum, but everything else came together very well ~ Oh, yeah, I also left out the ice, but did use 2 frozen bananas & uped the coconut milk to 6 ounces! Although I did leave out the ice, I had to double the rest of the ingredients to get a couple of large drinks for the 2 of us ~ Just 1 cup doesn't do it for either of us! We both enjoyed the lemon/strawberry combo here! [Tagged, made & reviewed for the ZINGO part of ZWT5]

Vine-riped or not, the veggies I used in preparing this gazpacho made for A GREAT TASTING TREAT! [Tagged, made & reviewed in the Zingo part of ZWT5]

When making this recipe I decided to stick with the 'creamy' part of it so did peel the sweet potatoes, but another time I'd like to try it WITH skins, & dicing the cooked potatoes very small! [Tagged, made & reviewed in the FAMILY PICKS part of ZWT5]

I don't do many pot roasts but this recipe might well have changed my attitute there ~ THIS IS A WONDERFULLY TASTY ROAST, & I look forward to making it for company! I went vegetarian with this recipe & used vegetable instead of chicken broth, but other than that I included everything as indicated & had a very satisfying dinner & even get a keeper of a recipe, too! Many thanks! [Tagged, made & reviewed during the ZINGO part of ZWT5]

Was in the process of cleaning & freezing a big batch of fresh strawberries so used some of those for this recipe instead of some I still had frozen ~ THIS IS A REALLY GREAT, REFRESHING SALAD, what with the combo of fruits used! We REALLY LOVED THIS CHICKEN ~ Great taste all around even though I did leave out the mushrooms! Particularly enjoyed the Dijon & tarragon sauce! Thanks for a really great keeper of a recipe! [Tagged, made & reviewed in Please Review My Recipe]

ABSOLUTELY OUTSTANDING, DEFINITELY! I made the big muffins & they lasted no time at all! With one exception I followed the recipe ~ I used a very generous cup of fresh blueberries! Thank you so much for this WONDERFUL BREAKFAST TREAT! [Tagged, made & reviewed in Zaar Stars tag]

I made your soft pretzels a year ago, & when I tagged this recipe, I knew I'd be making those again to go with this one! OUTSTANDING DIP, & as before, I loved your pretzels! Very much a keeper recipe here! [Tagged, made & reviewed in Please Review My Recipe]

How wonderful it is to get something like this with so little effort ~ OUTSTANDING! Made it as directed, though I just might have used a generous measure of the zest! DEFINITELY A KEEPER ~ Thanks for sharing it! [Tagged, made & reviewed in Zaar Stars tag]

I did a bit of juggling (Read that as changes!) here, but there were only 2 of us, & still we had 2 meals from this! Couldn't have been better, we thought ~ Thanks for posting! [Tagged, made & reviewed in 1-2-3 Hit Wonders tag]

I'm not big on tofu, but will admit that it really worked in this drink! Of course, it helps that this chocoholic loves his strawberries! It's also a great drink recipe to pass on to my vegetarian son & DIL! Thanks for the treat! [Tagged, made & reviewed in Every Day Is a Holiday! tag]

This might be a great drink for cold weather, but it's also a great one for just about anytime, in my book, hot or cold! ABSOLUTELY GREAT DRINK! I tripled the recipe for 2 of us (TALL glass drinkers) & used a bit more than a 'splash' of OJ, as well as frozen bananas along with fresh strawberries & no ice ~ Couldn't have been better! Thanks for a great keeper of a recipe! [Tagged, made & reviewed in Zaar Stars tag]

Made this up as a munchie, but then we tried them in a salad & they really made a difference there! Also great, by the way, over breakfast granola for a great new taste! Thanks for a wonderful keeper of a recipe! [Tagged, made & reviewed in the Gimme 5 tag]

Made this for an unexpected potluck to which we were invited & it was a big hit! I did use macadamia nuts along with a dark brown sugar, which I thought was great with the pineapple & coconut flavors! Thanks for the great cake recipe! [Tagged, made & reviewed in Please Review My Recipe]

Very, very nice banana treat, & a recipe that's so quick to make! Served this with a frozen vanilla yogurt, but another time would like to find a praline ice cream to go with it! Thanks for a simple & tasty treat! [Tagged, made & reviewed just for the 'halibut!']

Was gonna make this in two baking dishes, keeping one for us & the other for a neighbor couple who loves mac & cheese! Made this for my other half to take to a special work-related get-together last Saturday & it was well received! Made these according to the recipe (using very ripe bananas) & these really made for a satisfying breakfast treat ~ Much nicer than those from the bakery! Thanks for posting the recipe! [Tagged, made & reviewed in Every Day Is a Holiday tag]

For us this was a unique & very tasty treat! I liked it paired with some low-fat vanilla yogurt, while my other half preferred it plain or with a small scoop of frozen vanilla yogurt! Either way, definitely worth 5 stars! Thanks for sharing it! [Tagged, made & reviewed in Went to the Market tag]

OUTSTANDING, & so easy to make, too! I enjoy Canadian bacon & pineapple pizza so was sure I'd like this as well! Definitely did enjoy consuming them, as much as I enjoyed making this great keeper of a recipe! [Tagged, made & reviewed in Please Review My Recipe]

Definitely a great bean salad, & this recipe really does dress up an otherwise kinda plain veggie! This recipe is so simple & easy to make, but it makes A UNIQUE & GREAT TASTING DESSERT! Very, very nice, & a definite keeper! Thanks so much for sharing the recipe! [Tagged, made & reviewed in Went to the Market tag]

OUTSTANDING! We really enjoy having this kind of shrimp, what with the combo of orange & soy in the sauce! Served with a brown rice & peas combo, this made for a very pleasant dinner! [Tagged, made & reviewed in the Unrated Asian Recipe Tag Game]

I'm not usually much for creamy dressings, but THIS SALAD DRESSING IS REALLY NICE & VERY NICE TASTING! You've got A VERY NICE, FESTIVE & GREAT TASTING SALAD ~ Really loved the dressing & will be making this again! Thanks, Jackie, for this great recipe! I'm one of those who'll eat Brussels sprouts plain, if I have to, but jazzed up, as in this recipe, they're VERY, VERY SATISFYING! Made this recipe as written & we had a very satisfying dish that I served with a combo of brown rice & peas! We love our green beans around here, & this makes for a very tasty way to serve them! Simple, but flavorful ~ Couldn't be better! [Tagged, made & reviewed in Make My Recipe]

Made this just today & am expecting enough of it to still be around for the final celebration fling at the end of the year! Along with others who made & reviewed this recipe, I used roma tomatoes (4 fair-size ones), seeded & sliced & followed the recipe after that! Easy to put together, & very enjoyable eating! This is certainly a keeper of a recipe ~ Thanks for sharing it! [Tagged & made in Please Review My Recipe]

Made these to add to my finger food counter for this evening's New Year's Eve celebration, & THESE LITTLE MUNCHIES ARE JUST GREAT ~ Loved the combo of cherry-sweet & bacon-salty! Definitely to be made again! [Tagged & made in Please Review My Recipe]

Made these for my finger food counter this evening but I'm with Pat's suggestion that these would go great with soup on a cold day ~ Very, very nice tasting these are, & we particularly enjoyed the rosemary in them! Thanks for sharing the recipe! [Tagged & made in Please Review My Recipe]

Made this with a slight twist in that I marinated then baked the tenders in the oven before serving them with the sauce as a side! Made this as a breakfast for 2 of us & what little was left over made a nice mid-day snack! I used a mild Italian sausage & mild cheddar cheese, as well! Great combo of flavors & so easy to prepare, too ~ Thanks for posting the recipe! [Made & reviewed in Zaar Stars tag]

Interesting, but I do have to say right up front that I definitely do not like the taste of Reese's Peanut Butter Cups, & inspite of that, in most cases, I really do enjoy the combo of PB & chocolate, just as I did with these cookies ~ THEY'RE GREAT! When making this recipe I steamed the baby carrots, but other than that followed this easy to make recipe & had A VERY, VERY TASTY CARROT SIDE! Made this recipe pretty much as written, but was generous with the peas (almost double the amount)! I also took Debbwl's hint & sliced 1 green onion into the mix! This might be a great summer salad, but it's also great right now in the dead of winter! I made it as written using the rotini & it was great ~ Colorful, tasty, the whole bit! Thanks, much, for sharing this make-again recipe! [Tagged & made in Please Review My Recipe]

Will admit that I changed this recipe just slightly, mostly because there were only 2 of us & 1 of us doesn't care for avocado very much ~ Still, I thought it turned out very well, & I'd be willing to make it again, perhaps for company! OUTSTANDING, MOST DEFINITELY OUTSTANDING! I first had some of these ages ago when I went to New Orleans (Mardi Gras, no less) & thoroughly enjoyed them then! Very, very nice 'cakes, these! Very, very nice tasting potatoes! We were pleasantly surprised at the inclusion of cinnamon & garlic, which combined well with the other seasonings! Made this very easily with strawberries, blueberries & raspberries & little banana, & it went well over a simple pound cake! Made these pretty much as indicated, but did take a bit more time than indicated (old age &  slow . . . you know what I mean!) but thoroughly enjoyed making these & working with the wrappers, which gave me no trouble at all! Am definitely gonna have to start including more chicken thighs in my meal preparations (we're usually chicken breast eaters) as we really enjoyed this recipe!
