Fantastic!  The sauce is so good it makes you want to lick the plate!  Even DH, who is not a fan of mustard loved this.  I didn't have shallots and used red onion instead.  We will be having this again---thanks for posting!  Made for PRMR.
I'm not normally a fan of processed cheese, but this was good!  Will be an easy fix to take to office potlucks.  Thanks for posting!  Made for PRMR.
I made this exactly as written but wasn't all that crazy about it.  It had a funny texture, somewhat spongey.  Novel idea though.

We really loved these!  But I think we're going to call these 'The Three Little Pigs Beans."  Why?  Because they have bacon, smoked sausage, AND ham!  And it's so easy to "pig out" on them if you're not careful!  Thanks for posting Gail!  Made for Newest Zaar Tag.

Simplicity at its best!  If you want a non-frou-frou chicken salad, this is for you.  I love just the tiniest bit of sweetness that the honey adds.  Thanks for posting Chef Jean!  Made for PRMR tag game.
Very good!  Didn't have parsley, but we didn't miss it.  I used a tube cake pan.  Makes a really visually interesting presentation.  Thanks for posting!  Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders.

Wonderful! So many different flavors in each bite! I did change a couple of things. Instead of fresh cranberries, I had some dried cranberries I needed to use. And when I saw the price of cashews in the store, I decided to use some of the pecans I have in my freezer. The only thing I'll change the next time I make this is to cut the grapes in half.  I will definitely be making this again! Thanks for posting Sydney Mike! Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders.
Easy meal to fix in the summer so you don't have to turn on the oven!  The meat was fall-off-the bone tender.  I liked it but DH wasn't that crazy about it.
Good, but would like to give it a try when I have fresh basil; I think that would make it even better!  Made for Aus/NZ Recipe Swap #30.

Quick and easy lunch! Wish I had read the previous review about toasting the muffins first. I think that would have made them even better! And I like my toppings on top of the cheese, so I made them that way. Made for Aus/NZ Recipe Swap #30.

We loved these!  I have to admit, I'm not a big Tex-Mex foodie and made this primarily for my DH, but I was the one going back for seconds!  And he loved them as well!  I used ground beef and for the chili powder I used Penzey's Chipotle Powder.  Made for Aus/NZ Recipe Swap #32.

Loved this!  Tastes very similar to a muffuletta.  My pasta was really hot when I added the provolone which melted quickly and made it a little gooey, but it still tasted wonderful!  For the olive salad I used Olive Sandwich Spread which is sold in the bakery/deli at Wal-Mart.  Will be making again!  Made for Adopt-A-Tag 2009.

Wonderfully rich chocolatey brownie with just a hint of coffee flavor.  I don't like a really strong coffee flavor.  These were just right.  I've got to make some of these to take to work - major brownie points!  Made for Aus/NZ Swap #32.
Had a craving for egg salad and decided to try yours.  Glad I did!  It was great!

Ooooh, I love fried sandwiches!  Heck, I love just about anything fried!  These were great!  Love the combination of sharp flavors from the mustard, salami and cheese.  Sure to be making these again!  Made for Aus/NZ Recipe Swap #33.

Great for a low-carb diet!  I left out the capers because I don't care for them and used chervil instead of the parsley and it tasted great!  Should have drained my tuna a little better than I did. Thanks for posting!  Made for Aus/NZ Recipe Swap #34.

I loved these kebobs!!!  This is so simple to throw together for a quick weeknight meal, but so tasty!!  I added onions with the green peppers and chicken.  I used skinless, boneless chicken thighs.  I also loved that this used the right amount of the ingredients to marinade the chicken without alot leftover/wasted.  Will definitely be making this again.  Thanks Boomie for a great recipe!!!!

I made this for dinner using 6 chicken thighs with the skin on and set them in the marinade in the morning. I then cooked them on the grill. I served them with a rice dish made with cream of mushroom and french onion soups and a salad. Very nice and quick meal to fix on a week night.

I will just say, Yum Yum Yum!!!!!  I just love lemon flavored food, drinks etc.  But I will definitely not buy the store brand  again.  This is so worth using, actually  alot cheaper, and so nice to have here in Florida with all the hot weather but a ton of citrus fruits.  Thanks Marra for a wonderful drink recipe.

Yummy!!!  I made this recipe this morning right before I had to get my 15yo DS up for school.  I do grind my own coffee bean and did so for this recipe.  I then used my coffee maker as well as filter to finish the recipe.  We really enjoyed this, thanks Boomie for another great recipe.

Made this for a breakfast drink for DS and myself.  This is very tasty, but felt it could have used the juice of the whole orange and forget the optional water, needed additional liquid but not the water.  This wasn't too sweet or require additional sweetner for us.  Definitely a great smoothie and good luck with RSC!!!!

I made these for breakfast this morning and this are delicious.  I cut the recipe in half and I don't have an 8 count muffin pan so used the 12 count size.  This made 6 muffins.  I put butter on the first half of the biscuit, but they are so tasty that they don't really need anything added to them.  Thanks loof, made for 123 tag.

This was delicious!!!  I doubled the recipe, except the amount of butter I left the same.  I didn't have swiss cheese, so used a combination of mozzarella, parmesan and romano shredded cheeses.  I used baby portabella mushrooms.  Very cheesy and tasty pasta dish.  Thanks bmcnichol for a great recipe!!!

I made this for our Sunday breakfast and it got mixed reviews.  I too love the method of cooking it this way, in fact I didn't need to flip or anything, I didn't even need to bake as long as stated for baking.  Next I would cut the amount of potatoes in half for our tastes.  Thanks for post Sue.  Made for ZWT 2008.
Delightful healthy treat/dessert, especially if you fixed a heavy meal.  I made this for the Eastern Europe ZWT Holiday Cuisine challenge.  Thanks !!!

This is delicious!!!  It is so quick and simple to get together, but yet so fresh tasting. Followed the directions as written, allowing chicken to marinade between 1/2 to 1 hours time.   Made for the ZWT Greek Photo Challenge.  Thanks Vicki for a great recipe that will be used often in our house.
Made these for dinner last night along with grilled greek chicken and a salad.  Loved the lemon garlic flavor and it was very quick to get together.  Made for ZWT 4.  Thanks Sassy!!

I love citrus, so when I saw this recipe, had to try it!!!  I made this in the morning to have later with lunch.  This is so refreshing and I love the combination of the lemons and oranges.  I followed as directed, but cut the recipe in half.  Next time I may even cut back on the amount of sugar or use a sugar substitute.  Thanks Japan for a great recipe!!!

I made these potatoes to go along with a grilled flank steak.  I liked that you can make this ahead of time, which I made these in the morning and then reheated while grilling the steak.  I liked the combination of cheeses and onion flavor.  Made for ZWT 4.  Thanks for posting a great recipe.

Wow!!!!  What a drink!!!  Just loved it and it tasted very similar to a shot I have tasted, but not sure Zaar would let me right the name of it!!!  I would definitely make this again, would be very nice as a after dinner dessert!!!  Thanks mary for a great drink.  Made for ZWT 4!!!

I really enjoyed this frozen dessert, but admit I did make a substitution for the first layer.  I used fresh strawberries and strawberry jam in place of the apricots and used a chocolate almond discotti.  I also decreased this to a serving for two.  This is full of flavor and I really loved the toasted almonds with all the other flavors.  Thanks Cook must be crazy!!!  Made for ZWT4.

I made this using apple cider vinegar, what I had on hand, and this was so simple/quick to get together.  I did also add some garlic salt, taste preference!!  Thanks Dreamer for a nice Vinaigrette recipe.  Made for ZWT4.

Wow!!!!  This is delicious, I am so glad you told to me to get some of the liqueur!!!!  I put some fresh coffee, from this morning, in the refrigerator in order to get it cold.  I then made it as written.  Will definitely make this again, nice happy evening drink on a terrible non-stop raining day.
Thanks for a great drink recipe and recommendation!!!  Made for ZWT4.

I picked this recipes for the ease in making, which is so easy, plus I had never had plantains.  Mine were not sweet like a banana, and less flavorful than a banana.  I baked them 25 minutes and allowed them to cool a bit before eating.  I think I would make a butter/brown sugar sauce to add on top of these next time.  Thanks for posting Sarah Jayne as this was a great introduction to plantains!!!!  Made for ZWT4.

Wow just mix four ingredients for the marinade, talk about simple.  This was quick to get together but very tasty was the end result.  I only used 1/2 cups of the soy, wine and oil, but still used full amount of the garlic.  My steak was smaller then 2-3lbs.  Thanks Melibug for a nice recipe!!!  Made for ZWT4.

This was a very nice mild flavored rice, next time I might add some minced onion.   It went perfectly with the mojo chicken and corn on the cob.  Very easy to get together but makes alot, I would say it serves six.  Thanks for sharing and this was made for ZWT4.
I made this for dinner, but used chicken quarters.  This was so quick and simple, yet so fresh, full of lemon flavor!!  I will make this often.  Made for ZWT4 zingo.  Thanks Mama for a great recipe.

I made this morning for a light breakfast.  I didn't have Coco Lopez, plus don't care a whole lot for coconut, so subbed  in lowfat vanilla yogurt, otherwise made as directed.  This is very refreshing morning smoothie and liked the strong citrus/orange flavor!!!  Made for ZWT4 family picks.
These were just as described nice and crispy oatmeal cookies!!!  We love them!!  Thanks Ravenseyes for posting.  Made for ZWT4 zingo.

Delicious!!!!  I cheated and didn't bother cutting mine into pieces and skewering.  I used ribeyes and marinated them for about two hours and then grilled.  I did brush on some of the marinade in very beginning of grilling.  Made for zaar stars tag.  Thanks Pneuma for posting.

Since it is so hot right now in Florida, I made this in the morning when it still cooler, but cut this to a quarter of the amount.  I had to sub the Swiss Miss with sugar as thats what  I had on hand and did add a splash of half and half to lighten it up.  This is DELICIOUS!!!  This will be great in the cooler winter months in the evening!!!  Thanks KateL.  Made for 123 tag.

This is a great way to use up leftover mashed potatoes.  I only made half of the recipe as I only had about two cups of leftovers.  This is quick and simple but tastes like twice baked potatoe filling, whats not to like?  Thanks iewe.  Made for Zaar Stars tag.

I made these cookies for a back to school treat, but cut the amounts in half.  I also made regular size cookies and it made 2 1/2 dozen.   I loved the addition of the butter brickle (toffee chips).  Thanks CoffeeB for posting.  Made for 123 tag.

I had my sister and niece here visiting and made these along with a fruit salad and they couldn't get enough of these and asked for the recipe.  So simple and quick to make, especially since I used refrigerated hash browns.  I also forgot to get gouda cheese, so I subbed cheddar cheese.  Will definitely be making again, but use the correct cheese.  Thanks Sydney for a great recipe.  Made for Zaar Stars tag.

Delicious!!!!  Had company and my niece, who just turned 21 in July wanted to try different drinks, just love this drink!!!  Great combo of flavors!!!  Made for 123 tag.  Thanks Mary for a great drink recipe!!!!

Delicious and so refreshing on this hot August evening!!!!  I loved this drink, especially getting the additional lemon juice from sucking on the slice between sips.  Will definitely be having this drink often at our house.  Thanks Mama!!!  Made for bevy tag.

Delicious smoothie!!!  I made as written except that I had to sub 2% milk and left out the sugar.  I found the orange and blueberries to be sweet enough for my tastes.  Thanks for sharing.  Made for Zaar Stars tag.

This made nice breakfast treats.  It was easy and quick to get together.  I think I would use a sweeter apple or add some sugar to the batter if using granny smiths.  In the directions it says to use 1 1/2 tea. oil but then in the instructions it says to add 1 Tab. of oil.  I went with the 1/2 Tab of oil and only added the milk as it would have been too thin with the water.  Thanks for sharing weekend cooker.  Made for Everyday is a Holiday Tag.

Who needs Star Bucks?  I was making this for a late morning pick me up so I left out the Tia Maria and did cut the recipe in 1/2 for 1 serving.  My 16 yo DS came home from school and saw me editing my photo for this and said you need to make that for me, but didn't have the coffee now so promised tomorrow I would save some of the coffee for him.  This is delicious!!!  Thanks Annacia!!!!  Made for bevy tag!!!
Loved it!!!  Nice bubbling citrus flavored drink.  Very good for a hot summer evening!!!  Especially liked that I have all the ingredients on hand.  Thanks Sarah Jayne.  Made for Zaar Stars Tag.

Wow!!  What a simple dressing or as in my case marinade to get together.  I used this on skinless, boneless chicken breasts and then grilled them.  They were so flavorful and juicy!!!  I also basted them in the beginning of grilling.  Made for bevy tag, thanks January Bride for new yummy marinade.

This made for a wonderful mid morning snack.  I didn't use the sugar-free ingredients, and therefore didn't add the teaspoon Splenda, which it definitely didn't need it made this way.  It really does taste like a banana split!!!  Made for 123 tag.  Thanks for posting CoffeeB.

Absolutely delicious!!!  This could be served for a breakfast/brunch or with dinner.  My 16 yo DS couldn't get enough of these potatoes, I think he had three helpings!!!  I did do things a bit different than written, as I sauteed the onion in 4 tbsp's butter then mixed it with all the ingredients.  I then used 4 tbsp's butter with the crushed corn flakes, so just a little lighter.  Thanks for sharing weekend cooker.

I made this with white wine, with permission of Boomette, and then followed exactly as written.  This is a delicious sangria, loved the combination of the wine, oj and limoncello.  Thanks for sharing!!!  Made for bevy tag.
Great smoothie!!!  I also used frozen berries, no fat vanilla yogurt and left out the sugar.  This made for a wonderful healthy breakfast.  Thanks for sharing Jackie.  Made for 123 tag.

Made these for a breakfast treat!!  I cut the recipe in half and I then used a food processor to cut the butter into the flour mixture.  I forgot to get raisins, so mine was made without them, but did add pecans.  I did have to add quite a bit more flour to the dough in order to get to a consistency where I could cut out rounds with a biscuit cutter, but the end result was a delicious scone.  Thanks for sharing Annacia.

Made this for Saturday lunch for DS and DD.  They both gave it two thumbs up and came back for seconds and I also loved the combination.  I followed as written but used all mozzarella cheese and backed at 400 degrees.  Thanks for sharing.  Made for zaar stars tag.

Nice sloppy joes which I had for lunch and DS had for an early dinner before his basketball.  We both enjoyed them but found them to be different than most sloppy joes in that they kinda tasted like chili.  Thanks for sharing. Made for Holiday tag.

This gets 5 stars for flavor and texture, but like Annacia, this required at least 1/3 cup or maybe more, didn't measure, before it could be handled.  I used the dough cycle, then kneaded it and formed into a loaf and let rise again.  It didn't hold its shape, probably should've added more flour than I did, so no picture was taken.  We loved the flavor and the texture and will make again using 1 cup of water instead of the 1 and 1/3 cup.  Thanks Lorrie for sharing this bread.  Made for holiday tag.

I made this for a awesome lunch today!!!  Neither of my kids care for pork chops or pork steaks, but I do, so I tag them every so often to indulge myself at lunch.  I cheated and didn't measure the spices, just sprinkled all four on each side of the pork steak.  I then cooked it on our outdoor gas grill on high to get some good grilling taste.  I then covered the plate with foil, and patiently waited, lol!!!  It was so tasty and juicy, in fact, I had to get a paper plate after taking picture, to put the raw carrots and garlic bread on!!!  Thanks Wi Cheesehead for sharing this yummy recipe.  Made for 123 tag!!
Delicious afternoon treat!!!  I too love the Baileys, coffee and the chocolate rimmed glass.  Thanks for sharing this yummy drink!!!!  Made for bevy tag.

I made this for dinner last night, but I was being lazy and didn't cut up and skewer the meat.  I made the marinade as written, but added some minced onion since I wasn't using it on the skewers.  I used 3 petite sirloins and marinaded them for about 4 hours.  My DD, DS and I all thought this had fantastic flavor!!!   Thanks for sharing Boomette.  Made for Zaar Stars tag.

This is a delicious coffee!!!  I used fresh ground regular coffee and regular swiss miss(what I had on hand).  I think even using a hazelnut flavored coffee would work for this also!!!  This was a wonderful morning treat!!!  Thanks for sharing Kate!!!  Made for holiday tag.

This is wonderful, so addicting, gonna have to hide it from myself!!  I too, had to do things differently, as I didn't have a double boiler.  I bought Ghirardelli white chocolate chips and then melted them in the microwave on 50% power.  This worked out well.  I also bought Crispix Cereal, which is part rice and part corn, so didn't need two boxes of cereal.  This is perfect for the holidays.  Thanks for sharing such a yummy recipe!!!  Made for you football pool win!!!

I made these for snacking while watching football games.  These were very easy to make and very tasty.  I followed the recipe as written, except I sprinkled some toasted sesame seeds on them after they were cooked.  I am not a fan of the hot buffalo wings so this was a great recipe for me!!!  Thanks for sharing weekend cooker!!  Made for Holiday Tag.

Made this for dinner last night and we all loved it!!!  It is so quick and simple to get together.  I followed the recipe as written, but put in a small amount of sliced onion, that I had left over from another recipe.   I served this over pasta with green beans and garlic bread.  Thanks for sharing this great simple chicken recipe LifeIsGood.  Made for holiday tag.

This was a wonderful recipe to perk up green beans.  I did use canned cut green beans.  I had bought the shredded parmesan cheese, but asked DD to add the 6 tablespoons of the cheese and she used the grated/canned kind. This didn't melt well, but it still tasted delicious, despite not looking as appealling.  Made for potluck tag.  Thanks for sharing a great recipe.

Delicious flank steak!!!  I had good intentions of making the marinade the night before, but of course, that didn't happen, so made it first thing in the morning.  I made as written but had to sub red onion in place of the green onion, but worked out great with nice onion flavor.  Served it with some home-made rolls, green beans and potatoes.  Thanks for a great flank steak recipe, Lazyme!!!  Made in honor of your win in the football pool!!!

Nice blend of flavors, pineapple being the dominant.  Very tropical type of drink.  The only thing I did different was cut the grenadine to 1/4 ounce.  This is also a great drink for those that don't like to be able to taste the alcohol, very smooth and fruity!!  Made for bevy tag.

This was so tasty, just loved it!!!  I made this as written, except used 3 very large chicken breast halves but kept the same amount for the sauce, as I was serving it over pasta and left out the olives.  I loved how it infused the flavor into the chicken.  Will definitely make again, but will probably sub boneless, skinless chicken breasts and decrease the cooking time.  Thanks for sharing a great recipe Kate.  Made for 123 tag.

This is delightful drink, not to strong, just creamy and tasty!!!  I made the white russian, which I haven't had in probably 20 years, this really hit the spot while watching football tonight!!!  Thanks for sharing and bringing me down memory lane, and one I will make again!!!  Made for your win in Tic Tac Toe tag!!!!

I made these potatoes for breakfast and they were delicious!! I went the easy route and used the refrigerated hash browns, so no peeling or shredding. I cut the recipe in half, but otherwise followed as written. Thanks for sharing this recipe. Made for your win in Tic Tac Toe tag.

Made this using a large sirloin cut into two pieces.  I loved that this is simple with ingredients I always have on hand and no dicing or chopping any ingredients.  I used basalmic vinegar and  extra garlic, and marinated it throughout the day.  It turned out nice and juicy!!  Just seemed like it could use/needs something, like maybe onion, dry mustard or citrus, can't place it.  Thanks for sharing Boomette!!  Made for holiday tag.

Excellent breakfast or brunch dish!!!! I made an extra baked potato the night before and then cut this up in the morning for the dish. I used bacon in place of the ham. I didn't want the soft yolk, so I scrambled them and poured them over the potato mixture. I think the brie cheese put this over the top!!!  I did reduce the recipe to serve 2 and cut the brie into small pieces to get even distribution.   Will definitely make this again, especially when having company. Thanks for the recipe Gayla. Made for PRMR.

I loved that this recipe is just to serve one!!!!  Great strawberry daiquiri!!  I had to use more than double the strawberrries as mine were small.  Will definitely make this again, but next time I will add some crushed ice to the blender as well.  Thanks for sharing Appley!!!  Made for 123 tag.

Absolutely delicious!!!  I followed this exactly as written, except didn't add any chocolate shavings.  I first added 1 tablespoon caramel, as not a huge sweet fan, but it wasn't sweet enough, so added one more tablespoon.  The SALT is the key to this wonderful recipe, don't leave it out!!!!  I will definitely make this cocoa again, just love it!!!  Thanks BK for sharing.  Made for Newest tag game.

I made this to go along with grilled chicken with wine sauce.  It got mixed reviews from my family.  My 16 yo DS loved it and 21 yo DD and myself thought it was really good, but it needed some more flavoring, some garlic and onion flavoring in addition to the salt and pepper.  I did add some extra butter as it was a little dry.  We LOVED the addition of the crispy croutons!!!  Will definitely make it again and tweak it a bit for my family's tastes.  Thanks Gayla!!!  Made for PRMR tag.

This a fun and different way to make baked potatoes.  I liked the crispy skin, kind of reminds me of potato skin appetizers as for the texture.  I made as written, then adding a little butter and sour cream.  Thanks for sharing.  Made for PRMR tag.

Great coffee drink.  I don't have an espresso machine, so just used strong coffee, which was hazelnut flavored coffee, as I didn't have the syrup.  I used 2% milk about 3/4 cup, but otherwise followed as written.  Thanks for sharing Mike.  Made for 123 tag.

Just like the recipe name states, simple and tasty!!!  I used a ribeye steak and followed the directions as written, til step #6 and thats when I realised that the propane had run out. :(  So I then had to switch to the pan, not what I like to ever do with a good steak.  But it still tasted good and was enjoyed after cooking desserts and side for Thanksgiving Dinner.  Made for your win in the football pool, congrats again!!!!

Excellent!!!  It does taste just like an Orange Julius.  I made as written, except that I used NutraSweet in place of sugar.  Will definitely make this again, especially for my Orange Julius loving DD.  Thanks for posting.  Made for photo tag.

This was a great  simple and quick rice side dish!!!  I made as written, although allowing for some light color in rice and onion.   It is nice and buttery, but felt it was two much, so only used 3 ounces of the butter.  I still felt it needed  more flavor, so added some Lawry's Seasoned Salt just  before serving and we really enjoyed the rice.  Next time I will just cook it on stove top with the lid that way not having to heat oven and top.  Thanks for sharing a great recipe Noo.  Made for PRMR.

Wonderful blend of flavors and textures!!!  Also very quick, using microwave to cook bacon, to get together.  Served this on a bagel for breakfast this morning.  Thanks KelBel for sharing.  Made for 123 tag.

I made these for lunch today and they are delicious!!!  I saved enough meat to make one 6 oz. burger, but then 16 yo DS decided to was staying 1st for lunch then leaving,  so it became two 3 oz burgers!!!  My DS asked if I seasoned the meat, I just said yes with salt and pepper, he then said it tasted more like steak than a burger, lol!!!  The neatest thing was seeing where the cold pat of butter had been, there was a hollow square the size of the butter pat!!!!  Thanks for sharing LifeIsGood.  Made for Holiday tag.

I grew up making homemade mac-n-cheese using a white sauce and then adding in cheddar cheese and macaroni, so that part was easy.  I had never added other types of cheeses and that really made a wonderful difference in flavor!!!  My DS, addicted to noodles, loved this and went back for seconds.  I only made 1/2 the recipe and made everything upto the broiling part, then 16 yo DS had a change in plans, so I put it in fridge until today.  I left it covered in 350 degree oven for about 35 minutes, then popped it under broiler for a few minutes and it was perfect.  Thanks for sharing Lainey.  Made for PRMR tag.

Made for a light lunch for one.  I only used 2 smaller potatoes, peeled and cubed, used 1 can of french style green beans.  I have never heard of verjuice, so looked it up online and subbed vinegar and used sour cream in place of the yogurt.  Loved the flavor of the beans and potatoes, great salad!!!!  Thanks for sharing bluemoon.  Made for Holiday Tag.

Yummy fruit salad!!!  I used a granny smith apple, as that is what I had on hand, but next time would use a less tart apple or leave out the strawberry jelly.  I loved the bananas with the strawberry jelly, but great mix of fruit without the jelly, as far as flavors, color and textures.  Made for PRMR tag.  Thanks for sharing 2Bleu.

Made this for dinner last night using a ribeye steak and it was very tasty!!!  I couldn't find, despite living in the South, the seasoning from SouthernFlavor, so I substituted Montreal Steak Seasoning.  It was so flavorful and nice and tender.  Thanks for sharing breezermom!!!  Made for Holiday Tag/MsSally.

Yummy steak!!!  I had to sub a flank steak, as my store had the flat iron steaks on the weekend, but when I went to get one this week they didn't have any of them.  I have found that I just love balsalmic vinegar with marinades for chicken and beef, and this didn't disappoint.  The only other thing I did differently was to use Montreal Steak seasoning for the salt and pepper.  Thanks for sharing BakinBaby!!!

Nice Peanut Butter cookies with the chocolate swirl!!!  I did find it hard to work with as it is so soft of a dough, but still managed to be successful, just not real nice swirl.  I baked 1/2 dozen today for a sample and for rating, the rest will wait till closer to Christmas.  Next time I will lower the temp of my oven to 350, as the bottoms got too browned at min baking time, but not a fault of the recipe just my oven.  Thanks for sharing.  Made for PRMR.

Delicious after dinner coffee!!  I went a little lighter orange liqueur as I wasn't sure how I would like it with coffee and also added some half-n-half cream.  Thanks for sharing.   Made for stars tag.

I made this using a ribeye steak, dark brown sugar, whisky and other ingredients as listed.  I cut the recipe in half.  This is so quick and easy to get together and only needed two hours for marinading, made for a great late decision for dinner last night.  Nice switch for a marinade, but definitely on the sweet side.  Thanks for sharing Noo.  Made for 123 tag.

What a wonderful morning treat on this nice cool morning!!!  I changed to one serving.  Mine was very rich, as it told me to add 1/4 chips, which really is more than the recipe called for in 1 serving.  I used 2% milk and the half-n-half and left out the almond extract.  Nice and rich with no other sweetner needed.  Thanks for sharing Sharon.  Made for PRMR.
Yummy!!!  What is not to like in this drink.  I loved the combination of flavors.  I too used cold, brewed coffee, but otherwise followed as written.  Thanks for sharing Kim.  Made for 123 tag.

Made this for breakfast/brunch this morning and they are wonderful!!!  If you haven't had swedish pancakes before, beware that they are more eggy texture than your traditional flour pancake, as my kids weren't used to pancakes this way.  I served that with frozen strawberries that I thawed and made into a sauce and bacon.  Thanks for sharing Weekend!!  Made for 123 tag.

This was perfect served with today's brunch.  I used orange sherbert and Sprite Zero.  It has been in the high 70's, so this was perfect this afternoon.  Thanks for sharing Nasseh.  Made for Zaar Stars Tag.

I made this for dinner last night and took the liberaty to use chicken instead of the lamb, as stated in the description.  Since I went with chicken, I used a dry white wine, as it was also what I had on hand.  Otherwise followed ingredients as written.  I only marinaded mine for about 3 hours, which worked out great flavor wise.  I used chicken breast cutlets and just left them whole.  I grilled them with a skewer of sliced onion and brushed the marinade throughout the cooking.  I love souvlaki and this is a wonderful recipe.  Thanks for sharing Breezermom.  Made for 123 tag.

Wonderful little pizzas!!!  I made these for 16 yo DS and I for lunch today and they were quick, easy and tasty!!!  The only thing I did differently is used shredded cheese and sprinkled them witha little garlic salt.  Thanks for sharing CoffeeB.  Made for stars tag.

Delish!!!! Enjoyed this drink last night for New Years Eve.  I love the tartness of citrus drinks and this was no exception.  I had grapefruits in the refrigerator that a neighbor had given me from their trees, so used fresh squeezed grapefruit juice and feel that really made this drink extra special!!!  Thanks for sharing loof!!!  Made for 123 tag.

Delicious scones/biscuits!!!  So quick and easy using the self-raising flour.  I too, didn't add the sugar as was serving with a sweet fruit salad.  I cut the recipe to serve 4 and that worked out perfectly.  Thanks for sharing I'mPat.  Made for PRMR tag.

Yum, yum yum!!!  I made this using left over mashed potatoes, that I warmed in microwave.  I made 1/2 of the recipe for 3 of us.  I served this along with a marinated steak and it was an awesome meal.  Thanks for sharing Jess.  Made for PRMR tag!!

Wonderful appetizers!!  I cut the recipe to 1/4, using a 4 oz. pkg of rolls.  I made 3 in an appetizer size per directions and then made 3 regular size crescents.  I cheated a little and bought a chive and onion cream cheese, which made these really quick to get together!!  Thanks for sharing CoffeeB.  Made for 123 Tag.

Oh Sharon this is a delicious, citrus smoothie!!!!  I had some oranges and grapefruits that my neighbor gave me from her trees, so I used fresh juices from both of them.  It is strawberry season here so also used fresh strawberries.  Wow!!!  I am feeling really healthy right now writing this review, lol!!!  I will continue to make these with all my fresh fruit!!!  Thanks for sharing Sharon!!!  Made for new tag.

Excellent Spanish tortilla!!! I used left-over baked potatoes, along with the onion and garlic. I didn't have any red bellpepper on hand, but this is the type of recipe you can add vegetables or meats of choice. I made it for a serving for one for a hearty lunch today. I used a small skillet and added 1/2 of the olive oil and 1/2 butter to add more flavor. I then added the onion and potatoes along with some seasoned salt and pepper. I then added the garlic for a minute or so and then the eggs/cheese mixture. (I scrambled them and added the cheese in with them). I then put this pan in the oven for 15-20 minutes and it was very flavorful but simple tortilla!! Thanks for sharing bluemoon. Made for PRMR.

I made this for my DS, DH and I for a snack/lunch this afternoon, so I cut the recipe in half.  The only change I made was to brown the ground beef with the onion and season it, then I drained that and added it back to the pan.  I then added the cheese and tomato mixture to the pan.  These perfect level of heat for me and it is addictive.   Thanks for sharing the recipe.  Made for your win in the football pool.

Delicious coffee!!  I cut the recipe in half and left out the baileys as it was in the morning, otherwise, followed exactly as written.  I think this would be wonderful as a dessert coffee with the added alcohol.  Thanks for sharing barefootmommawv.  Made for 123 tag.
This is a great rub!!!  It is more on the sweet side, so think next time I would use as a rub for ribs.  Thanks for sharing.  Made as a bonus tag for playing potluck tag.

I love orange julius and this came close to their flavor!!!  I followed exactly as written except only added half of the sugar.  This makes a very fluffy orange dream and what a refreshing treat this morning!!!  Thanks for sharing Taste Tester!!!  Made for a potluck bonus tag.

Loved it and so did my pasta loving DS!!  Served this with WW Chicken Parmesan and green beans for a great meal.  I also loved the slight hint of lemon to the alfredo sauce.  Thanks for sharing the recipe.  Made for a bonus tag for potluck tag.

Made this for lunch yesterday but cut the recipe in half and left out the peas for taste preference.  I was going between 4 and 5 stars on this one, as I felt the cream cheese was too overpowering, but loved that it was stove top made and uses ingredients I normally have on hand.  I would definitely make again but would use a flavored cream cheese like FT did with the boursin cheese and cut it back in amount.  Thanks for sharing breezermom.  Made for holiday tag.

DELICIOUS!!!!  I made these exactly as written and they turned out absolutely wonderful.  This is so simple and quick to get together for yeast rolls that is a new favorite of mine.  Would highly recommend this recipe to others and will make again.  Thanks for sharing this wonderful recipe Kelbel!!!

I made this for dinner last night, but prepared it earlier during the day.  I subbed ground beef for the Italian sausage so therefore used no oil, taste preference!!  I used diced tomatoes and followed all other ingredients and amounts.  After the sauce was bubbling I tasted it and felt is need some salt and more garlic flavor, so added some salt and garlic powder!!  I loved that you don't have to boil the noodles first, much easier and less pans to clean!!  Thanks for sharing your recipe.  Made for stars tag.  Pictures didn't turn out, but will try again with the leftovers!!

I just love falling off the bone BBQ baby back ribs and these were no exception!!! I did do it a little it differently, I too always take off the membrane as it helps for the meat falling off the bones and then a used a 9' X 13" pan and filled with 1/2 inch water, added the ribs uncut and then sprinkled with house seasoning (salt, pepper and garlic powder) and then covered the pan with foil. Then I baked them in the oven at 375 degrees for two hours. Then back to your method of covering them in sauce, I used Montgomery Inn BBQ Sauce, and then finished cooking them on the grill. I ate way tooooo much, but absolutely delicious!! Thanks for sharing your recipe. Made for Potluck Tag.

Wonderful savory pancake instead of the sweet pancake with maple syrup.  I made only 1/2 of the recipe, exactly as written.  I served it with some sour cream, reminded me a little of potato skins, and blueberry muffins.  Made for Stars Tag.  Thanks for sharing Noo.

I made this for breakfast this morning for myself, so only made 1/2 of the recipe.  I didn't have any plain yogurt so used all fat-free strawberry yogurt.  This was delicious, but think next time would also use frozen strawberries or add a little ice.  Thanks for sharing.  Made for Holiday Tag.

Whats not to like about this recipe?  Like 2Bleu said it is like a loaded baked potato but with rice.  I made this for lunch today for myself so cut the recipe down to 2 servings.  Thanks for sharing Loof.  Made for 123 Tag.

DELICIOUS BUTTERY ROLLS!!!  We loved these rolls.  I only made 1/2 the recipe, 8 rolls, which for in the US was 2 cups of flour.  I already had the main dish in the oven at 350 degrees, so I cooked these at that temperature for 30 minutes and they were perfect.  I made some with the sesame seeds and half with the poppy seeds.  Thanks for sharing this wonderful and easy recipe Noo.  Made for 123 Tag.

Loved these onions!!  I served over Recipe #326218 and what a great combination it made for dinner.  Very quick and easy to get together and I am sure would be great to accompany almost any type of meat/poultry!!  Thanks for sharing the recipe Noo!!  Made for Stars Tag.

Wonderful breakfast skillet!!!  For the veggies I used red bell pepper, onion and mushrooms.  I had a half of a leftover baked potato that I cubed and browned in the oven with the spices, quicker back time.  I used scrambled eggs and did add 2 slices cooked, crumbled bacon.  Thanks for sharing the recipe.    Made for Potluck tag.

If you want tender falling off the bone ribs, this is the way you do it!!! I used a long foil pan, added the ribs and water, then I seasoned the ribs with salt, pepper and garlic powder. I covered with foil and let them bake for 3 hours.  I then moved them to the grill and sauced them on the BBQ.   Served with baked potato and grilled corn on the cob for a quick no fuss meal or cleanup. For the sauce I used Recipe #249976. Thanks for sharing WiGal. Made for PRMR.

Delicious chicken recipe!!!  I was just making the chicken part of this recipe, as I was serving it with pasta.  This is very light and fresh tasting chicken and with the added grilling flavor was perfect.  Made for Holiday Tag.  Thanks for sharing your recipe.

Wonderful breakfast with these waffles this morning!!!  I only made 1/3 of the recipe as it was just my DS and I.  I didn't have vanilla sugar so just used all regular sugar.  I think next time I would add more baking powder in order to make them puff up more when cooking.  I add some fresh strawberries and some whipped topping!!!  Great breakfast for Valentines Day.  Thanks for sharing your recipe.  Made for Potluck Tag.

These are wonderful blueberry muffins!!!  I made half of the recipe which gave me 8 muffins.  I used blueberries that I bought fresh but then froze.  Next time I might up the cinnamon as I could hardly tell it was in the batter.  Thanks for sharing the recipe which was made for 123 Hit Wonders Tag.

This is what my family calls total comfort food.  I only made half of the amount of macaroni and doubled the amount of cheese.  I mixed the cheese in with the juice from the tomatoes and water to make a nice cheesy sauce.  I left out the pinch of cloves as my family doesn't care for nutmeg/cloves with their pasta.  Since I mixed the cheese in with the pasta I didn't feel the need to bake it, so just served it from that point and sprinkled a little extra shredded cheese on top.  Thanks for sharing a family favorite.  Made for 123 tag.

Great comfort food!!!  Made 1/4 of the amount for lunch today and it was so good.  I have never cooked the smoked sausage with the potatoe mixture and it kind of got a caramelized texture and was so good.  I did sub sliced potatoes from the refrigeratored section of the grocery store, but otherwise made as written.  Thanks for bringing back fond memories of my families comfort food.  Made for potluck tag.

I love smoothies and this was no exception!!!  This has my favorite fruit combination.  I used some unsweetened frozen strawberries, fresh banana and then some OJ.  I like that it is all fruit and because of using frozen strawberries, no need to add the ice.  Thanks Mersaydees for posting.  Made for Holiday Tag.

I make these all the time for a lower calorie treat!!  I used the light vanilla ice cream and Diet A & W Rootbeer.  The diet soda does cause the ice cream to get a icy coating, but for the flavor and lower calories, it is worth it!!  Thanks for posting Nif.  Made for Potluck Tag.

Just loved the nut coated chicken and the salad.  I did make some changes, I am not a fan of cashews so I subbed pecans, I didn't white vinegar so used apple cider vinegar and added some sea salt and pepper to the vinaigrette.  My salad consisted of iceberg lettuce, carrots, celery, redbell pepper, green onion and cucumbers.  My 16 yo DS is not a fan of any nuts, so I made his chicken first using just the flour and breadcrumbs and then added the nuts into the breadcrumbs for mine.  I think it would also be nice to cut the chicken into bite sized pieces before breading and serve over the salad greens.  Thanks for sharing this great recipe Bluemoon.  Made for PRMR.

Great quick and easy rice recipe that I served with some breaded chicken and salad.  I was making this for only two of us and 1 cup of rice (used Jasmine long grain) and 1 cup of pasta seemed like too much for two so I cut the recipe in half.  Boy did my hand get tired breaking up the spaghetti into small pieces, next time will buy the Rice-a-roni and just skip their seasoning lol!!!  Even cutting this recipe in half I feel it would easily feed a family of four.  I think this would be wonderful served with a nice and well seasoned gravy or sauce.  Thanks for sharing your recipe Lori!!!  Made for Holiday Tag.

I made this for my lunch, as DS doesn't care for bacon, and it was quick and delicious!!!  I used bacon and had to sub fettucine for the bucatini, but otherwise made as written for one serving.  Thanks for sharing Noo.  Made for PRMR.

This made for a lovely dinner last night, served with Recipe #203770 and green beans!!  I loved the orange sauce over the pork chops, I used boneless pork chops instead of a tenderloin.  I also subbed 1 teaspoon orange extract for the orange liqueur but otherwise followed as written.  Will definitely be making this again.  Thanks Sweet Baboo for sharing your recipe.  Made for PRMR.

Awesome drink!!!  I made this using a huge lemon that I juiced and then only added 1 teaspoon sugar!!!  I used fresh strawberries, now in their prime time in Florida and that was the perfect sweetness for me!!  The flavors of all ingredients make for one tasty drink!!!  Thanks for sharing!!!  Made for Everyday is a Holiday Tag!!!

I will add my 5 star review with the rest!!  Who doesn't love bananas and chocolate!!!  This is so delicious and truly like a dessert!!  I had to sub the dark Creme De Cacoa as that is what I had on hand and therefore no photo, but it was awesome with the dark!!!  Thanks for sharing and made for Bevy Tag!!

This is a delicious rub!!!  I used it as the dry rub for babyback ribs!!  I only made 1/4 of the recipe.  This is very similar to our own made up rub except not cayenne pepper, which was fine with me.  I put the seasoned ribs in a pan with some water and cooked them in the oven for 2 hours.  Then transferred them to the grill and basted them with BBQ sauce.  Thanks for posting a rub I will definitely use again.  Made for Photo Tag.

This iced coffee whirl is excellent!!! My only problem is it didn't make enough, maybe 4-5 ounces. I followed the recipe exactly as written, maybe my scooper is small. I did have to add a little bit more coffee to make it blendable, if that is a word, lol!! Then I did garnish with some whipped topping and chocolate sauce for a better photo!! Thanks for sharing Annacia!! Made for New Tag.  Forgot to add that I used a light vanilla icecream and was worried that it might need a sweetner, but it definitely required no additional sweetening!!!

Absolutely delicious!!!  Great for a mid-afternoon pick me up!!  I didn't have the sugar-free syrups so mine wasn't as guilt free, but oh so yummy.  I did extra ice to make this a little thicker for my tastes.  Thanks for sharing CoffeeB.  Made for PRMR.

These are so easy to fix but with a wonderful crunchy, buttery flavored crust!!  I made these using a 3 pork cutlets, so I cut back the butter by 1 Tablespoon but otherwise made exactly as written.  My 16 yo DS doesn't like pork chops, so when asked what it was, I stated chicken, and he ate them without a problem.  This is a recipe that will be repeated in the house!!  Thanks for sharing this great recipe.  Made for PAC Spring 09.

I was intrigued by this recipe because of the yeast, as I have never made pancakes using yeast.  This does take a longer time to make due to the rising time but it was really fun to make and use this batter.  This isn't a real sweet tasting pancake, which I also liked, as we always add syrup or sweet strawberries on our cakes.  Thanks for a new way of enjoying pancakes.  Made for Spring PAC 09.

This was a great lunch for me today!!  I used a boneless pork cutlet but then had to sub some ingredients.  I used dry breadcrumbs and did look for the fresh sage leaves but the ones at the market were going bad, so subbed rubbed sage, then made as written otherwise.  I loved the combined flavors of the parmesan, breadcrumbs and sage with the pork.  Made for PRMR.

I made this for myself and 16 yo DS, as he is off for Easter Break, for an afternoon treat!!  I made his with real vanilla ice cream and AW rootbeer, but made mine the light vanilla ice cream and diet AW rootbeer!!  I tried to get the Breyer's rootbeer flavored ice cream, as I have seen it in my store before, but it wasn't there this time, so had to sub the vanilla!!  But for us in the end, what is not to love about this recipe!!!  Thanks for sharing your recipe!!  Made for Stars tag!!!

I picked this to tag for Holiday Tag as I also have a recipe posted for a Bay Breeze, but it is very different.  I enjoyed the different flavor of juices and line with the vodka.  Not too sweet, but still very refreshing!!!  The only thing I did differently was to make it for one serving.  Thanks for sharing breezermom!!!

Excellent!!!  Loved these potatoes, as I am an onion lover and potato lover and the two of them together was wonderful.  I served them with a marinaded flat iron steak and salad.  Will definitely make this again.  Thanks Nif for a wonderful new potato dish and was made for Potluck Tag!!!

This is a very tasty flank steak, but for us the fresh ginger totally took over the flavor, thats all we tasted.  I did marinade it for 24 hours and used the fresh ginger and used a flat iron steak which is very similar to flank steak.  I like ginger but next time would cut it back and add some minced garlic and maybe marinade it less time!!  I served it with a potato/carmelized onion dish and salad, so made for a great meal, the meat was so tender!!

I made these as part of the our Easter dinner.  This was a very different method of making rolls and I loved it!!  It really was this quick!!  Everyone had at least two rolls, and my 16 yo DS had 4 of them by the end of the day.  We thought they had a great flavor and texture and the short time really make this recipe!!  Thanks for sharing the recipe Wicked Cook.  Made for Photo Tag.

I made this to go along with a chicken dish and it was perfect!!  I only made 1/2 of the recipe for two of us and there was plenty!!  I served and then added some of the sauce from the chicken dish to the rice.  Oh so yummy!!!  Made for Went to the Market Tag!!  Thanks for sharing your recipe Shuzbud!!

Oh my, the smells coming from oven last night, even 17 yo DS said it smelled good!!!  I must admit I cheated and used refrigerated sliced potatoes, so much easier!!!  It was probably only 3-4 cups of potatoes so I cut back a little on the sauce amounts but otherwise followed as written.  I served it with corn on the cob and blueberry muffins and we cleared our plates.  I loved the hint of thyme added to the recipe.  Thanks WiGal for sharing a great recipe.  Made for PRMR.

Nice oatmeal raisin cookies.  I made these exactly as written, although had to use pure clover honey as I couldn't find the acacia honey.  I made regular sized cookies using my cookie scoop and it made 21 cookies.  I didn't flatten them as they were smaller, but on 2nd batch I did flatten, as they don't spread when baking.  These had a very good strong cinnamon flavor but very little sweetness to them, which unfortunately was not a winner for my 17 yo DS.  Thanks for sharing Lalaloula!!  Made for Holiday Tag.

Oh my is this ever good!!!  I did have to make a change, in that I had no soda water, so I left out the sugar syrup and used a Lemon/lime soda (diet Sprite).  I also didn't have the plain colored Cointreau liquer so subbed Blue Curacao, which the dictionary here on Zaar showed that this is Cointreau.  This tastes very similar to a Whiskey Sour, which my parents always made for parties!!  Thanks for sharing Noo!!  Made for PRMR.

Great pancakes!!  I made this for the 2 serving portion, it will feed two people for the next two days, which is great!!  Very quick to get together!!  My batter was really thin, so I add a little more flour.  Thanks for sharing Kittycatmom!!  Made for potluck tag.

Absolutely delicious!!  I loved the strawberry/pineapple combination.  I don't care for coconut so subbed regular cream.  My 17 yo DS and myself enjoyed this for an afternoon treat.  Thanks for sharing BK!!
Made for Stars Tag.

I made this last night for a very late dinner as DH was late  getting home from work!!   I wasn't sure how I would like the maple syrup in the marinade, but it was wonderful and I guess alot of recipes have you add brown sugar, which I find to be sweeter than the syrup.  I used a good size flank steak so cut the marinade in half.  I served this with baked potatoes and salad for a wonderful dinner.  The meat was very tender and tasty!!  Thanks Lavender Lynn for sharing the recipe.  Made for PRMR!!

This is really good!! I made it as written except that I already had a cinnamon/sugar mixture made that I used and it worked great with the recipe. This gives off a wonderful sweet cinnamon smell while is was cooking!!  I then started to make like I normally would, added some butter and was about to put some syrup on it, but then tried it first.  It is sweet enough on its own that I didn't use any syrup.  Thanks for sharing the recipe!! Made for Stars Tag!!

I made this the other night for an after dinner drink/dessert!!  This is one strong coffee drink, but very yummy!!  I used regular rum but otherwise followed as written but for 1/2 the recipe.  I did end up adding an additional 2 ounces of coffee to make a full serving.  Thanks for sharing BK.  Made for 123 Tag.

This was a wonderful breakfast this morning.  Would also be great as a dessert.  I used banana, pears, apples, oranges and banana.  I forgot to sprinkle them with brown sugar, but didn't miss it.  I really enjoyed dipping the strawberries and bananas in the chocolate and liked the oranges and apples but didn't care for the pears with it.  Thanks for sharing WiGal!!  Made for ZWT Spain's kid friendly recipe.

This bread was delicious with our dinner last night!!  I used a small loaf of french bread (12 thick slices) and followed the herb butter except that I also added in some garlic salt to make sure the garlic flavor was on all slices.  This bread was devoured by my whole family!!!  Will definitely be making this bread again!!  Thanks Gailanng for sharing this recipe.  Made for Everyday is a Holiday Tag.

Yummy cookies!!  This was the first time I experimented with macadamia nuts and these cookies turned out great.  I made 1/4 of the recipe and used a cookies scoop to make them, which made 21 cookies.  The rest of my family aren't fan's of nuts!!  My 17 yo DS's friend came over while I was at the store, when I came home he told me how much he liked them!!  The only change I made was to use half butter and half shortening for the shortening amount listed.  Thanks Jim for sharing a great cookie recipe.  Made for ZWT5!!

I made these last night to go along with Recipe #222310 and green beans and it was perfect!!  I too went the easy route using a can of refrigerated breadsticks.  I made them exactly as written except I sprinkled in some garlic salt!!  This was so quick but yet so tasty!!  Will definitely be making these again.  Thanks for sharing the recipe.  Made for ZWT 5.

Great flavored flank steak!!!  I cut the marinade in half, as I was using less than a pound of flank steak for two of us.  I made the marinade first thing and the morning and then grilled it for dinner.  I left the garlic and green onions on the steak after marinading, giving additional cooked in flavor!!  This makes alot marinade, but probably cut in half for even larger flanks steaks, as I had a ton left over.  Made for ZWT 5 Caribbean region.  Thanks for sharing another great recipe Kittencal!!!

Yummy rolls!!!!  I don't have a stand mixer so I followed the beginning directions using a hand mixer, then used a wooden spoon and hands for adding the remaining flour.  I also only made 1/2 of the recipe.  I served them with roast beef in wine sauce, corn and mashed potatoes with gravy for a wonderful Sunday dinner!!!  The whole family loved the rolls!!!:-)  Thanks Tink for sharing your recipe!!!  Made for ZWT 5.

This was very different for me, compared to the omelettes I normally eat. But after a couple of bites, it grew on me. I followed the directions as written but had to sub regular onion for the red and left out the rosemary, but used all other optional ingredients for the omelette.  I used some fleur de sel for the salt to really make it a French omelette.   And since I was having this for breakfast, I didn't us the salad greens. Next time I would completely leave out the sugar, as the caramelised onions are sweet enough. Thanks for sharing the recipe. Made for ZWT 5.

I made this a couple of days ago, but forgot to post a review and upload the photo!!!  This is wonderful potato dish!!  We call potatoes made this way with cheese au gratin potatoes rather than the scalloped but whatever you call them, they are good!!  I subbed refrigerated potatoes that were already peeled and sliced and just added a pinch of the red pepper flakes, but otherwise followed as written for half the recipe amounts.  Thanks for sharing the recipe.  Made for 123 Tag!!

Great grilled bread!!!  This was so quick and simple to make for a dinner side dish!!  I used a combination of the olive oil and butter, fleur de sel, pepper and the optional garlic powder and we loved it!!  Will be making this often.  Thanks for sharing Kit!!  Made for Zingo in ZWT 5.

Wonderful flambe recipe!!!  Mine also flamed for a long time and was the first time I have made a flambe!!  I used a ribeye steak seasoned with fleur de sel and pepper, then grilled the steak.  I then put it in with the butter in the pan and followed the rest as written.  Thanks for sharing the recipe!!  Made for ZWT 5 zingo.
Very tasty drink!!  I used "Simply Lemonade" and followed as written.  Wonderful drink on a hot summer day!!  Thanks for sharing the recipes.  Made for ZWT 5 zingo!!

This was the perfect afternoon refreshment needed on a 90+ degree day!!! I made 1/4 of the recipe and don't like coconut so used 2% milk in its place, now wish I had made 1/2, and loved this yummy fruity cocktail!!! I did add a bit of whipped topping for garnish!! Thanks for sharing Sue!!! Made for zingo of ZWT 5.

Wonderful green bean dish!!!  I made this using canned cut green beans and left out the hard boiled egg as DS doesn't care for them, but otherwise made as written.  Just loved the tanginess of the green beans and the wonderful cruchy breads crumbs really took this over the top!!!  Thanks for sharing Karen Elizabeth!!  Made for PRMR!!

This is a great way to use up leftover mashed potatoes!!!  I too had a problem with the first potato patty that I made, it fell apart.  I then made smaller ones and that worked fine.  I only made half of the recipe.  Next time I would add a little less of the onion & garlic powders as toward the end it seemed to be overpowering, but thats just personal taste.  I used a combination of mozzarella and cheddar cheese and that was wonderful!!  Thanks for sharing Gailann!!  Made for 123 Tag!!

Delicious garlic bread!!!  I made this using half the amounts and had to sub dry oregano and did use some fresh and some dried parsley.  My parsley got to much sun and started dying so it is just starting to recover, so not enough there for this recipe!!  Despite using the dry herbs, this bread is delicious.  The only thing I changed was to sprinkle the butter with some garlic salt to ensure garlic taste throughout!!  Thanks for sharing the recipe!!!  Made for Holiday Tag!!!

This was a very quick and easy spaghetti dish!! I finely chopped the onion and added 1/2 of it to the meatball mixture for added flavor and moisture. I then fried them, once they were browned I pushed them to the sides of the pan and added the rest of the onion along with a bit more oil, in the directions it said to "saute the onions and garlic" but there wasn't any garlic listed in the ingredients, so I added a teaspoon minced garlic. I then added the tomatoes and let it simmer for a bit and then tasted it, at this point this was still to watery and thin for our tastes and needed spiced up. I then added a small can tomato paste and some oregano and basil. This worked perfectly with our spaghetti!! Thanks for sharing the recipe. Made for your win in the Games Summer Spectacular!!
Yum, yum, yummy!!!  This is a wonderful tasting drink!!  I was worried about the scotch being overpowering, but I didn't even notice it!!  Thanks BB for sharing the recipe!!  Made for holiday tag!!

Made this to serve 1 and it worked out great!!  I love almonds but think I would leave them out next time!!  This would be great to do on the weekend as you could get up and mix it all up and put in the oven while you have time to shower and get ready while it bakes!!  After baking I served it with a splash of milk.  Thanks for sharing the recipe.  Made for holiday tag.

Just loved the bacon made this way, reminded me a bacon that my sister had for my nieces' graduation parties/brunch done by a cater.  I only made 1/4 of the recipe and used Oscar Mayor bacon as it was what I had on hand and it worked out great!!  Loved the combination of sweet, peppery and salty flavors together!!!  Thanks for sharing Loof!!  Made for your winning guess in the Summer Spectacular!!

What a great fresh and healthy drink!!  I only made 1/4 of the recipe for me, which equaled a small juice glass.  I followed this recipe as written.  It was very tangy and that might have been due to using key lime juice, next time I would use fresh or just omit it!!  Thanks for sharing your recipe.  Made for Holiday Tag.

AWESOME!!!  I have tried many copycat recipes for Orange Julius's and this has to be closest in actually tasting like an Orange Julius!!!  The others have all been a great tasting drink, but this one actually hits the mark!!!  I will definitely be making this one again.  Thanks for sharing Nif!!  Made for you win in the Summer Spectacular Event.

Oh this is soooo good!!!  I followed the recipe but for 1 serving!!  I heated my milk in the microwave until it had some bubbles around the edge, then added the chocolate and coffee.  I then added the baileys and heated it a bit more in microwave.  Last night it rained all evening so it made for the perfect cooler summer night to try this latte!!  Thanks for sharing Shuzbud, made for your win in the Summer Spectacular!!!
Yummy chocolate shake!!!  It tastes similar to a Wendy's Frosty and is just delicious on a hot summer day!!!  Thanks for sharing the recipe.  Made for your win in the Summer Spectacular!!!

Well in my opinion, adding bacon to almost anything makes it taste even better!!!  This was great way to make a potato!!!  I was making it to serve along with a marinated flank steak, but wasn't sure how much propane was left, so I started it out in the oven and then when it was time to grill the steaks, I added it also to the grill.  I didn't add any cilantro and used a little butter along with the olive oil.  Thanks for sharing Kate.  Made for stars tag!!

Wonderful marinade!!!!  I think by bringing it to a boil and simmer for a few minutes really brings out the flavors and makes for a better marinade.  I made this as written but only half the recipe to use on a small flank steak.  Thanks for sharing this great recipe Gailann!!!  Made for Holiday Tag!!!

DELICIOUS!!!  This is very similar to the way I make our shrimp except with the addition of the wine and cayenne.  My DH and DS had steaks and I made two skewers of shrimp for me, which once their steaks were about done DH put my shrimp on the grill.  The marinade is quick and easy to get together and is so tasty.  I made it as written, but just shook the cayenne bottle a couple of times, as I am a whimp with heat!!  Thanks for sharing your recipe Nif!!!  Made for PRMR!!!

Great biscuits and very easy to make!!!  I made 1/4 of the recipe for myself this morning which gave me 3 nice fluffy biscuits.  Thanks for sharing the recipe!!  Made for you win in the Summer Spectacular Event.

Made this last night for a really wonderful dinner.  I served it with garlic bread and green beans.  I ended up needing to cook it on the stove, as I didn't get back as planned to do it in the crockpot.  I used fresh mushrooms that needed to be used and sauteed them first, then I set them a side and added the water for the pasta and put it on to boil.  I then brushed the chicken with olive oil and sprinkle on some sea salt, pepper, basil and oregano and then it went on the grill.  After the pasta was done and drained, I added in the mushrooms and the sauce and re-heated.  I then served with the sliced grilled chicken breast and shredded parmesan cheese and it was wonderful!!!  Thanks for sharing such a simple easy recipe!!!  Made for Newest Tag!!!

Great cookies, not like most of the one made here in the US, as these are crispy, but I like a crisp cookie!!!  I made as written other than adding in 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon!!  Thanks Noo for a great oat cookie recipe!!  Made for your win in the Summer Spectacular Event.

Great change for plain green beans.  I did as you suggested, I used part of the onions for the beans and the other half on top of a grilled ribeye steak, hmmmm!!  I had to sub canned french style green beans, as what I had on hand, which was less than the 1 1/2 lbs, so I decreased the rest of the ingredients by half.   Thanks for sharing this recipe Jackie!!  Made for 123 Tag.

Great  breakfast smoothie!!  The peach yogurt really switched it up for me!!  I also used a frozen banana and had to use a bit more of the OJ in order for it to get blended!!  I left out the honey as I have found it doesn't get blended into the smoothie with my blender.  Made for your bonus win in the Summer Spectacular!!!  Thanks for sharing the recipe Alligirl!!

Wonderful omelet!!  I made me a two egg omelet but still kept the same amount of bacon.  You really don't need to add any salt or it would be way too salty, and I love salty foods.   Made for Stars Tag.  Thanks for sharing a new way to make a wonderful  omelet!!

Wonderful french toast!!!  I couldn't find the Italian dessert bread/cake, so subbed regular Italian bread and then had to sub a vanilla creamer, as it was what I had on hand and need to use up.  I used 3 eggs and 1/3 cup creamer and I was making this for the three of us.  Thanks for sharing your recipe.  Made for Photo Tag!!

Great simple, yet so tasty, pasta dish!!!  I made this to serve one for lunch today and loved the bacon flavored pasta!!!  Very quick to come together and made for a filling lunch along with some garlic bread.  I used baby portabellas but otherwise followed as written.  Thanks for sharing the recipe.  Made for 123 tag!!

These are great for breakfast too!!!  I made 1/2 of the recipe for the pancakes and 1/4 of the syrup for breakfast.  It made 9 medium pancakes and the syrup is very sweet, so very little needed with the orange sweetened cakes.  Thanks for sharing your recipe.  Made for Stars Tag.

I just love mocha frappuccino's and so does 17 yo DS, so made this as an afternoon treat, well morning for him, lol!!!  I followed the exact amounts, but blender kept sticking as it was too thick so add more coffee, that worked great!!  I chose to add chocolate ice cream to make it a mocha iced coffee.  DS and I then decided we wanted that blended in also, so added them back to the blender!!  Yummy iced coffee!!!  Thanks for sharing your recipe Syd!!!  Made for 123 Tag!!

Nice quick and easy lunch for DS and I today!!  I used Piccolina (mini penne) and followed as written, except I cooked the pasta and then drained it, then added all the other ingredients and heated until cheese all melted.  I then topped with a little shredded cheddar cheese.  Thanks for sharing the recipe.  Made for 123 Tag.

This is delicious!!!  Would be great to serve for brunch or when you have out of town guests, but I only made it to serve one this time, as no one in my family likes pecans but I love them!!  I loved the crispy outside in contrast the the tender inside.  Will definitely be making this again.  Thanks for sharing the recipe.  Made for stars tag!!!

Whats not to love about these little treats!!!  Yummy pastry and chocolate can't be beat!!  I made them exactly as written and they turned out perfect.  17 yo DS and I are enjoying them!!!  Thanks for sharing the recipe!!  Made for PRMR.

Delicious coffee cake!!!  I didn't make it the night before, just whipped it up this morning.  I made exactly as written, using blueberry I bought and cleaned and then froze.  It was moist and very flavorful with the blueberries.  Also very quick to get together!!  Thanks for sharing the recipe.  Made for PRMR.

This was a hit for the family last night at dinner.  This was very different from the Scaloppine recipes I have had in the past, no lemon juice or garlic, but still tasty.  I used 5 thin chicken cutlets and subbed regular onion for the green onion (personal preference) and did add a teaspoon minced garlic.  I also coated the chicken lightly with some seasoned flour prior to browning.  I first cooked the mushrooms, onions and garlic and then set them aside while chicken browned.  I then added them bake with the chicken and followed as written.  I served it with my Recipe #345703, green beans and bread sticks for a wonderful meal!!!  Thanks for sharing a new twist on scaloppine.  Made for Stars Tag.

I made this for a lite breakfast along with some sourdough toast.  I used strawberries, pineapple, red grapes, canteloupe and musk melon.  The dressing made for a nice creamy topping over the fruit.  Thanks for sharing the recipe.  Made for Holiday Tag!!

Wonderful chocolate chip cookie recipe, as with most of Betty Crocker recipes!!!  I made these yesterday morning, 1/2 of the recipe, and they are almost gone.  I followed the recipe as written and wouldn't change a thing.  Thanks for sharing the recipe NWG!!

I made this using diet coke and all plain rum, as I don't care for coconut flavor much, but other wise made as written.  Great rum and coke with the addition of Cointreau liqueur!!!  Thanks Boomie, made for 123 tag!!!

Loved these wings!!  I made 8 each of wings and drummettes for DS and I for lunch and served with some teriyaki rice.  I am not a lover of food that sets my mouth on fire, so this was right up my alley!!!  DS loves the hot wings, so not his favorite, but he still enjoyed them.   Thanks for sharing Gail!!  Made for PRMR!!

What a great idea and can't believe I never thought to do this with frozen or canned corn, as I have done this to older corn on the cob.  I served this along with Recipe #229108 and mashed potatoes!!  I only used 1-2 tablespoons butter and less than a tablespoon of sugar with a 15 ounce can, for our tastes and that worked out great.  I think using this on the store brand canned or frozen corn would make it taste good and save some money from not getting the better brand name corn.  Made for Holiday Tag.

I made this for my lunch today for one burger as 17 yo DS wasn't up to trying a new burger.  It was a great burger, I just sprinkled it with sea salt, pepper, onion powder and couple dashes of worcestershire sauce and then added about 1/4 cup crushed Lay's BBQ chips and then mixed it all together and formed my burger.  The burger has a great flavor but really couldn't taste the chips in the burger.  Thanks for sharing your DD's recipe!!  Made for photo tag.

I made 1/4 of the recipe (which equaled 2 small biscuits) for a savory type of breakfast, but could definitely see making these to go along with chili/soups and stew!!  These are quick to get together and the flavor was wonderful.  The only thing I changed was to use all white flour.  Will definitely make these again!!  Thanks for sharing the recipe.  Made for Newest Tag.

Delicious chicken!!!  I made this using to chicken thighs and just loved the flavor, especially the skin, yummy!!!  I originally planned to make this on the grill, but it ran out of propane and I can't change the tank, so it went in the oven.  I served it with potato packets (which were also to be done on the grill) for lunch.  Nice and light, but so flavorful!!  Thanks for sharing Alli!!  Made for Stars Tag.

OMG is this ever rich but oh so yummy!!!    I made this for one serving, and as 2Bleu did, worked with the amounts for one serving.  I looked at the amounts that are posted on the food network and they are definitely wrong.  I used 1/2 banana, 2 tbsp of splenda brown sugar, 2 1/2 oz of cream cheese and 1/4 tsp vanilla for the filling.  I used 1 egg, 1/4 tsp vanilla, no sugar and 1/4 cup half and half.  For the sauce I used 1 1/2 tbsp butter, 2 tbsp brown sugar, splash of vanilla, 2 tbsp rum, 1/4 ounce half and half and I added 1/8 tsp of cinnamon and the remainder of my banana.  The filling was enough for at least 2 servings and more likely 3, the amount of batter was also enough for 2-3 and the sauce was perfect amount for one serving.  I used two large slices of white bread and just spread the cream cheese mixture on each slice and topped it with banana slices, then fried it in butter and after toasting it, I cut it into 3 pieces.  I could only eat 1/2 of mine as it is very rich and filling, but so worth it.  Made for 123 Tag!!

I love citrus fruits so had to give this one a go!!  I made it as a breakfast dish and it made for a nice fresh fruit and biscuit breakfast.  I only made one serving so just one orange.  Thanks for sharing Syd!!  Made for PRMR.

AWESOME!!! I made these in four square muffin tins and they came out perfect!! I absolutely loved the crunchy top edges, so yummy!! This is the perfect size for my family!! I then cut the cake in half, added a scoop of vanilla ice cream and some sliced strawberries for an awesome dessert. This is going into my keeper book and will be made many times more!! Thanks for sharing the recipe. Made for PRMR!!

WONDERFUL!!!  I can't believe how quick and easy these are to make, in fact, for me too quick, lol!!  At 9 minutes I checked them and they, at least to me, were not any where near done, all giggly!!  So I cooked for 4 minutes longer and the center was still bubbly and I thought "Perfect"!!!  Well by the time I ran a knife around each cake and then flipped them, it was not longer gooey on the inside, wet but not oozing!!  Next time, for my oven, I will take them out at 10 minutes and I am sure it will be the molten cake we expected, all my fault!!!  I used all semi-sweet chocolate and it wasn't overly sweet, just right!!  We loved the flavor of these quick cakes and served it with vanilla ice cream for Labor Day dessert!!  Thanks for sharing a recipe that I will be making again but experimenting with the cook time for my oven!!  Made for Adopt a Tag!!

Great spaghetti sauce that reminds me of the sauce that my Mom made, minus the chopped tomatoes and added sugar.   I made this using meatballs instead of browning the meat and onions but then followed the recipe except for I only used 1/4 of the amount of sugar (2 tbsps).  I didn't add the optional water, and that was a nice thickness for the sauce for our tastes.  Made for PAC Fall 09.

Excellent sauce!!!  I was making an Eclair cake for PAC and it called for chocolate sauce, so I used this as the sauce for the cake and it was perfect and I liked it for being a thicker sauce then say Hershey's!!  I only made 1/2 of the recipe and really could have made 1/4 of it.  It is very sweet, so next time I would use 1/2 the amount of sugar, but otherwise, I wouldn't change a thing.  Thanks for sharing and will be making this again.  Made for Potluck Tag.

WOW!!!  What a fun recipe!!  I used all the ingredients listed but did do it a little different.  I put the onion in a small dish, along with a dab of butter, and microwaved them for a minute to soften the onion.  I then followed the recipe as written.  After cooking for 13 minutes, I took it out and it seemed done until I slid it onto the plate and alot of liquid oozed out.  I then put it back in the bag and in the pan for another 5 minutes and it was perfect.  I just loved all the flavors and texture, as well as nothing to really clean up, what a bonus!!!  Thanks for sharing the recipe.   Made for PAC Fall 09!!

I just love citrus fruits and don't know how I have missed this in the past!!  This is fantastic!!  I put the OJ in the freezer at lunch time and two hours later I was ready to dive into this slush,  although I only made 1 serving size.  This was so refreshing on a 90 degree afternoon and I loved the slushiness of the OJ with the creamy ice cream!!  Thanks for sharing a wonderful recipe.  Made for PAC Fall 09.

Loved it!!!  I made this using 1/2 of a pink grapefruit that I had already had the other 1/2 the other day and had found it to be very tart and not very juicy.  I thought this might be a great way to perk up the grapefruit and it worked out great!!  It definitely became really juicy while heating in the oven, only thing that didn't happen was the caramelizing of the brown sugar, which I think dissolved in the juices.  I didn't have any mint, so left that out.  Thanks for sharing a recipe I will use again when a grapefruit needs help!!  Made for Holiday Tag.

Great quiche!!!  I made this for one serving, but to me that really made enough for two light servings.  I had to make my own self-rising flour, but that was simple, I used bacon and a combination of swiss and cheddar for the cheese.  I decided not to season it, as I had to add salt for the flour and the bacon was salty also, which worked out perfect for me.  Thanks for sharing a great recipe.  Made for PRMR.

What a great simple way to switch up canned tomato soup!!  I followed the recipe as written, using "Better than Bouillon" chicken base mixed with water for the chicken broth.  Next time I would simmer the soup for a longer time to cook the celery more and might add some chopped onion!!  Thanks for sharing the recipe.  I served it along with Recipe #390356 for a great lunch!!  Made for PRMR.

This is delicious and my 17 yo DS just can't get enough of this casserole.  I used refrigerated bag of hash browns (20 ounces) so no thawing required and also only used 1/2 of the butter.  I used 2 tablespoons of butter with with chopped onion and cooked them for a minute in the microwave to soften them and then used 2 tablespoons of melted butter with the crushed corn flakes and it worked out wonderful!! :-)  Thanks for sharing your recipe!!  Made for PAC Fall 09.
What a fun, simple and quick way to make doughnuts at home!!  I used the jumbo size biscuits and then sprinkled them with sugar.  Thanks for sharing the recipe!!  Made for Holiday Tag.

We love Chicken Piccata and we loved this recipe!!  I made 1/2 of the recipe using 3 large boneless, skinless chicken breasts, normally I use cutlets and think I would use the cutlets or butterfly the large chicken  breast next time.  I didn't use the artichoke hearts, as I was pushing it to use the mushrooms for 17 yo DS.  I served it with garlic bread, green beans and angel hair pasta, which my son requested that it be made with my Recipe #345703 sauce, although I would have rather had it with just the sauce from the chicken.  Thanks for sharing the recipe BakinBaby!!!  Made for 123 Tag!!

We just loved this for dinner last night and was easier to make than lasagna!!  I did do a few changes, in that, I used all ground beef and added 1/2 a small can of tomato paste to the mixture to make a thicker sauce.  I only used 1 tsp sugar, just to cut the acidity and just eyeballed all the rest of spices for our taste.  When assembling I used about 1 1/2 cup cottage cheese and at least double the mozzarella cheese and then sprinkled some parmesan cheese over that, as we love it cheesy!!  I served it with garlic bread and green beans for a true comfort meal!!!  Thanks for sharing the recipe, that I will definitely be making again!!  Made for Stars Tag!!

Fantastic!!!  My mother used to make something similar, but just used lemons and oranges.  I used one lemon, lime and orange.  Then added 2 1/2 cups water and 3 tablespoons sugar, I like it tart!!  Thanks Gail!!  Made for Holiday Tag.

I made these for our lunch today during the football games!! I cut the recipe back to 1/2 lb ground beef, added my own taco spices and added kidney beans along with some tomatoes and sauce. I then topped the chips with this and added a Mexican Cheese Blend and then put it under the broiler to melt the cheese. Served with salsa, sour cream and green onions for our toppings. Thanks for sharing a fun game day recipe!! Made for Holiday Tag.

I have an electric stove, so I also followed the advice of others and removed from the burner, as it was boiling and foaming up when I left it on it!!  I set my timer for 4 mins and took it out of the water.  My egg was on the smaller size but I think with a larger egg this would have been the perfect amount of time.   Thanks Nif for sharing a new method for poached eggs that I will use from now on, no need to babysit the pot this way.   Made for potluck tag!!

I too love grapefruit and wanted to try this recipe.  I used 1/2 of a grapefruit and cut honey/vanilla mixture to 1/4 of the recipe.  The grapefruit I bought recently haven't been as juicy and sweet as normal, so this was a great way to bring out the juices and sweeten it up!!
