I did not cover my burritos with foil, just topped them with some salsa and some cheese and they came out very great, my husband and son slathered them with sour cream and I ate them plain.  Thanks for posting a new family favourite!

I really like this recipe.  When I first made it I thought it was so-so, but after letting it marinate for 5-6 hours the flavours melded together.  I thought that I had enough white wine vinegar, but I was a little short of the 1/2 cup, but I don't think that it hurt the recipe.  I did use a mandolin to get the slices paper thin and liked seeing the white and green flecks in the bowl.  Thanks for posting a refreshing salad.

I made this on the weekend and we all enjoyed the flavour.  They were great right out of the oven however they were quite dry after they cooled off.  I think that I will try them again with some of the add ins and hopefully they will be moister.

This is a very good recipe.  I had people grumble when they heard what I made and then they tasted it and it disappeared.  Even my bean hating son loved this.  I topped it with more cheese, green onions, and tomatoes and it was the hit of the evening.  Thanks for posting this yummy recipe.

WOW!! Everyone rated these a 10! I made a double batch, as directed, though I forgot to add the cilantro at the end. Nonetheless, they were terrific.  I will be making these again, soon. Thanks for sharing this marvelous recipe.

I'm finally getting around to rating this recipe, though I made it all summer long with a few variations here and there. I love it with mung beans and arugula. I tried it on a buttered sliced of heavy, rustic walnut bread, without the basil or sprouts, and it was great that way too This is so simple, yet so delicious.  Thanks for sharing!

This salad was a huge hit with DH, so much so that I almost didn't get any. He took this out of the fridge and ate most of it (I had halved the recipe). He said it was a great salad. High praise from someone who doesn't like pasta very much. It was so easy to make. The pickle juice added to the mayonnaise gave it wonderful flavor. I loved it too, and will be making this quite often. Thanks for sharing the recipe.
I served this with roast chicken and it was very tasty. I actually added more caraway seed to my own serving because I liked it so well. Thanks for sharing the recipe. Made for ZWT6.
This salad dressing is a little sharp, so I used it with a chopped salad of tomatoes, cucumbers, onions and parsley. It was tasty. Thanks for sharing the recipe.

I made this as posted, with a London Broil steak. I marinaded it overnight, grilled it and sliced it thin. It was fantastic and enthusiastically enjoyed by all. Thanks for sharing this recipe. I will definitely be using this often. Made for ZWT6.

WOW - the best fish recipe ever!! I loved this and I think I could eat it every other day. It was that good. The fish was nice and crispy and the sauce was so good that I wished there was more. Without a doubt one of the best recipes I have ever found on Zaar. Thanks for sharing this with us. Made for ZWT6.

This turned out very well. I love the flavor of the cake itself. I cut it in half, filled it with Cool Whip, Recipe #417148, and then topped it with more cool whip and more strawberries jubilee. Wow! I will make this again and again. Thanks for sharing the recipe. Made for ZWT6.
We liked that this dish has some zip to it. The blend of flavors is very good. It was quick and easy to make. Thanks for sharing the recipe. Made for ZWT6.
I also chose to make this delicious sandwich today for ZWT6. I used a rye bread and unsalted butter. A perfect blend of flavors. I will definitely make this again. Thanks for sharing the recipe.

I loved this sandwich










I loved this sandwich! I used Splenda and sourdough bread. I will make this often. Thanks for sharing the recipe.

This was a terrific sandwich! The only change I made was to add a little thyme to the mushrooms (personal preference). Everyone loved the sandwiches and I will make them again. Next time I think I will sprinkle some Jarlsberg cheese on top. Thanks for sharing the recipe. Made for ZWT6.
Delicious salad! We enjoyed this for lunch today and I will be making it again. Thanks for sharing the recipe. Made for ZWT6.

We loved this squash. The only change I made was to cut up two roma tomatoes and add them in also. I cook squash like this all the time, but never thought to add oregano. It gave the dish a great flavor. Thanks for sharing the recipe. Made for ZWT6.
Perfect recipe for a quick and delicious breakfast, or light meal. Had this with some fresh-squeezed grapefruit juice and it was just great. Thanks for sharing the recipe. Made for ZWT6.
This was very easy to make and quite delicious. I will make it again. Thanks for sharing the recipe. Made for ZWT6.

Very good fritters. As another reviewer stated, they are not heavy with batter. You really taste the zucchini, onion and feta. I used less mint (personal preference). I will make these again. Thanks for sharing the recipe. Made for ZWT6.

Yum! I made these with a mature English Cheddar, and worcestershire black pepper instead of the stated cheese. I used whole wheat bread and these were very well received by all. I will make them again. Thanks for sharing the recipe. Made for ZWT6.

Perfect recipe! The only change I made was to use frozen blueberries. I patted the dough out by hand instead of rolling. I thought the dough was a bit wet, but after putting it down on the floured slab, it was fine. I made mine rather large, so I got 12. I baked them 18 minutes (since they were so large). I thought they might not be quite ready, because they gave a little when I touched the top, but I took them out anyway and left them on the pan for 5 minutes. This is the first time that I have gotten a moist scone instead of a dry crumbly one. I will always use this recipe in the future, though I might try using other add-ins, just for variety. Thanks for sharing this excellent recipe. Made for ZWT6.

I loved this sandwich. I used wheat bread rolls that I baked and an apple/cranberry chutney that I received as a gift and was waiting to use. This is something that I could eat often. I love the combination of the cheese with the sweet/tart flavor of the chutney. Thanks for sharing the recipe. Made for ZWT6.
Kudos to you for this exceptional recipe! I regularly make something very close to this, but decided to try your version and loved it. Thanks for sharing the recipe.
Wonderful recipe. I doubled it with no problem. I used a good chocolate and whole milk, and the flavor was so good. Everyone loved it. Thanks for sharing the recipe. Made for ZWT6.

I was a little dubious about the flax seed, but it actually gives this a nice crunch (I didn't grind mine). I used strawberry-kiwi yogurt and loved it. I will make this often during the hot summer months. Thanks for sharing the recipe.

You are so right about the rice being perfect! I doubled the recipe and used 4 tbsp of kosher salt in the water, together with 1/2 tsp garlic powder and 1/2 tsp onion powder. I followed your instructions exactly and even though it seemed that the rice wasn't quite ready when I drained it, it was perfectly cooked 10 minutes later, as your instructions say. I love the fact that no fat is used to make this rice. Thanks for sharing this recipe.

This was very, very good! I used 10 chicken drumsticks and the quantities given were perfect, except that I only needed 1 1/4 cups of bread crumbs. I used Italian flavored crumbs. I will make this often. Thanks for sharing the recipe.
I used this to make Recipe #414946 #414946 and it was very good. Thanks for sharing the recipe. Made for ZWT6.
The rice turned out perfectly and had good flavor. Thanks for sharing the recipe. Made for ZWT6.

I was too tired to cook tonight so I wanted to try this, but I had to change it. I was out of parm and dill, so I put sliced tomatoes over the feta and sprinkled with za'atar. It morphed into a middle eastern cheese toast! Delicious. Thanks for sharing the recipe. Made for ZWT6.
We liked these. I lightly drizzled home-made caramel over them and they were delicious with a cup of tea. Thanks for sharing the recipe. Made for ZWT6 Zingo.
I loved this dish! The blend of ingredients tastes wonderful. I look forward to making this again. Thanks for sharing the recipe.
I followed your instructions exactly and it resulted in a wonderful roasted chicken. DH said it was the best I had ever made. Thanks for sharing this excellent recipe!
This made a hearty and scrumptious breakfast. We all loved it. Thanks for posting.
A great, easy recipe for a delicious lunch, with a salad. A perfect meal! Thanks for posting.
A hearty and delicious breakfast. Everyone like it very much and had seconds. Thanks for posting this recipe. We will make it often.
I made this as part of a Sunday brunch and it was wonderful. I will be making it again soon, as all of the ingredients are family favorites. Thanks for sharing the recipe.
We had these today for breakfast, topped with a little butter and manuka honey. Delicious! Thanks for posting the recipe.
We all loved these. The crumb is so tender. I served them with fresh mixed berries and powdered sugar. I will make these often. Thanks for posting.
We enjoyed this dish very much. The spice was just right for us and I will definitely make this again. Thanks for posting the recipe.

We liked this very much. In fact it was completely finished in about 3 minutes. It is a cooling and delicious side to have with Indian food that is heavily spiced or hot from red pepper or chilies. I could eat this all by itself and be very happy. Thanks for posting the recipe.

The curry powder, ginger and coconut milk made this soup a wonderful change from the regular red lentil soup I make all the time. It was even better the next day. I will definitely make this again. Thanks for sharing the recipe.
A delicious drink. I was a little worried about the amount of tequila, but it was just the right amount. I served with a pineapple spear in the glass. Thanks for sharing a great recipe.
I added extra honey and baked them in mini muffin tins. Delicious! Thanks for sharing the recipe.

This was served as part of a Greek style buffet, for a couple who don't like vegetables in their food. It was gone in minutes. Everyone loved it. I wish I had doubled the recipe. Thanks for a tasty and super quick to prepare dish.
Great flavor! I added 2 sautéed shallots to the mix. Served as part of a Greek style buffet, with a dollop of tzaziki on top. They were all eaten up quick. Thanks for the recipe.
Great flavor. I will use this for green salad, pasta salad and over tuna. A very versatile recipe. Thanks for sharing it.

This is a delicious salad that comes together in minutes. I used red, yellow and green striped tomatoes from my garden. I also used 1 tbsp  fresh oregano from my garden. This was served as part of a Greek buffet style meal for a family party. There wasn't one piece left. I made it again the next day. So good.

I knew this would be good, but it was even better than expected. I served this as part of a Greek buffet meal. I doubled the recipe and even so, none left over. I will make this again next week, it's that good, with a baked chicken. Thanks for the recipe.

I made this in the early morning. The plan was to serve it later, after dinner. The house smelled so good and it looked so scrumptious when it came out of the over, that it became breakfast! We ate half the cake in one sitting, with lots of coffee. Thanks for sharing a great recipe.
I made these with 1 tbsp fresh dill, cut finely, instead of the cumin. Delicious and easy to make. Thanks for sharing the recipe.
I made this for lunch today, but I added 1 rib of celery, finely minced and 2 radishes, finely minced. Delicious!

Wonderful oatmeal - better than one I make which is similar to this. I will make this often since we love oatmeal. I use steel-cut oatmeal, so I adjust cooking time and liquid accordingly. I thought the level of sweetness was perfect. Thanks for sharing the recipe.
This is a great spice blend. I mixed one tbsp with 2 tbsp olive oil and 1/4 c grated onion to marinate my chicken kabobs. Excellent flavor. Thanks for sharing the recipe.
Excellent flavor! We made this as part of a North African buffet meal and every bit of it was gobbled up. I will use this recipe often. Thanks for sharing it with us.
Very tasty and so easy to make at the last minute when you need a side for dinner. I added 1/4 tsp dried ground ginger. Thanks for sharing the recipe.

I made this chicken as part of a North African brunch. The flavor was fantastic, though I thought it might be overpowering when I read the recipe. Not at all. Not one piece was left and I tripled the recipe. Thanks for sharing the recipe.

I made this up, browned chicken thighs separately, put the chicken in a greased baking dish with the couscous all around the chicken, covered with foil and baked it. The couscous absorbed the chicken juices and stayed moist. We loved this! Thanks for sharing the recipe.
Very flavorful corn! I made this for a North African buffet lunch and everyone loved it. Thanks for sharing the super easy and delicious recipe.
Wonderful recipe that will be used again and again. The spice blend is just perfect. Thanks for sharing the recipe.

This is a delicious way to serve eggs. My oven must run hot, because they were done in 10 minutes. I served them with sliced tomatoes, fresh from the garden. A wonderful breakfast. Thanks for sharing the recipe.

This was the perfect side dish to Recipe #503644 #503644. I needed an orzo that didn't have its own strong flavor and this was perfect. Very tasty and nice with the fish. I will make this again. Thanks for sharing the recipe.

Yikes! This will certainly get you wide awake in the morning. First time I ever tried coffee with chicory. I love coffee and usually drink about 3 cups of black coffee per day. I couldn't drink it without adding a package of Splenda, and even then I think this is an acquired taste.
Terrific recipe for grilled corn on the cob. It was so simple to make and what flavor! This one's a keeper, for sure. Thanks for sharing the recipe.

It's been so hot here that I used this for a cold pasta salad. I used 1/4 cup fresh basil leaves, added in 2 garlic cloves and mixed it with 1 lb penne. I added 1/2 c pasta water to loosen it up a little more. I garnished the pasta salad with halved cherry tomatoes and sliced black olives. It was great. Thanks for sharing the recipe.

After a light lunch, I wanted a good, quick snack for the family a few hours later, so I made these on whole wheat english muffin halves. They were enjoyed by all. A good combination of flavors in these. Thanks for sharing the recipe.

I served this at room temperature and liked the combination of flavors, but I felt it was missing something as far as seasoning. I might try it again and spice it up a bit. It has the potential to  be a great side dish. Thanks for sharing the recipe.
I marinated the chicken for 2 hrs. What terrific flavor! This was a huge hit. Thanks for sharing the recipe.

This was a good quesadilla. I loved the spinach and black beans together. I did not care for the pine nuts which didn't really suit the quesadilla IMHO. Next time will add jalapenos in their place as it was a little plain. Served with fat free sour cream and salsa.
Good quesadilla.  I used jack cheese and made in the panini press.  I topped with salsa and roasted jalapenos.
Excellent sauce for broccoli.  I used light sour cream and half the butter and it was still quite good.  Reviewed for PAC 2008.
Tasty pasta dish.  I subbed farfalle for the pasta and added kalamata olives and crushed red pepper flakes. For PAC.

Just as good as any restaurant.  I partially froze the steak to make it easy to slice super thin.  I also added red bell pepper because I had a partial left over in the fridge.  I also subbed red onion slices for green onion because it's what I had on hand.  Excellent.  For Aussie Swap.

These were tasty.  The mustard added a great flavor.  I overcooked them accidently so were a little dry, but that was my fault not Chef Potts.  I liked the idea of individual ramekins.  Be sure to spray them well with Pam as mine really stuck.  I used skim milk which proabably also lead to the dry texture.  Still, overall, good.
Gracious, how can something so easy be soooo good?  I love these little snacks.  Just making a few could be a great light lunch too.

Another Puppitypup great recipe.  Very good for dinner, but even better using the leftovers in a tortilla microwaved with salsa.  Being the good southern girl that I am, I used the bacon grease instead of butter.  For ZWT.
wonderful twist on yogurt.  I love almonds in my yogurt.  I did sub craisins instead of raisins.

Wonderful addition to my steak tonight.  I did really venture off and subbed cilantro for the parsely.  One because it's what I had on hand, two because I love it, and three it seems more relevant to South America.  Excellent results, highly recommend.  For  ZWT.

What a wonderful dinner.  I made the potatoes and onions ahead of time so dinner came together quickly.  This has so many possibilities, tomato and basil, peppers and sausage, etc could be added for variation.  Really satisying meal.  Cooked EVERTHING in the cast iron skillet and just set aside until ready to assemble, so one skillet, gotta love it.

The PERFECT rub.  It really is a complete balance of flavors, none overpower the other.  I quartered the recipe and still have enough for several more steaks (chicken, pork, etc), so beware it makes plenty.  For ZWT.
Great potatoes.  I cut mine into cubes and also just tossed all with olive oil then sprinkled on suggested spices. Also used chile flavored oil.  Really good.  For ZWT.

I love my salmon spicy and sweet.  Absolutely fabulous.  I accidently used chipotle powder instead of chili powder but had great results so will make it this way again.  For ZWT.  WONDERFUL, highly recommend.

This sounded so good, it just didn't quite meet my expectations.  It was good, just not great.  I used roasted potatoes cut in cubes.  Sounds great, just not what I expected; others should definitely give it a try.
Perfect appy!  I did sub kalamata olives as a personal preference and used a hot pepper infused olive oil.  I expected this be good, but it really exceeded all expectations.

Perfectly wonderful dish. Perfect balance of spicy, sweet, salty, crunchy. I just added all of the dressing at once with great success. I added some grated carrots to this as well and did not add the chef's optional veggies.  Note for others, be sure you have a VERY large bowl to toss this together as the ingredients tend to jump right out :)
I really liked these potatoes.  I subbed dill for chervil.  LOVED the lemon/dill combo.  Wasnt' sure what a "chat" potato was so used baby reds.  For aussie tag.
Steak, great.  Potatoes, fabulous.  Sauce...not my favorite.  The sauce, to me, really over powered the meat and potatoes.  Good luck :)
Great, precise instructions.  For Aussie Swap.

I too used to work in a hospital that had a grilled cheese/tomato sandwich that I loved.  Of course, it was in TX and rye or pumpernickle was an unknown :)  Everything on white.  I rarely eat butter any more, but am so glad I made this as directed.  Wonderful, crunchy, salty.  I did use reduced fat swiss ant two slices of tomatoes per sandwich.  Perfect sandwich.

5+ stars.  This had an amazing complexity of layered flavors that worked perfectly together.  The salty marinade with a crispy skin topped with the spicy, sweet sauce was amazing.  I used chicken leg quarters so cooked for only one hour (also didn't use the rack and water method, just placed skin side down in pam sprayed pan for 30 minutes, then basted with marinade and flipped to skin side up for last 30 minutes).  I used just regular sugar and rice wine vinegar vs white wine vinegar.  Also, I did not debone.  I just cut some slits through the skin before topping with the sauce.  This was super simple, yet elegant, and best of all absolutely delicious.

Since it is 18 degrees here, I cooked these inside with great results.  Instead of butter used a chile infused olive oil which was really wonderful.  I was a little leary about using lemon on these; to me just didn't sound too good.  So I tried without they were good, added the lemon that sent them over the top.

Had this on the table in < 10 minutes including making the sauce!  The key is to get the butter really hot to make the fish nicely browned and to give a nice nutty flavor to the sauce.  I used mahi mahi fillet with great results.  Super simple, yet delicious fish recipe.  Also, I just seasoned fish, then dredged in flour.

This was a good marinade.  I loved that I had everything in the pantry for this marinade.  As a garlic lover it shocks me to say this, but I think the garlic here was a little too strong.  I will revisit this recipe but cut back on the garlic, or perhaps sub garlic powder.  This was amazingly tender, whether due to the cut of meat or marinade I'm not sure, but terrific nonetheless.

The first bite was...different.  I'm not accumstomed to crunch with teriyaki, however by bite number two it had me!  The juxtaposition of crunch and sweet teriyaki was terrific.  I used a ginger teriyaki sauce and wheat thin crackers.  Chicken cutlets cooked very quickly so made a super simple, quick dinner entree.  For 123.

Rarely do I do a marinade for a steak as I usually prefer a dry rub.  However, I am so glad I tried this this.  It had the perfect balance of flavors;  salty from the soy sauce, tangy from the vinegar, and flavorful from the garlic and mustard.  I marinated 48 hours and then drained about two hours before cooking.  Since we had a storm come through tonight I seared in a cast iron skillet with great results.  Cooked on high heat for about 4 minutes per side for a rare to medium rare delmonico cut.

Really good potatoes.  I followed directions until the final cooking method.  Since I had salmon in the oven I put the potatoes, seasoning, onion in a cast iron skillet that I had preheated in oven with some oil.  So these cooked up just in time with Recipe #95376.

Excellent perfectly tender pork chops.  I served over  brown rice which is strongly suggested to soak up the great sauce this makes.  I used El Pato brand Mexican tomato sauce so mine had a little zip.  I also added two zucchini to boost the veggie intake.  Really wonderful and simple dinner.
Great drink for a dessert as it quite sweet.

This reminded me of a recipe my MIL used to make but she used green chiles.  This was much better because it had some zip.  I used a combination of roasted red jalepenos and regular green.  I used red onion and halved the cheese amount to reduce some the fat.  Cutting into 64 squares would be a challenge unless you let it cool.  These are even good at room temperature.  Funny...I have this same cookbook and had never made this recipe.
Awesome potatoes.  I used FRESH rosemary vs. dried herbs and just hand chopped.  These turned out wonderfully.

Good gracious, these were doglicious.  I did have to cook longer than the stated time, but I had them broiling on the second rack so I didn't have to watch so closely.  I am so glad I have leftover onion as these were superb--sweet with a zip.  I plan on either topping chicken or pork chops with them; they would also be terrific on hamburgers.  I would strongly suggest making extra onions when making these as they are perfect.  Instead of chipotle chile and sauce, I just used chipotle sauce (Bufalo brand).

Made my very selective process of best of 2009 cookbook.  Really wonderful, low fat, healthy meal.  I grated the ginger and just before adding the fish deglazed the pan with about one tablespoon of red wine.  Superb.  Served on roasted asparagus with sweet potatoes.  First time to cook with shitake and they turned out wonderfully.  I used whole, except cutting in half the larger ones.

Hearty meal and delicious.  I used a hot chili infused oil that had dried chilies in it so omitted the additional.  I added some parmesan.  Also added asparagus to make a one dish dinner.  Had the wine out to add; remembered to drink some wine but totally forgot to add to dish.  :)  Used whole wheat pasta.  Great, simple, quick dinner.  For 123 tag.

Another terrific recipe from weekend cooker! Can't go wrong with this chef.  I did goof and once I started making realized I had no onion flakes so subbed onion powder, also thought I bought swiss but instead had mozzarella.  Still terrific.  I cut up for a group into 16 small squares.  Neat the way the bread sort of bubbles/plumps up.  Terrific!  Another reviewer mentioned adding fruit.  This could be really good making as a Monte Cristo and topping with powdered sugar and serving with syrup.  For zaar stars.

I added one chopped onion to meat as it cooked.  Next time will top with chopped tomatoes and jalapenos and/or salsa. I added boullion cubes to the pasta water then just used this as the broth/water. For PAC.

Great potatoes.  I STRONGLY suggest spraying the foil with Pam as mine really stuck.  I subbed Lawry's seasoned salt for the Montreal, garlic, and paprika.  Aside from the sticking these could not have been better.

These were quite good.  However, they needed to cook for about 40 min vs. the 20 posted.  Also, was not really a fan of the cinnamon.  However, having said this, these are good sweet potatoes.  LOVED the onion with them.  Will revisit this recipe omitting the cinamon.

Really terrific flavors for this shrimp.  Game time decision decided to sear in skillet versus grill because these shrimp were smaller than I thought.  Kitten has a great suggestion for fresh vs. frozen shrimp, but for years have found if I thaw, then peel, then set on paper towels in fridge it drains ALL the moister off so marinades "stick".   For 123.
Panko made this spectacular!  Great dish!
Terrific.  I love potatoes and rosemary together.

WOW!  This was amazing!  I cooked inside; baked 420 degrees for 12 minutes and it was PERFECT.  Instead of cooking the scallions, I topped when the fish was done.  This really was a fabulous dish.  And is my norm...sorry not really a measurer but an estimator....worked out great.

Terrific roasted potatoes. Served with grilled steak. When getting the kalamata olives the roasted peppers looked good so I added some in to the mix as well. Didn't have parsley and didn't miss it. Didn't peel since I HATE that task. Great side dish. For ZWT 2009.

Yowza! Scotch bonnet peppers do make these hot, but I love heat. So good, no sauce needed as these are so flavorful all on their own. I made for an entree and served two. Used orange peppers so looked beautiful with the color of the shrimp.  I used frozen raw shrimp and they were perfectly cooked.  Served just slightly warmer than room temp. For ZWT.
Good guac.  I increased the cilantro because I really like cilantro.

I thought this would be okay...it was TERRIFIC.  I used fat free sour cream so mine was a little on the thin side consistency wise, but didn't miss the fat flavor at all.  Personally, I think the sauce portion is more like for four as just a couple of teaspoons was more than adequate on my strawberries (5)and peaches (1)  I had for breakfast this morning.

Good dish.  I deglazed the pan with some red wine which really worked nicely.  Topped with parmesan.  Divided into two dishes and froze one before baking.  I'll post later how that turned out.  For 123.
Very nice, easy pasta dish with ingredients that are readily available.  I did preseason the chicken with Paul Prudhomme's for a little spice.

My butcher only had sausage patties so instead made a topping vs. stuffing.  By no fault of the recipe or chef, but by my personal taste the sausage was very rich to be cooked on the grill.  I had never had sausage cooked this way and am acustomed to having sausage in sauces, not just grilled.  I would like to try this on keilbasa or hot dogs because the cheese/onion mixture was very good.

Fabulous burger.  I made just one portion so omitted the egg and put about a dash of everything else which worked out wonderfully.  Ever since this chef reviewed one of my burger recipes and suggested the dimple formation I have used that technique and burgers always turn out soooo much better and easier to serve in a bun; EXCELLENT tip.

These turned out quite good.  I made a few changes. Used 1 lb meat, 1/4 c onion, 1 egg, and 3/4 cup rice, 1 can tomatoes with 3 peppers which I halved.  Eyeballed the seasonings and used tobasco worcesteshire sauce.  Didn't prebake peppers, cooked covered 40 minutes then uncovered with cheese for ten.  Received rave reviews.

Very similar to the way my mom makes them.  I grated the onion on a microplane so I could use a piping bag to fill the whites.  I was thrilled to find three double yolked eggs in my batch, so upped the mayo just a touch.  Since I like a lot of filling per egg, I fill 11 egg halves and my dog gets the odd white left.  Classic recipe and very tasty.  Also used red wine vinegar because that's all I had.

Great pork chops.  I grilled them.  Next time will chop the rosemary as I wasn't thrilled with the whole leaves after grilling (sort of tough and crunchy).  The sugar made for a nice carmelization on the grill.
For a lighter version, I really didn't miss anything on taste.  I used chicken cutlets so chicken cooked much quicker.  For 123.
One word...amazing. I used fresh grated ginger. At these cooking times it was definitely medium rare, which I like for salmon.
The title says it all.
Simple and good.  I used fresh broccoli and it turned out wonderfully.
Nice steak recipe and was great to cook indoors since raining here.  Next time will probably omit the bread.
Absolutely fabulous steak.  I grilled rib eyes on gas grill high heat for three minutes per side for medium rare perfection.  Will definitely make this again!!  For 123.
One word, AMAZING.  I used chocolate covered coffee beans, as this was all I had.  Received rave review from the guests served.
Made for weekend guests and it received rave reviews.  Quite hardy so served on mini bagels.

These were good.  I had premade tostadas so saved me that step.  Sour cream is must as another reviewer mentioned.  The meat/bean mixture would also be wonderful on nachos with cheese melted in the broiler.
This was an amazing quiche.  Very creamy in the middle after 50 minutes, but fabulous nonetheless.  Used 3 roma tomatoes. One of the best quiches I have ever had.

Oui, oui, c'est bon!  I took another reviewer's advice and cooked the fish right in the sauce without straining.  Delicious!  Served with broccoli which really was wonderful with the sauce as well.  Salmon was my fish of choice.

This was absolutley fantastic!  For the Eastern Mixed spice I used a dash each of: cumin, coriander, cinnamon, ginger, black pepper.  The tomato sauce was perfection.  I did use an Egyption packaged rice mix and left the chicken thick cut instead of pounding out.  Thanks for posting a quick and easy dish that still manages to have a great complex layering of flavors.

Wonderful dinner.  I used less olive oil and butter and omitted the chick stock for a nice thick lemony sauce.  Also removed chicken then made the sauce to pour over for serving so chicken a little crispness.  Fabulous.
These were good.  I used boneless, skinless, thighs.  To me the honey came over a little too sweet, next time will up the dijon and reduce the honey.  Thanks for posting.

Perfection on a plate.  These were so easy yet were amazing.  Next time will add some capers.  Thought the sauce would be a little thicker, but still fab.  Put the chops in the sauce for the final five minutes of cooking.  Made it to my book #269572
Served with hamburgers and were delicious.  No clean up and easy, love it.

These were good.  I am a huge fan of roasted veggies.  I have to say, surprisingly, the potatoes were dry and the parsnips (one or two) were not completely cooked through).  I also would recommend peeling the garlic.  I will revisit this recipe but maybe add more oil next time and roast higher heat for shorter period.  Overall good though.
Made a delightful steak.  The lemon seemed a little strong to me so may omit zest next time.

Superb!!!  I used fresh cilantro instead of coriander and siracha instead of pepper flakes.  This was absolutely wonderful  I made with Recipe #225645 and strongly suggest the combo; cool peanut noodles with spicy, sweet, salty, hot steak.  Miss my teammates already!!!
Amazing.  I subbed cayenne for cumin for a great salty, sweet, spicy taste.
Perfect summer lunch.  I used a scant amount of olive oil to really make a crisp sandwich.

Great flavors.  Next time will add some sliced Thai chiles or jalapenos for a little zip.  I had to add quite a bit of water to get the right consistency.  I omitted the peanuts as a personal preference.

Great flavor! I really enjoyed the hints of the shallot and wine. The flavors were delicious and not overpowering. The only thing I would change is the thickness of the soup. Next time, I'll add more flour to get a thicker consistency. Great soup..thanks!

Definitely worthy of a 5 star rating! We loved the flavor chicken. Put that sauce over it and it's 'over the top'! Great sauce and so handy to make in the microwave. My family loved this recipe. I'm going to try it with seasoned bread crumbs next time.
Tip: I love using my food processor to chop the pecans..works like a charm.  Thanks for this recipe!!

5 plus stars for the flavor!!! I'm giving it 4 stars because the consistency, for me, turned out too thin. I'll have to experiment with the consistency because I WILL be making these pancakes a lot. My kids flipped over the flavor. In fact, I'm craving them right now. Love the pecans and the hint of cinnamon. So yummy. I really liked the honey raspberry syrup, but my kids just wanted plain ol' syrup..go figure.  Thanks for the yummy breakfast. :-)

What a yummy recipe this was! Great flavor combinations. My family really enjoyed the flavor. My only complaint is that the sauce was a bit too thin and didn't really stick to the pasta. Other than that, it was awesome!

We really loved these muffins. There were a lot of steps, but nothing overwhelming. I loved the idea for the strawberry butter. It was fantastic.  My muffins were done before 20 minutes..so I'm thinking I'll reduce the heat to 350 degrees when making these again. Thank you for the yummy muffins!

Simple, easy and very tasty. We enjoyed this chicken very much. Next time (personal preference here) I will use more pecans and a little less flour to dredge the chicken breasts. The raspberry sauce was a lovely touch. Thanks!

My family loved the taste of these waffles. Easy to put together, too! Great flavor...love the addition of pecans and raspberry preserves..yum! The only difficulty I had was that the batter kept wanting to stick to my waffle iron. Next time, more spray oil!  My waffles were done faster than avg.  Thanks for the great recipe!

I have never met a potato that I didn't like and this is absolutely no exception! Sooooooo yummy and soooooooooo easy.  Just make sure not to overcook the potatoes or they will fall apart. This not only tasted wonderful but also look beautiful with the fresh parsley, chives & lemon zest. The flavor was bright and clean and hit the comfort zone. Thanks , Andi!!

What a great way to have "deep fried" shrimp without all the fat!! I love the idea and technique. The shrimp come out crispy and tasty. The only thing I'll change  next time is to omit the Old Bay seasoning, since we didn't like that flavor peeking through. We thought it detracted from the shrimp flavor. I served them with some homemade cocktail sauce and a green salad. Yum.

These were really great chicken chimis. Especially since they were done with a healthier cooking method!  The tortillas still get a bit crispy since they are baked at 425 degrees...very nice! I think what made them extra special was the sauce. It was rich and thick with just a lil kick. Very nice recipe. Thanks, bmnichol. :-)

~PAC Spring 2008~ Simple and delicious. I used pita bread for my base. It took about 3 minutes under the broiler. I like this recipe because I usually have all these ingredients at home and can whip up a yummy lunch in no time.

~PAC Spring 2008~  This is a delicious, different and healthy way to enjoy french fries. My husband thought they tasted a bit like Arby's curly fries (although, they're a whole lot healthier!). We enjoyed these very much and will certainly be making them again!

~PAC Spring 2008~ This recipe provided us with a delicious one-dish meal. The chicken has a lovely flavor and roasts up beautifully, thanks to the honey and mustard (I used regular yellow mustard). And who wouldn't love roasted potatoes and carrots?!  I followed the recipe as written; adding salt & pepper to the chicken. Fabulous dinner!

This is a delicious pasta salad. It is simple and I appreciate how the star ingredients are able to shine through. Incidentally, this is a wonderful use for those garden tomatoes and basil. The dressing is simple and pure- tasting. I really love the hint of oregano. 
~Made for the Aussie/NZ September Swap~

Delicious salmon recipe! I enjoyed the Asian flavoring for a nice change from our usual salmon recipe. This was very easy to pull together. It is wonderful served over the rice.  Thank you! :)
~Made for the Sept. Aussie/NZ Swap~

This is a lovely recipe for homemade scones. The instructions are clear and easy to follow. I used dried cherries, since that is what I had on hand. I think raisins or cranberries would be good, too.  My kids enjoyed these scones for breakfast!  Thank you. :)
5 star crock pot recipe. The chicken was fall-off-the-bone tender. It also had really good flavor notes. In my book, that makes it a definite repeat when I need a crock pot recipe. Thanks!

Great recipe for a healthier version of fried chicken. The breasts were flavorful and moist. I used bone-in breasts. After baking them, I cut into slices and served atop lettuce spritzed with casear dressing. My whole family loved this as a meal! Thank you.
~Made for Every Day is a Holiday Tag~

Fantastic mashed potato recipe. The texture is smooth and silky. The flavor is great..love the taste of chives. Thanks for a great recipe!
~Made for Went to the Market Tag Game~

Very good, solid recipe for chinese beef with broccoli. The steak was nice and tender, due to slicing thin & pounding. Nice technique. I served over rice. The only thing I would do differently is to use half the amount of oyster sauce. I could taste too much of that ingredient. Thanks for a great, authentic recipe!

Good oatmeal variation for the health conscious. I think I would double the recipe for a single serving next time. Thank you for posting!
~Potluck Tag~
There were very tasty muffins! The banana and oat flavors really pulled through and made these very yummy. The muffins are very easy and quick to prepare. Made and reviewed for 123 Hit Wonders.

WONDERFUL crock pot recipe!!!
The meat is so flavorful and moist and the veggies turn out perfectly. I was a little worried about the flavor combinations of the flavor packets but they work together magically. You've got to give this recipe a try!!

I LOVED this recipe. More importantly, my whole family loved it. I was surprised because my husband doesn't like mayo...he either didn't guess it was in there or didn't care! I give this recipe even more credit for being very budget conscious. I opted to serve this in tortilla wraps and took them for a 'to-go' type dinner - on one of those ultra busy nights. I halved all of the ingredients and still had plenty to serve 4 people. If you are looking for an EASY and INEXPENSIVE dinner or lunch, this would be the perfect recipe.

What a creative recipe! I love the use of ramen noodles in the meatballs. I thought this recipe was easy to put together, tasty and easy on the budget. I liked how some healthy veggies were 'hidden' in the meatballs. The only improvement I would suggest is to ramp up the spicing a bit more...maybe more garlic and Italian spices.  Thanks for such a creative and cost-effective dinner idea!

This is so satisfying and yummy. Not many crockpot recipe are worthy of 5 stars for taste, in my opinion. This one is definitely worthy. I followed the recipe exactly and it was done perfectly. I served it over biscuits. It did remind me of a chicken pot pie. :-)

This recipe made it into book#234156!
FANTASTIC! My kids said, "Mom, this is just like cruise food" - which is the biggest compliment at our house. It's not a hard recipe to make either! Notes: I only used about 1/4 cup bread crumbs because I didn't want to lose the flavor of the crab and shrimp. It worked great with that amt. I'm thinking it will be possible to cut back on the butter next time because there is a great deal of it (which really isn't a bad thing!). Also, I'd recommend using a baking dish with sides instead of the baking sheet , due to the melted butter. This recipe gets 10 plus stars in my book. LOVED IT!!!

This recipe made it into book#234156!
Wow, was this ever good. My whole family gave it the 'thumbs up'. I'm always pleased to find a recipe that is simple AND tastes great. The recipe couldn't be easier to make and only has 5 ingredients. The chicken comes out very moist, protected by the crunchy coating. The stuffing mix (I used Peppridge Farm) mixed with the melted butter really imparts a wonderful flavor. It's reminiscent of the tastes of Thanksgiving! This is going into my weeknight cooking family favorites file. Thanks!! ~Made for the Aussie/NZ October Swap~

This recipe made it into book#234156!
~PAC Spring 2008~ FANTASTIC!!!!! What a delicious meal this recipe provided. The zucchini sticks are downright addictive! I halved the cheese sauce amount and it was more than enough. In fact, I will probably omit the cheese sauce from now on because the chicken and zucchini are outstanding on their own. The pretzel flavoring pairs wonderfully here. Don't skip the thyme, it adds just a hint of flavor that is perfect. I would also suggest grinding up the pretzels VERY WELL. If you don't, it won't adhere as well to the chicken & zucchini. I used a package of regular pretzel rods. Excellent recipe!!!!! :-)

This recipe made it into book#234156!
FABULOUS!! If I could give this 10 stars, I would. Some comments from my family: "This is delicious" ; "I LOVE it" ; and a two thumbs up because someone was too busy eating to talk. In my opinion, I did not think the recipe was at all difficult or time-consuming to put together. I recommend putting together the sauce and prepping the topping ingredients before starting on the fish. Don't skimp on any of the suggested toppings - the combination is what really makes this whole recipe stand out. The sauce is EXCELLENT...love it. I used plain greek yogurt (low fat) along with the mayo, jarred chopped garlic & fresh cilantro. Other notes: 1. For 4 people, I halved the fish & batter amts. but left the sauce amt. the same - it was perfect. 2. We tried it with both corn and flour tortillas and everyone here voted for the flour tortillas (the corn tasted too dry and was too crumbly for us). 3. Cutting the cod into "index finger size pcs" is a great recommendation. It seems too small at first, but once dipped in the batter and fried they are plenty big. 4. I used Killians Irish Red beer and loved it. 5. I didn't have Mexican oregano so I used Italian and it was fine. 6. I used canola oil for frying to make it as healthy as possible. This recipe will be made again and again. So yummy. Thank you! ~Made for Aussie/NZ Swap~

This recipe made it into book#234156!
 I wish I could rate this with 10 stars. It is fantastic!!!! It has that special "wow" factor in both presentation and taste. I had family coming for an overnight visit so I prepared the recipe the day before and put it in the fridge. In the morning, I just heated the oven and the breakfast was a breeze. I served this with toast and some fruit and yogurt. Everyone was so impressed and loved the taste. It is very filling, too! Since I love potatoes, I used 6 instead of 4. I used some good quality ham found near the deli department. The brie and ham combo...mmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmm. I thought it was such a pretty presentation with the eggs nestled into the mixture. I forgot about the paprika but I loved it as it was. If you like your egg yolks a little bit runny (like I do) , I would suggest checking them after 10 minutes instead of 15. Don't wait for company to try this breakfast, treat yourself!!!!

5 star recipe all the way. Fantastic. The beef was full of flavor, due to the marinating and made such a lovely dinner. I served it with: brown rice, salad and pita bread. Such an easy recipe with impressive results. Personal note: I will only use 1 cup of olive oil in the marinade next time. I think it should be plenty and will give the other marinade ingredients even more punch. I also may marinate them for a longer period of time.
We just loved this recipe. Thank you so much for posting!!!

We loved these! I had to make my own maple syrup crystals since I couldn't find the maple sugar. It was really simple to make - just added an extra step. Now I have some crystals saved for the next few times I make these!  I scrambled my eggs in coffee mugs, using the microwave (only about 1 min. for each egg).  These are delicious and worth every step!!

The orange sauce is really delicious in this recipe. It is not overpowering, just a subtle orange flavoring that complements the pork very well.  This is a nice and different way of serving pork tenderloin. Thank you for posting!
I made these for healthy snacks for this week. They were very easy to prepare. I enjoy the slightly spicy flavoring and the crispiness. Thank you for posting such a healthful snack recipe. :)

I made this for my daughter who has been having a rough week. I picked her up from school and handed her a thermos filled with this cocoa. (She loves hot cocoa and will often make some of the instant variety for herself.) She took one sip and said, "Ohhhhhhhh this is so good. What kind is it?" I was happy to reply that it was homemade. Yummy recipe and receives a definite 5 star rating from my daughter. :)

What a nice little after dinner treat! I loved the hint of chocolate and of course the yummy whipped cream, which slowly melted into the coffee. Next time I might lessen the amount of Grand Marnier and add a bit more chocolate. Great drink. Thanks!

My husband cannot stop eating these cookies. They are buttery, crispy and coconut-flavored. A delicious cookie recipe. Mine did seem to flatten and spread too much, I'm not sure why. It did not affect the flavor one bit, though! Thank you!

This is a great burger recipe! The grilled balsamic onions and the special chipotle ketchup help to put this burger "over-the-top". The ketchup has just enough spice and complements the burger very nicely. I LOVE the grilled onions. I didn't add all of the balsamic to the onions (I probably added about 1 T.) because I thought the onions were delicious even before adding the balsamic.  I opted for whole wheat hamburger buns. I used my grill pan indoors because it's still winter. I can't wait to grill these burgers outside!  Thank you!

I will never buy red wine vinegar from the store again! I had no idea making red wine vinegar could be as simple as combining red wine and, go figure, vinegar! I used some of this and combined it with a little olive oil, salt & pepper to top my green salad. YUM! I made a larger batch and have it stored for future use. twissis, thank you for posting this little gem!

We loved the flavoring of these chicken breasts, due to the coating. I used 3 rather large boneless/skinless chicken breasts and sliced them each (lengthwise) in half, so they were thin. I also added a little bit of olive oil to the pan - in addition to the nonstick spray. The coating adhered perfectly to the chicken and made for a flavorful and crunchy coating. This is a great "go-to" meal for a busy weeknight dinner. Thank you!

This gets 5 stars for it's ease in preparation and the fact that it is pure comfort food. You can literally put this together and be eating within about  15 minutes. I opted to not add the black olives, since I'm the only one in my family who likes them. Also, I didn't use the Muir Glen brand of pasta sauce. I used a generic tomato/basil.  Thanks so much for posting this easy peasy recipe.

This was super tasty couscous! I loved the addition of black olives, parsley, garlic and lemon zest. It made for much more flavor interest. Next time, I will increase the amt. of garlic and try chicken broth (personal preferences).  I highly recommend this recipe. It's both tasty and a pretty side dish to serve!
These are delicious rolls and sooooo easy! This is a great way to make rolls that taste like they are homemade. No one has to know how easy they are!

What a yummy snack I had today, thanks to this recipe. I love triscuits for snacking and this gives me another alternative for when I want something a little more. The flavors of cream cheese, tomato, green onion and Italian dressing meld so well together.   Next time, I may try heating the topping in the microwave (as 2bleu did) and serve it as a dip! Thanks!

Fantastic salad! As other reveiwers have stated, the dressing is wonderful. It is herby, creamy, fresh and figure-friendly! What's not to love?  I also really enjoyed the salad ingredients. It contains some of my favorites: avocado, bacon, tomato, cucs, cheese...wow!  Thank you for a yummy salad recipe. :)

I think I have a new favorite way of making and eating green beans! I'm a huge fan of sesame oil & seeds, so I knew I'd probably enjoy this recipe. The brown sugar is a bonus, adding such wonderful flavor. The recipe is very easy to prepare and didn't take me the whole 27 minutes. Great green bean recipe! :)

My family loved this complete dinner. The directions are perfect and the outcome is a delicious meal. I love to roast veggies and chicken and this is an easy way to do so. There is nice flavoring due to the broth/herb mixture. The chicken gets a nice crispy skin and stays moist on the inside. This is going to be put into a regualar rotation. Thanks!

Cheese lovers unite! This is a very easy and cheesy mac & cheese recipe. I halved the recipe and used the 1 can of cheddar cheese soup. I think next time, if halving the recipe, I'll still use 2 cans of the soup because we love that creamy texture with our mac & cheese. Thanks for sharing a winner!
I knew I liked that Michelle Obama. These are really yummy.  I think the lemon and orange flavors made this shortbread special. Let it be known, these cookies are sweet! A little goes a long way. :)

I thought this was a fantastic, meatless main dish (I used it for my lunch). Using fresh tomatoes and spinach make this very flavorful. A few notes: I didn't cook the sauce mixture for the full amount of time and I didn't use the full amount of feta cheese.  This is a great, healthy recipe. Easy, too!

Fantastic steak recipe. I made as directed but used New York strip steaks. The rub is nice and peppery, which we love. The ancho chile and ground red pepper give it just the right amount of spice and heat, but not too much. My husband went back for seconds and even remarked today (a day later), "man, that was a great steak".  I grilled mine on the outdoor grill and made sure to keep them a nice medium rare.

Fantastic drink! I, too, used fresh strawberries because I happened to have some. I'm not much of a hard liquor person but I really loved this and will make it again. Thank you for the treat after a hard day!!

Excellent Piri Piri sauce. Simple to make and it packs a flavor punch!! Nice and spicy. I used it in a chicken recipe with rice. I have enough left over to it for basting & grilling chicken next time. ~Made for ZWT 5~

Lovely salad! We enjoyed the combination of oranges, black olives and red onions. The dressing is lightly flavored and complements the salad perfectly. 
Delish! Made for ~ZWT 5~

I loved the combination of flavors in this salad. Plus, it's a stunning presentation. This worked very well using a store-bought cooked chicken and made for a fast dinner. I love the sesame oil taste and wouldn't change a thing in the dressing. Delish!
~Made for ZWT5 Epicurean Queens~

I really enjoyed these green beans. The directions were perfect. I loved the tang from the red wine vinegar and dijon mustard. The red onions were a fabulous addition. Easy recipe and tastes great. I will definitely be making these again.
~Made for ZWT5 Epicurean Queens~

I love it when an easy recipe, with mostly pantry-type ingredients, is tasty. For so few ingredients, this chicken is very flavorful! As a personal preference, next time I will add less Dijon and more honey & apricot preserves. I really loved the apricot flavor shining through!
I will put this in my make again file. :)  Merci Beaucoup! ~Made for ZWT5 - Epicurean Queens~

I really enjoyed this recipe. I ended up using a combination of flounder and sole for the fish (they taste similar) and fleur de sol for the salt. Other than that, it was made as directed. I loved the crust that formed on the outer layer of the fish. The sauce is very good and lemony.  A little goes a long way!  Note... be sure to set aside the 1 tablespoon of the flour mixture before shaking your fish in it all. 
Great recipe. Merci! ~Made for ZWT5 Epicurean Queens~

By tossing in some cooked chicken, this made for a complete, easy and very tasty meal! I was wary about adding extra sugar to the salad, but it took the flavor up a notch. I used recipe#321013 for the balsamic vinaigrette dressing. The combination and flavors were very yummy. Thanks for creating this salad, Sarah!  ~Made for Zingo during ZWT5 for the Epicurean Queens~

Another 5 star review for this recipe. What makes it a 5 star review for me is the combination of the fish, fruit salsa and coleslaw. Together, the flavor is absolutely delicious. I used a whole jalapeno in the salsa and it seemed perfect..just a hint of spicy. Next time, I'd like to make the salsa with fresh peaches. I added more cilantro in the slaw, since I love that ingredient. I offered taco shells and whole grain soft tortilla wraps. This recipe was easy and yummy. Thanks!

Very flavorful pork roast recipe here! The rub ingredient flavors complement eachother perfectly and taste great with pork. A nice combination of sweet and spicy (not too spicy). The directions were perfect. Thanks for posting!

Loved this simple yet flavorful recipe!! I used bone-in chicken thighs and drumsticks, so I grilled mine between 30-45 minutes. I started brushing on the marinade with about 15 minutes to go. GREAT flavor in the marinade. I couldn't get over that such an easy recipe could impress me so much! Delicious!!

Well, you can't get much healthier than this! This recipe is packed full of healthy indredients: spinach, walnuts, tomatoes, quinoa. I'm fairly new to using quinoa and I thought this was the best recipe I've tried so far. I really enjoyed the crunch the walnuts added. The parmesan cheese was a wonderful flavor addition. Caution - do not add too much salt to the quinoa during the cooking process because the parmesan cheese gives enough saltiness, in my opinion. Great, healthy recipe. Thanks for posting! ~Made for Veggie Swap~

What a fun and easy recipe! I would definitely serve this to overnight guests. It puffs up beautifully just like a souffle. We served ours with syrup and cinnamon. Note: I let my butter brown while melting it in the oven and so the souffle looked dark in spots. I would suggest watching your butter and taking the pan out as soon as the butter melts.

Great dressing! Easy to whip together and very flavorful. I love the creamy texture. This is much healthier than the bottled version, too.  Note: I used freshly minced onions but later realized that the chef may have meant dried minced onions.?  Either way, it turned out tasty!

Well, I love each individual ingredient here. Combined, it makes for a delicious and healthy wrap. I did use the avocado and would definitely do so again. I used a "Flat Out" whole grain wrap. Even though I only needed one wrap for lunch, I made the whole batch and combined the mixture for future use. Yum!

I'm giving this 5 stars because when a recipe is this easy and tastes great it deserves each and every star. I followed the recipe exactly and the dinner was ready in about 15 min.!  The grilled salmon was fantastic. Thank you!

We all gave these burgers a big thumbs-up. They were packed with flavor and kept juicy by the worcestershire sauce. These burgers were super simple, too. Just mix it all together and throw the burgers on the grill. We topped ours with ketchup, mayo, tomatoes and lettuce and served atop whole grain buns.

I love both couscous and roasted vegetables, so I knew I'd really love this recipe. I did grill my veggies and they turned out very nicely, but you could probably use your oven on a high temp. to roast them. I especially love the kalamata olive flavor in the finished dish. I did not add feta, but I bet that would be wonderful. Thanks for sharing! ~Made for Veggie Swap~

What a wonderful recipe to use up my summer squash from the garden! I was thrilled to have found this recipe. I used yellow squash, but may try zucchini or a combination next time. I LOVED the herb sauce. I thought that part of the recipe was just brilliant. The only changes I'll make next time are: prep the fresh breadcrumbs first (I had just used my food processor to do the herb sauce then realized that I needed it to grind up fresh bread crumbs); add less salt. I felt there was too much of a salty taste in the overall dish.
Thanks for the yummy sidedish recipe!

This got mixed reviews with my family. I loved the method of browning the chicken then roasting. It made for chicken that had a crisp outside and very tender/moist inside. However, the sauce was not to our liking. It may just be personal preference. Don't let that stop you from trying this recipe.

Fantastic and fool-proof marinade. I used it with boneless, skinless chicken breasts and then grilled. I think I'd even like it better with bone-in chicken and can't wait to try it again. Note: in my opinion, if using 4 boneless/skinless chicken breasts, you could probably half the marinade recipe. Thanks, Kitten! :)

What a lovely, rustic meal this made. I was able to use fresh tomatoes from our garden, too. I really enjoyed the slight cinnamon and clove flavoring. It made this chicken dish different. The chicken was nice and moist and, as suggested, went very well with potatoes. Thank you for posting! ~Made for TYM Tag~

We loved this flavorful soup. The biggest compliment I can give is to say that it tastes like it's full fat and cooked for hours. I used 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts (which, for us, was plenty), chopped into tiny pcs. and then halved the salt, pepper, rosemary and sage mixture. I upped the carrots to 3, since we love them in soup. I used 2 percent milk. I can't tell you how pleased I was with the result....so thick and creamy and packed with good flavor. This was the first time I used the chicken base and I think I'm hooked. Thanks for creating the great soup recipe. I will definitely be making this one again!! ~Made for the TYM tag game in the Cookbook section~

Fantastic, restaurant quality steak! The directions were written perfectly. The steak comes out tender, juicy and very flavorful. I was able to follow all directions but the southern seasoning. I used Montreal Steak Seasoning in it's place. I'm sure it's not the same thing, but I knew my husband loves that pepper seasoning on meat.  I'm very curious about ordering the southern flavoring now. Either way, this steak is delish and company-worthy! ~Made for Fall PAC~

YUM! Comfort food. Simple and delicious...pure and simple. The chicken was given so much extra flavor by: the butter/herb rub (I melted the butter), fruit/onion/garlic combination stuffed in the cavity AND the carrot and celery "rack". Delicious flavor. The chicken is crispy on the outside and stays very tender on the inside. I cut up some potatoes & drizzled with olive oil and added salt/pepper - put it on a separate pan and roasted them while the chicken was cooking. The gravy works so well and has a lovely, light consistency/flavor.

I've never done potatoes this way before. I thought they were great and I was happy that they were more on the healthy side, too! The seasonings were well balanced and added interest. Thank you for a new way to cook potatoes! ~Made for Oct. Veg*n Swap~

Perfect biscuits. They rose perfectly and were very flaky. As the title says, they are buttermilk biscuits and you do taste the buttermilk flavor. My whole family loved these. This recipe created about 24 biscuits for me. Next time, I'll roll them out to about 1/2 inch thick to produce even thicker biscuits.Thanks for the great recipe! ~Made for Oct. Aussie/NZ Swap~

Delicious soup with a very good blend of flavors. I loved the rice (I used uncooked arboria) in the meatballs. I made my meatballs a bit too large, so I've made a note to make them smaller next time.
Thanks for posting this interesting and fulfilling soup recipe! ~Made for TYM tag in the Cookbook Forum~

My whole family loved this creamy, comforting chicken recipe. The seasonings were perfect and a very nice blend of flavors. I'm glad your mom made this for you and that you shared the recipe! This is going into our weeknight rotation. I served this over brown rice. Yum!

After a long day at work, I love coming home to a quick, easy recipe to prepare for dinner. The recipe is super quick, if you prep the shrimp in advance (or buy it peeled and deveined!). The flavors are fresh, thanks to the tomatoes and basil. Simple and delicious. I used about 3/4 lb. of pasta and thought it was plenty. Next time, I think I'll wait to add my basil until the last few moments of cooking. That's the only change I'll make. This recipe is GREAT! Thank you. ~Made for TYM tag in the Cookbook Forum~

My kids thank you. This recipe is simple and very tasty. I halved the recipe and still had plenty for 4 people. This is a great side dish that I will definitely be making again and again. ~Made for the Veg*nSwap~

Fabulous! Great Asian flavor in a quick and easy wrap. I will definitely be making these again. I will probably only add about 1/4 of the crushed red pepper flakes next time, for my family. I personally loved the heat! The recipe comes together quickly. I love using the coleslaw mix and matchstick carrots. Lovely combination of flavors! ~Made for the Nov. Aussie/NZ Swap~

This is a great recipe for a healthier cornbread. I made as directed; using 2 egg whites, 1 T. sugar, etc... I opted to not use the corn kernels. The consistency is perfect! The only change I'll make next time is to use the 4 T. of sugar. Although, not quite as healthy that way, we do prefer a little more sweetness. It might be fun to experiment with the sweetness by using applesauce, too! Thank you, Loula, for a great and healthy recipe. ~Made for the VIP in the Veg*n Swap~

Fantastic waffles! I used the suggestions given. I ended up using 1/2 cup ground flax meal, 1 T. vanilla (great addition) and 2 whole eggs (I forgot to separate them and whip the whites - but it seemed just fine!). I loved the taste and texture the cormeal added to these waffles. I also loved that I could hide a really healthy ingredient, flax, and it was still enjoyed by my kids! Kudos to you, kitty!

We loved these roasted potatoes. I enjoyed the combination of sweet potatoes with regular potatoes. I roast veggies often, but thought about using Lipton onion soup mix. Great idea! It added a wonderful flavor. I just put everything on my lipped cookie sheet, mixed it together with my hands and popped it in the oven. No extra dishes!  Thanks, kitty, for the yummy recipe. :)

A winning bread recipe here. It's a hearty and healthy bread. I love that it contains steel cut oats and that I was able to sneak in some flax seed! I think this bread is especially delicious sliced thin and toasted - with just a touch of butter. Thank you for posting a healthier bread recipe! * I used the stand mixer method and it worked like a charm* Made for KK's Chef Pick forum game

Yummy comfort food here. I had saved the leftover turkey from Thanksgiving in my freezer. This looked like a great reason to defrost and use up that turkey! I'm very glad I tried this. The flavor is wonderful. The texture is creamy, except for the top noodle layer which crisped up delightfully. I will definitely be making this again. I might even try it with leftover chicken. The ONLY change I'll make is to omit the cayenne pepper. I do like spice/heat but didn't think this recipe needed it. Thanks for posting this family pleaser! ~Made for Dec. Aussie/NZ Swap~

Outstanding. Thank you for yet another fabulous recipe. The Caesar mayo is what sets this blt apart. It adds such a wonderful flavor and complements the bacon, tomato and lettuce very well. I made half of the mayo - made 2 sandwiches - and still have some mayo left! I only already had anchovy paste in my fridge and estimated to use 1/2 t. of it for half the recipe. It seemed to be perfect! Made for KK's Chef Pick forum.

Okay...how easy is this recipe?!!! I loved the ease and the lack of mess while making these tasty caramels. Speaking of taste - delicious!! I make these to give as gifts at Christmas. They turned out perfectly. Thank you!

Awesome. Addictive. MMMMMM
I made this recipe (quadrupled) to give as Christmas gifts to my two sisters. They are both eating the vegan way lately and I was in search of recipe that I could give to them. This recipe would please ANYONE.  I couldn't stop sneaking tastes as the nuts were cooling! I would recommend doubling the recipe for starters. You will be glad you did. For a double recipe - I used one 11/5 oz. can of Planters mixed nuts (mine were lightly salted and it seemed to work just fine); 1/2 C. sugar and 1 T. lemon pepper (by Mrs. Dash). The recipe is perfect and soooo tasty. Thank you!

Originally rated on 1/23/09 - This recipe made it into my book#266453. I'd give this 10 stars if I could. This is sooooo tasty, easy and healthy. I followed the directions exactly and it produced perfect results. The cashew flavor really comes through and adds such a lovely crisp exterior to the chicken. Browning the chicken really seals in the moistness. The mustard vinaigrette is full of flavor, yet not overpowering. I just can't tell you how much I loved this for dinner tonight. I'm already craving more. Notes: I used salted cashews because I couldn't find the unsalted. I used 2 heel slices of 100 % whole wheat bread to make the bread crumbs. Also, I ended up using romaine lettuce instead of rocket or spinach (sadly, my family won't eat spinach). Quality recipe!!!

Originally rated on 8/13/09 - This recipe made it into my book#266453. We all LOVED this yummy recipe. My daughter had a friend over and she kept saying that the chicken was the best she had ever had (and much better than her dad's grilled chicken!). The chicken is wonderful on it's own but the addition of the salsa is a delicious touch. The chicken has a big flavor punch, due to the rub. Just delish!

Originally rated on 11/13/09 - This recipe made it into my book#266453. Fabulous!! This makes A LOT, which is good because it is so yummy. I was able to refrigerate the leftovers and heated it up the next day. The bread is very flavorful. It was a huge hit with my whole family. Great recipe to 'step up' the regular ol' garlic bread. This is a winner! ~Made for Nov. Veg*n Swap~

Originally rated on 5/21/09 - This recipe made it into my book#266453. LOVE this bread. Wow. Such a delicious combination of flavors. I used roasted, salted macadamia nuts. I had one small slice and I'm using every bit of self-control to not go back into the kitchen for more. The bread is moist and flavorful, with hints of tropical flavors AND a slight crunch,due to the macadamias. Fantastic. Try this! ~Made for ZWT5 - Epicurean Queens~

Originally rated on 3/1/09 - this recipe made it into my book#266453. Holy smokes!!! I'm pulling out my imaginary 10 star rating for this recipe. This is a wonderful gem of a bread recipe. It was incredibly easy to prepare and the fact that there is more stored in my fridge is exciting!! We finished the whole loaf with dinner because we couldn't stop slicing more bread. I used 4 and a half cups of white bread flour and 2 cups of whole wheat flour. I opted for kosher salt instead of sea salt and it worked fine. The initial kneading was done effortlessy by using my stand mixer with the dough hook and it didn't take long. Fantastic recipe. Delicious, crusty bread. THANK YOU! :)

Originally rated on 8/21/09 - This recipe made it into my book#266453. Oh my gosh, I'm addicted to these. In fact, it's 9:30 in the morning and I just took one out of the fridge to eat cold. I used red and green bell peppers. The batter stayed on perfectly while frying and crisped up very quickly. The flavor is amazing with the combination of seasoned breadcrumbs and parmesan cheese. Okay, I must go back to sneak another ring out of my fridge. I'm not kidding!

Originally rated on 12/2/09 - This recipe made it into my book#266453. I LOVE this method. It worked like a charm. No muss, no fuss. I used baby yukons. The recipe is perfect as is. I'll definitely be doing mashed potatoes this way often. Great for those busy weeknights when you need an extra side. For my family, I will have to go through the extra step of peeling the potatoes because they don't like the peels (I do though...very rustic and tasty!). Delish! Thanks. :)

Originally rated on 5/29/09 - This recipe made it into my book#266453. I've rated some green bean recipes 5 star before but I'd rate these a 10 if I could. My new FAVORITE way to eat green beans! I boiled mine for 2 minutes, because I like my beans to be slightly firm. In the future, I think I'll even skip the chevre cheese because I felt that it wasn't needed. I used haricots verts but think it would work just as well with regular green beans. The walnut oil is key, I think, adding deeper flavor. Also, toasting the walnuts made a yummy difference. I added more shallots and more walnuts, because I love them both. The best compliment came from the actions of my daughter, who normally doesn't really care for green beans. She went back to the pan to see if there was more. Finding none, she returned to the table and started picking them off of my plate! Tres bien! ~Made for ZWT5 Epicurean Queens~

Originally rated on 5/21/09 - This recipe made it into my book#266453. 5+ stars!! We loved this recipe and it will go into my favorites file. It was so easy to prepare, too! I followed the recipe exactly, except I used flounder. The parmesan gives a slightly crispy coating and the roasted macadamia nuts really push the flavor and texture over-the-top. I had never bought roasted, salted macadamia nuts before. think they are much better than unroasted. Great fish recipe!! ~Made for ZWT5 Epicurean Queens~

Originally rated on 1/19/09 - This recipe made it into my book#266453. WOW! These rolls came out perfectly and they were so easy to make - no kneading!! I was a little worried when the dough didn't seem to rise after the first 30 minutes but they turned out fantastically. The rolls looked and tasted bakery worthy. We loved them served warm with a little pat of melting butter. This will become a favorite in our household

Rated on 9/15/09 - This recipe made it into my book#266453. Perfect. Absolutely perfect and delicious recipe. The garlic flavor was perfect here. I loved the added touch of drizzling the reserved garlic oil over the potatoes, too. This is my new favorite way to prepare mashed potatoes. Note: I don't have a steamer basket anymore, so I just boiled and drained my potatoes. ~Made for Veg*n Swap~

Originally rated on 6/9/09 - This recipe made it into my book#266453. We thought these were fantastic! I marinaded the pork chops overnight, which imparted a delicious and zesty flavor. I grilled my chops instead of broiling. They came out juicy and full of flavor. I enjoyed the avocado and cilantro as garnishes, but the pork still tastes great without. My husband kept remarking on how good these were and he even said they tasted like steak! ~Made for Family Picks ZWT5 for the Epicurean Queens~

Originally rated on 2/16/09 - This recipe made it into my book#266453. Where is the 10 star option?!! This is a FABULOUS recipe. Thank you to loof, who recommended this recipe at Best of 2008 Cookbook Tag. I chose to make the plain version for my first attempt and they were simply outstanding. Now I can't wait to try other flavors/toppings. The possiblities are endless! I want to include some comments from my kids. My daughter came in to help me make these bagels because it looked like "fun". We both ended up having a blast. They are really not that difficult to make and you won't believe how good they taste. I gave my son a taste of a bagel, still warm, and amid his "mmmmmms" he said, "make this EVERY weekend...EVERY weekend!" To sum it up, my daughter said, "I just can't believe we made bagels!" Notes: 1. I used a candy thermometer to make sure the water was the right temp. for the yeast to react. 2. All the kneading was done with my stand mixer with dough hook attachment (you could probably use the regular attachment if you don't have the hook). 3. I used the finger in the middle method (this was esp. fun to do with kids). 4. I made 8 large bagels. 5. I used the cooking spray glaze method. 6. I used the steam method by placing a cast iron skillet on the bottom rack while the oven was preheating and when I put the bagels into the oven, I put about 6 ice cubes into the cast iron pan to get the steam (I did not spray the oven walls).

Originally rated on 6/2/09 - This recipe made it into my book#266453. Going into my Best of the Best recipe file. We LOVED these fish sandwiches. The seasoning blend is perfect and gives the fish such great flavoring. Panko provides a delicate, crispy coating. The sauce is lovely and pairs with the fish very well. All this, plus toasted bread, fresh tomatoes, lettuce...C'est magnifique! I used whitefish fillets (only about 1 1/2 pounds and it fed the four of us), and sweet relish in the sauce because I couldn't find hot relish. Also, I forgot to sprinkle the fish with extra seasoning before breading - so I added it after and it was still noticable and tasty. I used fleur de sel instead of regular salt. Made for ZWT5 for the Epicurean Queens.

Originally rated on 10/20/09 - This recipe made it into my book#266453. Yet another 5 star review for this recipe. It was SO SIMPLE and tasted SO GOOD! Even my non-fish eating son enjoyed fish prepared this way. I loved everything about it: the crisp coating; flaky interior; the slight taste of lemon pepper; and the sheer ease of the recipe. Definitley will be making this again! Thank you.

Originally rated on 8/25/09 - This recipe made it into my book#266453. There is nothing better than bbq chicken in the summer and this recipe was fantastic and packed with flavor. We all really loved this. There is just a little kick due to the cayenne (use more if you like a lot of kick). I assumed that the 1/2 cup of brown sugar was to be added to 1/2 cup of bbq sauce.? At any rate, that's what I did and it tasted fantastic. Thanks for an excellent recipe to add to our grilling cookbook. This will definitely be made again and again!

Originally rated on 5/30/09 - This recipe made it into my book#266453. We LOVED this recipe. These wings are finger-licking good. I was worried that it would be too spicy for my family to enjoy, but it was perfect....I'd say a medium spice factor. The only adjustment I will make next time is to halve the sauce ingredients because it makes A LOT! Fantastic, quality recipe!! ~Made for ZWT5 Epicurean Queens~

5 stars given for excellent comfort food! The gravy has a wonderful flavor, due to the onions and mushrooms, and tastes great over the salisbury steak and mashed potatoes! I really liked the additional flavor from the Lipton onion mix.  My family really enjoyed this meal. ~Made for KK's forum~

A delicious dressing with a hint of sweetness. This recipe is very easy to prepare and you'll have enough left over to store in the fridge for later use. It reminds me of a Catalina dressing. We all enjoyed it over our greens. Thanks! ~made and reviewed for KK's forum Chef Pick's event ~

We loved this sauce! My son always asks for honey mustard sauce so he can dip his fries (not that we do that a lot). I made half of this recipe to go along with some homemade chicken nuggets. The sauce is wonderful and tastes very similar the restaurant versions. Half a recipe was plenty for four people. We even had some left over! Thanks!
~Made for Chef's Pick event at the forums in KK's site~

I LOVED the sauce. I took a tiny spoonful (as a taste,while cooking) and I found it hard to resist tasting more. It was addictive!  I used 8 drumsticks and 4 T. butter - every other amt. I kept the same. I opted for 2 chipotles and it was the perfect amt. of spice for me. My family perferred the chicken on its own, without sauce. They don't know what they were missing!  ~I tried this recipe because loof had it in her best of 2009 cookbook at the Top Favorites of 2009 Cookbook Tag Game.~

I just loved the aroma as this cooked away in my oven for a few hours. Mmmm...it made my whole house smell wonderful! The flavor combinations are perfect and I loved the carrots and pearl onions. I am going to try this again, either by adding more beef chunks OR using a little less wine. I'd prefer more beef to sauce ratio. That is the only thing I would want to tweek for my personal preference. Other than that, it was magnifique! ( P.S. I'd check it after cooking in the oven for about an hour and a half.  I had let mine go the full two hours and my beef got a little too well done. My faux pas! )

Yet another 5 star rating to add to the list. We all loved this bread! My husband didn't want to stop at one slice. I love the sliced strawberries and crunchy almonds...great combination. The almond extract adds the perfect amount of flavoring. The bread is moist and delicious. Thank you so much for posting. We will be making this again!

These were nice for an alternative way to have green beans. I read a review about the vinegar taste being too strong, so I only added 2 teaspoons of cider vinegar. My family thought it was still too strong of a flavor. When trying these again, I will omit the cider vinegar altogether and maybe try Italian seasoned breadcrumbs.  I love the idea of this recipe and the method. Thanks for posting.

Definitely worth a 5 star rating. It's so simple but absolutely delicious. The flavor of the vinaigrette is perfect. I wouldn't change a single thing. Just make sure you do have enough salad greens so the salad doesn't get over-dressed.

Fabulous chowder. I loved the spiciness. It was just enough, without being overpowering. Even my kids, who don't typically like beans, ate this soup and talked about how good it was. I'm packing some of the leftovers for my lunch today! Made as is and it was perfect. Thanks!
