These were really good!  Mine came out more hot than sweet but that's okay - I like hot!  Easy to make, these will be a perfect addition to our summer bbq's - thanks for sharing!

This dish is delicious!  Quick, easy, and inexpensive too.  The meat was tender, the sauce was tasty and just the right texture - not too thin or thick.  Served over rice, this made a delightful meal - thanks for sharing!

Enjoyed this quick and easy pasta dish!  I left out the onion (personal preference) and the taste was very light and fresh.  Served with a salad and focaccia bread, this was a great busy-weeknight meal and I will definitely make it again!
Ok you're right - this is the best sweet tea!  Easy, fresh and clear, and just the right amount of sweet - yum!  Thanks for sharing your method!

These potatoes were delicious!  Easy to make too!  I did not skin my potatoes and cut them into 3/4" wide strips.  The hour cooking time was perfect, resulting in a flavorful, not-to-crispy outside and a wonderful tender inside.  Will definitely make these again - thanks for posting!

Wow what a great salad!  So fresh with all of the fruits, veggies and nuts and the chicken really makes this a meal.  I used leftover recipe #305135  (I had made extra just for this purpose) and it was fantastic.  The raspberry vinaigrette was the perfect topper - absolutely loved this - thanks for sharing!

What an easy and simple weeknight meal!  I used recipe #244839 and left out the green onions as I don't care for them.  This made a very filling, very delicious meal that I will make again - thanks for sharing!

This chicken was delicious!  I *really* loved the basting sauce.  I was afraid the chicken might be bland since there was no marinating but not to worry - basting with that wonderful sauce kept it juicy and flavorful.  Thanks for posting this!

These burgers were great!  I took another reviewer's suggestion and used sliced mozzarella to fill the burgers and that made it really easy.  I pan-fried them and had very little leakage.  These flavorful burgers stuffed with cheese really hit the spot - thanks for sharing this recipe!

This stuff is FANTASTIC!  I used a medium salsa and added several generous dashes of cayenne.  The heat was a perfect match to the citrus flavor and the shrimp went great with these flavors.  I served with Tostitos scoops and it was just wonderful - thanks for sharing this recipe!

This was terrific - but then it's Baileys so how could it not be?!!  The coffee was a great addition and the chocolate-rim of the glass just put this over the top!  Thanks for sharing this delightful treat!

Outstanding!  The buttery brown sugar taste with the lime is wonderful and a perfect complement to the strawberries.  I served this warm on vanilla ice cream and it was terrific.  I think it would be great on waffles or pancakes too and will be trying that soon!  Thanks for posting this gem!

This is a favorite side dish for my family!  Potatoes, bacon, cheese - what more could you want?  I did leave out the onions and skipped the optional red pepper.  This is a great dish that would go with just about anything - thanks for sharing!

Wow these bagels were just great!  I have to admit, I don't have a stand mixer so I just kneaded the dough by hand.  These are the steps I used:  1) I made half of the recipe plain, half cinnamon raisin by adding about a tablespoon of cinnamon to the flour as I added it in, then kneading 2 small boxes of raisins in before the first rise  2) I made 12 medium-sized bagels, six of each flavor  3) I used the "finger in the middle method" of shaping which worked really well - I will make my holes a little bigger next time but they still came out fine this time  4) I added the honey to the water in the boiling stage  5) I used the non-stick cooking spray method for the glaze, with no additional toppings added  6) I cooked my bagels on a baking sheet sprinkled with cornmeal, no steaming, and they were perfectly cooked after 25 minutes.  The instructions for this recipe were so perfectly clear and it made these delicious treats easy to make.  Thank you so much for sharing this recipe!

This is a great hot dog topper!  I don't care for onions so made hubby's with and mine without - we both really enjoyed it.  I love the flavor of green chilis and they were a terrific addition to this combination of flavors.  Good stuff - thanks for sharing the recipe!

This is a wonderful treat!  Made for a 4th of July BBQ - I used strawberry cream cheese and served with pineapple chunks, strawberries, and red grapes and everyone loved it.   Some folks even ate it by the spoonful without the fruit!  This was a big hit - thanks for sharing!

What a great, fresh and healthy salad!  I made just as specified except left out the onions (personal preference) and added a couple of dashes of hot sauce to the yogurt mix.  I used planned leftovers from recipe #265530 and it was a perfect match for this salad.  This made a nice light dinner - thanks for sharing!
This was a yummy meatloaf!  Very moist, lots of flavor and the BBQ sauce on top was a nice addition.  Those Canadian firefighters really know their meatloaf - thanks for sharing this recipe!

This was just delicious!  I love brussels sprouts and this is a wonderul way to serve them.  The sweet from the brown sugar, tang from the mustard and salty from the bacon was a great match to the sprouts.  I will definitely make this again - thanks for sharing your recipe!

This chicken dish is absolutely delicious!  I followed the recipe as specified including the pinch of sugar.  After I reduced the sauce, I put the chicken back in the skillet and turned it a few times to coat it in the sauce, then served it drizzled with a little more sauce.  The result was a moist and flavorful chicken - I love the lemon/basil combination.  Thanks for posting this winner!

What a great way to make oatmeal!  So easy in the microwave and I love the cranberry/orange combination.  I added just a touch of brown sugar and served with just a little milk.  This is a great way to start the day - thanks for sharing!

This is a delicious dip!  I cut the recipe down to 1/3 and we enjoyed it for a nice light lunch.  I served with melba toast rounds and it was wonderful - sweet and savory and creamy.  So easy to fix I will make this often - thanks for sharing the recipe!
Oh wow this is just fabulous!  I doubled the ingredients and boy what a wonderful after-dinner cocktail.  The creamy mint with the vanilla vodka is just fantastic.  Loved this - thanks for sharing!

Delicious burritos!  I love the flavor of chipotles and it really came through in this dish.  I liked it with the ground pork and think it would be equally good with ground beef.  Quick and easy, the whole family loved these - thanks for sharing!

Outstanding chicken dish!  I used a red bell pepper and boneless skinless chicken breasts, then made just as specified.  The orange juice and onion soup mix were all the seasoning that was needed and matched beautifully with the tomatos.  My chicken came out fork-tender with a rich, delicious topping.  This is a recipe I look forward to making again - thanks for sharing!
This is a delicious vegetable dish!  Easy to make and very flavorful - love the addition of the cumin!  I didn't use the eggs this time but will try it next time.  Thanks for posting this recipe!
A wonderful cocktail, light and refreshing!  Goes down easy, a great summer drink - thanks for sharing!

This is a very good fish recipe.  The butter and the buttery crackers (I used Peppridge Farms as suggested) gave this a nice rich taste and the herb flavoring was right on.  I will use this easy to make recipe again - thanks for sharing it!

Odd as it may sound, I had a feeling I was going to like this and I was right - it's great!  It was okay with the corn syrup but I prefered it without.  The cinnamon and raisins go well with the Velveeta - sweet and creamy.  I love raisin bread and I loved this sandwich - thanks for posting the recipe!
This made a simple, quick and tasty meal!  I used ground beef and recipe #244839.  Love an easy weeknight dinner made from things that are always on hand.  Thanks for sharing this recipe!

Wonderful marinade for chicken!  I left my chicken in the marinade for about 3 1/2 hours, then grilled and ended up with flavorful, moist and juicy chicken.  Light, fresh and delicious - thanks for sharing!

My daughter loves lofthouse cookies and I have it on her authority that these taste just like the real thing! I used Betty Crocker *vanilla* cake mix and broke up all the lumps before adding the other ingredients. I rolled mine into balls a little bigger than 1" and flattened to just a little more than 1/4". They baked up perfectly after 8 minutes; I frosted while still a little warm and they came out perfectly. Thanks for sharing this recipe!

This is a very nice drink!  I'm not much of a coffee drinker but I like coffee-flavored cold and blended drinks, and I'm glad I tried this one because it's really good.  The yogurt gave this a slight tartness, and the brown sugar was a nice complement to the coffee and chocolate flavors.  I used chopped semisweet chocolate for the garnish.  I will make this again - thanks for posting!

These easy-to-make stuffed potatoes are terrific!  The egg adds a great texture to the stuffing and of course the ham and cheese are great together.  Next time I'm going to add some chopped broccoli too.  This made a terrific lunch with very little effort - thanks for sharing!

This is a wonderful and versatile dish that would go well with many types of meat. I served mine with baked chicken and it was a great match. This was very easy to make with ingredients I always have on hand. Thanks for sharing your recipe!  ETA:  I used the leftovers to make fried rice for lunch the next day - just stir-fried it with a little butter and some soy sauce - it was terrific!
Yummy garlic bread!  Lots of topping and your "secret ingredient" really makes this special.  Tasty, easy to make - loved it - thanks for posting!  Made for Fall PAC 2008

This is a delightful pasta salad!  All of the ingredients are so cool and fresh and go perfectly with the poppy seed dressing.  I was unsure about how the swiss would be but it added a very nice flavor.  An unusual group of ingredients that came together for a great lunch today - thanks for sharing the recipe!  Made for Fall PAC 2008

Sweet, creamy and delicious!  I used pineapple sherbet and used frozen pineapple chunks instead of ice cubes (in addition to the crushed pineapple).  Great texture and flavor - thanks for posting the recipe!

This recipe gets 5 stars because it has everything you need for a great weeknight meal - it's inexpensive, it's super-easy and it tastes great!  Served with macaroni salad (that I had made in the morning) and a green salad, I had a great dinner on the table in 10 minutes!  This is a recipe that I will use again and again - thanks for posting it!  Made for Fall PAC 2008

Yum, yum, yum - what a great way to dress up a simple pound cake!  You didn't specify the size of the pound cake and I used a 10.75 oz. frozen one.  The filling layer was really thick but that's fine with me 'cause it's so good!  Two tips for the assembly of this...once you put the nutella half on top, wrap it quickly because the nutella will begin to ooze out right away; and don't use too much foil or it won't fit back into the loaf pan (duh!) :)  Simple to make and nice enough for company, this would be great for a holiday party - thanks for sharing the recipe!

WOW - this is terrific!  I just loved everything about this dish.  The sweet/tangy/spicy sauce is great and the meat came out so tender.  I served this stew over fresh mashed potatoes and we all just loved it.  Thanks for posting this winner!

This is a terrific burger recipe!  I doubled the worcestershire and Tabasco, used a full-bodied wheat beer, topped them with cheddar cheese, and served on whole-wheat buns.  These burgers were very juicy and flavorful.  I had mine with dill pickle slices and the rest of the family topped theirs with your recipe #309199.  Thanks for posting this yummy recipe!
I really enjoyed this drink!  I used sweetened lime juice.  Refreshing, tastes good, goes down smooth - just great - thanks for posting the recipe!  Made for Election Eats 2008
This is great - creamy, sweet, and delicious!  I used Godiva White Chocolate and vanilla vodka and loved it - thanks for posting!  Made for Election Eats 2008

Just LOVED this pizza!  I don't care for onions so used a yellow pepper instead, otherwise made just as specified.  I love pizza without sauce and per Redsie's review I made sure that the first layer of cheese covered the edges of the bread - this seemed to keep them from getting too dry and crusty.  The garlic and fresh basil make this pizza special - really enjoyed this easy-to-make treat - thanks for posting the recipe!

This is a great mushroom dish with so many possibilities!  The texture was not quite the same as a sauteed mushroom but they were just as flavorful.  I used red wine; next time I'd like to try a mix of red wine and beef broth, maybe with some herbs sprinkled in.  We ate these as a side dish but they'd make a great topping for pizza or sandwiches too - thanks for posting the recipe!

This chicken is outstanding!  I made the marinade as specified, using plenty of Tabasco.  We marinated the chicken in half of the sauce, then glazed the chicken with the remaining sauce as we grilled it.  The chicken came out so juicy and the sauce was just delicious.  Thanks for posting this great recipe!
This was a tasty and easy-to-make breakfast dish!  The sour cream really made a nice topping for this, and I love the eggs with the Canadian bacon and Swiss.  Thanks for posting this recipe!

Fantastic recipe!!  I cut my chicken into strips and made exactly as directed.  I put foil on my pan so cleanup was a breeze.  This chicken was flavorful and moist with a wonderfully crunchy crust.  We ate them as is - no dipping sauce required!  Thanks for posting this yummy recipe!

Terrific sandwich!  So super quick and easy and what flavor!  I used precooked bacon which I heated in the skillet, then removed and added just a little butter to cook the chicken.  We topped them with cheddar cheese, mayo, fresh tomato and lettuce.  We enjoyed every bite for a great quick dinner - thanks for sharing your recipe!
Wonderful drink - rich, smooth and comforting!  The cocoa added just the right touch to the coffee and Kahlua.  Thanks for sharing this great recipe!

This is a great dish - comfort food at it's best!  Easy to make and a great way to use leftover chicken or turkey.  The french onion dip really made this dish.  I served it with broccoli and cauliflower but next time may add some peas to the chicken mixture to make it a one-dish meal.  Thanks for posting this recipe!

This is a great and flavorful egg salad!  We enjoyed the tang of the mustard and the bite of the horseradish and cayenne.  Served as you suggested, on wheat bread with lettuce, along side a hot bowl of soup - this was a great quick meal - thanks for sharing the recipe!
This is a delicious sausage dish!  I thought these were great but hubby really loved them - they're great "man food"! :)  Easy to make, loved the sauce - thanks for posting the recipe!
Woohoo - this is terrific!  Great flavor combination, smooth and rich and delicious.  Thanks for posting this treat!
This was so easy to make and just delicious!  What a great combination of vegetables, and this method of cooking just makes the flavors shine.  This is a winner - thanks for posting the recipe!

Oh boy these are soooo good!  As I was short on time I did microwave the potatoes to "bake" them, then cooked them in the oven after squashing as directed.  They were great plain and with sour cream.  Thanks for posting this great recipe!

This is a fabulous crock pot dish!  I used your recipe #219873 as the basis for my seasoning, scaling down to what I needed for this recipe and what I had available.  The meat was tender and the flavor was fantastic, not too spicy but just enough of a kick.  Served with green beans and mashed potatoes for a wonderful meal - thanks for posting your recipe!

This is absolutely fantastic!  The combination of spices is right on, with just the perfect amount of kick, and the basting liquid is a perfect match.  My chicken was about 4.5 pounds so I doubled all of the other ingredients and cooked it just a bit longer.  The chicken was so tender and juicy with wonderful flavor.  I cooked mine in the oven this time but am looking forward to grilling the next one.  Will make this often - thanks for posting the recipe!
Terrific!  Great as a shot or a sipper (ok gulper!).  Tart and tasty and awesome color!  Thanks for posting this gem!

What a great, quick and easy meal!  I was out of beef bouillon so just sauted the beef a little in the pan first, put it on the crust as instructed, then sauted the veggies in the same pan.  I don't like onions so only put them on half of the pizza.  This is a great no-fuss weeknight meal - thanks for posting the recipe!
Great tea!  I served it warm and really enjoyed the soothing sweet/spicy flavor.  I love orange tea and this is a great way to serve it - thanks for posting the recipe!

Oh wow - these are terrific!  I used smoked paprika, so added just a dash of cayenne pepper to add in the heat.  The sugar, paprika and cumin are such a great complement to the slightly sweet taste of the almond.   We just loved these - thanks for sharing the recipe!

This is a great brunch dish!  I left the onions out as I don't care for them.  I halved the recipe, probably using a little more cheese than called for.  I made it in a 7" round casserole dish and it puffed up beautifully.  I'll probably use chopped green chilis next time.  Thanks for posting this yummy recipe!
Love pizza and love quesadillas, so had to love this!  I made mine with green pepper and it was just terrific.  Simple and quick, a great lunch - thanks for posting the recipe!

Yum - loved this soup!  I left out the 3/4 cup water and added an extra can of rotel tomatoes (with juice) instead.  I served it topped with cheddar and sour cream.  This was an easy, rich and spicy soup that we all really enjoyed - thanks for posting the recipe!

Unusual and delicious!  The veggies in the pork were a great combination and the spices were right on.  I did not use the egg and used soy sauce instead of fish sauce as it's what I had on hand.  Served as specified these made a great, easy lunch - thanks for sharing the recipe!

I love blueberry pie and this was a nice, easy, tasty substitute!  I was glad I put the cups on a baking pan as specified because my filling bubbled over a bit.  Not too sweet, this really hit the spot.  Thanks for posting the recipe!

What a great soup!  Loved the addition of the anaheim and jalapeno peppers - added a nice kick to this rich and creamy soup.  This recipe makes a lot - looking forward to leftovers for lunch - thanks for posting the recipe!

Very tasty French toast and a great breakfast treat!  I used regular whole wheat bread, otherwise made as specified.  I topped mine with fresh blueberries - no syrup needed.  Thanks for posting this recipe!

This is a nice version of sweet-n-sour chicken!  I've never had the tropical fruit salad before but it was very good in this.  I may add a dash of tabasco to give it a little kick next time.  All in all a good combination of flavors that we really enjoyed - thanks for posting this recipe!

This is a terrific way to cook ribs!  I never knew about taking the membrane off; it was pretty easy to do and made a big difference in the quality of the cooked ribs.  I used a sweet/spicy bbq sauce and the ribs grilled up perfectly - thanks for sharing your recipe!

All I can say is wow - this is terrific!!  I used a whole egg instead of the egg beaters, otherwise made exactly as specified.  The oatmeal had a nice custard-like texture with a lightly crispy crust on top.  Absolutely delicious - thanks for sharing this winner!  Made for the Best of 2008 event
Oh yeah.....this is fabulous!  Rich and creamy, smooth and delicious.  Loved it - thanks for posting the recipe!

This is a great broccoli salad!  I left out the onions, otherwise made as specified.  The almonds and celery in the salad and the pepper in the dressing made this a little different than others I've tried and I really enjoyed these additions.  This is terrific - thanks for sharing the recipe!

Wow - this is a delicious way to cook fish!!  I only used tomatoes for the garnish, otherwise made just as specified.  The sauce is absolutely fantastic - rich and spicy - and is a perfect complement to the mild fish.  Really enjoyed this - thanks for sharing the recipe!  Made for the Best of 2008 event

This was a nice and different focaccia bread.  The potato and rosemary combination is delicious and adds a nice touch to the bread.  I only had to use about half of the water specified.  I did have to cover the bread after about 30 minutes as it was getting quite brown, but it still cooked up fine.  Thanks for posting this recipe!

Great dessert drink - sweet, thick and creamy!  The Bailey's and strawberries go great together.  I didn't use the honey and thought it was perfectly sweetened.  Thanks for posting this recipe!  Made for the Best of 2008 event
These muffins are terrific!  I used bacon and left out the onions, and lined my pan with foil liners.   The cayenne gave these a really great flavor too.  Thanks for posting this great recipe!

This is a yummy apple treat!  I used Granny Smith apples as you suggested and enjoyed the sweet/tart flavor it gave the crisp.  I halved the recipe and served with vanilla ice cream - great dessert - thanks for sharing the recipe!  Made for the Best of 2008 event

This is a great and easy way to prepare broccoli!  I roasted mine at 350Â° for 25 minutes and it was perfectly cooked.  Tossing in the basil at the end was a great complement to the garlic and parmesan.  Thanks for sharing this recipe!

Great burger with real down-home country flavor!  The BBQ sauce and onion rings (I used the frozen, breaded kind) are a great combination.  Add the bacon and cheese and you've got a burger for the heartiest appetite - thanks for sharing your recipe!  Made for the Best of 2008 event

This fruit salad is so unusual and really good!  It's got a nice mixture of textures and flavors.   I found the dressing to be very rich and may cut down on that next time I make this.  Thanks for sharing this fruity treat!  Made for the Best of 2008 event

This is one of the best tuna casseroles I've made!  I left out the onion (personal pref) and used the optional red pepper and cheddar (on top).  I was trying to use stuff from the pantry so I used some penne pasta that I had, plus a handful of noodles.  This is so creamy and flavorful, and so quick to make from ingredients I always have on hand.  Thanks for posting this great recipe!  Made for the Best of 2008 event

Great stuff!! I left out the onion (personal preference), otherwise made just as specified.  I used sweet Italian sausage and the flavor paired wonderfully with the carrots and herbs.  After I cooked the pasta I added it to the pan with the sauce, turned up the heat, and let it bubble a few minutes to thicken the sauce even more.  We really enjoyed this easy and delicious dish - thanks for sharing your recipe!

This makes a nice, light, refreshing drink!  I wanted something light after an afternoon of working outside and this hit the spot.  I used diet Sprite in a 1-part-beer to 2-part-Sprite ratio.  Thanks for posting this recipe!  Made for the Best of 2008 event

This is a great way to make oatmeal!  I made 1 serving and really enjoyed it.  The oatmeal itself was not as sweet as I thought it would be, but a nice scoop of strawberry preserves took care of that.  Thanks for posting this yummy recipe!

This is a great quick and easy way to cook fish!  I used a cookie sheet covered with foil so there was virtually no clean-up.  Simple to make and flavorful - thanks for posting the recipe!  Made for the Best of 2008 event
Wow I loved this dish!  Very quick to make and so flavorful.  The chicken was tender and juicy and the sauce was just great.  Thanks for posting this recipe!

Wow - these are terrific!  Not really all that sweet, just rich and chocolatey.  I halved the recipe with good results, did not use the optional walnuts, and baked mine for 35 minutes.  This a brownie recipe I'll use often - thanks for sharing it!  Made for the Best of 2008 event

This was just terrific!!  So flavorful and just spicy enough.  I left out the onions, otherwise made just as specified.  Mine came out nice and thick, not soupy at all.  Thanks for posting this delicious winner!  Made for the Best of 2008 event

This is just terrific!!  Very easy to make and so tasty.  The thyme adds a wonderful flavor to this dish.  I don't care for onions so used half of a green pepper, minced,  instead.  I served this as the main dish, with a green salad.  The whole family (plus a couple of friends) just loved this - thanks for sharing the recipe!

What a great snack and so easy to make!  I don't care for onions so used green pepper instead.  The Italian dressing was a great seasoning for this.  I served on top of big Wheat Thin crackers and really enjoyed - thanks for sharing the recipe!

What a great dish - fresh, light and delicious!  This method of cooking kept all of the flavor and goodness in the veggies and the black and red pepper really pulled the flavors together.  I easily halved the recipe and we really enjoyed this - thanks for sharing the recipe!

This is a great idea for a tasty and hearty breakfast!  I added half of the cheddar on top of the rice before putting the eggs on; it made a nice gooey layer in between to hold the rice to the eggs.  Really enjoyed this TexMex treat - thanks for posting the recipe!

Great sandwich!  Definitely falls into the "why didn't I think of that?" category.  I used Hidden Valley Spicy ranch as that's what we alway's have on hand, and I didn't use the optional tomato.  Great way to flavor up a grilled cheese sandwich - thanks for posting this recipe!  Made for Spring PAC 2009
Great drink!  I used fresh strawberries and just 2 teaspoons of sugar and loved the tartness of the drink.  Thanks for posting this recipe!

One word - FANTASTIC!!  Just loved this dish!  I used boneless skinless breasts.  Problems with my oven forced me to cook the chicken in a skillet, but I coated it in butter and topped with chili and onion powders as specified, then sauteed until done.  The chipotle sauce is just terrific - I used 3 chipotles and it was rich and spicy good.  Loved everything about this - thanks for sharing this keeper!  Made for Spring PAC 2009
Terrific - what a great and easy lunch!  I made 8 "bites" and used white cheddar, ham, dijon mustard and pickles.  Baking them is a great idea.  Thanks for posting this recipe!

These were great fries!  I wouldn't have thought to add sugar to oven-baked fries but it was a nice flavor combination with the salt, pepper and cayenne.  Thanks for posting your recipe!  Made for Spring PAC 2009

These is great southern sweet cornbread!  I used a regular muffin pan and got 8 good-sized muffins.  The best thing about these muffins is how moist they are.  Great with chili - thanks for sharing the recipe!  Made for Spring PAC 2009

This salad is CRAZY good!!!  I went light on the cilantro and used broken-up fritos for the croutons.  The sweetness of the corn and red pepper was the perfect match to the spicy dressing.  I served this as a side dish but will have it as the main course next time - it's that good!  Thanks for posting this winner!  Made for Spring PAC 2009

This is a great, fresh and delicious salsa!  I used 2 huge jalapenos, one including the seeds and one not.  I added a little less cilantro and a little more salt than called for.  We really loved this salsa - thanks for sharing the recipe!  Made for Spring PAC 2009

Terrific!!  I did not use the onion, otherwise made as specified.  The chicken cooked up so moist and tender and I just loved the sauce - it was a perfect match to the chicken.  Great presentation too - looks like you fussed but it's really pretty easy to make.  Thanks for posting this great recipe!  Made for Spring PAC 2009

This is a great, filling oatmeal!  I like my raisins softer so I added them to the oatmeal before cooking.  The applesauce gave this a light taste with just the right amount of sweetness.  Thanks for posting this easy breakfast treat!  Made for Spring PAC 2009

This zippy dip was a great match for sweet potatoe fries!  I think this would work well with raw carrots and celery too, and maybe on a roast beef sandwich.  Thanks for posting this tasty recipe!  Made for Spring PAC 2009

Great hearty and filling omelet!  I've never used this cooking method before but it seems easier than flipping, folding, etc.  I used ham and replaced the onion with chopped red bell pepper.  Serve this with some salsa on the side and really enjoyed it - thanks for sharing the recipe!

Great veggie recipe!  I used a little less onion than specified, otherwise made as directed.  These peas had great flavor and were so easy to make.  I used frozen peas but look forward to trying with fresh.  Thanks for posting this great recipe!

This is a great breakfast oatmeal!  I cut my banana into tiny pieces instead of mashing, otherwise made as directed.  Surprisingly, this was not overly sweet - it was just right.  I served mine with a little milk and really enjoyed - thanks for sharing your recipe!

This is just terrific!  I used 1 egg instead of the egg substitute, otherwise made just as specified and wouldn't change a thing!  Mine cooked perfectly in the time specified; the bottom was set but soft, just like a tamale is, and the topping was nice and cheesy.  Such great flavor and so easy - wonderful - thanks for sharing your recipe!

This is a great drink - fruity and refreshing!  I made 1/4 of the recipe, leaving out the Sprite, and kept it in a pitcher in the refrigerator.  To serve I just poured it in a glass with some ice and added some diet Sprite.  How easy can you get - thanks for sharing this great recipe!
This is a great drink - smooth and easy to drink.  I made one with spiced rum and one with coconut rum and enjoyed both.  Thanks for posting a great summertime refresher!

Delicious muffins!  Light and moist and I love the blackberry/blueberry combination.  The topping was a great touch.  I made just as specified and got 12 good-sized muffins out of the batch.  Thanks for posting this recipe!

Oh boy this is a great breakfast casserole!!  The gravy mix gives the eggs a rich taste and smooth texture - it really makes this dish.  This will be a brunch or "breakfast-for-dinner" staple at my house - thanks for posting this recipe!

Oh boy - this is an extra-special breakfast treat!  Just loved the rich flavor of the Amaretto with this.  Since I cooked the French toast in butter, I didn't use the Amaretto butter, but I did use the syrup and it was terrific.  Thanks for posting this winner!

Great soup!  I left out the onions, otherwise made as specified.  The yellow pepper and garlic gave this such a rich and hearty flavor.  We all really enjoyed this soup - thanks for posting the recipe!

Amazing flavor in this stuffed potato!  I love basil and its flavor was the star of this dish.  I did use the pine nuts and thought they were a nice touch.  Really enjoyed these potatoes - thanks for sharing the recipe!

This is a great way to prepare chicken!  I made mine tenders instead of nuggets, so had to cook a little longer (about 20 minutes).  The chicken was moist and the crust was flavorful.  Served these with 3 sauces (bbq, ranch, and sour cream/salsa) and really enjoyed - thanks for sharing your recipe!

Outstanding pasta dish!  The amount of pepper seems like a lot but use it all - it makes the dish - a great pairing with the tangy citrus flavors.  Easy to make and just delicious - thanks for sharing this recipe!

This is an easy and yummy breakfast treat!  The pancake baked up golden on top and soft and eggy inside.  It's not sweet at all; I mashed up a couple of strawberries and mixed them with a little maple syrup and this was a perfect topping.  Thanks for posting this recipe!

Really delicious chicken!  I used boneless breast tenders, otherwise made as specified.  Just loved the sweet and spicy sauce, and it smelled so good cooking all day.  This recipe made a lot; I shredded the leftover chicken and mixed it with the remaining sauce - it'll make great bbq sandwiches!  Thanks for posting this recipe!

Wonderful refreshing drink!  I love the combo of cranberry juice and lime, and the fruity grenadine and bubbly seltzer were great additions.  Great cooler on a warm summer evening - thanks for posting the recipe!

What a great idea for a quick and easy dessert!  Simple to make, impressive to look at, and delicious.  I'm sure any flavor of pie filling would be great with this.  Served warm with vanilla ice cream and really enjoyed - thanks for posting the recipe!

Wow these are true gourmet burgers - just delicious!  Just loved everything about these.  Take the time to grill the veggies and make the basil-mayo - they make these burgers extra special.  Thanks for posting this winner!

Great grill recipe for pork!  I used this on 2 1-1/2" thick bone-in pork chops and oh what flavor!  I used the sauce but didn't top mine with the peanuts.  This marinade is a great match for pork and the meat came out so moist and tender.  Thanks for posting this great recipe!

Oh boy is this ever a great pasta dish! I don't care for onions so left them out; I used fresh garlic and fresh baby spinach (just stirred it into the sauce until it wilted), otherwise made as specified. Wonderful flavor, rich and filling - no meat needed! Served as the main course with salad and rolls - terrific - thanks for sharing this recipe!
This bread is just delicious!  Light and soft with the perfect amount of seasoning.  Easy to make, this would go with just about anything - thanks for sharing your recipe!

This is a delicious smoothie!  I'm not fond of buttermilk but it was great in this.  I made half of the recipe and used fresh strawberries.  Now I can get the health benefits of buttermilk by using it in this yummy smoothie - thanks for sharing the recipe!

What a great snack!  Love the cheddar flavor and the black pepper - perfect!  I had to cook mine in 2 batches; in the first batch when I rolled the 8" circle my dough was thicker and the crisps were not as crispy (still tasted great tho!).  The second batch I just rolled the dough as thin as I could and got wonderfully crispy crackers.  Great snack with cocktails out on the deck - thanks for sharing the recipe!

Oh yeah....these are FANTASTIC!  Just love the combo of sweet and spicy, and so easy to make.  Love'em on burgers with Swiss cheese and pineapple, and on crackers with cream cheese.  Thanks for sharing this winner!

Great salad!  Made just as specified and loved every bite.  The dressing is fantastic on this, and the simplicity of the ingredients is what makes this work so well.  Thanks for posting this great recipe!

So easy and so good!  My chocolate syrup wasn't sugar free but my vanilla was.  I shook this up in my cocktail shaker with ice so it was nice and frothy.  What a great treat on a hot Texas day - I'll enjoy this often this summer - thanks for sharing the recipe!

Great quick and easy pasta recipe!  I was surprised at how much flavor the noodles picked up without a lot of butter.  I used a *generous* pinch of hot pepper flakes 'cause we love them, and added just a little sea salt.  Thanks for posting this recipe!

Boy I loved this chicken!!  Quick and easy to make with amazing flavor.  I loved the crunchy crust and it's great that it didn't take a lot of oil or butter to get it.  I made exactly as specified and would not change a thing.  Good enough for company, quick enough for everyday, I'll use this recipe often - thanks for sharing it!

Amazingly delicious burgers!  I don't care for onions so left them out, otherwise made as directed.  Even with so few ingredients these burgers had such great flavor and were so moist and juicy.  Cooked them on the grill and just loved them - thanks for sharing this great recipe!
Great way to enjoy fruit!  I used peaches, grapes and strawberries and really loved the sour cream/brown sugar combination.  Simple and delicious - thanks for posting the recipe!

What a great and easy pasta dish!  The only thing I did differently was to add the noodles back to the pot to warm them in the sauce, instead of pouring the sauce over the noodles in a serving bowl.  Loved the tomato sauce and queso combination.  The whole family really enjoyed this - thanks for sharing the recipe!

Great oatmeal recipe!  I halved the recipe and left out the almonds, otherwise made just as directed.  It's perfectly sweetened as it is - served topped with a little milk and it was a terrific breakfast - thanks for sharing the recipe!

Great guacamole!  Nice and spicy, and liked the green peppers and tomatoes.  I used smoked paprika and left out the celery salt.  Served with tortilla chips and on fajitas and everyone enjoyed - thanks for sharing the recipe!

This is a great, flavorful dish!  I left out the onions, otherwise made just as specified, using your recipe #262189.  Served with flatbread and loved the rich warm flavor of the meat - thanks for sharing this recipe!

This is a yummy pepper salad!  I halved the recipe and used less onion than called for.  I used a pretty good amount of lemon juice and enjoyed the fresh flavor it provided.  Thanks for sharing this recipe!

Love, love, loved this tea!  It is pretty sweet but so refreshing and so tasty!  Great for a hot summer day, a BBQ, or anytime!  Thanks for posting this recipe!  Made for the Comfort Cafe Event, July 2009

Good brownies, easy to make and great for a quick treat!  I halved the recipe and used a regular egg (instead of egg beaters), otherwise made just as specified.  My chips sank to the bottom which seemed to make the brownies stick to the pan a bit, but that didn't seem to affect the flavor, which was great.  Thanks for sharing your recipe!

Delicious way to serve fresh tomatoes!  I only had time for about 8 hours of marinating but they were still terrific.  I've got a couple of slices left which I will enjoy for lunch tomorrow - at that point they will have marinated the full 24 hours! :)  Thanks for posting this recipe!
Yummy, juicy burgers!  All of these flavors worked so well together, and were terrific on the onion buns.  Moist and delicious - thanks for sharing the recipe!
Great smoothie!  Sweet enough but not overly sweet, and just loved the pineapple-coconut flavor.  I used a little more ice and really enjoyed - thanks for posting the recipe!

Nice and tasty oatmeal!  I used half peach juice, half water, otherwise made as specified.  I used a fresh peach and the combination of that flavor with the banana and honey was just great.  This made a yummy and filling breakfast - thanks for sharing this recipe!

This is a great and flavorful meatloaf!  I don't care for onions so left them out of the meatloaf and subbed green pepper for them in the sauce.  The seasoning in this was really good but I will probably use less oatmeal next time.  Loved the sauce too.  Thanks for sharing this recipe!

This is a great, quick and easy grill dish!  We used spicy Italian sausage and thought it was perfect with the bread, onions, and dressing.  I was surprised that the bread toasted so well without burning.  Great meal - thanks for sharing the recipe!

Oh these were good!  Loved the dressing, especially the basil flavor.  I used whole wheat low-fat wraps instead of tortillas, otherwise made as directed.  Really enjoyed these wraps - thanks for posting the recipe!

Mmmmmm - so yummy!   Makes 2 huge servings of sweet, creamy goodness.  I used skim milk, otherwise made just as specified.  Loved the caramel with just a hint of chocolate - went great with the coffee flavor.  Really enjoyed this drink - thanks for sharing the recipe!  Made for the Comfort Cafe Event, July 2009

Yummy tuna salad!  I left out the water chestnuts and pimientos.  I liked the addition of the peas and eggs.  Served this on crackers and enjoyed this quick weeknight meal - thanks for sharing the recipe!

Great soup!  I left out the onion and chopped the carrot instead of grating, otherwise made as specified.  We loved the creaminess and flavor that the sour cream gave this soup.  Great dinner - thanks for posting the recipe!

Wonderful breakfast treat!  Loved the light, eggy pancake - it was great with the fruit.  I loved the blueberry/banana combo but I'm sure any number of fruits would work as well.  Thanks for posting this recipe!

Easy, healthy and delicious!  I had 2 large chicken breasts that I cut into tenders, and used a extra clove of garlic.  This had such great flavor and the lemon added a nice fresh touch.  This came together quickly and all in one pot - loved it - thanks for sharing the recipe!

Wonderful tasty and filling casserole!  I left out the onions as I don't care for them.  I had a can of Rotel tomatoes with chilis so used that instead of the can of green chilis, and increased the macaroni by 1/2 cup to compensate for the extra liquid.  This casserole was delicious and made a LOT - looking forward to leftovers for lunch - thanks for sharing the recipe!

Wonderful dish!  I halved the recipe and left out the onions, otherwise made as specified.  The sauce was fantastic and perfect with the eggs and ham.  Hubby enjoyed his with the avocado, I enjoyed mine without.  We like having "breakfast-for-dinner" and this was a great one - thanks for sharing the recipe!
Great potatoes!  I've never cooked the fingerlings before and they baked up well with a nice flavor.  Loved all the garlic and the parsley too!  Thanks for sharing your recipe!
Good oatmeal, smooth and creamy.  I liked the rich flavor that the butter added.  I love brown sugar and it was perfect in this oatmeal.  Thanks for sharing your recipe!
How easy can you get, and so good!  I left out the onions, otherwise made just as specified.  The ginger flavor was subtle and delightful.  Enjoyed this very much - thanks for posting the recipe!

Oh boy was this a great marinade!  I used it on a couple of steaks, marinating for about 2 hours, and what wonderful flavor.  I look forward to trying it on a roast too as other reviewers have done.  Thanks for posting this yummy recipe!
Really good and flavorful garlic bread!  I halved the recipe and used dried oregano, otherwise made as directed.  Served with some great pasta and really enjoyed - thanks for sharing the recipe!

Wonderful comfort food - rich and delicious!  I don't care for onions so left them out and added a couple of extra cloves of garlic to make up for it.  I used about a teaspoon of salt and a heaping 1/4 teaspoon of pepper.  This was great before the addition of the wine but REALLY great after!  The whole family loved this - thanks for sharing your recipe!  Made for Fall PAC 2009
Yum - what a wonderful way to serve grapefruit!  I did not use the mint and I really enjoyed the flavor of the brown sugar on the grapefruit.  Thanks for sharing your recipe!

Great recipe!  I couldn't find broccoli rabe so had to use regular broccoli.  Instead of red pepper flakes I used recipe #222752 for part of the olive oil.  I went pretty light on the lemon juice but enjoyed the freshness it added to the salty/spicy of the dish.  Thanks for posting this recipe!

Great banana bread!  I used lite butter instead of shortening and used the baking powder as you suggested.  I baked in mini loaf pans and got 4 light and moist little loaves.  Not too sweet with great banana flavor - really enjoyed this bread - thanks for sharing the recipe!  Made for Fall PAC 2009

Great recipe!  The honey, ginger, cinnamon and anise were a perfect flavor compliment to the grapefruit.  I served over some cottage cheese and really enjoyed this - thanks for sharing the recipe!  Made for Fall PAC 2009

Quick, easy, delicious - what more could you ask for?  I made just as specified, using 2 eggs per sandwich.  I would imagine that garlic, pesto, or chipotle mayo would be great as well.  Thanks for sharing your recipe!
Loved these tasty burgers!  I made just as directed and wouldn't change a thing.  They were moist and delicious with a great hearty bbq flavor - thanks for sharing your recipe!

Absolutely delicious chicken!  I used boneless skinless breasts, otherwise made as specified and wouldn't change a thing.  The spices in the rub were outstanding and went so well with the sweet and smoky bbq sauce.  Loved this chicken - thanks for posting the recipe!
So easy and so delicious!  I halved the recipe for 2 and used Vigo brand rice.  Served with some sauteed asparagus and a great dinner was ready in a flash - thanks for posting this recipe!
Great way to prepare asparagus!  It was tender and crisp with a great garlic flavor.  I'll probably use about half the butter next time.  Thanks for sharing your recipe!

What an amazingly simple and delicious breakfast treat!  I cooked mine on a foil-lined cookie sheet for easy cleanup and was careful to spread the topping all the way to the edges of the bread so I wouldn't have any burned spots.  I loved that this was made with brown sugar - tasted like a warm sweet and gooey cinnamon roll.  Thanks for sharing your recipe!
This is terrific!!  The texture is great, sweet but not overly so, and the apples/raisins/nuts are wonderful.  Great and easy breakfast treat - thanks for sharing your recipe!

Whew - this is great stuff!  You weren't kidding about the spice - it's hot hot hot - but rich and flavorful too.  I left out the onions and used less cilantro, otherwise made as specified.  Served it with sour cream and shredded Monterrey Jack and really enjoyed - thanks for sharing the recipe!

Wonderful recipe for grilling turkey!  I marinated for about 12 hours and the turkey was so moist with great flavor.  I used breast tenderloins so the cook time was only about 20 minutes.  Really enjoyed this - thanks for sharing the recipe!

Boy this is a great recipe!  I didn't use the olives, otherwise made as directed and was pleasantly surprised with just how good it was.  I served this with pasta but with a salad I think it could be a meal on its own.  Thanks for sharing your recipe!

This is a really good soup, quick to make and so flavorful!  I made 2 small changes:  I left out the onions and used fresh mushrooms.  The olives and the wine really gave this soup a great robust flavor.  Enjoyed this very much - thanks for sharing the recipe!
Yummy grilled cheese!  I left out the olives, otherwise made as directed.  Loved the yellow pepper in this, great with the swiss and tomato.  Thanks for sharing your recipe!

This is a terrific egg casserole!  I halved the recipe, used ham, and left out the onions.  The casserole baked up nice and fluffy and the sour cream/parmesan topping really made this dish.  Loved it - thanks for posting this winner!

These were really great peppers!  I didn't boil the peppers, just put them empty in the casserole dish I was going to bake them in and microwaved for 3 minutes.  These were very filling and had lots of flavor.  Thanks for sharing your recipe!

Oh boy - I need more than 5 stars for this recipe!  These are terrific nuts - sweet, lightly spicy, perfect with the addition of the dried cranberries.  Great with cocktails or anytime - just loved them - thanks for sharing your recipe!

Loved this soup!  Very tasty with the tarragon and thyme, and quick to make with ingredients I always have on hand.  I used cheddar jack and left out the onions.  Great quick lunch or light dinner - thanks for sharing the recipe!

Yummy egg salad!  I have not added dill to egg salad before but I will from now on - it gives it a wonderful flavor.  Enjoyed with crackers and cucumbers for a great lunch - thanks for sharing the recipe!

This is wonderful oatmeal!  I didn't use the optional raisins and pineapple, otherwise made as stated.  The texture was great and it was perfectly sweetened.  I made this in individual ramekins and cooked for 35 minutes.  Just loved this - thanks for sharing your recipe!
This is a great way to serve steak!  The sauce was a great complement to the beef and easy to make.  Thanks for posting this recipe!

This is a winner of a recipe!  Great taste, easy to prepare with staple ingredients, and healthy too.  I used Recipe #244839 for the seasoning, and didn't use the sour cream.  Loved this - thanks for sharing the recipe!

Great quick and easy enchiladas!  I used leftover turkey and left out the green onion.  During the last few minutes of cooking I sprinkled just a little extra jack cheese on top.  Enjoyed these as a quick hot lunch - thanks for sharing the recipe!

Terrific!  The dash of ginger really gives this drink that something special.  I used dried cranberries as my garnish as that's what I had on hand - they were yummy too after a soak in the drink :)  Thanks for sharing this recipe!

I already love tomato soup so I knew this was going to be great!  I used Velveeta for ease of melting but I think swiss or monterrey jack would be good too.  I added cracked pepper but no extra salt.  Served this as I always do, with Ritz crackers, and really enjoyed - thanks for sharing your recipe!

Delicious!!  Loved the brown sugar with the cranberries.  I didn't have any orange zest so I just added 1/4 tsp of orange juice and that gave it just a hint of orange flavor - perfect.  As with your other 2 baked oatmeals I've tried, I halved the recipe and cooked it in 2 ramekins - ate one warm the day I made it, ate the other cold the next day.  Wonderful both ways - thanks for sharing your recipe!

This is just fantastic!!  I sauteed the mushrooms and bacon in the worcestershire, otherwise made as directed.  The garlic/worcestershire/bacon was so good with the mushrooms - we really loved this - thanks for sharing the recipe!

Wonderful cookies!  I love chocolate and cinnamon together, and the subtle flavor of the cayenne really enhanced both of these.  This recipe's a winner - thanks for posting it!  Made for Photo Tag's Holiday Cookie Exchange 2009

This is a good and flavorful grill rub!  I made it just as directed, using smoked paprika.  I put it on NY strip steaks and thought it was a little sweet - I think it would be terrific on a brisket or ribs.  I left it on overnight and the steaks came out tender and juicy - thanks for sharing your recipe!
Yum - great drink!  Yes it's not too potent, unless you have 2 because it's so good and not too potent :)  Really enjoyed this - thanks for posting the recipe!
This rice is terrific!  I left out the onion, otherwise made as specified.  Great combination of flavors - loved the cajun seasoning - and so easy to make.  Thanks for posting this recipe!
What a delightful way to serve peas!  Made this just as directed and wouldn't change a thing.  The chicken/orange/tarragon combo is just terrific - loved these - thanks for sharing the recipe!

Yum - this is great!  Like a loaded deep dish pizza served upside-down!  I don't care for onions so used green pepper instead; I also left out the olives.  Easy to make, hearty and delicious - thanks for sharing your recipe!
This is a wonderful marinade for chicken!  I made just as directed, marinating for 2 hours, then grilling.  The chicken was moist and tender with such great flavor.  Thanks for posting the recipe!

Mmmmmm - delicious!  I took another reviewer's suggestion and added the candied ginger to the milk as it was warming to bring out more of the ginger flavor.  Really loved this rich and comforting cocoa - thanks for sharing your recipe!  Made for the Comfort Cafe Event, January 2010

Great pasta dish, easy and satisfying.  I removed the sausage from the casing to cook it and left out the onions, otherwise made as specified.  I liked the addition of the green pepper to this; next time I'll add more mozzarella on top.  Thanks for sharing your recipe!
I love homemade bread and this is a good one!  The cheese and bacon are subtle and allow the bread to keep a great soft texture.  Terrific - thanks for sharing the recipe!
This is very tasty oatmeal!  Just as easy as plain old oatmeal but with a great flavor twist.  I made a single serving and didn't add the salt.  Great breakfast - thanks for sharing the recipe!

This is a different and tasty oatmeal!  The chai provided a nice flavor and using honey for the sweetener was a good match.  Enjoyed this breakfast - thanks for posting the recipe!  Made for the Comfort Cafe Event, January 2010
Easy and tasty chicken dish!  I used thin sliced chicken breasts which made the wrapping easy, and I just held them with toothpicks.  Really enjoyed this - thanks for sharing the recipe!

Oh yeah....this is comfort food for me too!  I used wide egg noodles, didn't add the optional caraway, and couldn't resist adding just a little crisp crumbled bacon.  Easy to make and inexpensive - really enjoyed this - thanks for sharing the recipe!

Boy this is great stuff - and one-pot easy!  I used less mozzarella and a little more garlic.  I stirred half of the cheese I used into the sauce and melted the rest on top.  I loved the addition of spinach to this as well.  Thanks for posting this great recipe!

Wow - terrific dessert - easy yet elegant!  I didn't have any almond extract so I used Amaretto - yum!  Dusted mine with a little cocoa powder and really enjoyed - thanks for sharing your recipe!  Made for the Top Favorites of 2009 event

Boy I loved these carrots!  The cook time was right on to produce tender yet firm carrots and the sweet glaze was terrific!!  Really enjoyed these - thanks for sharing the recipe!  Made for the Top Favorites of 2009 event

Yum - these are terrific potatoes!  I left out the green onions, otherwise made as specified.  The rich gouda cheese really makes this dish.  Thanks for sharing your recipe!  Made for the Top Favorites of 2009 event

I love baked oatmeal and this one's a winner!  The pumpkin flavor shines here; I was afraid it wouldn't be sweet enough but it was just right.  I halved the recipe and did add the optional pecans and enjoyed every bite - thanks for sharing the recipe!  Made for the Top Favorites of 2009 event

Delicious!  Love the cranberry/jalapeno mix.  I left out the onion and went light on the cilantro.  Served over cream cheese with melba toast and really enjoyed - thanks for sharing the recipe!  Made for the Top Favorites of 2009 event

This is terrific pasta!  I left out the onions, otherwise made as specified.  This dish came together so quickly with a wonderful, light and fresh taste.  Healthy and delicious - thanks for sharing your recipe!  Made for the Top Favorites of 2009 event

Delicious quesadillas!  I left out the onions and used mushrooms from a jar, otherwise made as specified.  We really enjoyed the addition of the mushrooms and bacon to this.  Great use for some leftover chicken - thanks for sharing your recipe!  Made for the Top Favorites of 2009 event

Very nice French Toast!  I've never baked a french toast before and this was really good.  I scaled this down to a single serving and enjoyed the subtle orange flavor.  Topped with a little syrup this made a great breakfast - thanks for sharing the recipe!  Made for the Top Favorites of 2009 event

This odd combination of ingredients made a really GREAT hamburger!  I halved the recipe (but used 1.25 lbs gr beef) and used onion powder instead of minced onion, otherwise made as directed.  These grilled up perfectly with great flavor.  Served no-frills with cheese, ketchup and mustard and really enjoyed - thankd for sharing the recipe!

Great pancakes, rich and tasty.  The oatmeal in these made them dense and hearty, and the brown sugar was perfect.  Thanks for posting this great breakfast treat!  Made for the Top Favorites of 2009 event
I love zucchini and this is a great way to prepare it!  Easy to make, perfectly seasoned - terrific - thanks for sharing the recipe!

You've gotta love a dish that tastes great and can be on the table in 20 minutes!  I was a bit worried that this would be bland but it really wasn't - the garlic and bacon really gave this fresh dish just the right amount of flavor.  I used fettuccine, served with garlic bread and really enjoyed - thanks for sharing the recipe!
Oh what a great recipe!  Easy to make and just delicious.  The coating for the chicken is perfect and the sauce is terrific.  The whole family loved this - thanks for sharing your recipe!

Wow - these beans are terrific!  Easy to make and packed with flavor.  I ground the herbs together and what a great combination they were with the balsamic vinegar.  Loved these - thanks for sharing the recipe!
Oh yeah - this is fantastic!  I only had pink lemonade so had to use that and it was soooo good.  Love this drink - thanks for posting the recipe!
Rich, creamy, satisfying, delicious!  I did throw a couple of raisins in and really enjoyed this great breakfast - thanks for sharing the recipe!
Very tasty chicken recipe!  I had peach preserves on hand so that's what I used.  Great combination of sweet and savory and very easy to make - thanks for sharing the recipe!

Mmmmm - great carrots!  I scaled the recipe to 2 servings and was a little heavy-handed with the cayenne because I love it.  I used cut baby carrots and this was ready to cook in a jiffy.  Great sweet flavor with a nice kick from the cayenne - thanks for sharing this recipe!

This wrap makes a great breakfast!  I used a lowfat multigrain flatbread wrap instead of a tortilla, and lowfat cheddar-jack cheese.  I also cooked mine using cooking spray instead of oil, so I ended up with a tasty and filling breakfast that was pretty healthy too.  Enjoyed this - thanks for posting the recipe!

YUM!  I loved this oatmeal.  I liked the pieces of banana cooked in the oatmeal - mine was lightly sweet and very tasty.  I topped mine with chopped pecans instead of pumpkin seed and really enjoyed - thanks for sharing your recipe!
Very nice fish recipe!  The lime and the Mexican spices are a perfect pairing.  I used tilapia and my fish-loving DH gave this 2 thumbs up - thanks for sharing your recipe!

Yum - very tasty eggs!  I cut this down to 2 servings; I don't care for onion so left it out, and I used a small red potato so I didn't peel it.  Served with salsa and enjoyed a great breakfast - thanks for sharing the recipe!
We really loved these peppers!  So fresh and light and easy to make.  I used garlic salad croutons for the bread pieces and it worked perfectly.  Thanks for posting this recipe!

This is a great hearty potato that's a meal in itself!  I mixed a little pepper-jack cheese into the potato mixture as well as putting some on top.  Very filling, very tasty - thanks for sharing your recipe!
This is an easy and flavorful chicken dish!  I halved the recipe and used a small red potato.  Very tasty and healthy - thanks for posting this recipe!

Great fruity smoothie!  The flaxseed gave this an interesting texture as well as a nutrition boost.  I used apple juice instead of honey as I don't like my smoothies too thick.  Thanks for sharing this tasty recipe!
Amazingly easy and delicious!  Love all that garlic!  I used less oil and more sesame.  I served this to two but I could have eaten the whole batch myself - thanks for sharing your recipe!

I really loved this breakfast treat!  The almonds I thought I had were actually pecans so I used those, and used regular (not quick cooking) oatmeal.  The raisins and spices were a perfect match to the nutty quinoa.  I served with a little low-fat milk and enjoyed every bite - thanks for sharing the recipe!

Lovely chicken dish!  I used boneless skinless breasts and no oil, otherwise made as directed.  The chicken was perfectly cooked and full of flavor - loved the cinnamon and cloves.  Served with roasted potatoes and green beans and just loved this - thanks for sharing the recipe!
What a great refreshing drink!  Not too thick but very tasty.  I used vanilla ice cream this time but I'm looking forward to trying it with lemon or lime sherbet.  Thanks for sharing your recipe!
Wow - these are awesome turkey burgers!  I left out the onion as I don't care for it, otherwise made as directed.  These came out moist and so flavorful.  Great recipe - thanks for sharing it!

Mmmmmm - great mushrooms!  My mushrooms were huge so 1 per serving was plenty for us.  I used recipe #424830 for the pesto and it was terrific.  Perfectly grilled after the 20 minutes and just delicious - thanks for sharing this recipe!

Loved this couscous!  I loved grilled veggies so I knew this would be great and it was.  I used basil for the herbs (plenty of it!) and did not used the olives or feta.  Thanks for posting this recipe!
Great BBQ sauce!  Loved the tangy and sweet flavor.  I grilled boneless skinless chicken breasts and they came out so juicy with great flavor.  Thanks for posting this recipe!

Delicious!  I left out the onion as I don't care for it; I had on hand 1 zucchini and 1 yellow squash so that's what I used.  Even that small amount of red wine vinegar gave this a nice little zip.  Served over spaghetti and loved it - thanks for sharing the recipe!

What a great spice mix!  Nice blend of "hot" spices and "sweet" spices that is perfect for chicken.  I used this on your recipe #422400 and we really enjoyed it - thanks for sharing the recipe!  Made for ZWT6, Zwizzle Chicks

What a great scone recipe!  These had the perfect texture and I love the combo of salty bacon and sweet blueberries.  Except for the fruit these were not all that sweet which I think is a good thing.  Really enjoyed these - thanks for sharing the recipe!  Made for ZWT6, Zwizzle Chicks

Different and tasty sandwich!  I used honey-wheat bread instead of rye, otherwise made as directed.  I really loved the dressing, the dill was a perfect touch and great with the eggs.  Fresh and delicious - thanks for sharing the recipe!  Made for ZWT6, Zwizzle Chicks

Yummy eggs, quick and easy!  I made one serving using lower-fat cheddar and it came out really well.  Served with toast and juice for a great breakfast - thanks for sharing the recipe!  Made for ZWT6, Zwizzle Chicks

Loved these cupcakes!  I made these more of a dessert - I mixed some low-fat cream cheese with some marshmallow creme, put a scoop on top of the cupcakes, and put some strawberry slices on that.  The strawberry soda really gave these a sweet fruity flavor and they were so moist.  Thanks for sharing your recipe!  Made for ZWT6, Zwizzle Chicks

Loved this recipe!  The garlic and crushed red pepper made this a winner for me.  The broccoli was a nice combination with the tomatoes and parmesan.  Great recipe - thanks for sharing it!  Made for ZWT6, Zwizzle Chicks
Very nice drink, refreshing and smooth.  The sweet lime was great with the whiskey.  Thanks for sharing the recipe!  Made for ZWT6, Zwizzle Chicks

Nice mushroom recipe with great flavor!  I used less onion and sliced instead of diced, otherwise made as directed.  I didn't add any salt as the chicken stock powder is salty enough.  Enjoyed these with grilled steak - thanks for sharing the recipe!  Made for ZWT6, Zwizzle Chicks

Boy this was really good!  I don't care for onions so left them out, and left out the feta to keep the calories down a bit.  I love Cavenders - who knew it would taste so great in eggs?!  This makes a great breakfast that I will definitely make again - thanks for sharing the recipe!  Made for ZWT6, Zwizzle Chicks
Great drink!  Made as directed and served over ice.  Loved the melon/coconut combo - thanks for sharing the recipe!  Made for ZWT6, Zwizzle Chicks

Great sandwich, tasty and filling!  I don't care for onions so left them out and just added a bit more celery.  I loved the salty addition of the bacon.  Thanks for posting the recipe!  Made for ZWT6, Zwizzle Chicks
Nice drink!  I like limeade with just about anything so this was great for me.  I used lemon-flavored club soda and really enjoyed - thanks for sharing the recipe!  Made for ZWT6, Zwizzle Chicks

I *loved* this salad!  I don't care for onions so left them out.  I used red wine vinegar as it's what I had on hand and the dressing was *perfect* with the lettuce, cukes, and strawberries.  Terrific summer salad - thanks for sharing the recipe!  Made for ZWT6, Zwizzle Chicks

Wonderful, flavorful dish!  I don't care for onions so left them out, otherwise made as directed.  I used diced tomatoes with basil and garlic so didn't need to add anything else to the meat.  The only thing I would do differently next time is to add the cheese midway during baking, as mine got a little brown this time.  Really enjoyed this - thanks for sharing the recipe!  Made for ZWT6, Zwizzle Chicks
Great drink!  Goes down smooth and easy.  I used vanilla vodka and really enjoyed - thanks for sharing the recipe!  Made for ZWT6, Zwizzle Chicks

WOW - these are TERRIFIC!  I left out the been thread noodles and used extra bean sprouts instead.  Mine got nice and crispy; I wish they had gotten a little browner but the flavor and texture was still perfect.  Loved the dipping sauce too; I didn't have any hot sesame oil so just added some red pepper flakes.  Can't say enough about this great recipe - it's a keeper!  Thanks for sharing!  Made for ZWT6, Zwizzle Chicks

Very nice dessert - like a walnut brownie!  The walnut taste really shines through here.  I served with a light drizzle of nutella; next time I may sprinkle some chocolate chips and/or coconut on top before baking.  Thanks for sharing the recipe!  Made for ZWT6, Zwizzle Chicks

Quick and easy lunch!  I used a regular tortilla as that's what I had.  The addition of the basil gives this a little something special.  Nice lunch with ingredients I always have on hand - thanks for sharing the recipe!

Great oatmeal, quick to make and tasty.  I cooked mine in the microwave.  I liked the brown sugar with the blueberries, it's a great combo.  Thanks for posting the recipe!  Made for ZWT6, Zwizzle Chicks

Nice breakfast, easy to make and filling.  I don't care for onion so left it out, and I left the skin on my potatoes.  I put a lid on the skillet after adding the eggs to help them get set on top.  Thanks for sharing your recipe!  Made for ZWT6, Zwizzle Chicks

Great roasted veggies!  I don't care for onion so left it out, otherwise made as specified.  The addition of the balsamic vinegar before roasting gave this a unique flavor.  Thanks for sharing the recipe!  Made for ZWT6, Zwizzle Chicks

This is a great little salad!  I used cucumber instead of zucchini and really loved the dressing.  Great combination of crunchy veggies, croutons, nuts and seeds - we enjoyed this - thanks for sharing the recipe!
This soup is fantastic!  So easy to make and tastes delicious.  We love the soup we get at our favorite Chinese restaurant and this is as good if not better - thanks for sharing the recipe!

Great burgers!  Loved the glaze on these; I added a couple of spoonfuls of it to the meat mixture as well.  To shave off a few calories I used ground turkey and low-fat low-cal sandwich rounds.  The sweet-n-spicy flavor was great with the turkey.  Thanks for sharing the recipe!

This is a great and healthy version of potato salad!  I left out the onions as I don't care for them, otherwise made as directed.  I enjoyed the dijon dressing; it was a nice and light change from mayo.  Thanks for posting this recipe!
Great sandwich!  Easy to make and so flavorful with the fresh basil (my fav!).  I liked the method of toasting, brushing with olive oil and broiling.  Thanks for posting a great recipe!
Tasty and easy oatmeal!  I doubled the oatmeal and water but left the other ingredients the same.  I really liked the addition of the vanilla.  Thanks for posting the recipe!

Great chicken recipe!  I don't care for onions so just used a little extra mushrooms and peppers, otherwise made as directed.  I used crushed red pepper flakes and was generous with the amount - this had a great little kick!  Gotta love a tasty recipe that can be made with ingredients I always have on hand - thanks for sharing the recipe!
Great burgers, moist and flavorful!  I left out the onions, otherwise made as specified and cooked on the grill.  Great summer meal - thanks for sharing the recipe!

These tomatoes were SO good!  Easy to fix, I served with pork chops but I think they'd be good with just about anything.  I made just as directed and would not change a thing.  Thanks for sharing this great recipe!

Outstanding BBQ sauce!  Loved the smokey/spicy/sweet flavor.  I added a little more chipotle than called for.  Used this to grill chicken breasts but I think it would be terrific on ribs as well.  Thanks for posting this keeper!

Great zucchini sticks!  The cook time/temp was just right and mine came out nice and crunchy.  The only thing I will do differently next time is cut my sticks a little smaller.  Thanks for sharing your recipe!

Delicious and healthier quiche!  I used canadian bacon and celery instead of onions.  This was easy to make and nice and hearty - I think maybe because of the potato - I was surprised how good it was with only 4 eggs.  Loved the basil too.  Thanks for posting this recipe!

This is a terrific veggie dish - quick and easy to make and delicious!  I left out the onions, otherwise made as directed.  I served this as a side dish but next time will serve as a main course over rice or tossed with pasta.  Loved this - thanks for sharing the recipe!

Wonderful!!  I made just as directed using both cinnamon and nutmeg.  I added the raisins shortly after adding the milk so that they would plump up.  This smelled so good while cooking and came out sweet, creamy, spicy and delicious - thanks for sharing the recipe!

Great oatmeal recipe, tasty and filling!  Using the maple syrup for the sweetener really made this and set it apart from my usual oatmeal.  I used lowfat milk and didn't toast the almonds.  Thanks for posting this recipe!

Great recipe, easy to make and delicious!  I didn't use the oil, just sauteed with cooking spray, and used lowfat mushroom soup with good results.  Loved the dijon flavor in this.  Topped it with chopped parsley and loved this chicken - thanks for sharing the recipe!

Great inexpensive recipe and fairly easy to make!  I sprayed my pan with cooking spray and used as little oil as possible to cook the flatbreads.  Served them with dinner but I think they'd be good for breakfast, warm and sprinkled with cinnamon and sugar too.  Thanks for posting the recipe!

Sometimes you find a recipe that is as enjoyable to make as it is to eat and this is one of those recipes!  The aroma of the parsley, lemon, and all the spices in the baharat is just wonderful and is noticed while you make the meatballs and while they are cooking.  I used your suggestion of recipe #79179 as a base for the spices that I added.  These turned out moist and delicious - thanks for sharing the recipe!

Great recipe and so easy to make!  Very filling and flavorful.  I used regular enchilada sauce this time but will use hot next time.  Served for dinner and enjoyed a great hearty meal - thanks for sharing the recipe!
Delicious!  Cheddar jack cheese was great with the bacon and egg.  I used the ready-to-eat bacon so this was a breeze to put together.  Thanks for sharing the recipe!
What a wonderful treat!  I halved the recipe, otherwise made as directed.  These were easy to make, wonderfully sweet, and loved the walnuts.  Thanks for sharing the recipe!

Oh boy did we love these meatballs!  I made just as directed and would not change a thing.  I'm not a big fan of onions and when I tasted the sauce after pureeing the onion and tomatoes I was afraid the onion flavor would be too strong for my taste.  After cooking I thought the sauce was delicious and a perfect complement to the seasoning in the meat.  I served these with recipe #323307 Mana'eesh (J)gibneh - Cheese Pastries; the next day I split one of the pastries, tucked a few slices of meatball in, and enjoyed a wonderful lunch.  Thanks for sharing this recipe!

These were terrific!  The dough came out smooth and easy to work with.  Mine rose quite a bit while baking and came out soft and tender, just as I wanted them.  I topped with mozzarella cheese.  I served these with recipe #387638 Koftit Roz (Rice Meatballs) ; the next day I split open one of the pastries, stuffed a couple of sliced meatballs in, and enjoyed a delicious lunch.  Great recipe - thanks for posting it!

Really enjoyed these eggs!  Very unusual combination of flavors and nothing I would think to add to a scrambled egg but they really went well together.  I'll probably reduce the amount of mustard a bit next time.  Thanks for sharing the recipe!
Great drink!  Love that fresh lime flavor.  Enjoyed with the vodka and I think it would be great with rum or spiced rum too.  Thanks for sharing the recipe!

Great simple and tasty salad!  I left out the onion (don't care for it) and used parsley instead of cilantro.  Pretty to look at, great texture and such a nice fresh taste - thanks for sharing the recipe!

This drink is a pure delight!  I used lowfat milk and my dark chocolate was sweetened, so 1 T of honey was plenty for me and gave it a wonderful sweetness and richness.  This was a nice relaxing treat on a dreary rainy day - thanks for sharing the recipe!
This shot is just great!  I've made this chilled and shaken before but I really enjoyed it layered as well - gave it another taste dimension that was just wonderful.  Thanks for sharing this!

Easy to make and healthy soup!  I used fresh broccoli, otherwise made as directed.  I was pleasantly surprised at how well the tomatoes went with this soup.  We enjoyed this very much - thanks for sharing the recipe!

Filling and tasty soup!  I don't care for onions so left them out, and I didn't peel my potatoes.  I had to add the extra water as you suggested and my soup was still thick, like a chowder.  Made as directed this was very good; next time I'll probably add a chopped jalapeno and maybe top with a little cheddar.  Thanks for posting this recipe!

This is a wonderful soup!  I made two small changes:  I rinsed and drained the beans, and I used chopped fresh tomatoes instead of canned.  The basil pesto really made this soup, adding a rich flavor that was perfect with the beans and other veggies.  Served with a caeser salad and pita chips, this was a terrific quick and easy meal - thanks for sharing this winner!
This is a wonderful cake!  Easy to make, rich, moist and delicious.  I made half of the recipe with good results.  Loved this - thanks for posting the recipe!

I loved baked oatmeal and this is a good one!  I made 1/3 of the recipe with good results, and I added some chopped walnuts for a little extra crunch.  I liked that this was not overly sweet.  Thanks for sharing the recipe!

Nice rub and very tasty on fish!  I made just as directed and found it to be a very nice flavor combination.  Used on some tilapia that I pan fried and we really enjoyed - thanks for sharing the recipe!

I enjoy cooked carrots and this is a great recipe for them!  I especially enjoyed the tangy flavor of the vinegar.  I used baby carrots sliced very thin and they came out great - thanks for sharing the recipe!

Yum!  DH loves his deviled eggs and he thought these were terrific!  I left out the onions as I don't care for them, and I used the dill option.  Creamy, flavorful, delicious - thanks for sharing the recipe!

Oh yeah this was GOOOD!  The sauce was bold and flavorful, perfect with the meat.  I reserved some of the marinade to use as a basting sauce instead of boiling the used marinade, and we didn't use any for dipping.  Wonderful recipe - thanks for sharing this keeper!

This was delightful!  I made half of the recipe.  I don't have a regular food processor, just a mini one that has to stay closed while it's running, so I just added a tiny amount of oil, processed a bit, added more, etc until I got the consistency I wanted.  I added just a small amount of honey for sweetener and no extra salt.  Enjoyed on multigrain toast - thanks for sharing this treat!

This salad is a delight!  I just love the combination of cinnamon and cumin in this, it's a great pairing of flavors that goes well with the sweetness of the carrots and apples.  This salad definitely needs to be chilled for a couple of hours before serving to allow the flavors to meld.  Thanks for sharing the recipe!
Very nice recipe for roasted veggies!  Loved the garlic and lemon.  Easy to make too - thanks for posting the recipe!

Different and tasty way to prepare sweet potatoes!  The Parmesan/garlic/rosemary topping was wonderful with the sweet potato flavor.  Mine were not as crispy as I'd hoped they would be but they were delicious none the less.  Thanks for sharing this recipe!
Yum!  Nice and spicy (the way we like it!).  I don't care for onions so replaced them with red bell pepper.  Light and healthy but very filling - can't beat that - thanks for sharing the recipe!

This is fantastic!  I used dried cranberries instead of raisins and walnuts instead of pecans, as that's what I had on hand, otherwise made as directed.  I served with maple syrup as you suggested but only a little, just to get that maple flavor, as this was already wonderfully sweet.  This will be a great breakfast to serve to company over the holidays - thanks for sharing the recipe!

Wow these are terrific!  A little time-consuming to make but well worth the effort.  Perfect balance of sweet and spicy and the smoked paprika is a must - wonderful with the other flavors.  Loved these - thanks for sharing the recipe!

Love this great zucchini dish!  I left out the onions and pine nuts and used turkey Italian sausage.  I also sauteed the zucchini pulp in with the sausage.  Loved the addition of the crushed red pepper flakes, gave this a nice little zip.  Thanks for posting this great recipe!

I was totally amazed by this dish!  I've never had tofu before (not knowingly anyway!) but I'm always looking for ways to make my favorite dishes lighter and healthier so I decided to give this a try.  I don't care for onions so left them out, and I used turkey sausage instead of ground beef, otherwise made as directed.  Following your suggestion to generously season the tofu mixture I used about a teaspoon of basil, 1/2 teaspoon of salt, 1/2 teaspoon of garlic powder, 1/2 teaspoon or oregano, and 1/4 teaspoon of black pepper.  The texture and flavor just as it should be, rich-tasting and creamy.  We really loved this and I will definitely make it again - thanks for sharing this keeper!
Simple and delicious soup!   I used turkey meatballs with good results.  Nice and spicy, and easy to make - thanks for sharing the recipe!

Great healthy snack mix!  Instead of using raisins and mangos, I used a dried fruit mix of raisins, apples, pears, plums, and peaches.  This was my first try of pumpkin seeds and I enjoyed them.  Thanks for sharing your recipe!
Great drink, sweet and strong!  I used 3 oz of lowfat milk instead of half-and-half and it was still nice and creamy.  Loved the cinnamon and brown sugar too.  Thanks for sharing the recipe!
Great hot chocolate!  Loved the cinnamon and the sweetening from the brown sugar.  Rich and comforting - thanks for sharing the recipe!
