These are easy to make and tasted great.  I has small potatoes so they cooked in about 11 minutes.  I like the addition of the lemon juice, makes the potatoes taste lighter.  Made for Week 2 Football Pool win 2010.

This was was to make and tasted great!  I made 1/2 the recipe for DH and I and it was the perfect snack while watching football.  I only added one green onion instead of 2 because not DH's favorite, but you could still taste it.  Made for PRMR.

Wasn't sure how this would go over, but everyone loved it!  It was creamy and flavorful; even got everyone to eat the tomatoes!  I used a deep frying pan to brown/simmer the beef so there was room to mix the noodles, cheese and soup in, then just poured all into the casserole.  Made for Everyday Holiday.

This is so good and quick to whip up!  I made with chicken fillets so no need to pound flat the chicken.  I used regular thick cut bacon instead of the pepper bacon so DSs would eat it.  Is a good summer meal; may try it on the grill next time.  Made for I Recommend Tag.

This is very similar to what my MIL calls chili!  Was very easy to put together and perfect for a quick early dinner.  Mine was not really a 'soup', the finished product had more of a spaghetti consistency, but was very tastey.  Made for I Recommend Tag.

This was good and pretty easy to put together.  Made for a cold fall Saturday lunch and everyone gobbled it up!  I used pineapple tidbits that I drained and did not chop, and deli ham that I chopped up.  We all love Hawaiian Pizza so this was perfect for my family.  Made for I Recommend Tag.

YThis is a good drink that is not too sweet and not to sour.  I love the combo of pineapple and Midori, next time I will use Malibu Rum rather than plain since it is my favorite.  Made for Everday Holiday Tag.
This was really good!  I was weary of the ranch dressing, but it was tastey!!  I made it with shredded hashbrowns but otherwise made as is.  Made for PRMR.

These are excellent potaotes!!!  Made with beef smoked sausage.  These were moist and cheese and were perrfect as a side dish, next time will make as as main dish.  Putting this into our Best of 2010 cookbook!  Made for Newest Zaar.

This is soo good, I ate what was left after dinner right out of the bowl!!  I used my mandolin and sliced the onions very thin.  I couldn't find the Smokehouse pepper so used regular, but will have to search a few other stores to get it and try.  Made with recipe#433985 and it was a good compliment.  Made for Photo Tag.

These were good and a change from the usual plain peas.  I used a mixture of frozen peas, and fresh snow peas and sugar snap peas (the snows peas at the store didn't look that good).  I did cook them in the boiling water a little longer since we prefer more tender veggies.  Topped with chives and DH ate 2 servings!!  Made for Everyday Holiday.

These were good carrots and the fact that I can just put in the crockpot and not worry about them is even better!  Made as is except accidently grapped the 1/2 cup measuring cup rather than the 1/3 so there was a little more glaze.  It actually turned out well, had a little to pour over the carrots.  Made for 123Hits.

This is a good chicken salad to have as a filling lunch.  Made a few changes to accomodate for what I had on hand:  used sour cream instead of the yogurt and green onion instead of regular.  Also did not add the bell pepper.  Served this on crusty Italian bread; I made a serving for 3 which gave DH and I a FULL sandwich!  Made for Everyday Holiday.
This was so good and so easy to make!!  I added a little bacon, grilled chicken and corn.  Will be making again, DH LOVES rice!!  Made for Make My Recipe Aus/NZ.

This chicken is delicious!!  I marinated for about an hour and then pabed at 350F for 40 minutes and it was perfect.  I used b/s chicken thighs since that is what we usually eat for dark meat.  Will make again!  Made for 123Hits.

This chicken was flavorful and easy to make.  DH and DS's really liked it; I thought the lemon flavor was a bit strong, but then again I am not a huge fan of sour flavors.  Made for Sharon123 Cook-A-Thon.
This is very tastey!!  I omitted the red pepper flakes and used dried parsley.  Was a good addition to our spaghetti dinner.  Made for Sharon123 Cook-A-Thon.
This was a little too sour for me, I like REALLY sweet drinks!  DH on the other hand loved it and drank it down quickly!  Made for Week 6 Football Pool win 2010.

These were quick and easy; I sliced the potatoes on my mandolin so they would be evenly cooked.  I did add salt and pepper to every layer and next time will also add cheese to every layer.  Made for I Recommend Tag.

Good sandwich!!  I like that there is not a ton of eggs on it; will have to try also with a fried egg.  Made as is with white bread.  Had one for breakfast and wrapped up the other for DH to take to work tomorrow.  Made for I Recommend Tag.

This was very tastey and quick to make!  I used dried parsley since my parsley plant froze and died, but it still had a nice flavor.  I chopped my cashews up small so you wouldn/t get bit hunks when you take a bite.  I did sprinkle in a little cumin since I served this with chimichangas.  Made for Photo Tag.
These were so easy and quick to make!  I put sticks in the marshmallows so used those to dip them in the chocolate; added some sprinkles and dessert is covered.  Made for Sharon123 Cook-A-Thon.

I love cream soda and thought that mixed with ice cream it would be too sweet, but it wasn't!  Made with vanilla bean ice cream and drizzled a little caramel sauce on top.  Made for Sharon123 Cook-A-Thon.

These were tastey made as directed.  I did add a little chopped green onion tot he top and some salt and pepper, but otherwise made as is.  I liked that you get  your veggies and a potato side done in one dish!  Made for Everyday Holiday.

These potatoes are very good!  I am the only one that eats broccoli so I scaled it back to 2 servings for dinner and a lunch later in the week.  I just guessed on the weight of my potatoes and was a little short because after I mixed everything together, it was a little creamier consistancy than mashed potatoes, but was so good still!!  Will make again and do a better job at measuring.  Made for Newest Zaar.

This is really good!  Made as written but used dried parsley and crumbled some bacon on top.  Went well with our bacon and lettuce sandwiches.  Next time I may add sone ham and potatoes to have a complete meal.  Made for PRMR.

We really enjoyed this recipe!!  We love and prefer b/s thighs to white meat, and I can make breaded chicken everyday for DH and he would be happy!  Using the panko crumbs make it so much crispier!  Made exactly as written (except used dried parsley), only change next time is I may only use half the mushrooms since I am the only one who eats them.  Made for AUS/NZ Make My Recipe Tag.

I made this exactly as written, and the shells came off perfectly!  The yolks were bright yellow and there was not a spot of green/grey color.  The only thing I will change next time is to boil the eggs a minute or two longer (as suggested in the recipe) so the yolks are cooked a little more; I wanted to try the recipe first as stated before changing times.  Made for I Recommend Tag.

These are really good!!  I did cook them a little longer so they got a little softer (DSs do not like crunchy-cooked carrots), and I used dried parsley.  The ginger ale gave the carrots a sweet flavor, but not overpowering.  Will make these again!  Made for Newest Zaar.
This was a really good and not overpowering marinade.  I let it marinate for 5 1/2 hours; it grilled up quickly!  Made for Week 7 Football Pool win 2010.

This is so good!  It was quick and easy to throw in the crock pot and I used a liner so clean up was a snap!  I used b/s chicken thighs rather than breasts that I cut into pieces.  Seasoned the chicken with seasoned salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder.  This is a definate keeper!!  Made for AUS/NZ Recipe Swap #46.
Excellent chicken!!  I used b/s chicken breasts but otherwise made as written.  Such a great flavor from just 3 ingredients!  Will make again.  Made for Photo Tag.

This is a really good tenderloin!!  I marinated it yesterday morning and got home too late to make last night so made today; the flavor from the marinade from being in so long was excellent!  I liked it with the added sauce and without; the sauce had a sort of sweet and sour taste but complimented the tenderloin well.  I forgot to add the peanuts, but otherwise made as it.  This was worth grilling in the 45 degrees and dark!  Made for Photo Tag.

These potatoes are amazing!  I made as written but used dried rosemary.  I cut my potatoes small and they were done in 50 minutes.  Next time I will make the whole recipe instead of half so there are leftovers for me too, not just DHs lunch!  Made for 123Hits.

This was really good, filling and messy to eat!!  I used green leaf lettuce so it was a little hard to wrap since the leaves were wavy and thin.  I did add in 1/2 a diced avocado that was going to go bad.  This will be made again!  Made forEveryday Holiday.

This was really good and perfect for DH and I.  I made 1/2 the recipe since DS's do not eat potatoes and it was more than enough for dinner and a couple of lunched for DH.  Next time I may cut back a little on the cajun seasoning and go with something a little milder (I am a wimp!!).  Made for PRMR.

Sooo good!!  I made this with Italian sandwich bread and it turned out great!  There was enough egg mixture to cover 5 slices which was plenty for DH, DS and I since we also had eggs and bacon.  Will make this again, it was so easy and I liked that you don't have to let the bread sit overnight.  Made for 123Hits.

These green beans were really good and the cajon seasoning gave them great flavor!!  The only change I made was to steam the green beans rather than boil them.  Will be making these again and again, I love fresh green beans so always looking for great recipes! Made for I Recommend Tag.

These were really good!  I like that you can taste the onion which I like, but it was not too overpowering like DH likes.  I made with cheddar cheese, but otherwise made as is.  Will be making these again!  Made for AUS/NZ Make My Recipe Tag.

I agree this is more like a biscuit than bread, but it is very good.  Next time I think I will add some bacon crumbles; am going to use some of the leftovers to make homemade croutons, will be a perfect cheesy bite in a salad.  Made for 123Hits.

This is such a great marinade!!  I used canned pineapple since it is hard to get a fresh one in WI this time of year.  Made as directed and it was perfect.  DH kept saying Mmmmm, so good with every other bite so it is a keeper!  Made for Photo Tag.

These were really creamy and cooked well, I didn't know potatoes would turn out so well in a crockpot!!  I used dried chives and parsley and added salt, pepper, and garlic powder.  The lemon is a nice addition that does not overpower the potatoes.  Made for Everyday Holiday.
This is sooo good!!  I used sugar-free cherry jello and 1% milk.  The possibilities are endless and this is the first time my 4yr DS said he liked jello!!  Made for Photo Tag (24hour rule).
These were great and I like that they didn't get flat and crispy!  Made 1/2 the recipe as directed; will make these again!!  Made for 123Hits.

I made this for Thanksgiving and everyone loved it!  I do not usually like pumpkin pie, but with the butterscotch it sweetened it up and made it so good!!  I like that it has a top crust too, that is my favorite part.  I couldn't find a lattice cutter and no time to order one so I used a small leaf cookie cutter to make a design.  Also made this for DSs Thanksgiving pie sale and it was one of the firsts to go!!

These were great to munch on during the football games ion Sunday!  I like that the sauce is sweet and not spicy or tangy, reminded me of sloppy joes.  Will make these again; may try cutting the biscuits in half and reshaping to use in a mini-muffin pan for an appie.  Made for Week 10 Football Pool win 2010.

These were really good and easy to get made and in the slow cooker.  Made fro DH to take to a friends to watch Sunday football, but did keep one for myself to taste.  I like that the sauce is not too salty or too sweet and the meat just falls off the bone!  Will be making these again.  Made for AUS/NZ Recipe Swap #47

This was so good!!  I used b/s chicken thighs and a grainy mustard, and left out the red pepper flakes.  I let it marinade for 3 1/2 hours and the flavor was perfect!  Will have to try grilling this when it warms up, loved the marinade!  Made for AUS/NZ Recipe Swap #47.
This smells sooo good cooking with the cinnamon/sugar topping!  I love the subtle taste and the you can still taste a little banana.  Made for PRMR.

Very good!  I did add a little extra brown sugar, but otherwise made as is.  I like that you pretty much just put them in the oven and not worry about them.  I used a bag of baby carrots that I didn't cut.  Made for PRMR.

Amazing flavor and so easy to make!  I did decrease the tabasco but otherwise made as is.  Will be making this again, it was the most tender and juicy tenderloin I have ever made!  Made for AUS/NZ Recipe Swap #47.

These are great beans and will be really good for a summer BBQ!!  Made as is (just made 1/2 the recipe) and they had a great flavor.  A little sweet, but that is how my mom made baked beans so I loved them!  Made for AUS/NZ Recipe Swap #47.

This is very good rice!!  DH loves white rice and I can only eat so much steamed white rice; the pine nuts and stock (I used chicken) gives it a much better flavor.  Can't wait to try it with beef stock!  Made for Make My Recipe in the AUS/NZ forum.

This is very easy to make and yummy too!  I didn't have taco seasoning so used recipe#409568 #409568.  I did goof and added a whole (15 oz) can of corn but it sill turned out good!  Was the perfect meal to have on a lazy day of watching football!  Made for PRMR.
So good!!  Made by cutting recipe in 1/2 and using cheddar cheese.  I did put on more cheese than the recipe called for and it was cheesey goodness!  Made for Football Pool Week 15 win.

These tasted and looked fancy but were so easy to make!!!  I halved the recipe and used recipe#204998 for the dressing.  Will definately be making these again, adding to my Best of 2011 Cookbook!  Made for PRMR.

These are really tastey and will be made frequently because both DSs LOVE these!!  I was able to get a small box of oat bran (just in case we wouldn't use it all) and so I can make a few more batches.  I put too much cooking spray in the muffin cups bacause I was afraid of sticking, so the spray burned a little on the outside.  I added the pecans, used vanilla yogurt and cinnamon applesauce.  I don't feel so bad for letting DS's eat these for lunch since they are so healthy!!  Made for AUS/NZ Recipe Swap #48.

This was quick and easy and had a good flavor.  I had a 12 oz bag of noodles and glad I used less, with the 16 oz I think it may have been too dry.  I got my 5yr DS to eat it but no luck with 1yr DS, but he doesn't eat a ton of things yet so that is expected.  Made for Football Pool 2010 Divisional Playoffs win.

So easy and has a great flavor!  Made 1/2 a batch and stuffed it all in 2 mini-bundt pans.  I used garlic paste so it didn't have as strong of a garlic flavor (so DSs would eat it).  These will be made again!!  Made for Best of 2010 Tag.

These were really good in the oven, I bet will be ten times better this summer on the grill!!  Made in a foil pan for easy clean up.  Added a little dried parsley on top for garnish.  I needed these to cook faster to be done the same time as the rest of my meal (poor planning) so cook for 35 minutes on 400 degrees F.  Made for Photo Tag.

Made this as a pick-me-up after getting home from a day of travel.  Was very tastey and the amount of espresso was perfect!  I added the ice cream to the blender and mixed it in rather than leaving the scoop in the drink.  Made for PRMR.

So good!!  I like that the chili powder cuts the sweetness a little, but is not too spicy for me to eat since I am a whimp!  Made a single serving; glad I did because I could sit and eat a ton of this!  Made for Best of 2010 Cookbook Tag and going into my best of 2011 book!

This was so good!  I think though next time I will add the tomato after the sandwhich is cooked (I don't like warm/soften tomato on my sandwhich) just a personal preference.  I used recipe#438987 for the bacon and it gave it a nice sweet-heat flavor.  Will definate make again!  Made for Best of 2010 Cookbook Tag.

Made these for an easy dinner with the DSs today and they both liked it so big plus!  I left out the peppers and decreased the salsa a little but otherwise followed the recipe.  Served mine with sour cream and extra salsa on the side.  Made for 1-2-3-Hits.

Made a single serving of this for lunch today and it was so good!!  I used red bell pepper but otherwise followed the recipe.  It was very filling and a healthy one-dish meal!  Made for AUS/NZ Make My Recipe Tag.

This was my second attempt at making fresh fish and it turned out perfect!  I used tilapia and made for 1 serving, but did 2 servings of the marinade just in case.  Was so tastey and cooked perfectly; I like that the marinade was not too sweet and the soy sauce didn't over power.  I also used part canola oil and part sesame oil.  Going into my best of 2011 book!  Made for 1-2-3-Hits.

Very good broccoli!  I made 1 serving to have with lunch and it was the perfect amount.  I did leave out the pepper flakes but otherwise made as is.  Will definately make again!  Made for Best of 2010 Cookbook Tag.

This was quick to put together and had a nice creaminess to it.  I didn't use the processor, just a nut chopper and ground the walnut really small; nice time I may use the processor as it was a little too crunchy for me.  Served with mushroom and thyme ravioli it was a great combo.  Made for AUS/NZ Recipe Swap #49.

This was really good and quick to throw together for lunch!  The only change I made was using bottled lemon juice and no zest since I didn't have any lemons.  Will definately make again, especially this summer when my fresh parsley starts growing again!  Made for Best of 2010 Cookbook Tag.

Well I completely forgot the vinegar at the end and they still turned out great!  I loved the addition of the sugar to give them a little sweetness.  I also loved that they are made with fresh not frozen sprouts; i am the only one that eats these so it is easy to pick up 5-6 and make a serving for just me.  Made for Best of 2010 Cookbook Tag.
I must say these are STRANGE, but GOOD!!  I made as is and they had a nice sweetness from the sugared onions and the cream cheese was a nice touch.  Made for PAC Spring 2011.

These were so easy to make and really good!  I used red potatoes and they were done in about 7 minutes since I cut them so small.  Will definately make again, will be perfect in the summer when you don't want to heat the house with the stove/oven.  Made for PAC Spring 2011.

I made half the recipe using southern-style hashbrowns, could not find shredded.  These were really good!  I also used cornflake crumbs rather than crushed up cornflakes.  Will make these again were so easy to  mix up and put in the oven.  They came out creamy and cheesy!  Made for 123Hits.

Really good!  I love teriyaki sauce and French's fried onions so this was perfect for me!  I used a bottled teriyaki sauce, but next time I will use my recipe (the bottle stuff was to salty).  Only thing I did different was to put the onions in the food processor and ground them into dust so DS's would think thet were breadcrumbs. :wink:  Made for PAC Spring 2011.
These are really good and good for you!  Made as is, except put 1/2 the raisins.  Are really good warmed up for breakfast.  Made for PAC Spring 2011.
This is a great seasoning combo!  I used it in my spaghetti sauce and also sprinkled it on french bread with parmesan cheese.  Will be using often!  Made for 123Hits.

Very good!  Made plain Stove Top fancy.  I made with low-sodium chicken flavored and left out the celery.  The addition of the apples and craisins gives it a nice sweet flavor.  I will be making this again!  Made for Everyday Holiday.

These are fantastic!  I got lazy and just added all the seasonings and cheese to the butter and mixed the biscuits around in it.  They came out evenly seasoned and buttered.  Served with pizza and a salad for a quick dinner, and both boys ate them so a big plus!!  Made for 123 Hits.

These spuds were so good!!  I like "baked" baked potatoes (rather than microwaved) and these tasted just like one.  The oil gave the skins a nice crispy texture and the inside was fluffly.  We topped these with butter and sour cream; next time may add cheese and bacon and make a loaded squashed potato!  Made for PRMR.
So simple and quick, this made a great side dish tonight!  I made half the recipe and used a chicken bullion cube in the water since that is all I had.  Made for ZWT 7-HOT PINK LADIES.

I LOVE baked sweet potatoes, and the addition of the brown sugar reminds my of how they made them at a favorite resturant of mine in WI!  The only chage I made was to use unsalted butter since that is what I buy.  Made for ZWT 7-THE HOT PINK LADIES.

This chicken has such a great flavor!  I used b/s chicken thighs, but otherwise made as directed.  We eat a lot of baked-breaded chicken and this is one of my familys' new favorites!  Made for ZWT 7-THE HOT PINK LADIES.

This was a nice light lunch!  It didn't have too much mayo like some crab salads so that was good.  I used imitation crabmeat, subbed parsley for cilantro (do NOT like the stuff) and left out the pepper.  Will make this again!!  Made for ZWT 7-THE HOT PINK LADIES.

We really enjoyed this and it was so easy to make!  I made a few changes; DH does not like broccoli so I steamed it separate.  I plated his right before I added the mushrooms (doesn't like those either); then I added the mushrooms and broccoli, let it cooked for a couple minutes and heat through then proceeded with the cheese.  It was creamy but not too much of a tomato flavor.  I also used small shells since I was out of the large.  Made for ZWT 7-THE HOT PINK LADIES.

These green beans may have just became my new favorite!  I am not a big fan of lemon (or anything sour) but these were not sour at all and the lemon and lemon pepper gave the green beans a fresh flavor.  Made as written and will be making these again!  Made for 123Hits May game win.

Such a quick pizza to whip up and a favorite of the whole family!  I used a store bought crust and minced the onions and put them on the sauce, under the cheese so DS's would not see them...also added a little crumbled bacon that was leftover from another recipe.  Will be making this again!  Made for ZWT-7~THE HOT PINK LADIES.

We really LOVED this rice!  I forgot the peas, but otherwise made as written.  Between the soy sauce, sugar and the pineapple it was neither too salty nor too sweet, just perfect.  We will be making this again!!  Made for ZWT-7~THE HOT PINK LADIES.

I had some leftover chunked imitation crabmeat from another recipe and this was a good way to use it.  Made as written but used celery salt to season rather than plain salt.  Made for ZWT-7~THE HOT PINK LADIES.
This was great!  Tasted like a tart apple, but still had a hint of sweetness.  I did add less lemon juice, but otherwise made as directed.  Made for ZWT-7~THE HOT PINK LADIES.

We really enjoyed the potato and sausage portion of this dish, but the eggs were a little odd...The yolks came out similar to hard boiled and the whites were just barely set.  I would make this again minus the eggs, it was still very flavorful.  Made for ZWT-7~THE HOT PINK LADIES.

This was a nice change from traditional mac and cheese.  I used rotini since that is what I had left and thought it could have used a little more cheese; next time I will add some to the top with the bacon like a previous reviewer stated.  Made for ZWT-7~THE HOT PINK LADIES.

I really enjoyed this (DH said wouldhave been better w/out the peppers).  I didn't have leftover meat so used some beef stew meat I had in the freezer and cooked it with the mushrooms, some garlic and seasoning in a 300 degree oven for 2 hrs the day before.  When ready to make I just added the mushrooms and diced the meat.  Will be making this again!!  Made for ZWT-7~THE HOT PINK LADIES.

Made this minus the red pepper flakes because we are wimps!  I was planning on grilling hamburgers so I sprinkled some of this on to try it and it gave the meat a great sweet and smokey flavor.  Can't wait to try it on chicken or pork chops.  Made for PRMR.
A great drink to sip on while making dinner.  I prefer sweet drinks to sour so this was perfect for me!  Made for ZWT-7~THE HOT PINK LADIES.

These were really good and much better than any casserole that I am forced to make during the holidays!  I didn't have white vinegar so subbed apple cider which made the beans a little sweeter than what they were supposed to be (I would assume) but they were still really good.  Made for ZWT-7~THE HOT PINK LADIES.

Made as written and this was excellent and so easy too!  I used b/s thighs and was worried about the main ingredient being soy sauce because it makes food salty, but this wasn't at all.  Will make again since it was so easy and came out super tender!  Made for ZWT-7~THE HOT PINK LADIES.
Not as sweet and thick as bottled sauce, but this has a nice flavor.  Served on grilled pork chops seasoned with recipe#459461 and they paired well together.  Made for 123Hits.

This coen is great!  I already had the oven going for some bread so thew the corn in with it.  It got hot and cooked completely and not all watery like when I boil it.  Will be making this more often!  I did clean some of the silk off, pulled the husks down about 1/2 way; didn't seem to bother it.  Made for PRMR.

I used some leftover seasoned ground beef that we used for tacos; also had some leftover corn from another night.  Cut the recipe in 1/2 and mixed up for lunch tomorrow.  I mixed it all and will bake tomorrow.  I did have to sample a few bites and it is great!  I like the tomato soup rather that tomato sauce, it tastes less acidic.  Made for I Recommend Tag.

This is a great salad!  I loved the flavor of the toasted walnuts with the creamy cheese.  Made one salad for lunch; will make again for dinner and add some diced chicken to make it a meal!  Made for I Recommend Tag.
These pancakes have a great flavor!  Not super sweet but the banana comes through.  I topped mine with agave nectar, fresh sliced bananas, and powdered sugar.  Made for I Recommend Tag.

This is really great with strawberries!  I had whipped-plain cream cheese so I diced up some strawberries and mixed them in to make fruit-flavored cream cheese.  Followed the recipe the rest of the way.  We will be making this again, goes great with the summer fruit that is available.  Made for Zaar Stars.
This was tasty and refreshing!  Made as written and the whole family drank it.  I did double the amount of sugar.  Made for 123Hits.

This is the first time I have made chicken parmigiana and this was great.  I only used 2 cans of tomatoes and about 1/2 the onions,  but otherwise followed the recipe.  Next time I will use my immersion blender before putting the chicken back in and break up the tomatoes a little since DH is not a big fan of chunky sauce (but he ate it tonight!).  Made for I Recommend Tag.

These were great served on my burger for dinner, as well as by themselves as I grazed from the bowl while cooking dinner!  They are so simple to make and the mustard is not overpowering which is good since it is not one of my favorites.  Made for Everyday Holiday.

This is a great salad!  Made for a play-date/lunch with my friends and we all loved it.  I put about half the amount of red onions (not big on raw onions), used a pomegranate vinegar for the dressing and doubled the sugar since it was a little tart for my taste.  Made for I Recommend Tag.
This tastes just like an Orange Julius!  Was quick to whip up and is very refreshing on a HOT Vegas summer day!  Will be making these again!  Made for Zaar Stars Tag.

This was a good smoothie with a strong orange flavor!  Made as written, except added about 2 Tbs of Splenda to sweeten it up a little.  Next time I may tey freezing the mandarin oranges so it is a little thicker.  Made for Zaar Stars.

This was great and easy to throw together so even better!  I used thick-cut boneless chops and didn't have whole carrots so cut up some baby carrots.  The sweet of the apple juice and the savory rosemary were a good combo.  Served on egg noodles; forgot to get spaetzle noodles at the store.  Made for Zaar Stars Tag.

These potatoes are amazing!  I made half the recipe; didn't peel the potatoes and used red bell pepper (so it would blend with the pimentos to fool DH) but otherwise followed the recipe.  They were creamy but not too creamy/runny like some loaded potatoes tend to be. Will be making these again!  Made for I Recommend Tag.

This was my first time cooking and eating cauliflower and I do not know why I never tried it before!  This is a great recipe to start with since it gives the veggie a little more flavor.  Next time I will use a little less mayo since that seemed to be the main flavor that I could taste.  Made for I Recommend Tag.

These are very good pancakes!  I usually make thinner ones, but these are very fluffy and light so we enjoyed them.  Were good with strawberries and whipped cream as well as butter and maple syrup.  Made for I Recommend Tag.

Very good! I used baby heirloom tomatoes and dried herbs.  I was out of lemons (fresh and bottled juice) so I subbed orange juice.  I love gorgonzola cheese so this was a perfect way to serve it.  Made for a light lunch with some crusty bread.  Will be making this again!  Made for I Recommend Tag.

These are a little time consuming, but worth the effort!  I used leftover recipe#412855 that I shredded and froze.  I used a shallot rather than the onion, didn't have quite 1 1/2 cups chicken so added extra veggies.  Also I didn't have frozen peas so used frozen mixed veggies (corn, peas, green beans).  These cooked up in the time listed and were golden and flaky.  Will make again!!  Made for I Recommend Tag.

Very good, but I used extra crunchy peanut butter and it was heavy on the crunchy!  Still a great flavor and moist.  I had to cook mine 52 minutes to get the middle cooked through.  Made for I Recommend Tag.

I am not a huge fan of raw cucumbers; when added to salads I pick them out...but, I also never had an English cucumber before!  This has a milder taste and with the dressing they are very tasty!  Made for I Recommend Tag.

This is really good!  It is very cheese and the fried onions add the perfect amount of salt and crunch.  I used about half the amount of celery, but otherwise followed the recipe.  Will make again when my mom comes to town since we are the only two that eats broccoli.  Made for I Recommend Tag.
Very good sticky rice!  I like white rice this way if I do not cook it with chicken stock or add orzo; just plain rice nicely salted.  Will use this recipe often.  Made for I Recommend Tag.
Made as written; just added extra cheese and topped with sour cream.  Was very flavorful but not spicy, just the way we like it.  Made for Zaar Stars.

Very tastey!  I made as written with 2 small zucchinis.  Had for lunch with a sandwich.  Much better than having chips with my sandwich!  The breading was nice and crispy and stuck to the zukes nicely.  Will make again!!  Made for Dinning on a Dollar Contest.

Oh so good!!  Made with 2 chicken breasts, but once I flattened them they were HUGE so I cut each in half and we ended up with enough for 4 sandwiches...lunch for tomorrow!!  I used Virginia Ham and provolone cheese, and no onions or pickled peppers.  Will be making again!!  Made for All You Can Cook Buffet Game.

I used all the veggies listed, just decreased the amount of onions and added some seasoned salt; this is a filling healthy side.  DH would have preferred white rice but I think the brown rice was a perfect accompaniment.  Made for Dinning on a Dollar Contest.

All the fresh herbs in this dish made is so good!  I was hesitant on using the amount of garlic listed, but went ahead and was pleasantly surprise how not overpowering it was.  I didn't have green onions so subbed chives but otherwise followed the recipe.  Will make this again!  Made for Everyday Holiday.

I make a dish similar with beef smoked sausage and canned sliced potatoes, but this is 100% better!!  Made as written, just used one whole onion.  DH and I both really liked it, this will be my new sausage/potato recipe!  Made for Zaar Stars Tag.

I had the smallest asparagus I have ever seen but this was a great recipe to use it up!  I roasted mine for about 8 minutes longer because I like it a little crispy/blackened.  The sauce was great, I made half but kept the same amount of capers.  Made for Zaar Stars Tag.

I used some white yams for this recipe; I am part of a co-op that gets fruits and veggies every week,  we never know in advance what we will get.  I got what I thought was sweet potatoes until I peeled them and they were white not orange!  This recipe still turned out great!  I drizzled a little honey and sprinkled some cinnamon on the potatoes when they were done.  Came out sweet and tender; cannot wait to try this on actual sweet potatoes.  Made for Everyday Holiday.

I liked the flavor of this dish as well as the quickness of making it, but I also thought it was too liquidy.  Next time I will probably drain the pineapple and bake it in the oven and see if that helps to thicken it up.  Made for PRMR.

This is so good!  I loved the parmesan crust, it reminds me of the quick garlic bread my mom would make.  The cheese combo was tasty too, and melted well.  Will be making this again!  Made for All You Can Cook Buffet Game.

This is really good!  I never eat banana splits but this may change my mind.  I used fresh (frozen) strawberries and a frozen banana and a very healthy squirt of chocolate syrup.  Made for Zaar Stars.

This hit the spot on a warm sleepy evening!  I used surgar-free pudding, lite cool whip and Starbucks VIA packet for the coffee.  Made 2 large coffees for DH and I and was just the right amount.  DH requested these again and wants to add chocolate to it and make a mocha.  Made for PRMR.

So good and easy to whip up!  I used Grands buttermilk frozen biscuits and didn't have sausage patties but otherwise made as directed.  This is similar to how my mom made biscuits and gravy.  Will be making again (even if I am the only one who eats it!).  Made for Zaar Stars.

I used frozen peas in a steam bag for this recipe and they still came out fresh tasting.  The basil and orange zest in the butter gives the peas a sweet fresh taste.  Will have to try this with fresh peas next time.  Made for Almost Five Tag.

Very good green beans!  Used fresh beans, Penzeys Spices pasta sprinkle and a little less olive oil than what the recipe calls for.  Were seasoned perfectly, will make these again.  Made for Zaar Stars Tag.

This was a good lite sandwich to have for a late breakfast.  I liked the garlic powder on it, it seemed to take away some of the saltiness of the olives.  Will make again, I LOVE green olives but the rest of the family doesn't so we always have a half of a jar in the fridge!  Made for Almost 5 Tag.

So rich and creamy these potatoes are great!!  I didn't have chives so added a little green onions (tops) for color.  Would be good with some chopped ham mixed in to make a meal.  Will make again!  Made for PRMR.

Super easy and quick to make!  I added the vinegar but not the salt.  I think I cooked my eggs for about 1 minute too long; the yolk started to set so it was only a little runny.  Still very good served on an english muffin with ham and cheese.  Made for Everyday Holiday.
Very quick to put together!  I made 1/2 a batch and they were perfect for an afternoon snack.  I used mini chocolate chips and walnuts in the streusel.  Will make again!  Made for I Recommend Tag.

This is great!!  I did add a little garlic salt with the parsley and used 3 large chicken breasts.  Perfect dinner for me to make for DH; chicken and rice is his favorite.  Great that it can all be made in one pan.  Made for Almost Five Tag.

These veggies were GREAT!!  I peeled my garlic and left it whole (crushed a little with the back of the knife) so I could get the bigger chunks of roasted garlic.  I made half the recipe since it was just for DH and I and didn't tell him there were parsnips until he was eating them (can be as picky as the 5yr and 2yr DSs sometimes!)  I will definately be making this again!  Made for AUS/NZ Recipe Swap #56.

Such a great salad and the dressing is what makes it!  I was skeptical of the dressing, it didn't sound too appetizing but it is great!!  I did used dried minced onions in it because I was not in the mood to cut onions; also added a little shredded cheddar to the top but otherwise followed the recipe.  Will be making this again!  Made for PAC Fall 2011.

I made these to munch on during the Sunday Football games.  I like that they do not have sausage inthem like a lot of stuffed mushrooms do, I felt just a little less guilty eating so many!  They had a great flavor!  Made for Zaar Stars Tag.

I made for 2 and had it for lunch today.  I put a little in a cheese quesadilla and ate the rest with chips.  Was really fresh tasting; I loved the balsalmic vinegar, it gave it a nice bite.  Will be made again next summer with fresh corn.  Made for Everyday Holiday.

Great flavor, went well with recipe#326418.  I liked having the beef flavor in the rice; so used to using chicken stock to make rice.  It had a Mexican flavor with the cumin, but I am glad it was not loaded down with chili powder.  Made for Zaar Stars.

The prep for this recipe was very time consuming, but the end result was great!  Made as written except diced the pork before marinating and then sauteed it and poured the sweet and sour sauce over the top when it was done (ran out of propane for the grill).  Was very flavorful and I enjoyed everything though DH said it was too 'colorful'; meaning too many veggies!  Made for Almost Five Tag.
I made this with minced onions and leftout the milk; served with fresh veggies it was perfect.  Will have to try it with Ruffles... Made for October 2011 Think Pink Tag Event.
These were very good!  I left out the dried rosemary and just added a little extra of the fresh.  Cooked these for approx. 1 hour and they were perfect.  Made for Zaar Stars.

This was so quick and easy!  I did add 1 1/2 Tbs sugar to the sauce since my DSs are used to a slightly sweeter tomato sauce.  I loved that there was spinach in and I got both DSs and DH to eat it!  I had to chop it up really small so they would think it was "seasoning" but it worked!  Made for AUS/NZ Recipe Swap #58.

I used shelled edamame that came in a steam bag so didn't boil them before adding the sauce.  Also used a teriyaki sauce with sesame seeds in it so did not add anymore.  I like the flavor of the sauce on the edamame my only change would be to reduce the amount of sesame oil by half or more, it was too overpowering for me.  Made for Zaar Stars.

This was a great and rich cake.  Made last week to take to a family dinner and everyone loved it!  Not sure if I made too much glaze but there was a lot more to just drizzle on so I put it on like frosting but it was still perfect.  I left out the nuts since one the the kids is allergic.  Made for 123Hits.

These were very tasty and so easy to make!  I did run about half of the tomatoes through the blender since DH doesn't like the "chunks" and there were still too make for him.  Next time I will use a pizza or pasta sauce.  I loved the pie crust for these, I liked how it got crispy/flaky.  Made for Zaar Stars.

Great chicken!  I made with b/s chicken thight and cooked it for about 4 hours.  Turned the crock pot to the warm setting and added a little cornstarch/water slurry to thicken the sauce a little.  Turned out great.  Nice way to dress up plain BBQ sauce.  this sauce would also be good on grilled chicken, may have to try that... Made for PRMR.

This was so easy and tasted great!  I made it for 'country benedict' and it was the perfect amount of cooked and ooey gooey.  Served on an english muffin with a slice of cheddar and then covered with sausage gravy.  Will use this technique from now on!  Made for Football Pool Win.
Very good!  I have not had squash coated with cornmeal, just breadcrumbs and this was very light and crispy.  Made as written and will be making again!  Made for PRMR.
Good carrots!  There were a ton of flavors in these, a nice change from the usual sweet-glazed carrots.  Made for Everyday Holiday.

This was a great meatloaf!  I liked that there was not a lot of liquids in the mixture to make it mushy and that addition of green onions was great; I love green onions.  I did drizzle a little of ketchup on top.  Made for Everyday Holiday.

Sooo good!!  The only change I made was to use a dark rum instead of the Burbon since I didn't have any.  Was so tender and juicy and the glaze was amazing, just the right amount of sweet and spicy; although next time I will cut out on the spicy a little for DSs' sake.  Made for Zaar Stars.

Made for DHs birthday and he loved it.  I did use 1% milk and Splenda but otherwise followed the recipe.  Were dangerous to drink since it went down so well; too much chocolate and Bailey's make for a lazy morning!  Made for Zaar Stars.

Great flavor in this rice!  I told DH we are going to start only eating brown rice (no more white) and he is fine with it as long as it is this good.  I didn't want to overwhelm him with the garlic so I used 4 small cloves, but next time I will use 6.  Made it on the stove top and it was perfect; going to try in my rice cooker.  Made for PRMR.

This was a great combo together!  I loved that the broccoli got so much flavor from the pancetta and there wasn't a need for additional salt.  I did overcook my broccoli a little when I boiled it, but it still turned out great!  Made for AUS/NZ Recipe Swap #60.

These are great.  I usually make these from a box mix and not too often since I am the only one that eats them.  These are so much better than the box and I always have all the ingredients on hand and I can reduce it to half a batch if I want.  These will be my go to recipe.  Made for Best of 2011 Cookbook Tag Game.

I had a change of meal plans at the last minutes so this ended up marinating for about 24 hours!  I used b/s chicken thighs and served it as a meal so didn't cube it.  Was a great flavor!  Sort of a like a teriyaki sauce but not salty like most.  Made for Best of 2011 Cookbook Tag.

Made minus the horseradish and it was great!!  I seared it a little in a skillet and then broiled it in the oven.  Was moist and very flavorful, I will be making this again and going to try it on the grill.  Made for 2011 Best of Cookbook Tag.

Made using chifferi noodles and left out the cayenne and hot sauce (personal preference).  This was so creamy and cheesy and the addition of the bacon gave it a nice salty contrast.  Both DSs really enjoyed it which is huge because my oldest says he only likes the "blue box" stuff.  Will be making this again!!  Made for Mommy Diva's Cook-A-Thon.

These are so good and rich!!  I love that I can eat the dough too and not get sick.  Made as written and used Valentine's sprinkles to decorate.  I used my 1 1/2 in cookie scoop and got 33 dough balls.  Will be making these again, will be a great summer (don't heat the house) treat.  Made for 2011 Best of Cookbook Tag.

So simple and so good!  My mom made a similar dish when we went camping with sausage and canned potatoes.  I used beef kilbasa and left the skins on the potatoes.  Loved the one pan breakfast for dinner!  We added shredded cheddar cheese before serving and it was great.  Made for Cooking from the Pantry Challenge.

GREAT scalloped potatoes!!  I did peel my spuds because they didn't look so good on the outside, and also left out the celery since DH doesn't like it.  I loved the gouda and white cheddar together and I like my sauce thick too so I didn't thin it out with any additional milk.  Will definitely make this again!  Made for Best of 2011 Cookbook Tag.

Loved this rice!!  I used 2 large shallots and they gave this rice a great flavor.  Will be making this again; only change would be to not use cooking wine again.  Couldn't use real wine since I am pregnant and the bottle would go to waste in my fridge.  Made for All You Can Cook Buffet.

This was a quick and tasty veggie to have with our chicken.  I am not a huge fan of sesame oil, but there was such a little amount that it did not overpower the asparagus.  I have some thick asparagus so cooked it for 15 minutes to get them tender and sprinkled a little sea salt on it when it came out of the oven.  Made for 2012 Spring PAC.

LOVE these green beans!!  Had all my favorites mixed in and they were quick and easy to make.    Not sure if I liked cooking the bacon in the butter, may try cooking the bacon, draining the grease and then adding the butter and continuing on from there... Made for 2012 Spring PAC.

Mixed a little of this with some olive oil to make a sort of paste that I rubbed on b/s chicken thighs and grilled.  Very flavorful and I like that there is not a ton of salt.  Made for 2012 Spring PAC.

Great cake!  Made with plain Greek yogurt so gave it a little bit of a tangy taste.  Was moist and rich tasting.  Served with whipped cream and a drizzle of chocolate syrup.  Made for 2012 Spring PAC.

Made this over the weekend when my dad was in town and it was a HUGE hit!  Everyone loved it!  We are all big fans of chicken cordon bleu so this was similar but the sauce is what made the dish!  Will be making this again, DH already asked it I added it to my permanent cookbook!  Made for 2012 Spring PAC.
These are fluffy/thick pancakes that have a great flavor!  Made as written and made the whole batch so we have leftovers to put in DHs lunch/breakfast for work.  Made for I Recommend Tag.
Great flavor with this tenderloin!  Made as written  and it was nicely cooked and still very juicy.  Will be making again and like Mikekey, I will grill it next time.  Made for Down on the Farm Tag.
These are very good muffins!  Super moist and not too sweet.  The banana, strawberry and chocolate go well together; kinda like a banana split muffin!  Made for PRMR.

This is so good!  Made with 2lbs of ground beef and decreased the rest of the ingredients to match.  Since I made it for Mother's Day dinner I followed the recipe and put it in the crock pot so I didn't have to mess with it.  Was the perfect balance for sweet and savory; the chili powder was not too much for the DSs.  Made for 123Hits.

Very good and fast veggie side!  Made as written, well I forgot to toast the sesame seeds but they were still good un-toasted.  I liked that the honey made the soy sauce and ginger not so salty/tart tasting but not making the sauce too sweet.  Made for 123Hits.

I made this for a BBQ so doubled the recipe since there was 20  people and I came back with 3 bars!!  I added a little too much marshmallow creme but it made it really ooey gooey and good!  I sprinkled some mini chocolate chips on top for decoration and it was a big hit!  Will be making these again!  Made for Down on the Farm Tag.

This bread is so good!  Made exactly as written and it was cooked perfectly at exactly 1 hour.  Originally made for DH to take to work for the office, but once I tasted it, I had 2 pieces!  This one is staying home with me!!  Made for Zaar Stars.

Great drink from my childhood!  My brother and I got these (and Shirley Temples) as a treat when we went out to dinner since we didn't get cafinated drinks at home.  My DSs loved it too!  Made for PRMR.

This is one of the best chicken alfredos we have had!  The addition of the bacon gives it so much more flavor.  I used b/s chicken tenders and it was juicy and very flavorful.  Served with salad and garlic cheese bread and even my picky 3yr DS ate it up!  Made for Photo Tag.

Made this with 5 b/s thighs, but kept the sauce amounts the same.  Was very good!  I liked how the sauce thickened up and was still sweet, but not too sweet thanks to the addition of soy sauce.  Will make this again, we usually eat b/s thighs and this cooked up quick.  Made for Everyday Holiday.

Great chicken!  Made with b/s chicken thighs and I did thicken the sauce at the end.  Was a good combo of sweet and salty.  Served mine and DHs over white rice and DSs over penne noodles (they don't eat rice).  Made for Zaar Stars.

Very good casserole!!  Had everything we love.  I used mini penne noodles and put a little extra french fried onions on top.  Will make this again, but will try with cream of chicken soup and put a lot more onions on top.  Made for Chef Alphabet Soup Tag.
This recipe was good, and so simple!  Made with a combo of four-cheese tortellini and Italian sausage tortellini.  Made for 123Hits.

This was great!  I don't cook fish at home very often since I am the only one who eats it so this was easy to make and very quick!  Made with tilapia and it had a great flavor, not too overpowering.  Will make this again.  Made for ZWT8.

So easy and had a great flavor!  Both my DSs ate this all!  The only change I made was to use shredded cheese instead of sliced.  Will use this breading recipe often, it has a great flavor.  Made for ZWT8.

Nice and creamy dip.  I sometimes mix sour cream and salsa for a little change on nachos, but the addition of the cheddar cheese and avocado makes this so much better.  I did add a little extra salsa so it would better hide the avocado color, DH does NOT like avocados but he ate this!  Made for ZWT8.

Great marinade!  I can only imagine this is amazing on the grill; we got rid of our old grill before we moved and have not bought a new one yet so I had to saut? the chicken on the stovetop.  Was not too sweet or to bitter/sour from the lemon juice and soy sauce.  Will make again when we get a grill!  Made for ZWT8.

Great potatoes!  Made with golden potatoes and they were nice and crispy on the out side and creamy on the inside.  The amount of butter was perfect and helped the potatoes not dry out in the oven.  Topped with bacon and cheese and they were excellent.  Would also be good with a little sour cream on top, but it was not needed.  Made for ZWT8.
Great sandwich!  Made with recipe#482678 and it was a great combo.  Was very cheesy, salty and creamy.  Will definitely be making this again!  Made for ZWT8.

Wow, this is so good and RICH!  I made 3 servings and used my mini crockpot and it was perfect.  When I blended mine, it didn't expand much, but once it chilled it set up nicely.  DH REALLY loved this, anything super chocolately is up his alley.  Made for ZWT8-Food of the Aztecs Challenge.

Scaled this back to a serving for two and it was a great side with our baked chicken.  I was out of green onions so used some shallots.  Were nice and creamy and tender; not like some scalloped potatoes that turn out watery and not completely cooked.  Made for ZWT8.
This is a great "sandwich"!  Made as written and enjoyed it for breakfast.  The mayo/cheese combo gave it a nice creamy taste.  Made for ZWT8.

Excellent potatoes!!  Made half the recipe since it is just DH and I that eat potatoes and it was enough for both of us for dinner and lunch for DH...should have made the full batch so I could have leftovers too!  I didn't have leftover mashed potatoes so made some from scratch and cooked the onions with the bacon.  Made for ZWT8.

I made half the recipe since I only had 3 medium-sized pork chops.  Was very flavorful and the sauce was really good with the bacon, onions and mushrooms.  DH said he would eat this again; but leave out the mushrooms! :). Made for ZWT8.
Very tasty and very easy to make!  Only change is I used beef broth rather than chicken since I served it with meatloaf and mashed potatoes.  Made for ZWT8 Family Picks.

I bought French's horseradish mustard for this recipe and I am glad I did, they were really good!  I never knew I liked horseradish... Made 1/2 the recipe and roasting times were right on for my oven.  Served with recipe#464990 464990 and a salad for dinner.  Made for Everyday Holiday.

These are so easy to make and come out light, crisp and buttery.  Made 1 dozen since they do not contain chocolate I am sure DH won't be helping me eat these (which is fine with me!). I topped them with some sugar crystal sprinkles for a little extra sweet crunch.  Made for ZWT8 Family Picks.
Very quick and easy with a good balsamic flavor.  Made with 3 b/s chicken breasts so there W's extra sauce, and used Yukon gold potatoes.  Made for 123Hits.

Great salmon!  I made using orange marmalade, sliced oranges on top and cooking wine.  I baked it in the foil for 25 minutes since my salmon was kinda thick.  Was perfect and I loved that it is scaled back for 1 serving since I am the only one in my family that eats fish!  Going into my Best of cookbook.  Made for PRMR.
Great pan-fried potatoes!  Made as written and they came out perfectly.  Sprinkled with salt and pepper and served with recipe#482589 482589. Made for 123Hits.

This is very tasty!  I did make a few changes to how I made it vs the recipe directions... I didn't have pre-cooked bacon so I diced it up and saut?ed it with the garlic and onions and left out the mushrooms and butter.  I removed it from the pan and cooked the chicken, which I also diced, in the bacon grease to heat it through.  Since I made this as a main dish, I used 2 tortillas per quesadilla and sandwiched them together.  DH and I both really liked this and will be making it again!  Made for Cookbook Tag.

These are so good!  I love sweet potatoes and caramelised onions so putting them together was perfect.  Made as written and served with meatloaf.  Definately going to make these again!  Made for Zaar Stars.
Super fast and easy to put together.  I left out the green peppers but otherwise made as written. The bacon gave it a nice salty flavor.  Made for Zaar Stars.

Great fish and the sauce was excellent!  Was easy to reduce the recipe for 1 serving since I am the only one who eats fish.  Was cooked perfectly when I followed the cooking times and came out flaky and tender on the inside and crispy on the outside.  Made for 123Hits.
Great and easy potatoes!  Made as written and they came out creamy like when I use a hand mixer, but I used a masher.  Served these with lots of butter and salt.  Made for Football Pool Win 2012-13.

Love these carrots!  Made as written with a bag of baby carrots.  They are so easy to make and have a nice natural-tasting sweetness to them.  Will be making these again as this is going into my Best of cookbook!  Made for AUS/NZ Recipe Swap Nov 2012.
I made this with two large pork steaks cut in half to make 4 servings. Turned out very tender with a slight sweetness.  Made for 123Hits.
This makes a great glaze and makes it taste like it has been baking for hours.  Made as written and will be making again!  Made for I Recommend Holiday Tag.

Great potatoes!  I reduced it down to 2 lbs of potatoes and followed the recipe as written.  I didn't need to add milk or the broth/cooking water, they were a good consistency without it.  The sour cream and cream cheese give the potatoes a nice tang and thickness.  Made for I Recommend Holiday Tag.
Great smoothie for an after-school snack.  Made with sugar free strawberry jello and fat-free cool whip so it is was even healthier.  Made for Zaar Stars.

Made this with cream of mushroom soup since I couldn't not find cream of onion, otherwise made as directed.  The only change I would make next time is to add some minced garlic and salt/pepper to the tenderloins before putting them in.  Made for PRMR.
Great Brussels Sprouts!  I loved the garlicky cracker topping.  Made with 1/2 lb sprouts and decreased the rest of the ingredients to match.  Will make these again!  Made for PRMR.

Great popcorn!  It was a little sticky for the DSs, but it did not stop them from eating it.  They did ask that I put less of the "spicy stuff" (cinnamon) on it...any seasoning they can see they say it is too spicy.  So I will just make 2 batches; one for them and one for me!  Made for 123Hits.

Great wings!  Made with 3lbs of wings.  The only change I would make is to take them out of the crock pot when they are done and put them back under the broiler for a few minutes to crisp up the skin again.  Made for Football Pool 2012-13 win.
These were very good; holiday dinner worthy!  I made minus the mushrooms since DH and DSs don't eat them; next time I will saut?e a little on the side for myself.  Made for AUS/NZ Reunion Tag.

This is a great light meal!  I grilled the chicken strips, used just green leaf lettuce and left out the radishes.  Served with some sliced French bread and it was a filling meal.  Will be a regular in the hot summer months.  Made for I Recommend Holiday Tag.
Very good carrots; just the right amount of sweet and tangy.  Made with Dijon mustard and cut back on the spice.  Made for Football Pool 2012-13 Win.

This is good bacon!  Sweet, salty, and just the right amount of bite from the pepper.  Made for our 'breakfast for dinner' night with waffles and eggs, was the perfect addition.  Made for Football Pool 2012-13 Win.

Great recipe and very east to make!  It came out nice and tender and very flavorful!  Made as written and served with mashed potatoes and deviled carrots.  Will be making this again; it is a good stick-to-your-ribs winter meal!  Made for AUS/NZ Recipe Swap #71.

Made this for a nice healthy lunch and it was excellent.  I made it on sheep herder bread with sprouts and no onions.  I ate 1/2 as is and put a little tuna salad on the other 1/2; both ways were great.  Will be making this again.  Made for Zaar Stars.

These are great!  I loved the flavor of roasting the sprouts rather than cooking in butter or plain steaming.  Not having to use a lot of oil and not really having to do much for a tasty veggie is perfect.  Made as written for 1 lb of sprouts and since I am the only one who eats them, I have lots of leftovers.  Made for Make My Recipe AUS Day Tag.

This is a great sauce for fish!  I made with dill rather than tarragon (since I didn't have any) and served it over snapper.  Was a nice light sauce that didn't overpower the fish.  Made for Football Pool 2012-13 Win.

I really enjoyed this spinach!  I made it a little differently, but I think it still turned out the same...I sauteed the bacon in a sauce pan and when it was almost done I added the garlic and onions and cooked through.  I then drained the grease and added 1/2 the butter to have the flavor and then followed the recipe from there.  I didn't have feta so topped with a little parmesan cheese and it was the right amount of saltiness.  Was a nice addition to the chicken and pasta I was having.  Made for AUS/NZ Recipe Swap #72.
This was so easy to make and so very flavorful!  I made as written and served mixed with orzo.  Will be going into my Best of Cookbook!  Made for Rookie Recipe Tag.

Great chicken!  This is the kind of recipe I make to get my DSs to eat more meat!  Made as written using thin-cut b/s chicken so I didn't have to pound them flatter.  Cooked in a cast iron skillet so gave it a nice crunchy crust.  Made for Best of 2012 Tag.

So yummy!  I thought we would miss the cheddar since we usually add it to scalloped potatoes, but this was great with the parm.  Only change I made was to sprinkle a little more parmesan cheese on the top during the last few minutes of baking; I LOVE the smell and taste of toasted parmesan cheese.  Made for I Recommend Tag.
Great potatoes!  I used Yukon Gold, left the skins on and used dried thyme.  The brie was so rich and creamy in these potatoes and made them over the top-good!  Made for Best of 2012 Tag.

Great recipe!  I made this with a baked potato cubed up and thick cut bacon.  Seasoned with seasoning salt and pepper and it was a great addition to our 'breakfast for dinner' meal.  Served this with a fried egg on top.  Made for Football Pool 2012-13 Win.

Very tasty!  I make something similar with just the sausage and potatoes, but adding the eggs makes it a great breakfast dish; or as we had it, 'breakfast for dinner'.  I left out the red pepper flakes cause we do not like the heat and seasoned with seasoning salt and pepper.  Made for Best of 2012 Cookbook Tag.

Great chicken!  I made with thin-sliced b/s chicken breasts.  I didn't have buttermilk so made with milk and lemon juice.  This came out nice and juicy and super crispy!  I left out the gravy since DSs do not eat it and DH prefers gravy if there are mashed potatoes.  Made for Best of 2012 Cookbook Tag.

These are really good!  Only having an egg and a little bit of sauce in the meat I thought they may be dry, but they were perfectly moist.  I loved the addition of the green onions (my fav) and fresh parsley.  the gravy was a great compliment to the meat.  Served with mashed potatoes and recipe#258527.  Made for Best of 2012 Cookbook Tag.

Strange, but soooo good!!  Made an written and served on a toasted baguette.  I love syrup and bacon together and everything tastes better with avocado!  Glad I bought real maple syrup for this.  Made for Best of 2012 Cookbook Tag.

So flavorful and good!  I luckily have all the ingredients in my pantry usually so this can be made often.  The only change I made was to use b/s chicken thighs since that is what was in the freezer.  Made for Zaar Stars.

Made these for our weekly 'breakfast for dinner' with eggs, bacon and toast and they were a perfect addition!  I liked that they got crispy on the outside and cooked all the way through.  Will be making these again since they are so easy.  Only change I made was to add a little seasoned salt in the mix.  Made for AUS/NZ Recipe Swap.

WOW, this is soooo good!  I made as written and kept a little of the sauce to baste 1/2 way through cooking.  Was the right amount of sweetness.  Going into my Best of Cookbook; it is so easy to make with just 3 ingredients and has tons of flavor.  Made for AUS/NZ Recipe Swap.

So quick and easy and had a great flavor!  Made with white cheddar since that is what was in the fridge, but left the rest of the ingredients as is.  I didn't mash the potatoes too much, left them kind of chunky.  Made for Zaar Stars.

Great potatoes!  I liked the combo; DH doesn't eat sweet potatoes so if I want them I have to make 2-seperate meals...this way I just give him the russet and I can have both!  I used dried rosemary, but otherwise kept the recipe as is.  Made for AUS/NZ Recipe Swap.

Great bread!  I always have these ingredients on hand so it can be made on a whim.  It was the perfect moistness and sweetness.  I used walnuts and it gave it a nice texture.  Made for Spring 2013 PAC.

These were so good with just the right amount of sweetness.  I made with just one rather large potato since I am the only one who eats them and they cooked up perfectly in the amount of time stated.  I used a white-cooking wine, but otherwise made as written.  Will be making these again!  Made for AUS/NZ Recipe Swap.

I made this with canned corn and it was a great dish!  I added some salt and pepper but otherwise made as written.  Was a rich veggie dish that would be good for a holiday or everyday dinner.  Made for Spring PAC 2013.

This was very good and not bad for you at all!  I didn't use olive oil, just sprayed the pan with cooking spray.  I used an orange pepper since that was all that I had left and seasoned the chicken with fresh-cracked pepper rather than the cayenne.  The chicken came out so juice and flavorful and not at all over cooked, went well with the pasta and veggies and I didn't miss any sort of cream sauce on the pasta.  Will be making this again!  Made for Spring PAC 2013.

This is a good, not too loaded down, egg salad.  I liked the crunch of the celery and bite of the chives.  I made with 4 eggs and added approx. 2 tsp mayo.  I also used seasoned salt and fresh cracked pepper.  Served this on toasted wheat with a handful of spring mix.  Made for Spring PAC 2013.

Very tasty burger, I loved the BBQ onions!  I seasoned my burgers and onions with Montreal Steak Seasoning, and I grilled the burgers since the weather was nice.  I topped these with sliced of cheddar since we do not buy American cheese, but it didn't make that much of a difference.  I loved the BBQ sauce mixed with the onions; gave it just enough sauce that you didn't need to put anything else on the burger, but it was not to sloppy.  Made for Spring PAC 2013.

This is my new go-to fried rice recipe!  Healthy and flavorful and the big bonus, DH loved it too (edamame and all)!  There is nothing I would change about it!  Going into my Best OF cookbook!!  Made for Spring Photo Tag.
Very tasty!  I made 1/2 the recipe and didn't have plain sesame seed so used the black seeds I had (didn't toast) and it was still good.  Made for Everyday Holiday.

So good!  The only change I made was to sub parsley for cilantro since I do not like cilantro.  Was fresh and tropical tasting and was great over my grilled chicken salad.  Made for Rookie Recipe Tag.

These were great potatoes!  The best part was that both my DSs LOVED them!  They usually do not eat any potato that is not shaped like a French fry or tater tot! lol  Though these tasted like French fries, it is a start towards other potato dishes. :)  I used 3 large potatoes so added a little more lemon juice.  I didn't really taste the juice after they cooked, but it did help soften the potatoes some and draw out a lot of the water.  Made for ZWT9.

This is a good veggie combo and the dressing gave it a great flavor.  I had a somewhat large eggplant and used it all so there was more eggplant than all the other veggies which was fine.  I used an orange and a yellow pepper and baby yellow potatoes.  This made a LOT of veggies which is good for leftover lunches.  Made for ZWT9.

So quick and easy to make and they have a nice light/delicate flavor.  I used my 1-inch cookie scoop and made cookies that were a little large so 1-2 is plenty for an afternoon treat.  Made for ZWT-9 Parting Gifts Challenge.
This was really good!  Would be good served with Mexican food in place of the guacamole.  Made for ZWT-9.

This was so good!  IT cooked up perfectly in the time stated.  I did add the glaze at the end and put it back in the warmed oven for about 5 minutes to thicken it up and caramelize it a little.  Going into my best of cookbook!  Made for ZWT-9.

These were so easy to make and very tasty!  Made as written and I liked that they got a little crispy/browned in the better.  These would go well with lots of dishes since they do not have a strong flavor.  Made for ZWT-9.

This marinade made the chicken so tender.  These spices/combination are not my favorite (not a big fan of curry) but this was tasty.  Was out of propane for the grill so had to bake the chicken in a casserole dish.  Served with brown rice and green beans.  Made for ZWT 9.

I really liked this dressing; may make a big batch and served on salad greens with grilled chicken.  I used fresh green beans that I steamed and some leftover grape tomatoes that I halved.  this is a great summer salad since it is served cold and can transport since there is not mayo/cream dressing.  Made for ZWT9.

Very tasty!  I made about 1/2 lb since it is just me and I have enough for leftovers too.  They have a nice creamy flavor and even though my butter got a little dark, it didn't make the spuds taste burnt.  Made for ZWT9.

These were soooo good!  I made about 1/2 lb and had to cook them in the oven since I am out of propane so I did add a little extra sauce to make sure there was enough.  I cooked them @ 400 degrees F for about 15 minutes and they were nice and tender.  I also sliced the mushrooms and diced the onion to make sure they cooked through.  Will be making these again!  Made for ZWT9.

Great chicken!  Glad I made this after DH went out of town, I was able to load it up with mushrooms and not get complaints!  The sauce was so flavorful and was perfect served over mini penne and with French bread.  Made for Rookie Recipe Tag.

Made these for lunch and they were great!  Not too salty or overly spiced; would like to try the spice mixture on boneless wings since my DSs don't eat bone-in wings.  Served tossed in medium wing sauce with steamed brown rice.  Definitely going to make these for DH on a football Sunday!  Made for PRMR.

I used this marinade and super thin boneless loin chops which cook fast and tend to dry out...this made them stay tender and juicy.  I topped mine with BBQ sauce, but DSs ate theirs as is and really enjoyed the chops.  Made for PRMR.

This is so good!  Mine didn't turn out too pretty since I am not the greatest omelet maker, but the flavor is outstanding!  My pear was not super ripe so I sliced it as thin as I could so it wouldn't be too crunchy.  Will be making this again!  Made for Football Pool Win 2013-14.
So good!  I marinated these overnight and they came out so juice and flavorful!  Served with rice pilaf and fresh green beans.  Going into my Best of Cookbook!  Made for Football Pool 2013-14 Win.

I am not a huge fan of zucchini but this was GREAT!  Only change I made was using dried parsley and garlic salt rather than plain salt.  I loved how the shallots got a little carmalized.  Made for Best of 2013 Tag.
Great way to make asparagus!  I liked that it didn't come out mushy.  I sprinkled salt, pepper and Parmesan cheese on it and ate way too many!  Made for Best of 2013 Tag.

Chose to make this knowing I had tons of boxed pasta...apparently every kind except penne!  Made with veggie farfalle and it was amazing!  I decreased the amount of thyme and basil so my boys wouldn't freak out on the amount of "green stuff" and it still had wonderful flavor.  I loved that it was made and on the table in less than 30 minutes.  Will be making this again and again!  Made for PAC Spring 2014.

Surprised to see this recipe because I found it in a European newspaper this winter.  It is an excellent simple way to prepare salmon and more horseradish can be added to taste.  Thanks for putting it in print.

Not often I try something from this site and have to rate it a 3 - maybe it is just our personal tastes.   We found it much too heavy with the rice in the bottom and, also, the chicken dried out quickly.  Maybe I should have covered for half the time?   Next time (because we loved the flavors) I will omit the rice, cover it for 15 mins. uncover and then add cheese. Maybe that way we can make it more to our tastes.  Sorry!!
Great - need I say more!   Very versatile and used for many meals: lunch with a salad, snacks, picnic or just  for a midnight fridge raid. Thanks for submitting.

I have made this recipe (almost the same) for years.  The only difference being  that I soak the oatmeal for 1 hr. and use 2 ozs. oil plus 2 ozs. of applesauce -other than that the rest remains about the same.  I change fruit according to what I have in the cupboard.  Sometimes I add a tsp. of grated orange rind and omit the vanilla.   There are many options here.

Perfect way to treat new potatoes (old work too).  Should not be overlooked as a side dish because sometimes simple is best. I do add a dash of fresh lemon juice just before serving. Thanks for submitting.

These are lovely muffins when one wants a sweet treat. Because we do not like strawberries cooked (only fresh and firm) substituted raspberries and forego the butter.   Worked beautifully and probably not quite as sweet as strawberries. Depends on how sweet one likes their treats!!!   Anyway, this is one to keep even if I have to substitute.  Thanks for posting.

Made this tonight for my husband (I am not a rice eater) and his only complaint was too much lemon peper so next time I will cut that in half.  Other than that it is a great recipe and would probably go with most entrees. Thanks for submitting - always need another easy rice dish.

Just found this recipe recently and had been looking for a difference textured bran muffin.  Thanks for much because this is the answer - definitely is properly descriped as the Rolls Royce of Bran muffins.   A nice balance of sweetness and not too much molasses which can be overpowering.   Great.

Great little cake for 2 (or doubled) and similar to a lemon bread.   For us we prefer to top it, while still hot, with a lemon drizzle of 2 tbls. lemon juice and 1/4 cup sugar.   Of course this is a matter of taste.   WE need more small recipes on this site.
Thanks for submitting.

This is the best - the chicken tenders are so much moister than breasts (and also more foregiveable).  Only difference I make my own spaghetti sauce, but in a pinch will use canned. 
Thanks for a great entree.

Sorry for giving this a 4 because they are super brownies.   Un-fortunately I did not have Bailey's Irish Cream and substituted a coffee liqueur (which tasted great).   The only change I would make again is to add the drizzle while brownies are still warm. Also, for my taste, there is too much icing (but I am probably in the minority!!)   Wonderful submission, thanks.
Thanks for another great potato dish.  A nice change from the cream cheese/sour cream versions and easier too.   Loved the flavors.   Now a regular and in my files to stay.

These bars are wonderful and I have been making them for years. When I volunteer to bring a dessert these are most frequently requested.  To add insult to injury!!! I top them with cream cheese icing flavored with lemon juice and zest .... yum.....
Thanks for another great small recipe for 2 - this is lovely and moist and afraid it gets eaten hot here.   Very versatile and can use orange or lemon zest.

This is an excellent recipe and great for gifts. When our daughter was in the catering business she made a smiliar recipe but using only pure white chocolate - very good.  Sometimes she substituted apricots for the cranberries.  A lot of options here.  Thanks for submitting.

A perfect Shepherd's pie and similar to what my mum made (she didn't use wine).   Comfort food at it's best and certainly makes good company fare.  Agree with you that there is nothing Irish about corned beef and cabbage because I never tasted it until I came to Canada!!!!!!

Wonderful with salmon which we love.   Had to cut back on sugar a little but that is the norm for us.   Sure it will go with with grilled halibut too.  Now that I have fresh dill growing on the balcony it will be made a lot. Thanks for a great submission.

Tinkerbelle you have no idea how old this recipe is!!!!   Can't believe it actually was printed in a cookbook.   My grandmother used to make these and that was the only time I had ever heard of them, except when I have made them myself.   I think some of the great cooks out there will be surprised just how good these can be.

Good to finally see this recipe in print here.   I used to make these at Xmas when the family was at home and they disappeared very, very quickly. It is a failproof recipe, easy and even non peanut butter eaters like them.

Wonderful flavors, especially when made with very thick cut cod   Enjoy some great fish dishes when we live in the Algarve (6 months of the year). A terra cotta dish is a good investment.  Have also had this, or similar, made with salt cod.
Wonderful concoction and the only change for us is to omit Italian parsley and use curly.  Thanks for a wonderful recipe.Also the fact that it keeps so long makes it even more desirable.
Finally a recipe that is really Irish Champ.    We always peeled the potatoes and also added some parsley. Thanks again for a great contribution.

Finally got around to making this bread (1/2 quantity). Always follow a recipe exactly as written before rating. Love lemon and cranberries but felt that it needed 1/2 cup butter rather than 1/3. Maybe we like a richer taste. Next time (and there definitely will be a next time) I will make this change. A suggestion re using lemon rind. You get a more potent lemon taste if the rind is grated into the sugar and rubber together with your fingers. Thanks for posting.P.S. with the changes mentioned above they are now better than our Tim Hortons (so agree with other reviewer!!!!)

Love the flavors.   Now that we have fresh rosemary growing on our deck this will be used often. Of course we can never have enough garlic.  The sitting time makes a difference - something I would never have thought to do before. Thanks again for a great contribution to my files.

This recipe just popped out at me because I was searching for something that I could make ahead for a vegetarian friend.  (Had to cook a different meal for everyone else).  This is great and has ingredients that most of us have in our cupboards.   Did add some chopped artichokes and black Olives because of taste preferences.  Thanks for a great contribution.
The best - cake flour is the answer.
I always have avoided buying eye of the round because it can be so dry.   This is an excellent cooking method: pink for me and darker for husband.
Yum says it all..........wonderful flavor and the lemon shines thru beautifully.   Sometimes roast chicken can have an oily taste but ths is sharp and clear.   Thanks.......

Have made this cake occasionally (only resort to a cake mix base if rushed) but do not use lemon extract because it is too artifical for us.   Prefer to add either lemon juice or lemon zest. Also, poppy seeds, as someone else suggeted, are a very good addition.

I have been making a similar recipe for a long time (avoiding the creamy type I always made before).  I add crushed garlic and chopped black olives, but this is because we love both. Thanks for putting this recipe here for others because it is very, very good and you can play around with it.

Exceptionally tasty casserole and a big plus being it can be frozen.   I omit the fennel because we do not like it and doubt if it deters from the final result.    Can see this being put in the freezer often for drop in company. Thanks because it will be very useful seeing we have out of town company coming and they are pasta lovers.

This is the absolute best Bavarian I have ever tasted......am sure it is thanks to the sour cream.    Many different toppings can be used to taste but you certainly can't go wrong. Thanks for such a wonderful addition to my dessert file.

I made these last night and we really enjoyed them. I served them with a scoop of vanilla ice cream but tonight I'll serve them with whipped cream and a dash of cinnamon.
Ask me how they are for breakfast!
I made these for Kittencal's cookathon 2008

Delicious!
I couldn't find the fiesta nacho cheese soup so I used another can of cheddar cheese soup and a little salsa.
I cooked it on low for 7 hours but the potatoes weren't quite done so I turned the crock pot to high for another hour which really did the trick.
I served this with roast beef-onion sandwiches for a hardy, hot dinner.

The meatballs were tender and had lots flavor. The sauce was very good but a little too sweet for us. Next time, I'll cut down on the sugar. This recipe makes a lot of sauce so I served it on rice but may try it next time over potatoes.
