I like this as it can all be prepared in advance so it's perfect for a school night or if you are entertaining.  Thanks for posting!!

Johnny invaded my kitchen again and I'm glad he did.  This was easy and tasty.  I used pinto beans and a three cheese mexican blend instead of cheddar because that's what I had on hand.  My favorite part was the crispy corn bread on the bottom of the pan.  Thanks for posting!!

Very good.  I used the celery, onion and carrot rack and it provided delicious flavors for the drippings.  My 3.5 lb bird wouldn't hold all of the orange/lemons however I had contaminated them while attempting to stuff the chicken so I had to throw them away :(  The wine sauce is an excellent accompaniment and really accents the chicken well.  I served this with Recipe #390354.

Good and easy recipe Kim.  I used Red Potatoes, skin on.  Time was right on with a 1000 watt microwave.  Depending on potato size and microwave power this will vary.  I sprinkled the potatoes with s/p and garlic powder before cooking.  I then added cream, butter and prepared horseradish.  Served as a side and used the gravy from Recipe #389781. YUM!!
Very good, served over egg noodles.  Made as directed except used beef broth instead of chicken.  I also used a full 8oz package of mushrooms.  This was easy and cheap to boot!!  Thanks for posting.

Excellent.  Had a bag of frozen diced baked ham in the freezer and didn't know what to do with it.  This was perfect.  I made it as directed also added some garlic powder....  Thanks for posting another winner Sarasota!!

I was out of "Blue Box" mac and cheese and was looking for a substitute.  JUST KIDDING!!!!!  I was actually looking for a decadent mac and cheese to share a spot on my plate with a beautiful grilled steak.  This fit the bill perfectly.  I followed the recipe exactly except I halved the recipe and added some garlic powder.  Was excellent!!  Thanks for posting Swedish Chef!!

Tasty, quick and inexpensive whats not to like?  Next time I will add some cilantro to the slaw and tomato mix. I couldn't find sticks or fillets so I used the Beer Battered Tenders.  Two was a perfect amount for a normal taco sized flour tortilla.  Thanks for posting!!

EXCELLENT.  I love greens and have a challenge figuring out how to cook them.  These were perfect and surprisingly crispy.  It is REALLY easy to over do the salt so go easy.  I omitted the sesame seeds as I don't like them and added extra garlic, was delish!!  Would be great as a healthy snack as well.  Thanks for posting.

Mmm! great, light cookies! They een crinkles at the top! I loved molasses so i had to try these, and i wasn't disappointed by the deep, rich flavour! I added 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon, 1/4 teaspoon cloves, and 1/8 teaspoon nutmeg to boost the spice. I wasnt disappointed! i only got 30 cookies, so the serving size definetly isn't correct. I put mine in for 15 minutes, but they were very crispy so i would put them in less next time. When i made these, i was at first alarmed as i mixed the dry into the wet that the cookies would be to dry. But once incorperated, i thought they were to sticky! I just wetted my fingers though, and the dough didn't stick to them. Thanks!

I'm enjoying a bowl of this right now! I made this with just under 1/2 cup water, and 3 tablespoons pumpkin, and after trying it once, I used a little less spice. I also sweetned this with real brown sugar (about 2 1/2 teaspoons). I will enjoy this again soon! The oatmeal measurements are also great for a basis of other oatmeals. Thanks!

I made this but in a bit of a smaller amount, and a little bit of ground flaxseed instead of the meal, as well as some honey for sweetness. I also altered the cooking to my own preferance. Very yummy! Very creamy. I Used milk instead of water.

Delicious! I made a couple of changes as follows: 1/3c. 1% milk, 2/3c. skim, canola oil instead of butter,  a 1/2 tbsp. less sugar, 1/2 fibre enhanced flour, a bit of cinnamon, and 1c. strawberries (thawed from freezer) + 1 c. bananas. The combination was fabulous and we enjoyed them so much. There were very thick, but I think that was from all the wonderful fruit. We will use this recipe again.

I made this recipe exactly as written with no deviations. This is a great recipe! I made Recipe #281399 as an appetizer and then served this delicious soup. It left us with that warm, satisfied feeling in the tummy you get when it's chilly out and you are tired and you just want to relax. I did remove my portion of the soup before I added the cilantro at the very end, as I detest it. However, I tasted hublet's portion and it was really good.

I made this recipe exactly as written with no deviations. What a wonderful treat this was! Fast, easy, smells tremendous and went great with my homemade Tzatziki which,  I always have in my fridge. This panini combines all of the fabulous Greek flavors that I adore. Thank you for a very satisfying meal!

I made this recipe exactly as written with no deviations. I made this over the weekend and it was fabulous! I love Mediterranean type foods and this one fit the bill. I served it with my homemade Tzatziki sauce and warm pita breads.

I made this recipe exactly as written with 1 deviation. I did not use walnuts, as I do not care for them in any form. WOW! This was so light and refreshing. I used leftover rotisserie chicken and happen to find the most gorgeous pencil thin asparagus at the grocery this week. This salad was light, refreshing, tasty and did not leave me feeling like I had to take a nap after eating it. Romaine lettuce really makes this salad and is my favorite lettuce. This one is going into my recipe rounder.

I made this recipe exactly as written with no deviations. First let me say that I should either be embarrassed or applauded because I had every single ingredient on hand except the molasses. I made this sauce 5 days in advance and stored it in the refrigerator to allow it to love itself. My friend adored this sauce, which is a bold statement, as she really dislikes BBQ sauces of any kind. I filled 4 requests for the recipe at my BBQ and my hublet requested that I keep a bottle in the fridge, as he is the self proclaimed "Condiment King". This sauce is a perfect blend of ingredients and I love the thickness of the sauce without it being overpowering. It now has a permanent home in my fridge door.

This fruit salad is so good and so refreshing! It's light and all the textural differences complement one another so very well. It is not overly sweet or gloppy with dressing. I did not have fresh grapes so I used canned fruit cocktail; drained really well. I used roasted almonds, fat free Activa yogurt and it was just delicious. It held up really well for the 3 days it was in the fridge while we consumed it- very little breakdown or condensation from the fruit. My husband loves this recipe as much as I do.

I made this recipe exactly as written with one deviation: I used the toaster oven instead of a crock pot. This was fabulous! Very rich and velvety in texture. Luscious chunks of crab and the toasted top was divine. I served this dip with sesame crackers, homemade sourdough baguette, cold carrots and red pepper strips.

I made this recipe exactly as written with no deviations. I made this for a friend who adores espresso in any form, but who is also picky about her flavor profiles. She loved this to no end and was sure to take the recipe with her. I, on the other hand, detest any sort of coffee flavor on planet earth. I did rim her cup with a mix of cocoa powder, bakers sugar and espresso. I made mine just as written except I omitted the espresso. I think this is a lovely and versatile hot cocoa! I did rim my cup with cocoa powder and bakers sugar.

I made this recipe exactly as written with no deviations. A friend and I made this recipe at her home. This is a very good scone recipe! It is was easy to prepare and as you can see from my photos, it has a flaky texture and we truly enjoyed the flavor.

We enjoyed these croquettes very much. I did find that wrapping the dough in plastic wrap and letting it set for 15 minutes, allowed the flour to soak up the water and egg. This made it much easier to shape into balls. I did roll the balls in Panko crumbs after dipping them in the egg white. It gave them a nice crispy texture on the outside. I served these with sweet chili sauce on the side.

This was very good! I loved the fresh taste and simplicity of this recipe. I served this salsa with corn tortilla chips and there was no salsa left even after the chips were gone! I ended up placing the rest of the salsa on my homemade baguettes which I first toasted in the oven. It was a refreshing crostini!

Yummy Yams! I wanted to use up only 1 sweet potato, so I used amounts for 1 1/2 servings. I tossed potatoes directly in the pot in which I melted the sugar (less clean-up). I also lined my baking dish with foil (also for clean-up). Popped this in my convection toaster-oven and it was ready in less than 30 minutes.  These truly are candied! Some of the pieces on the side were slightly crunchy and stuck to my teeth, like caramel :) Ate them right out of the pan. Thanks for another great recipe Kittencal!!!

Delicious! I made very few changes, I used vanilla yogurt & since that was sweetened, I lowered the sugar to 1/3 cup. I also added an extra 1/2 cup of cranberries and a handful of walnuts. They came out sooo moist, and are gorgeous with the powdered sugar on top!!! Thanks for sharing :)

Yummy! I did change the the marshmallow (4 cups):cereal (5 1/2 cups) ratio. I also omitted the white chocolate chips and added a handful raw cocoa nibs along with 4 Tbs of REAL maple syrup. I would like an even stronger maple flavour - so I may add some maple extract or sprinkle some maple sugar over top next time. I think adding more syrup might make them too sweet to my liking.

The only thing I can figure is that maybe it did not refrigerate as long as it should. I am not a yogurt fan but DH is. I put in fridge for 3 hours & I'm sorry but neither of us enjoyed the dressing. The yogurt was so dominate I didn't taste the other ingredients. Made for your Football week 16 win.
Wonderful!
Got my smoothie fix & it was fabulous. Love the combination! Made for Everyday's a Holiday. Probably be making more in the next few days. Big hit at our house. Thanks Sydney Mike

Made for Every day's a Holiday & for Super Bowl 2010. Party hasn't even started and we are eating this dip.Love it Diner24! Don't think there will be any left for our guests because it is hard to resist.
Ooey, Gooey chewy! Just the way I like them. I, like Marie in NYC, couldn't taste the Nutella but who cares? Made for Everyday is a Holiday. Thanks Boomette!

Have to tell you a story, DH asked what was for dinner & when I told him broccoli he balked & said yuk. Well, I made your recipe & he was begging for mine- loved it! So finally, I can fix broccoli without complaints from him. Thanks!
Made this tea this afternoon after work. Really hit the spot. Thank you Mikekey. Made for Everyday's a holiday tag game.
Tasty, Tasty Tasty! Made this last night for a quick dinner & it was delightful. Made for 2010 PAC.
Deb- this is so, so, so yummy!!!!!!! I made the entire recipe even though there are only two of us and DH inhaled them. Made for 2010 PAC
Very, Very tasty recipe. Made with red snapper & it was better than any restaurant fried fish I ever had. Thank you for posting!
Very easy, quick & quite tasty. Served with Spicy Chicken & it was perfect. Thinking of adding chicken to the mix next time I make it.
So easy & light & very flavorful. We really enjoyed this. I doubled the sauce(always do) & I am using the little bit that is left on pasta for lunch tomorrow. Thanks for posting, Scoutie!
What a wonderful treat this pie is. So incredibly easy too. Made for your 2010 Football pool win.

Don't believe I have ever made a cake that took so little time. Not only that but I always have the ingredients. Above all that,,,, it is absolutely divine. There are so many times I need to make something for a sick friend or new baby & have to waste time going to the store, This is ideal for that. Thank you so much for sharing ElaineAnn! Made for your Football Pool week 8 win.
Yummy recipe. Big hit at our house last night. Made for your Football Pool week 10 win.

Made this wonderful recipe for your Football Pool 2010 Wild Card win. Huge Hit & I do mean huge. DH asked when we could have it again. He's supposed to be dieting so it will be a long while if I can hold him off.

Definitely a tasty fix & forget dinner. I agree with Lavender Lynn no point paying for sirloin when a less expensive cut would be just as good. Served this to my sister & she had to have the recipe. Don't know what changes you made mama smurf, we enjoyed this very much
Big hit at Church's 50th anniversary. Tons of icing leftover.
Made for family this week & it was a huge hit!
We enjoyed this marinade. Made it on the George Foreman & it was great but think next time I will grill it slow which I think will be delicious.
Yum, Yum, Yum
Made Azparzych's Recipe #460835 for our tailgate. Loved by all! Easy to make, light & extremely good. Thanks for an excellent recipe. Made for your Football week 4 win.
We really enjoyed these muffins. Fixed them to accompany Brunswick Stew and they were just right! Thank you for sharing this recipe. Made for your Football Pool week 5 win.
We made this tasty treat for your Football Week 4 victory. Very enjoyable & easy. Wanted an easy snack for watching the games & this fit the bill. Again, Congrats Taz
Light, quick & perfect for my diet. Made for breezer's Football Week 9 win.
Hearty & very tasty! Made for breezermom's Football Week 10 win. Very quick to put together and DH said he likes it better than chili.

DH & I just got home after driving six hours in the pouring, freezing rain. Came in & I decided we needed to sit down, chill & try Diner's Recipe #329227. I'm a genius! it was so good and perfect just to help us relax those tense muscles. So glad you won & we got to try this recipe.
Wonderful coffee for a treat! I only treat myself to a few indulgences but this is going on that list. Made for your awesome Superbowl win!
Very flavorful soup, and nice texture! It was a great soup for Ramadan. Thanks!
Considering I pick my mangos fresh off the tree, this smoothie was DELICIOUS! :) Thanks Nasseh!

yummyyyyy! I love cinnamon drinks, and I never tried english tea before (I normally drink green tea), so this was a treat! I do have a sweet tooth, especially during Ramadan, so I did add just a hair more sugar, but other than that this was great! Thanks Um Safia!

Yummy, yummy, yummy! Made it to go along with out bbq and turned out great! I substituted a different kind of cheese for the feta, since I was sent fresh cheese from Palestine (hehe) and the salad turned out great!!
This is also a great way to prepare tea for little kids...excellent recipe!
very very refreshing!! I drank one as a midnight snack and it left me full and cooled off hehe! Made for Ramadan Tag! =)

I loveee roz el laban but it never seems to work for me but this came out great! I like cinnamon so I added a lil more and used rose water cuz thats what I had.  Me and my daughter at it all! Made for Ramadan Tag!

My husband has to have soup everyday during Ramadan so I like to try new recipes to mix it up a little bit, and this one was great! I love split pea soup but never thought add sweet potatoes.  Made for Ramadan Tag!
I was hoping to try the fresh flowers but did not have any so I found dried ones at the store, and it really gave the coffee a refreshing taste and smell! Made for Ramadan Tag.

I had to leave the hot sauce out because of bad heartburn :( other than that this was a great universal dip that I used with chicken kabobs! Made for Ramadan Tag.

I normally make boring smoothies with the usually ingredients and whatever fruits I have that I need to use up, but this recipe was different and I wasn't sure if I was going to like it, but I did! It's just the right amount of ingredients to where its not as sweet as usual, which is what I like. Great recipe!
Very refreshing, especially on a very hot day! Made for Ramadan Tag 2010!
simple, yet very enjoyable! made for Ramadan Tag 2010
This went great over my chicken salad, and I believe it would be great on some french bread in the oven as well! Made for Ramadan Tag 2010

My mother in law sends me something similar to this to dip in coffee or tea, but it is not sweetened at all.  With this one, I did not sweeten the coffee and it worked out great. Made for Ramadan Tag 2010

I prepared this for PAC Spring 2008.  I found it to be an excellent sauce that would rival any gourmet bbq sauce I have tasted.  It's has a robust flavor that is neither too sweet or too spicy.  Smokey undertones are present without being overpowering.  This sauce is a very nice consistency that will stay on the meats instead of dripping to the bottom of the grill.  Extremely easy to prepare with common kitchen ingredients makes this a winner in my book.
A wonderful recipe for "just two".  I prepared the night before and froze half.  2 1/3 cups of the final mixture if you're wondering.  I can't wait to try it with different meat and veggie combos.
I used this for grilled pork.  It was excellent.  Especially delightful because all ingredients are usually in the pantry.

This is fast, easy and inexpensive.  We loved the flavors but didn't care for the food processor blended texture.  If I make it again I will either blend until totally smooth or not at all.  The flavors mix well for a light treat.

This was a great recipe.  I just made the chicken and the sauce because I was having another pasta recipe as a side dish.  I had a roasted red pepper sauce like this at a restaurant with a puff pastry filled with mushrooms.  I will definately be making this sauce again.  I used 2% milk and the dish was still nice and rich.
My husband is in love with this sorbet. We left out the alcohol. The sorbet froze up quickly in the ice cream machine.
I really enjoyed this cocktail.  I added a little bit of lime juice as suggested in an earlier review.  Thanks for the great drink!

I just had a happy cooking accident!  I didn't check my oatmeal box before starting and it wasn't until I got to the end of the recipe that I discovered that I only had 1 1/4 cup oatmeal.  I went ahead and made the cookies and they turned out even thin and crispier and were still incredibly yummy!  They remind of the cookies that they use in the "It's It" ice cream sandwich so we are going to enjoy some of these with some vanilla ice cream.  Great flavor in these cookies.  I will make again with the correct amount of oatmeal. :)
Yummy and easy comfort food.  What more could you ask for!  I paired this with Recipe #181936.

I love basil, tomato, and mozzarella together so I knew this was going to be a treat.  I used sun-dried tomatoes that were not packed in oil so I subbed in a little bit of olive oil to sautee the onions.  The sun-dried tomato flavor was still strong enough in the end without the oil.
I just made myself this lovely adult "milkshake" and I must say it is quite tasty!  The taste reminds me of the marzipan candies in a box of See's chocolates.

I love flavor in the morning and this definately fits the bill.  What a nice treat to have and a great use of leftover sauce.  I made as is but will try more cheese next time as others have suggested.  Yum!

Really great drink once again!  I always seem to enjoy your drink recipes so much.  I agree with Sue L that these taste just like the coconut Brachs chews.  This one will be showing up on the summer drink rotation. :)  Thanks PAC mom. :)
Wow.  What great way to enhance the flavor of bacon!  We enjoyed this a lot and will defiantely be making bacon this way again.  Thanks PAC Mom! :)

I love baked stuffed tomatoes, one of my favorite lunch time summer dishes (along with a nice glass of white wine).  The stuffing was a little dry but the flavor was great so I would add a bit more olive oil.  My cheese also got really crunchy so I might reduce the heat a bit next time.  Thanks for posting.  I look forward to making some more of these when my tomatoes are growing out of control in a couple months! Made for the Saucy Senoritas ZWT 5.
This was easy to throw together and the meat cooked up great.  I would add more garlic next time and use some fresh squeezed juice and zest.  Thanks for posting.  Made for the Saucy Senoritas ZWT5.

These were great!  I brushed olive oil across each piece of bread, topped with a slice of brie, drizzled honey, and sprinkled chopped walnuts across the top.  I just popped them in the broiler for a minute on the lowest rack.  Had some sliced apples along with the "tapas".  Fantastic!!!  I actually ate these two nights in a row for dessert with a glass of white wine! Made for the Saucy Senoritas ZWT5.
These are fabulous!  Easy to throw together with stuff I usually have on hand!  Love it!  Had with some vanilla ice cream and chopped walnuts.  Made for ZWT5.
My husband really enjoyed this and asked that I make it again.  Easy way to kick up corn.  Thanks.  Made for ZWT5.
Wow!  This was great and so easy to put together.  I used a shortbread crust instead of chocolate.  Thanks for posting it!  Made for ZWT5.
Great coleslaw recipe.  Loved the sweetness and the slight tang combined with the bite of the onion.  I might toss in some raisins next time I make it!  Thanks for posting.  Made for ZWT5.

Another fantastic recipe Loof!  I have to admit that I did sub some fresh squeezed tangerine juice (I boiled it down so it would be more concentrated).  I have a pile of these amazing tangerines from a friend's tree that are making all these orange related dishes sing!  I doubled the sauce and reserved half for dipping.  This flavor combination is great.  I didn't even have a chance to get a picture as we were so excited to eat and now it is all gone.  My hubby has requested it as a repeat really soon.  Thanks Loof!!  Made for PRMR.

Made these exactly as written and they were wonderful.  Tender and full of so much flavor!  We had them with Recipe #54866 and had some of your peanut sauce on the side.  These will definately be showing up again this summer at our cookouts!  Made for ZWT6.
Great twist on a snack mix.  We used a Crispex cereal (half corn/half rice) and butter flavored pretzels.  I like how this mix is just slightly spicy so everyone can enjoy it.  Thanks for the treat!
These were quite nice.  The dill flavor was very subtle and the mix of sour and sweet works well.  Thanks for the light side dish.
Nice and easy dinner tonight.  Great robust flavors in the cheese and the dijon mustard.  We used rye bread and ham.  Made for ZWT6.
Nice refreshing beverage.  The pineapple flavor is really the star.  Made for ZWT6.

I agree with PaulaG.  Seems like this was missing something and nuts would have been a nice addition.  We also doubled the curry powder and will probably double the apples next time too.  Served it up on some open face tea sandwiches.  Made for ZWT6.

These were great.  We made little mini scones and served them up as appetizers with some garlic butter.    The sundried tomato flavor was very nice and the mix of herbs worked well together.  Our tomatoes were packed in oil with herbs so I cut back on the parsley and basil just a bit. Yummy!
These were great.  We made little mini scones and served them up as appetizers with some garlic butter.  Yummy!
Love my oatmeal nice and creamy and this was lovely.  Topped it with some maple syrup and a little brown sugar.  Yum!!

So this is a sweet salad (as the title does say!) and I love a sweet salad.  If you typically enjoy the sweetness of honey mustard and french dressings this is a salad for you.  I used Havarti cheese and threw together some balsamic dressing.  Great flavors.  I usually go for dried cranberries and sunflower seeds on my salad so this was a nice change of pace.  The combination of nuts, dried fruit, and sweet dressing is yummy!

My DH and I loved this salad.  The flavors worked great together and I also appreciated all the different textures.  Made exactly as stated.  I was a little hesitant serving a Moroccan dish to my husband but it was hands down his favorite dish of the day!  Yummy!  Will make this again soon.

What a great tasting simple side dish.  I made my noodles ahead of time and tossed them with the butter and caraway seeds.  When the rest of dinner was ready they reheated nicely.  DH went back for seconds and finished off the rest of the noodles.  Easy and yummy!
My DH loved this recipe.  I would double the mushrooms and the sauce ingredients next time.  We enjoyed this with buttered egg noodles.  A very filling and satisfying dish!

I order this soup a lot from my favorite Thai place so being able to make it at home myself is a real treat.  We always order our soup with tofu and that is what we opted to use instead of chicken.  I replaced the water content in the recipe with chicken broth and it worked great.  Fantastic overall flavor!

Little mini apple pies.  Just heavenly!  These were a lot of work but after I figured out how to work the dough the process went a lot quicker.  My apples took a long time to cook, the liquid seemed like it was never going to cook off.  I might try a slightly higher temp next time.  Just for personal flavor preferences I will also cut back a bit on the cloves.  Overall these were a great little treat and I will be making these again for company.
Loved this soup!  I used fettucine noodles and opted to use tofu instead of chicken.  I also used light coconut milk.  Warm and comforting.

I had the same experience as cookiedog.  Based on flavor these were a solid 5 but mine also turned out flat like a lace cookie.  The flavor reminded me of a cross between sesame stick candy (the honey influence) and a nut brittle (they were very buttery).  I don't think I ground my nuts up fine enough and I also ended up putting my dough in the fridge for quite awhile to harden up.  I also used a silicon baking mat so I think that contributed to the cookies spreading out so much.  I ended up trimming all the cookies into squares when they were still warm and will use them to make ice cream sandwiches.  My teenager enjoyed eating all the trim pieces and he is a totally picky eater!

So I found a new way to use up my tomatoes and zucchini from the garden!  Yummy!  I used ground turkey instead of pork and kept my seasoning simple, just some garlic, basil, salt and pepper.  These were easy to throw together and super tasty.  This will be my go to lunch this summer when I am home alone . . . with a nice glass of white wine to wash it down!

My DH and I are not vegans but we do eat mostly chicken and tofu so I thought trying a recipe with TVP might be another alternative we could add into our diet.  We were pleasantly surprised by the flavor of this meal.  I followed the recipe exactly and added quite a bit of salt, pepper, and Braggs to the sauce at the end. The "meatballs" seemed a bit soft but the flavor was great.  I don't know if this was my fault or if the TVP/bread crumb combo just creates that soft texture.  That was my DH's only negative comment.  He even asked for a slice of bread to sop up all his left over sauce.  Thanks for taking me on a new culinary experience!

This is a fantastic dessert!  My hubby asked to have it for dessert three nights in a row, good thing it is just the two of us although I am surprised it lasted three days (I thought for sure DH would sneak in and eat it when I wasn't looking).  I am going to try this again with almond extract and peaches.  I imagine it would also be really good with the chocolate whipped topping they sell around the holidays, maybe with cherries????  So glad I found this light and versatile recipe!  We will make this often I am sure.
These made for a great meal.  We served ours over rice.  DH even went back for seconds.  We mixed the extra gravy and rice together to have as a yummy leftover.

My husband called to say he was bringing home some fresh caught cod, so I immediately went to the Zaar for help. This recipe sounded great and I used the Pepperidge Farm's butter crackers as suggested.
This has become my favorite recipe thus far for fish. My daughter who normally turns her nose up at fish tried it and loved it. The flavors really compliment the fish! I even managed to get some photos before it was devoured! LOL! Thanks Katel!

I too made this as part of the "Dining On A $ contest. I added more spaghetti sauce and cheese and I used it as a side dish to orange roughy. I also omitted the pepperoni as DH can't handle the spice. It was certainly a supper easy dish! Thanks for posting!

WOW! These were fantastic and super easy too! My DH who dislikes asparagus loved the recipe. He ate a second helping. All I could get was fat asparagus, so I cut them in half length wise and it worked out good. I didn't use the pepper flakes or the black pepper. This was made for the Kittencal Cook-A-Thon. Thanks for posting!!!

I love the cinnamon vanilla flavor in this creamy coffee. This is a coffee I could drink every day. It would be a special treat with a little whip cream topping it off. Thanks for posting! This recipe was tagged in the Comfort Cafe's Jan. 2009 tag game.

I give this a 5-Star WOW FACTOR!

Great tasty wrap! I added some chopped apple instead of the cucumber and some sweet chili sauce. I also used 2 tablespoons of hummus and pre-cooked chicken from leftovers. This was a quick meal I put together after I got home from bowling. Thanks for posting! This recipe was made for "Potluck Tag (January) - Bring a Friend Event!!!"

Great tasting hot cocoa especially with the dash of cayenne pepper which gives it a new level of sophistication. In addition I added both chocolate and regular whip cream. Thanks for posting.

We were most impressed with this panini! We used Vermont smoked cheddar, virginia baked ham, teaspoon yellow mustard, an Italian roll and granny smith apples. This is a great sandwich! This recipe was made for the Potluck Tag (January) - Bring a Friend Event!!!

This was very good even without the dried onion flakes. To compensate for not having them, I used sauteed onions. Thanks for posting. Made for Feb. 2009 Potluck tag.

Delicious creamy peanut butter lovers delight! I omitted the green onions only as I didn't have any.

My first thought when I looked in the microwave after the timer went off was YIKES! Half of the mug cake bubbled out of the mug, all over the mug and inside of the microwave. What a mess! This is a 10-Star coffee treat! I took Boomette's advice and reduced the brown sugar down to 2-teaspoons worth. I figured if it wasn't sweet enough I could always add more brown sugar, but it was perfect.
Thanks for posting! Made for Spring 2009 Potluck tag. :D

I used whole wheat rolls as my super market did not have ciabatta rolls. I also left the spinach out by accident and added vadalia onions. Sandwiches were moist, delicious comfort food. Made for Photo Tag.

This coffee cake recipe is to die for!
It is a moist, light and tasty recipe. My DD made this as a special treat to celebrate the completion and submission of her college term paper. She cut the sugar to 1/2 cup and used brown sugar Splenda blend for the streusel topping. Yum! Thanks for posting.
Boomette is right, about this drink being very refreshing! I used white rum as that was what I had on hand. Made for photo tag Spring 2009.

Totally Awesome! Great crunch to the coating and deliciously tender inside. I fried them in batches of 3-4 and then placed them in a 300 degree F oven to keep hot while I cooked 2-pkgs of chicken tenders. Thanks for posting! Made for Spring 2009 Potluck tag.

Superb! I would recommend cooking the potatoes and cooling them down in advance. I used one mutant sized vadalia onion as we love out onions.

I loved this cool refreshing coffee drink! I like Irish Rose couldn't find the Torani Irish Creme syrup, so I used sugar free non-dairy Irish creamer. Made for Photo tag 2009.

Very moist juicy chicken breast! Sometime when cooked, boneless chicken breasts come out too dry but these were perfectly prepared by my DD and the flavor was excellent. Thanks for posting!
Made for Hot, Spicy & Tasty Event.

This is a tasty new rendition of an old favorite. I used Jack Daniel's Honey Smokehouse BBQ sauce for a sweet and savory lunch time treat.
Thanks for posting Babycat!

My daughter just loved this recipe!
After doing a test run she decided that she would serve it as an after dinner dessert for her friends from college!

Great tasting super easy kabob entree! My DD and I used powdered ginger instead of fresh but that was the only change in the recipe.
Made for the 2009 New Kids On The Block  tag game.

I too didn't use the whip cream as I only had cool whip in the house and I didn't think it would look that good in the photo. Based on Boomette's review I reduced the amount of maple syrup to 3-tablespoons and it was perfect. Made for Sunner '09 Comfort Cafe tag game.
WOW! Great flavor on this one. I tripled the recipe and I too skipped the chocolate shavings. Made for the Summer 2009 Comfort Cafe.
Excellent combination of ingredients. I also liked how I didn't have to saute the shallot first. Made for New Kids On The Block tag.
Annacia has done it again! Great coffee drink! Nice and creamy! I used chocolate chip ice cream and it was just heavenly. Made for summer Comfort Cafe 2009.

This drink is so good! I added a tablespoon of chocolate malted milk powder as someone had used up all of my cocoa powder without telling me. Hmmm? I wonder who that was?  Made for the Summer 2009 Comfort Cafe.

This is a very good salad and a tasty dressing to boot! I plan on trying it without the wild rice which I know was a required ingredient, but wild rice is just not for me. I do like a mixture of wild rice and brown rice which I think would make for a better tasting. Also in my survey, I mentioned I thought the walnuts should be toasted, which I didn't notice was a suggestion in directions.

This is an updated review after the posting Chef made corrections to the recipe: I made this again last night and I think it was 100% better than the original. This time the lemon juice enhanced the minty flavor instead of overpowering it. Made for New Kids on the Block tag.

This was quick, easy and delicious just as stated by the posting chef!
I served it with a wild rice mixture and duck and even my non-veggy eating DH liked it, so it will be a repeater! Thanks for posting. Made for Summer 2009 Photo Tag.

This drink was excellent! I used Carnation Instant Breakfast for the dry milk powder and low fat Hershey's chocolate syrup. I didn't notice that the recipe served two (hee hee) and had to make the supreme sacrifice and drink both servings. Made for Summer Comfort Cafe '09.

Excellent! Its amazing how just two tablespoons of sherry can affect the whole cup of mushrooms in such a positive way. I used cream sherry which game the mushrooms a sweet and savory taste which we couldn't get enough of. Thanks for posting.
Made for the New Kids On the Block tag game.
My DH and I thought these were very tasty! I added 1 tablespoon of some Riesling wine too. Thanks for posting such a easy and flavorful recipe. Made for Potluck Tag 2009.
This was totally sinful! I had it as a late afternoon snack. I halved the white chocolate liqueur and it was still outstanding! Made for Summer 2009 Comfort Cafe.

BK its a Winner! Darn, Annacia reviewed it before me, LOL!
I used a tablespoon of marshmallow fluff instead of the mini marshmallows. I will be making this again real soon! Chocolate and orange are flavors that go perfect together! I also divided it in half for one serving. Thanks for posting. Yummy! Made for Summer 2009 Comfort Cafe.

I made this with a mixed wild mushroom blend, used light cream and doubled the sauce. For our taste I should have reduced the parmesan to 1 tablespoon or sprinkled it on at the table side. Next time I make it, I'll just skip the pasta. Made for Potluck Tag.

What a glorious recipe! I cut it back to one serving plus I cut the sugar back to 1 tablespoon as the combo of the Hershey's Low Fat chocolate syrup and caramel are sweet already. Thank you Diner for such a delectable drink. I love caramel in coffee and with the chocolate it amazing. I used Hershey's chocolate low fat syrup as you have to cut down somewhere! LOL! Made for the Summer Comfort Cafe 2009.

Fantastic coffee beverage! I scaled  this down to one tall drink and I used low fat Hershey's chocolate syrup and low fat vanilla ice cream as well and DeCaf coffee. Made for the Summer Comfort Cafe 2009.

This is a 10 star recipe however, I can only give it a 5. I only used raspberries, blackberries, blueberries as I couldn't find black currants. After cooking the fruit on the stove I let it cool to the point where I could touch it without getting burned. I also used blueberry herbal tea and since I didn't have a cheesecloth I used a Bounty paper towel in combination with the sieve which I have used before as a filter. After a lot of the liquid passed through to the bowl, I then squeezed the paper towel with my hands and was able to remove more juice. Delicious and so worth the extra work. Made for the Veggie Swap Lucky 13.

Delicious! I followed the recipe to a tee except, I took some of the riesling white wine, butter and parmesan cheese and made a nice sauce to drizzle on top and enhance the other flavors, as we love our sauces. Made for Potluck tag.
Wow! What a clever idea! I used instant chocolate pudding mix as that was what I had on hand and skim milk. Made for Veggie tag.

Very refreshing beverage, although I cut down the sugar to 1-tablespoon as I felt since I don't drink my tea sweetened normally it would be way too sweet. I also didn't have any fresh oranges so my photo when posted is missing the garnish. Made as a "Bonus" for Veggie 'n Swap tag 9/09.

I used cranberry raspberry juice and it was delicious! My DD and I shared it and both agreed it was spot on tasty. We have tried a lot of smoothies and this is one of the best. Made for Veggie Swap #14 9/09.

I actually loved this healthy beverage although my DD & DH felt it needed something more to sweeten it. I felt the banana made it sweet enough as it was very ripe.
Thanks for posting! Made for "Veg*n Swap 15 ~ Oct 2009!
Kittencal has done it again! I used strawberry ice cream and white chocolate pudding mix. Sinful! Made for "Think Pink - Going Strong thru October."

When I first looked at this recipe I thought it called for pork tenderloins, so that was what I bought, however when I began to make it tonight I realized it was for chops. So I sliced the tenderloins into about 12 one 1.5" thick chops. The recipe doesn't call for peeling the apples so I didn't, but both DH and DD both thought the thinly sliced apple skin didn't enhance the dish as they got stuck in their teeth. I also quartered the pecans so DH and DD could pick them out easily. I also served the chops with the apple pecan mixture on top. All and all I thought it was a great Fall dish and I will be making it again. Made for Fall Photo tag.

Delicious creamy chowder! DH and I thoroughly enjoyed this recipe for lunch today, although I only used shrimp in it as crab meat is so expensive. So easy to make too!
Made for "TYM - Theirs Yours & Mine photo tag game (October 09)."

Everything is better with cheese! Although I actually love cauliflower without any embellishments. This is a very good and easy side that is sure to please the most finicky vegetable eater. Made for the Veggie Swap #15.
Excellent refreshing beverage! I did make one modification since I used a cran-raspberry juice blend. This has become my new favorite fruit juice drink. Made for Veg N Swap #16 tag.
WOW! Delicious little bites of heavenly cheesy goodness! Thanks for posting! Made for Potluck tag.

We loved this recipe too! I pulverized the almonds in order to hide the fact that they were an ingredient coating this fish. Delicious garlic enhanced asparagus!
DD and I thoroughly enjoyed this super easy and tasty side. Made for Veg 'N Swap #16 tag.

First rate delicious coffee beverage!
So decadent and satisfying! Made for Veg 'N Swap 2009 Recipenap.
Deliciously moist and tender healthy chicken fingers. Loved the ease of not having to deep fry them. Made for Partying The Diabetic Way 2009.

Very tasty peanut butter cake! I made a layer cake out of it. I used the peanut butter icing for the middle layer and covered the rest of the cake with dark chocolate frosting. Delicious hearty vegetarian soup! I blended in the blender which it very silky and smooth. I did not use the fresh coriander as I don't care for it.

Delicious flavor combo! I did added a teaspoon of sugar to give it a little more sweetness. Made for Made for Veg-n-Swap #17 tag.

Wow! Delicious vegetarian hot chocolate beverage. These were delicious morsels! The flavor of the glaze enhanced the sweet potato flavor. I opted not to peel the sweet potato as the skin has good nutrients. I also used stone ground mustard as I didn't have any Dijon as I'm not a fan of its taste.

Yummy! Loved this treat! My DD and I shared it as a dessert after dinner tonight. I left off the whip cream only because someone had used it up without my knowledge. Made for the 2010 Winter Comfort Cafe.

Quick, easy and delicious! I used baby portabellas and freeze dried chives.

Delicious creamy chicken pasta dish!

Delicious flavorful salmon dish! Orange, soy and salmon go perfect together, and it was such an easy dish.

I enjoyed these very much! However my DH was complaining that they should be stuffed with crab. He did come around after tasting them and suggested I give them 5-stars. I also left the red pepper flakes out. Made for Veg 'N Swap tag.
MMMMMMMMM! Delicious! I will be making this again often! I made it with 1% milk. Made for Potluck tag 2010.
Yum! We actually made two servings for lunch today. It was refreshing,  filling and healthy treat. The banana helped to thickened it. Made for Potluck 2010 tag.

WOW! So thick and delicious! I used left over coffee from my morning brew which was almond biscotti flavored coffee. Simply yummy! Made for the Cook-a-thon Memorial for Sharon's DH.

Delicious savory soup. I cheated and used canned pumpkin. I also didn't puree the soup which gave the soup some texture from the onions and celery. Very hearty vegetarian delight. Made for Veg N Swap #32.

This is a great idea! Love the how easy it is to make! And its a wonderful creamy texture and delicious flavor! I might try making it with almond extract too. Thanks for sharing! Made for Veg "N Swap tag!
The whole family actually ate this bean recipe! I used frozen Italian green beans and a mixture of red, orange and yellow bell peppers! Will make again! Made for Honor Thy Mother Diabetic tag!

Thanks for posting this recipe Rita~ !! As I bought a bulk bag of couscous at an Amish market that came with no directions! So as soon as I saw this recipe in the Veg 'N Swap I knew I had to tag it! Such an easy and refreshing beverage for a hot and humid summer day! Thanks for posting such a great idea! Made for Veg 'N Swap tag 37!
This is a wonderful summer beverage! I used sparkling water with ice cold seedless watermelon and it was superb! Made for Veg 'N Swap tag 37.

Great tasting meatloaf!! We loved the glaze too. However with the pie plate there was no place for the juices to run off, so it was a bit soggy. Also the timing was off, I think because the zucchini was too wet.

I used homemade vegetable stock and the soup was yummy! Loved the garlic, although my DH wouldn't touch it since it was green. So I had it for several days. Next time, I plan on making half.

I used asparagus beans which are mutant sized pole beans that can grow as long as 24 inches. I cut them in off the vine when they are about 12 inches in length, and then I cut them into 1 inch segments. This recipe had a tad too much ginger for me, but it was still very good.

I used run of the mill New Jersey cukes and sliced them paper thin with a potato peeler! I also used white wine vinegar instead of the plain white vinegar and omitted the chili flakes. WOW! Ann you have out done yourself with these tasty treats! Who knew raw broccoli would be great? My DH and I had these tasty treats for our anniversary lunch. Made or the Tailgate Party in the Diabetic Forum.

Great idea! I used a whole wheat pita mini and opted not to cut them in half. I used jarred pasta sauce along with the rest of the ingredients suggested. It made for a quick and easy lunch. Made for Veg 'N Swap tag.

What a unique way to make quick bread. I would not have thought of this in a million years! The bread was very moist and delicious! And I made it for the New Years Eve 2012 feast. Made for Let's Party 2011 tag.

Delicious combo of ingredients. I used French vanilla tea which is what I had on hand. It will be interesting to compare as to whether or not the French vanilla tea altered the taste significantly.

Excellent! I used vanilla yogurt and a combo raspberries and blueberries. Loved the color! Will making this again. Can't wait until the summer when my fresh garden crop of strawberries comes in. I loved the flavor, but than again one of my all time favorite herbs is thyme! Will be making this recipe often especially in the summer when my fresh green beans from my garden will be plentiful. Made for Veg 'N Swap tag 2-2012.

An amazingly tasty way to cook broccoli. I cheated and used frozen flowerets as the fresh didn't look to good at the market. I will be making this again with fresh broccoli from my garden.

Yummy to say the least! I had this for breakfast today and it is so good! Thanks for sharing! Made for Veg 'N Swap tag. :)
